title: 危险的秘密
titleEn: Dangerous Secrets: The Story of Iduna and Agnarr
blurb: F1 前传：伊杜娜与阿格纳从敌对两侧到相守一生的秘密往事。

paras.en: THE STORM IS GETTING WORSE.
paras.zh: 风暴越来越猛烈了。

paras.en: Lightning slashes across an angry black sky, soon followed by the crash of thunder.
paras.zh: 闪电划破愤怒的黑色天空，紧接着便是雷声的轰鸣。

paras.en: Waves pound against the ship’s hull as I grip the wooden rail with white knuckles.
paras.zh: 海浪重重拍击着船身，我双手死死攥着木栏杆，指节都捏得发白。

paras.en: Fierce gusts of wind tug my hair free from its braid, and damp brown strands whip at my face.
paras.zh: 一阵狂风把我的发辫吹散，湿漉漉的褐色发丝抽到我的脸上。

paras.en: I don’t dare let go to brush them away.
paras.zh: 我不敢松手把它们拨开。

paras.en: Instead, I keep my eyes on the sea.
paras.zh: 我只是死死盯着海面。

paras.en: Looking for her In some ways, I’ve spent my entire life looking for her.
paras.zh: 寻找着她。从某种意义上说，我这一生都在寻找她。

paras.en: And tonight, my journey may finally come to an end.
paras.zh: 而今晚，我的旅程或许终于要画上句点了。

paras.en: Unfinished.
paras.zh: 未竟。

paras.en: Unfound.
paras.zh: 未寻。

paras.en: Ahtohallan.
paras.zh: 阿图哈兰。

paras.en: Please!
paras.zh: 求求你！

paras.en: I need you!
paras.zh: 我需要你！

paras.en: Perhaps she never existed at all.
paras.zh: 也许她根本就不存在。

paras.en: Perhaps she was simply a myth.
paras.zh: 也许她只是一个传说。

paras.en: A silly song to lull children to sleep.
paras.zh: 一支哄孩子入睡的傻气歌谣。

paras.en: To make them feel safe and secure in a world that’s anything but.
paras.zh: 好让他们在这个一点也不安全的世界里，感到安稳无虞。

paras.en: Perhaps I was a fool to think we could simply go and seek her out.
paras.zh: 也许我真是傻，竟以为我们能就这么去找她。

paras.en: Learn the mother’s secrets.
paras.zh: 去探明那位母亲的秘密。

paras.en: I do know something about a mother’s secrets.
paras.zh: 关于母亲的秘密，我确实知道一些。

paras.en: Another wave sweeps in, bashing against the ship’s hull, sending a spray of icy seawater splashing at my face.
paras.zh: 又一道海浪涌来，猛撞在船身上，冰冷的海水溅了我一脸。

paras.en: I stumble backward, momentarily blinded by the salt stinging my eyes.
paras.zh: 我踉跄后退，咸涩的海水刺痛双眼，一时什么也看不见。

paras.en: A I turn, already knowing whom I’ll find standing tall behind me.
paras.zh: 我转过身，早已知道身后站着的是谁。

paras.en: The man who has been with me almost my entire life.
paras.zh: 那个几乎陪伴了我整生的男人。

paras.en: The man who has made me laugh—and cry—more than anyone else in the world.
paras.zh: 那个比世上任何人都更让我又笑又哭的男人。

paras.en: My husband.
paras.zh: 我的丈夫。

paras.en: The father of my daughters.
paras.zh: 我女儿们的父亲。

paras.en: My enemy.
paras.zh: 我的敌人。

paras.en: My friend.
paras.zh: 我的朋友。

paras.en: My love.
paras.zh: 我的挚爱。

paras.en: Agnarr, king of Arendelle. “Come, Iduna,” he says, pulling me around to face him.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔的国王，安格瑞。“来，伊杜娜，”他说着，把我转过来面对他。

paras.en: He reaches out, clasping my hands in his.
paras.zh: 他伸出手，把我的双手握进他的掌心。

paras.en: They are as warm and strong as mine are cold and trembling.
paras.zh: 他的手温暖而有力，正像我的手冰冷而颤抖。

paras.en: I look up, taking in the sharp line of his jaw.
paras.zh: 我抬起头，端详着他棱角分明的下颌。

paras.en: The fierceness in his leaf-green eyes.
paras.zh: 还有他那双叶绿色眼睛里的锐利光芒。

paras.en: If he’s frightened, he’s not showing it. “We need to go below deck,” he says, shouting to be heard over the furious wind. “Captain’s orders.
paras.zh: 就算他害怕，也丝毫没有流露。“我们得下到甲板下面去，”他喊道，好让声音盖过狂怒的风。“船长下的命令。

paras.en: It’s not safe up here.
paras.zh: 这儿不安全。

paras.en: One rogue wave could knock you overboard.” I feel a sob rise to my throat.
paras.zh: 一个突如其来的浪头就能把你卷下海。”我感到一阵哽咽涌上喉咙。

paras.en: I want to lash out, protest the orders.
paras.zh: 我想发作，想抗议这道命令。

paras.en: I’m fine.
paras.zh: 我没事。

paras.en: I can take care of myself.
paras.zh: 我能照顾好自己。

paras.en: I’m not some silly girl frightened by the elements.
paras.zh: 我可不是被风雨吓坏的小姑娘。

paras.en: But what I really want to say is, I can’t leave.
paras.zh: 可我真正想说的是：我不能走。

paras.en: I haven’t found her yet.
paras.zh: 我还没有找到她。

paras.en: If I go below, I may never find her.
paras.zh: 要是我下去了，也许就永远找不到她了。

paras.en: And if I don’t… Elsa.
paras.zh: 而如果我找不到……艾莎。

paras.en: My sweet Elsa…My dear Anna… Agnarr gives me a pointed look.
paras.zh: 我甜美的艾莎……我亲爱的安娜……安格瑞朝我投来意味深长的一瞥。

paras.en: I sigh, untangling my hands from his, and begin stumbling toward the stairs that lead to our cabin below, on legs unaccustomed to rough seas.
paras.zh: 我叹了口气，把手从他手里抽出来，迈着不习惯颠簸海路的双腿，踉跄地朝通向下方船舱的楼梯走去。

paras.en: I’m almost there when the ship suddenly pitches hard to the left and I lose my footing, grabbing on to the railing to save myself.
paras.zh: 眼看就要到了，船却猛地向左一倾，我脚下一滑，赶紧抓住栏杆才没摔倒。

paras.en: I can feel a few of the crew watching me with concern, but I push forward, keeping my head held high.
paras.zh: 我感到几个船员担忧地望着我，可我还是昂着头，继续往前走。

paras.en: I am a queen, after all.
paras.zh: 毕竟，我是一位王后。

paras.en: There are certain expectations.
paras.zh: 总有些该有的样子。

paras.en: Once below, I push open our cabin door and move inside, letting it bang shut behind me.
paras.zh: 一进下层，我推开我们船舱的门走了进去，门在身后砰地关上。

paras.en: The captain has given us his cabin for the journey, which I insisted wasn’t necessary, but I was overruled.
paras.zh: 船长把他的舱房让给了我们这趟旅程用，我坚持说没必要，却被否决了。

paras.en: It’s the only cabin suited for a fine lady, But now, at last, Agnarr knows the truth.
paras.zh: 这是唯一配得上一位贵妇的舱房。不过现在，安格瑞终于知道了真相。

paras.en: I ease myself down on the bed, reaching to grab my knitting needles and my half-finished project.
paras.zh: 我在床上慢慢坐下，伸手拿过织针和我那件织了一半的东西。

paras.en: An inappropriate task under the circumstances, but perhaps the only thing that might steady my hands—my pounding heart.
paras.zh: 这种情形下做这活儿实在不合时宜，但也许只有它能让我的手——还有我狂跳的心——安定下来。

paras.en: I can hear Agnarr push open the door, his strong, solid presence filling the room.
paras.zh: 我听见安格瑞推开门，他那结实而沉稳的存在感瞬间充满了整个房间。

paras.en: But I don’t look up.
paras.zh: 可我没有抬头。

paras.en: Instead, I start to knit as the ship rocks beneath my feet.
paras.zh: 我只是随着脚下船身的摇晃，开始织起来。

paras.en: It’s dark down below, too dark to really see the delicate yarn, but my hands are sure and true, the repetitive motions as natural and familiar to me as taking in air.
paras.zh: 下层很暗，暗得看不清细软的毛线，可我的手又稳又准，那一下下的重复动作就像呼吸一样自然熟稔。

paras.en: Yelana would be proud.
paras.zh: 耶拉娜准会为我骄傲。

paras.en: Yelana.
paras.zh: 耶拉娜。

paras.en: Only Ahtohallan knows.
paras.zh: 只有阿图哈兰知道。

paras.en: Suddenly, I want to throw my needles across the room.
paras.zh: 忽然间，我想把织针扔到房间那头去。

paras.en: Or collapse on the bed in tears.
paras.zh: 或是瘫在床上哭一场。

paras.en: But I do neither, keeping my attention on the unfinished shawl.
paras.zh: 可这两样我都没做，只是把注意力留在那件没织完的披肩上。

paras.en: Forcing myself to let each stitch lull me into something resembling comfort.
paras.zh: 逼着自己在每一针里，寻得一点近似安慰的平静。

paras.en: Agnarr pulls out a wooden stool from the captain’s desk, sitting down across from me.
paras.zh: 安格瑞从船长书桌下拖出一张木凳，在我对面坐下。

paras.en: He picks up a corner of the unfinished shawl, running his large fingers across the tiny stitches.
paras.zh: 他拈起没织完的披肩一角，用宽大的手指抚过细密的针脚。

paras.en: I dare to sneak a peek at him, realizing his eyes have become soft and faraway. “This is the same pattern,” he says slowly.
paras.zh: 我偷偷抬眼瞧他，发现他的目光变得柔和而悠远。“是同样的花样，”他缓缓说道。

paras.en: And I know what he means without asking.
paras.zh: 不用问我也懂他的意思。

paras.en: Because of course it is.
paras.zh: 因为这当然就是。

paras.en: I hadn’t even realized it when I started, but of course it is.
paras.zh: 我开始织的时候甚至没意识到，可它确实就是。

paras.en: The same pattern as the shawl my mother knitted me when I was a baby.
paras.zh: 和我出生时母亲为我织的那件披肩，是同样的花样。

paras.en: The shawl that saved his life. “It’s an old Northuldra pattern,” I explain, surprised how easily the words leave my mouth now that the truth is known. “Belonging to my family.” I pick up his hand and place it on each symbol in turn. “Earth, fire, water, wind.” I pause on the wind symbol, thinking back to Gale. “It was the Wind Spirit who helped me save your life that day in the forest.” He gives a low whistle. “A wind spirit!
paras.zh: 那件救了他性命的披肩。“这是很古老的北地人花样，”我解释道，奇怪真相大白后，这些话竟能如此轻易地说出口。“是我们家族的。”我拿起他的手，让他依次摸过每一个符号。“土、火、水、风。”我在风的符号上停了停，想起盖尔。“那天在森林里，是风灵帮我救了你的命。”他低低吹了声口哨。“风灵！

paras.en: If only I’d known,” he says, reaching up to brush his thumb gently across my cheek.
paras.zh: 要是我早知道就好了，”他说着，抬起手用拇指轻轻抚过我的脸颊。

paras.en: Even after all these years, his touch still sparks a longing ache deep inside, and it’s an imperative, not an option, to drop my needles to return the gesture.
paras.zh: 这么多年过去了，他的触碰依然在我心底激起一阵渴望的酸楚，于是我放下织针去回应他——这不是选择，而是无法抗拒的本能。

paras.en: To run my fingers against the light stubble of his jaw. “It would have made my stories to the girls so much more interesting.” I smile at this.
paras.zh: 用指尖蹭过他下颌淡淡的胡茬。“那样我讲给女儿们听的故事，可就有意思多了。”听这话，我笑了。

paras.en: I can’t help it.
paras.zh: 我忍不住。

paras.en: He has always found a way to help me find sunshine amidst the gloomiest of days.
paras.zh: 他总能在最阴郁的日子里，替我寻到一线阳光。

paras.en: It’s strange, though, to realize he knows everything now.
paras.zh: 不过，想到他现在已经什么都知道，还真有点怪。

paras.en: After a lifetime overshadowed with secrets, it should feel freeing.
paras.zh: 在秘密的阴影下活了一辈子，这本该让人感到自由。

paras.en: But in truth, it still scares me a little, and I find myself glancing at him when he doesn’t know I’m looking.
paras.zh: 可说真的，它还是让我有点害怕，于是我会在他没察觉时，偷偷打量他。

paras.en: Trying to see, trying to know whether the truth has changed his feelings toward me.
paras.zh: 想看看，想知道真相是否改变了他对我的感情。

paras.en: Does he resent me for keeping so much from him for so long?
paras.zh: 他会不会怨恨我，瞒了他这么久这么多？

paras.en: Or does he truly understand why I did it?
paras.zh: 还是说他真的理解我这么做的原因？

paras.en: If we survive this night, how will things change between us?
paras.zh: 要是我们能熬过这一夜，我们之间又会变成什么样？

paras.en: Will the truth bring us closer together?
paras.zh: 真相会让我们更亲近吗？

paras.en: Or tear us apart?
paras.zh: 还是会把我们拆散？

paras.en: Only Ahtohallan knows….
paras.zh: 只有阿图哈兰知道……

paras.en: I reach out and take Agnarr’s hands in mine, meeting his deep green eyes with my blue ones.
paras.zh: 我伸出手，把安格瑞的双手握在掌心，用我蓝色的眼睛迎上他深绿的目光。

paras.en: I swallow down the lump in my throat that threatens to choke me, and force another smile. “I will never forget that day,” I start with a whisper, not sure he can even hear me over the tempest outside. “That horrible, wonderful day.” “Tell me,” he whispers back, leaning in close.
paras.zh: 我把堵在喉咙、几乎要让我窒息的硬块咽下去，勉强又挤出一丝笑。“我永远忘不了那一天，”我低声开了口，不确定在这外面的狂风里他能否听见。“那个可怕又美好的一天。”“告诉我，”他也凑近低语回应。

paras.en: I can feel his breath on my lips.
paras.zh: 我能感觉到他的气息拂过我的唇。

paras.en: Our faces are inches away. “Tell me everything.” I swallow all the words that threaten to jump out of my throat in a hurried rush, throwing myself back on the bed, staring up at the wooden-beamed ceiling.
paras.zh: 我们的脸只有几寸之遥。“把一切都告诉我。”我把所有急着想冲出喉咙的话都咽了回去，整个人向后倒在床上，盯着木梁的天花板。

paras.en: After I breathe calmly, I say, “That might take all night.” He crawls onto the bed, lying down next to me.
paras.zh: 等呼吸平稳下来，我说：“那恐怕得讲上一整夜。”他在床上爬过来，在我身边躺下。

paras.en: He reaches out and curls his hand into mine. “For you, I’ve got forever.” I swallow hard, tears welling in my eyes.
paras.zh: 他伸出手，把我的手握进他的掌心。“为了你，我有永远的时间。”我用力咽了下，眼泪在眼眶里打转。

paras.en: I want to protest: we don’t have forever.
paras.zh: 我想反驳：我们并没有永远。

paras.en: Or even all night.
paras.zh: 甚至连一整夜都没有。

paras.en: We may not have an hour, judging from the way the wooden beams of the ship are I swipe the tears away, rolling to my side and propping my head up with my elbow. “You have to tell your part, too,” I say. “This story isn’t only mine, you know.” His arm curls around my waist, his hand settling at the small of my back as he tugs me closer to him.
paras.zh: 从船身木梁的动静来看，我们怕是连一个小时都没有了。我抹去眼泪，翻过身用胳膊肘支起头。“你也得讲讲你的那部分，”我说。“这故事可不全是我的，你知道的。”他的手臂环住我的腰，手落在我后腰，把我往他怀里拉近。

paras.en: He’s so warm.
paras.zh: 他好暖。

paras.en: How is it possible that he’s still so warm? “I think I can manage that,” he says with a small smile. “But you must start.
paras.zh: 他怎么会还这么暖？“我想这个我能做到，”他微微笑着说。“但得由你开头。

paras.en: It all began with you, after all.” “All right,” I say, resting my head on his chest, his steady heartbeat against my ear.
paras.zh: 毕竟，一切都是从你开始的。”“好吧，”我说，把头靠上他的胸膛，他平稳的心跳贴着我的耳朵。

paras.en: I close my eyes, trying to decide where to begin.
paras.zh: 我闭上眼，思量着该从哪儿讲起。

paras.en: So much has happened over the years.
paras.zh: 这些年来，发生了太多太多。

paras.en: But there is that one day.
paras.zh: 可总有那么一天。

paras.en: One fateful day that changed the course of both our lives forever.
paras.zh: 那个命中注定、永远改变了我们两人命运轨迹的一天。

paras.en: I open my eyes. “It all starts with the wind,” I say. “My dear friend Gale.” As I speak, the words begin to course through me like the forbidding waters roiling outside.
paras.zh: 我睁开眼。“一切是从风开始的，”我说。“我的好朋友盖尔。”说话间，那些词句像外面翻涌的骇浪一样，在我体内奔流起来。

paras.en: And like the waters, I will finally make myself heard.
paras.zh: 而就像那海水一样，我终于要让自己的声音被听见。

paras.en: Agnarr will listen.
paras.zh: 安格瑞会听。

paras.en: He’s always been the storyteller in our family.
paras.zh: 他向来是我们家那个讲故事的人。

paras.en: But not this time.
paras.zh: 但这一次不是。

paras.en: Now it’s my turn to tell the tale.
paras.zh: 现在轮到我来讲这个故事了。

chapters.title: Chapter One: Iduna: Twenty-Six Years Earlier

paras.en: “STOP IT!
paras.zh: “住手！

paras.en: YOU’RE TICKLING ME!” I squealed in protest as the wind swirled around me, twirling me off my feet.
paras.zh: 你在挠我痒痒！”风在我身边打着旋，把我卷得双脚离地，我一边抗议一边尖叫。

paras.en: Gale, the Wind Spirit, seemed particularly, well, spirited And who didn’t want to fly? “Where have you gone to, Iduna?” Yelana’s voice cut through the forest. “Come back here and finish your knitting!” Uh-oh. “Coward,” I scolded.
paras.zh: 风灵盖尔今天似乎格外——嗯，有精神。谁又不想飞呢？“你跑哪儿去了，伊杜娜？”耶拉娜的声音穿透了森林。“回来把你的针线活织完！”糟了。“胆小鬼，”我嗔怪道。

paras.en: Gale swept up a small pile of leaves, creating an overly exaggerated Yelana-shaped leaf monster, complete with I turned my gaze toward the direction of our camp, where Yelana was probably sitting near the fire with the rest of the women.
paras.zh: 盖尔卷起一小堆落叶，变出一个夸张到不行的、耶拉娜模样的树叶怪物，还带着……我把目光转向营地的方向，耶拉娜大概正和其他女人们一起坐在火边。

paras.en: Knitting.
paras.zh: 织着东西。

paras.en: They’d come to us years ago with an offer of peace and goodwill, promising to build a mighty dam to help us water our reindeer and keep our land fertile and fresh.
paras.zh: 几年前，他们带着和平与善意的提议来到我们这里，答应修一座大坝，帮我们灌溉驯鹿、让我们的土地保持肥沃常新。

paras.en: I didn’t really understand the whole thing, and I wasn’t sure our elders were completely sold on the idea at first.
paras.zh: 我并不是真懂这整件事，也不确定我们的长老们一开始是不是完全信服。

paras.en: But in the end, they came to an agreement and the dam was built.
paras.zh: 但最后，他们达成了协议，大坝也修起来了。

paras.en: That day we would feast together to mark this new alliance between our people and theirs.
paras.zh: 那一天，我们要一起设宴，庆祝我们两族之间这崭新的结盟。

paras.en: It was a day to dance and sing and celebrate the beauty of the forest.
paras.zh: 那本该是个载歌载舞、欢庆森林之美的日子。

paras.en: Not sit around and knit.
paras.zh: 而不是坐着织毛线。

paras.en: Besides, I was only twelve years old.
paras.zh: 再说了，我不过才十二岁。

paras.en: Which meant I literally had ages to learn boring grown-up things like knitting.
paras.zh: 也就是说，我有一辈子的时间去学织毛线这种无聊的大人活儿。

paras.en: Not to mention I already had a perfectly good knitted shawl to keep me warm.
paras.zh: 更别提我已经有了一件织得挺好的披肩保暖了。

paras.en: I hugged it to my chest, running my fingertips along the intricate patterns depicting the four spirits.
paras.zh: 我把它抱在胸前，指尖抚过上面描绘四位精灵的繁复花样。

paras.en: My mother had made it for me when I was a baby, and I’d worn it ever since.
paras.zh: 它是我小时候母亲为我织的，从那以后我一直戴着。

paras.en: I remembered her now, cuddling my five-year-old self close as I breathed in her warm, earthy scent.
paras.zh: 我想起了她，想起五岁的我被她紧紧搂在怀里，嗅着她身上温暖而带着泥土气息的味道。

paras.en: Listening to her sing sweet songs about a river of memories.
paras.zh: 听她唱起关于那条记忆之河的甜美歌谣。

paras.en: Memories were all I had left of my mother now.
paras.zh: 如今，记忆是我母亲留给我的一切了。

paras.en: My father, too.
paras.zh: 还有我的父亲。

paras.en: I shook the memories away, turning back to Gale, who was busy stirring up a pile of brown leaves into a small whirlwind.
paras.zh: 我甩开这些回忆，转回去看盖尔——它正忙着把一堆棕色落叶搅成一个小旋风。

paras.en: I bowed playfully to the spirit as I moved farther away from Yelana and her call to return to knitting. “May I have this dance, fine sir?” “But of course, my fair lady!” Gale picked me up again, with more force this time, twirling me back into the air.
paras.zh: 我调皮地朝精灵鞠了一躬，一边往离耶拉娜和她“回去织毛线”的呼唤更远的地方挪。“可否邀您跳一支舞，先生？”“当然可以，我美丽的女士！”盖尔又把我卷了起来，这次力道更大，把我转着抛回空中。

paras.en: This time I didn’t bother to fight it. “Higher!” I begged instead. “Higher than the treetops!
paras.zh: 这回我没挣扎。“再高一点！”我反而央求道。“比树顶还要高！

paras.en: I want to see the entire world!” “Anything you wish, Princess!” I wasn’t really a princess, of course.
paras.zh: 我要看尽整个世界！”“您想要的，都依您，公主！”我当然不是什么公主。

paras.en: We didn’t even have royalty here in the forest.
paras.zh: 我们森林里连王室都没有。

paras.en: Instead, we had a council of elders, which was basically a bunch of wise old people who liked to sit around and give advice.
paras.zh: 我们有的，是一个长老会——说白了就是一群爱坐在一起出主意的聪明老人。

paras.en: Other voices should be invited to the conversation, even if they didn’t always agree with each other.
paras.zh: 别的声音也该被请来一起商量，哪怕他们并不总是意见一致。

paras.en: For one person to rule over all, the elders would say, wasn’t good.
paras.zh: 长老们常说，让一个人统治所有人，这不好。

paras.en: But in the books the Arendellians brought to our villages as gifts while building the dam, there were often princesses.
paras.zh: 可阿伦黛尔人在修大坝时当作礼物送到我们村子的那些书里，常常有公主。

paras.en: And princes and kings and queens, too, who were breathtakingly beautiful and wore fine clothes and jewels and lived in mighty castles like the one down on the fjord.
paras.zh: 还有王子、国王和王后，他们美得惊心动魄，穿着华服、戴着珠宝，住在像峡湾边那座一样宏伟的城堡里。

paras.en: Some were good and helped their people prosper while keeping the peace.
paras.zh: 有的心地善良，既保一方太平，又让百姓安居乐业。

paras.en: Others were evil and did not appreciate all that was given to them.
paras.zh: 有的则心术不正，把别人给的一切当成理所当然。

paras.en: They would scorch the earth for their own selfish gain, not caring who got hurt in the process.
paras.zh: 他们会为了一己私利把大地烧成焦土，全然不顾会伤到谁。

paras.en: If I ever became a princess, I’d be one of the good ones for sure. “Whoa!
paras.zh: 要是我真成了公主，我一定当个好公主。“哇！

paras.en: Who’s that?
paras.zh: 那是谁？

paras.en: Hey, come here, little fellow.” I almost fell out of the wind’s embrace as I whirled around, my eyes locking on a strange boy far below me, trudging down the reindeer path.
paras.zh: 嘿，过来呀，小家伙。”我打着旋转过身，差点从风的怀抱里摔出去——我的目光锁定了下方远处一个陌生的男孩，他正沿着驯鹿小径艰难地走着。

paras.en: He didn’t look much older than me, with thick blond hair and a strange fitted green jacket and a shirt as red as the autumn leaves underneath his feet.
paras.zh: 他看起来比我也大不了多少，一头浓密的金发，穿着一件奇怪的合身绿外套，里面是件红得像脚下落叶的衬衫。

paras.en: As I watched from above, he knelt to the ground, reaching out to try to pet a small One of the baby reindeer lagged behind the rest, going up to him and sniffing him curiously.
paras.zh: 我在上面看着，他跪到地上，伸手想去摸一只小……一只小驯鹿落在了鹿群后面，走到他跟前，好奇地嗅着他。

paras.en: The boy’s face brightened and he dropped to his knees, pulling the creature into his arms and cuddling it as if it were the most precious treasure in the world.
paras.zh: 男孩的脸亮了起来，他双膝跪地，把那小家伙搂进怀里，像捧着世上最珍贵的宝物一样疼爱它。

paras.en: It made me smile.
paras.zh: 这让我笑了起来。

paras.en: I was about to tell Gale to set me down so I could introduce myself when I heard an angry voice cut through the trees. “Agnarr!
paras.zh: 我正要叫盖尔放我下去、好去自我介绍，忽然听见一个怒气冲冲的声音穿过树林。“安格瑞！

paras.en: Where are you?” The baby reindeer froze.
paras.zh: 你跑哪儿去了？”小驯鹿一下子僵住了。

paras.en: It squirmed out of the boy’s—Agnarr’s—arms and raced in the direction of the herd.
paras.zh: 它从男孩——安格瑞——怀里挣脱出来，朝鹿群的方向飞奔而去。

paras.en: Agnarr watched it go, a sad expression taking over his face.
paras.zh: 安格瑞望着它跑远，脸上浮起一抹忧伤。

paras.en: The voice came again.
paras.zh: 那声音又响了。

paras.en: Louder this time.
paras.zh: 这次更大声。

paras.en: More impatient.
paras.zh: 更不耐烦。

paras.en: His shoulders slumped and he ran toward it, disappearing from view.
paras.zh: 他耷拉着肩膀朝那声音跑去，消失在视线之外。

paras.en: It was then that it all started to come together.
paras.zh: 就在那时，一切开始串起来了。

paras.en: He must be one of the Arendellians! “Come on, Gale!
paras.zh: 他一定是阿伦黛尔人！“快，盖尔！

paras.en: Let’s follow him!” I cried, any thought of adhering to Yelana’s impatient call forgotten. “I want to see their camp!” Gale obliged, whisking me in the direction Agnarr had gone, opposite the path of the reindeer herd.
paras.zh: 我们跟着他！”我喊道，早把听从耶拉娜那不耐烦的呼唤抛到了脑后。“我要去看看他们的营地！”盖尔顺从地照做，把我往安格瑞去的方向一卷——那正好与驯鹿群的小径相反。

paras.en: A few moments later, a small camp came into view.
paras.zh: 片刻之后，一座小小的营地出现在视野里。

paras.en: There were tents set up around a central firepit, though they were much different from the huts we used, which consisted of a tripod of poles covered by flat wooden slats.
paras.zh: 帐篷围着中央的火坑搭着，不过和我们住的屋子大不一样——我们的屋子是三根杆子支成三脚架、再盖上平直木板那种。

paras.en: These tents were more like little houses made of brightly colored fabrics and topped with tiny flags fluttering gaily in the breeze.
paras.zh: 这些帐篷倒更像是用鲜艳布料做成的小房子，顶上还插着在小风里快活飘动的小旗子。

paras.en: In the center, plopped down on the firepit, was a huge black cauldron, bubbling over with a delicious-smelling stew. “Put me down,” I whispered to Gale. “I want to get a better look.” The Wind Spirit lowered me gently.
paras.zh: 正中央，架在火坑上的，是一口巨大的黑锅，里面炖着香气扑鼻的浓汤，正咕嘟咕嘟冒着泡。“放我下来，”我凑盖尔耳边低语。“我想看得更清楚些。”风灵轻轻把我放下。

paras.en: Once on the ground, I It was then that I noticed the red cloak hanging from a rope stretched across two trees, alongside other clothes, probably hung out to dry.
paras.zh: 一落地，我……就在这时，我注意到一件红斗篷挂在两棵树之间拉起的绳子上，旁边还搭着别的衣服，大概是晾着等干。

paras.en: The need to run my hands over the bright, colorful cloth washed over me and, before I thought it through, I motioned for Gale to grab it and bring it to me.
paras.zh: 一股想用手抚摸那鲜亮彩布的冲动涌上来，我还没想清楚，就示意盖尔去把它抓来给我。

paras.en: A moment later, the spirit dropped the cloak into my arms.
paras.zh: 片刻之后，精灵把斗篷丢进了我怀里。

paras.en: I ran my hand against the finely woven fabric, watching as it slipped through my fingers like gossamer.
paras.zh: 我用手抚过那细密织就的布料，看它像蛛丝一样从指间滑落。

paras.en: How did they make it this soft?
paras.zh: 他们是怎么把它做得这么柔软的？

paras.en: Inspired, I slipped the cloak onto my shoulders, pulling the hood low over my face.
paras.zh: 受了蛊惑似的，我把斗篷披上肩，把兜帽拉低遮住脸。

paras.en: Then I glanced at my reflection in a nearby stream.
paras.zh: 然后我瞥了一眼附近溪水中的倒影。

paras.en: I looked like one of them now.
paras.zh: 现在，我看起来就像他们中的一员了。

paras.en: A sudden idea took hold, and stuffing my shawl into a knothole in a nearby old oak, I grinned conspiratorially at Gale.
paras.zh: 一个念头突然冒了出来，我把披肩塞进旁边一棵老橡树的树洞里，冲盖尔心照不宣地一笑。

paras.en: Time to explore.
paras.zh: 是时候去探探险了。

paras.en: I slipped into the camp, feeling as if I’d stepped into another world.
paras.zh: 我溜进营地，觉得自己仿佛踏进了另一个世界。

paras.en: The fancy tents were even more elaborate up close—gigantic pavilions with massive rooms containing actual beds and tables and chairs that looked to be hewn of the finest oaks.
paras.zh: 近看那些华丽的帐篷更不得了——巨大的帐篷里空间宽敞，摆着真正的床、桌子和椅子，看上去都是用上好的橡木打造的。

paras.en: How had they carried all this up through the forest?
paras.zh: 他们是怎么把这一切搬着穿过森林的？

paras.en: And more important, why would they bother?
paras.zh: 更重要的是，他们又何必费这番功夫？

paras.en: I shook my head, confounded as I continued to explore the camp.
paras.zh: 我困惑地摇摇头，继续在营地里探索。

paras.en: Suddenly I came across a group of women in simple homespun dresses and aprons, chattering as they carried baskets full of fruits and vegetables over to a long row table. “I can’t believe we’re really here!” I heard one of them say. “It’s so magical!” “Magical?” scoffed another. “This forest is filthy!
paras.zh: 忽然，我撞见一群穿着粗布裙子和围裙的女人，她们一边叽叽喳喳，一边把装满水果蔬菜的篮子搬向一长排桌子。“真不敢相信我们真的到了这儿！”我听见其中一个说。“太像魔法了！”“魔法？”另一个嗤之以鼻。“这片森林脏死了！

paras.en: Get me back to civilization as soon as possible!” “You just want to get back to Stephen,” teased another. “The The second woman grinned. “All I can say is he’d better be working on our love spoon!
paras.zh: 赶紧把我弄回文明世界去！”“你不过是想回斯蒂芬身边罢了，”另一个打趣道。“那……”第二个女人咧嘴一笑。“我只能说，他最好正忙着给我做定情木勺呢！

paras.en: I’m not planning to wait forever, you know!” The trio broke out into giggles as they set the baskets on the table, then turned around for another batch.
paras.zh: 我可没打算一直等下去，知道吗！”三个女人把篮子放到桌上，咯咯笑作一团，又转身去搬下一批。

paras.en: I ducked to keep out of sight, popping into a nearby vacant tent.
paras.zh: 我赶紧蹲下身子不让人看见，一头钻进旁边一座空帐篷。

paras.en: Empty of people.
paras.zh: 里面没有人。

paras.en: But full of food.
paras.zh: 却堆满了食物。

paras.en: I stared wide-eyed at the feast piled high on the table.
paras.zh: 我睁大眼睛，盯着桌上堆得高高的宴席。

paras.en: The smells surrounded me even as I feasted on the sight with my eyes.
paras.zh: 香味将我团团包围，而我先用眼睛大饱了眼福。

paras.en: Puffy loaves of steaming dark brown bread, plates of rich meat soaked in gravy, smoky chunks and slices of various fish, earthy potatoes, roasted vegetables, and… What were those dark brown blocks near the desserts at the very end?
paras.zh: 蓬松冒热气的深褐色面包、浸在肉汁里的丰盛肉盘、带着烟熏味的各种鱼块和鱼片、土香的土豆、烤蔬菜，还有……最末了甜点旁边那些深褐色的小方块是什么？

paras.en: Unable to resist, I snuck a delectable chunk and shoved it in my mouth.
paras.zh: 我忍不住偷偷掰了一块美味，塞进嘴里。

paras.en: The sweetness practically exploded on my tongue as I closed my eyes in rapture.
paras.zh: 甜味简直在舌尖炸开，我闭上眼，陶醉其中。

paras.en: Suddenly, I heard voices outside the tent.
paras.zh: 忽然，我听见帐篷外有说话声。

paras.en: I froze. “There you are, Agnarr,” someone barked. “What did I tell you about running off like that?” I froze.
paras.zh: 我僵住了。“你在这儿啊，安格瑞，”有人厉声说。“我怎么跟你说的，不许这样乱跑？”我僵住了。

paras.en: Agnarr?
paras.zh: 安格瑞？

paras.en: The boy from earlier?
paras.zh: 刚才那个男孩？

paras.en: I dared peek outside the tent to get a better look.
paras.zh: 我壮着胆子往帐篷外偷看，想看得更清楚。

paras.en: Sure enough, there he was, still dressed in his bright green suit.
paras.zh: 果然是他，还穿着那身鲜亮的绿衣服。

paras.en: But he was no longer smiling.
paras.zh: 可他不再笑了。

paras.en: Instead, he was hanging his head, appearing ashamed.
paras.zh: 相反，他垂着头，一副羞愧的模样。

paras.en: A tall, robust-looking man with a big blond mustache towered over him. “I’m sorry, Papa,” Agnarr murmured, shuffling his feet. “I just…wanted to look around a little.
paras.zh: 一个留着金色大胡子的高大壮汉居高临下地站在他面前。“对不起，爸爸，”安格瑞低声说，脚在地上蹭着。“我只是……想四处看看。

paras.en: It feels so…magical here.” His father’s face grew beet red. “Magic,” he spat. “Agnarr, what have I told you about magic?
paras.zh: 这里感觉好……像魔法。”他父亲的脸涨成了紫红色。“魔法，”他啐了一口。“安格瑞，我跟你说过的，魔法是怎么回事？

paras.en: Nothing good comes from magic.
paras.zh: 魔法不会带来任何好东西。

paras.en: It is to be feared, not admired.” “I’m sorry, Papa,” Agnarr murmured, still not looking his father in the eye. “I just—” But his father waved him off, dismissing him without so much as a goodbye.
paras.zh: 它只该被畏惧，不该被仰慕。”“对不起，爸爸，”安格瑞低声说，仍不敢直视父亲的眼睛。“我只是——”可他父亲一挥手把他打发走了，连句再见都没有。

paras.en: Instead, he stormed over to the soldiers gathered at the head of the camp. “Are you ready?” he asked. “For the… way I turned my attention back to Agnarr.
paras.zh: 他反而大步走向聚在营地前头的士兵们。“准备好了吗？”他问。“为了那……”我的注意力转回到安格瑞身上。

paras.en: He was watching his father with a look of unhappiness.
paras.zh: 他正望着父亲，一脸不快。

paras.en: And maybe a little…loneliness?
paras.zh: 也许还有一点点……孤独？

paras.en: My heart tugged at the sight.
paras.zh: 看到这副模样，我的心被揪了一下。

paras.en: I knew all too well what it was like to feel alone.
paras.zh: 我太清楚那种孤独的滋味了。

paras.en: Even when surrounded by so many others.
paras.zh: 哪怕身边围着那么多人。

paras.en: I watched as a new man approached.
paras.zh: 我看着又一个男人走了过来。

paras.en: This one was wearing the same uniform as the other soldiers and had dark skin and kind eyes.
paras.zh: 这人穿着和其他士兵一样的制服，皮肤黝黑，眼神和善。

paras.en: Agnarr looked up at him and I saw his face brighten.
paras.zh: 安格瑞抬头看他，我看见男孩脸上亮了起来。

paras.en: Whoever this man was, he was a friend.
paras.zh: 不管这人是谁，他是个朋友。

paras.en: I couldn’t catch what they were saying, but I could tell they were joking around; the somber mood was lifting.
paras.zh: 我听不清他们在说什么，但看得出他们在说笑，方才沉重气氛正在散去。

paras.en: The call of horns broke through the air, announcing the official start of the feast.
paras.zh: 号角声划破长空，宣告宴会正式开始。

paras.en: Everyone in the camp erupted into excited chatter and rushed toward the sound, arms laden with trays of food and other baskets and boxes, presumably gifts of some kind.
paras.zh: 营地里所有人都兴奋地嚷嚷起来，朝着号角声涌去，怀里抱着一盘盘食物、一只只篮子和盒子，想必是某种礼物。

paras.en: Now no longer nearby the others, I was able to sneak out of the tent—after taking a second helping of the sweet brown blocks, obviously—and head in the direction of the celebration.
paras.zh: 既然别人都不在跟前了，我总算能溜出帐篷——当然，是又抓了一块那甜甜的褐色东西之后——朝庆典的方向走去。

paras.en: I was halfway there when I realized I’d left my shawl in the tree and was still wearing the borrowed Arendellian cape.
paras.zh: 走到半路，我才想起披肩还落在树上，身上还穿着借来的阿伦黛尔斗篷。

paras.en: I slipped the cape off my shoulders and hung it on a nearby tree branch; if the elders caught me wearing something so unfamiliar, they might question why.
paras.zh: 我把斗篷从肩上褪下，挂在附近一根树枝上；要是长老们撞见我穿这么件陌生玩意儿，怕是要追问缘由。

paras.en: I considered going back to get my shawl, but in the end decided against it.
paras.zh: 我考虑过回去取披肩，但最后还是打消了念头。

paras.en: It would still be there when I returned later, and I didn’t want to be late for the feast. “Gale, take me to the celebration,” I whispered.
paras.zh: 等我回来它还在那儿，我也不想错过了宴会。“盖尔，带我去庆典，”我低语。

paras.en: In a moment I was up in the air, swirling in the gusts, twirling among the leaves.
paras.zh: 转瞬间我便升到了空中，在阵风里打着旋，在落叶间翻飞。

paras.en: The air tickled my flushed cheeks and I couldn’t help laughing out loud.
paras.zh: 空气挠着我发烫的脸颊，我忍不住放声大笑。

paras.en: And who could blame me?
paras.zh: 这又能怪谁呢？

paras.en: It was a glorious thing, dancing with the wind.
paras.zh: 和风共舞，是件多么美妙的事。

paras.en: Suddenly, I got the sense I was being watched.
paras.zh: 忽然，我感觉到有人在看着我。

paras.en: Had Yelana finally become impatient with my absence and tracked me down?
paras.zh: 是耶拉娜终于等得不耐烦、循迹找来了吗？

paras.en: Well, when I looked below, it wasn’t her at all, but rather Agnarr himself, looking up at me with the most fascinated eyes.
paras.zh: 可当我往下看时，那人根本不是她，而是安格瑞本人，正用无比着迷的眼神仰望着我。

paras.en: I realized he probably thought it was magic, what his father had been talking about before.
paras.zh: 我意识到，他大概以为这就是他父亲方才说的那种魔法。

paras.en: That I was some creature of nature, able to spread my hands and fly of my own accord.
paras.zh: 以为我是某种自然生灵，能张开双手、凭自己的力量飞翔。

paras.en: The thought tickled me even more than Gale’s breeze, and I burst into laughter as the Wind Spirit spun me higher and higher until I was breathless and dizzy.
paras.zh: 这念头比盖尔的风还让我觉得好玩，风灵把我越转越高，直到我笑得上气不接下气、头晕目眩，我终于爆发出一阵大笑。

paras.en: I could feel Agnarr still watching me.
paras.zh: 我能感觉到安格瑞还在望着我。

paras.en: But I didn’t mind.
paras.zh: 可我不在意。

paras.en: Instead, I tucked my knees to my chest and launched into a perfect double-barrel roll.
paras.zh: 相反，我把膝盖收向胸口，来了个漂亮的双连环翻滚。

paras.en: Might as well give him something to see.
paras.zh: 不如让他看个过瘾。

paras.en: But just as I was about to have Gale set me down so I could meet Agnarr at last, the laughter and happy sounds emanating from the feast suddenly grew quiet.
paras.zh: 可就在我正要让盖尔放我下去、好终于和安格瑞见个面时，庆典传来的笑声与欢闹忽然安静了下来。

paras.en: Too quiet.
paras.zh: 安静得过头了。

paras.en: MY HEART POUNDED WITH FRIGHT AS A heightened pitch of angry voices suddenly reached my ears.
paras.zh: 我的心吓得狂跳，因为一阵拔高了调门的怒喝声忽然钻进我的耳朵。

paras.en: What was going on?
paras.zh: 怎么回事？

paras.en: Gale seemed to sense my unease, setting me down before I could ask.
paras.zh: 盖尔似乎察觉到我不安，没等我问就先把我放了下来。

paras.en: By the time my feet had touched the earth, Agnarr was long gone and the angry shouting had transformed into screams of terror.
paras.zh: 等我的脚落地，安格瑞早已不见踪影，而那愤怒的叫喊也变成了惊恐的尖叫。

paras.en: A herd of spooked reindeer bolted past, almost trampling me.
paras.zh: 一群受惊的驯鹿狂奔而过，差点把我踩倒。

paras.en: It was then that I smelled it.
paras.zh: 就在那时，我闻到了。

paras.en: The stench of smoke.
paras.zh: 烟的臭味。

paras.en: I looked up, shocked to see flames of a purplish hue emanating from the angry Fire Spirit leaping from tree to tree, setting everything aflame, black smoke rising skyward.
paras.zh: 我抬头，惊呆了——只见愤怒的火灵喷出紫色的火苗，在树与树之间跳跃，所到之处尽数燃起大火，黑烟直冲天际。

paras.en: The ground suddenly rocked under my feet and my heart leapt to my throat as my ears caught an all-too-familiar sound.
paras.zh: 脚下的地面忽然摇晃起来，我的心跳到了嗓子眼——耳朵捕捉到了一个再熟悉不过的声音。

paras.en: It was the roar of the Earth Giants!
paras.zh: 是大地巨人的怒吼！

paras.en: The earth trembled with every pounding step.
paras.zh: 大地随着它每一步的践踏而震颤。

paras.en: Had our celebration awoken them from their slumber by the river?
paras.zh: 是我们的庆典把它们从河边沉睡中惊醒了么？

paras.en: A shiver of fear tripped down my spine.
paras.zh: 一阵恐惧顺着脊背窜下。

paras.en: I needed to find my family.
paras.zh: 我得找到我的家人。

paras.en: Now.
paras.zh: 马上。

paras.en: I raced through the forest, the smoke getting thicker as I got closer to our camp, until it was nearly impossible to see.
paras.zh: 我冲过森林，越靠近我们的营地烟越浓，浓到几乎什么都看不见。

paras.en: My The Arendellians and Northuldra were attacking one another.
paras.zh: 我……阿伦黛尔人和北地人正互相攻击。

paras.en: My ears picked up the sound of swords violently clanging against each other.
paras.zh: 我的耳朵捕捉到刀剑猛烈相撞的铮鸣。

paras.en: The shouts of anger, then agony, rising above the crackle of flame and the roar of wind.
paras.zh: 愤怒的喊声，继而痛苦的哀嚎，盖过了火焰的噼啪和狂风的呼啸。

paras.en: Through the thick smoke I could barely make out shadows darting and swooping in combat, though what had begun the battle was unclear.
paras.zh: 透过浓烟，我勉强能辨出战斗里纵跃穿梭的黑影，至于这场战事因何而起，却说不清。

paras.en: All I knew was that the situation was very bad, and seemed to be getting worse by the minute.
paras.zh: 我只知道情形糟透了，而且似乎每过一分钟都在恶化。

paras.en: I didn’t know where to go.
paras.zh: 我不知道该往哪儿去。

paras.en: What to do.
paras.zh: 该做什么。

paras.en: Was there anywhere safe to retreat until this was over?
paras.zh: 有没有什么地方能让我安全退避，直到这一切结束？

paras.en: My mother’s shawl!
paras.zh: 我母亲的披肩！

paras.en: I had to get it now, since the trees were on fire.
paras.zh: 我得现在就去取，因为树都烧起来了。

paras.en: It was the only thing I had left of her and I couldn’t let it burn.
paras.zh: 那是她留给我的唯一物件，我不能让它烧掉。

paras.en: I changed directions, sprinting back toward the tree.
paras.zh: 我调转方向，朝那棵树飞奔回去。

paras.en: My throat was raw from inhaling smoke and my lungs ached.
paras.zh: 喉咙被烟呛得生疼，肺也跟着痛。

paras.en: As I ran, my mind raced with troubled thoughts.
paras.zh: 奔跑时，纷乱的念头在脑中飞转。

paras.en: The spirits were clearly angry, lashing out at everyone in the forest.
paras.zh: 精灵们显然在发怒，朝森林里每一个人发作。

paras.en: Was their rage caused by the battle?
paras.zh: 它们的愤怒是因为这场战斗吗？

paras.en: Or had they started it?
paras.zh: 还是它们自己挑起的？

paras.en: Finally, I reached the tree outside the completely deserted Arendellian camp.
paras.zh: 终于，我到了那座空无一人的阿伦黛尔营地外的树旁。

paras.en: Upon plucking the shawl from the hollow, I wrapped it around my shoulders.
paras.zh: 从树洞里抽出披肩，我把它裹上肩膀。

paras.en: Hugging the fringe to my chest in relief, I looked all over.
paras.zh: 我松了口气，把披肩流苏抱在胸前，四下张望。

paras.en: The fire was still raging, the earth still shaking.
paras.zh: 火还在烧，地还在震。

paras.en: Even the wind had risen up into a monstrous gale.
paras.zh: 连风都化作了一头凶猛的狂飙。

paras.en: I’d never seen anything like it.
paras.zh: 我从没见过这样的场面。

paras.en: I was on the verge of leaving when I heard a weak cry.
paras.zh: 我正要离开，忽然听见一声微弱的呼喊。

paras.en: Whirling around, my eyes widened as I spotted a crumpled figure splayed out against a large boulder.
paras.zh: 我猛地转身，一眼瞥见一个蜷缩的人影瘫靠在一块大岩石上，顿时瞪大了眼。

paras.en: Blood seeped from a cut in the person’s head, pouring down the rock, darkening the earth below.
paras.zh: 血从那人头上的伤口渗出，顺着岩石往下淌，把下方的泥土染黑。

paras.en: There was so much blood that it took me a moment to recognize him.
paras.zh: 血太多了，我愣了一会儿才认出他是谁。

paras.en: But when I did, I gasped.
paras.zh: 可一旦认出，我倒抽一口凉气。

paras.en: It was the boy.
paras.zh: 是那个男孩。

paras.en: Agnarr.
paras.zh: 安格瑞。

paras.en: And he was badly hurt.
paras.zh: 而他伤得很重。

paras.en: I glanced back at my forest.
paras.zh: 我回头望了一眼我的森林。

paras.en: I knew I needed to return there, Suddenly I heard voices calling my name from somewhere within the forest.
paras.zh: 我知道我得回到那里去，忽然，我听见森林深处有人在喊我的名字。

paras.en: My family was looking for me, I realized.
paras.zh: 是家人在找我，我明白了。

paras.en: They sounded worried.
paras.zh: 他们的声音里满是担忧。

paras.en: I needed to get to them, let them know I was all right.
paras.zh: 我得去他们身边，让他们知道我没事。

paras.en: Let them lead me to where it was safe.
paras.zh: 让他们带我去安全的地方。

paras.en: But then Agnarr would die.
paras.zh: 可那样安格瑞就会死。

paras.en: I stared down at him, paralyzed by indecision.
paras.zh: 我低头看着他，拿不定主意，僵在原地。

paras.en: He looked pale as death, but I could see his chest rise and fall with shallow breaths.
paras.zh: 他脸色惨白如死，可我看得见他的胸口还在微弱地起伏。

paras.en: He was alive, but for how long?
paras.zh: 他还活着，可还能撑多久？

paras.en: There were no Arendellians around.
paras.zh: 周围一个阿伦黛尔人都没有。

paras.en: Even if they were looking for him, they might not find him before he lost too much blood.
paras.zh: 就算他们在找他，也可能赶不及——在他失血过多之前找到他。

paras.en: Before his lungs filled with smoke and he couldn’t breathe.
paras.zh: 在他肺里灌满烟、喘不上气之前。

paras.en: But—just maybe—I could save him.
paras.zh: 但——也许——我能救他。

paras.en: My mind raced; I was torn.
paras.zh: 我思绪飞转，内心撕裂。

paras.en: I thought back to the forest.
paras.zh: 我回想起那片森林。

paras.en: The fighting between his people and mine.
paras.zh: 他的族人与我的族人之间的厮杀。

paras.en: That made him an enemy, even if I didn’t know why.
paras.zh: 这让他成了敌人，尽管我并不知道缘由。

paras.en: I looked down at his drained face.
paras.zh: 我低头望着他失血的脸。

paras.en: And yet…he was also just a boy.
paras.zh: 然而……他也只是个男孩。

paras.en: An injured boy who would die if I didn’t do something.
paras.zh: 一个若我不做点什么就会死去的受伤男孩。

paras.en: A tree behind me creaked, fire snapping at its limbs.
paras.zh: 我身后一棵树吱呀作响，火舌正舔噬着它的枝干。

paras.en: A branch broke, crashing from above.
paras.zh: 一根树枝折断，从上空砸落。

paras.en: On instinct, I threw myself at Agnarr, rolling him to the side just in time to avoid the fiery brand.
paras.zh: 出于本能，我扑向安格瑞，把他滚向一旁，刚好避开了那根着火的断枝。

paras.en: It hit the ground where he’d been lying only seconds before, and the dry brush around it flared up.
paras.zh: 它砸在几秒前他还躺着的地方，周围的干草灌木一下子燃了起来。

paras.en: I inhaled deeply, making my decision.
paras.zh: 我深吸一口气，下了决心。

paras.en: Lifting my raw voice to the sky, I sang for Gale, calling for the Wind Spirit the same way I always did. “Ah ah ah ah!” For a moment, I heard nothing, and I began to worry the spirit was too wrapped up in whatever was happening to answer my call.
paras.zh: 我扯着沙哑的嗓子向天空唱起，像往常一样呼唤盖尔。“啊——啊——啊——啊！”有那么一瞬，什么回音也没有，我开始担心精灵正忙着别的事，无暇回应我的呼唤。

paras.en: But at last there was a rush of wind and a breeze that floated around me questioningly.
paras.zh: 但终于，一阵疾风来了，一缕微风带着疑问在我身边打转。

paras.en: I let out a breath of relief. “Help us, Gale,” I begged.
paras.zh: 我松了口气。“帮帮我们，盖尔，”我恳求道。

paras.en: The Wind Spirit obeyed, scooping both of us up into its embrace and sweeping us across the forest in a fierce rush.
paras.zh: 风灵听从了，把我们俩一起拢进怀抱，裹挟着飞快掠过森林。

paras.en: For a moment the boy’s eyes fluttered and I wondered if he would regain consciousness.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻，男孩的眼睫动了动，我猜他会否恢复知觉。

paras.en: He muttered something softly that I couldn’t quite hear, then passed out again. “Come on,” I said to the wind, my heart beating fast in my chest. “We have to hurry.” Gale picked up the pace, rushing us faster away from danger.
paras.zh: 他含糊地咕哝了句我听不清的话，又昏了过去。“快呀，”我对着风说，心在胸腔里咚咚直跳。“我们得抓紧。”盖尔加快了速度，带我们更快远离险境。

paras.en: As we flew, my eyes darted around the woods, desperate to find someone—anyone—who could help us.
paras.zh: 飞行中，我的目光在林间急扫，迫切想找到能帮我们的人——随便谁都行。

paras.en: It was then that I saw the group of Arendellian horses and wagons, piled high with injured people hacking and sputtering, rubbing their eyes, their skin caked with soot.
paras.zh: 就在那时，我看见一队阿伦黛尔的马和马车，上面堆满了伤员——他们咳个不停、喘着粗气，揉着眼睛，皮肤上结着一层烟灰。

paras.en: It appeared they were about to evacuate the area. “There!” I pointed for Gale. “Put him down in that wagon.” The Wind Spirit obliged, sweeping us forward and dropping us gently onto the wagon.
paras.zh: 看样子他们正要撤离这片区域。“那儿！”我给盖尔指方向。“把他放那辆车上。”风灵照做了，卷着我们向前，轻轻把我们落在马车上。

paras.en: As Agnarr’s back settled against the cart’s wood, he murmured something again.
paras.zh: 安格瑞的后背贴上车厢木板时，他又咕哝了一句。

paras.en: I leaned over him, trying to hear what he had to say.
paras.zh: 我俯身靠近他，想听清他说什么。

paras.en: Suddenly, everything went dark.
paras.zh: 忽然，四周全黑了。

paras.en: I reached up, surprised to find an Arendellian cloak over my head, covering almost my entire body.
paras.zh: 我伸手一摸，惊讶地发现头上盖着一件阿伦黛尔斗篷，几乎把我整个人都罩住了。

paras.en: Gale must have thrown it over me.
paras.zh: 准是盖尔把它甩到了我身上。

paras.en: But why?
paras.zh: 可为什么呢？

paras.en: Danger was approaching.
paras.zh: 危险正在逼近。

paras.en: My ears pricked at the sounds of footsteps, loud, and of more than one person approaching.
paras.zh: 我的耳朵竖了起来——脚步声很响，而且不止一个人正走过来。

paras.en: I held my breath, my heart pounding so hard I wondered if I’d crack a rib.
paras.zh: 我屏住呼吸，心跳猛得像要撞断肋骨。

paras.en: The wagon rocked, as if someone had stepped onto the front of it.
paras.zh: 马车晃了晃，像是有谁踩上了车头。

paras.en: Then, to my horror, it began to move.
paras.zh: 接着，令我惊恐的是，它动了起来。

paras.en: I struggled to peek out from under the cloak.
paras.zh: 我挣扎着想从斗篷下偷看。

paras.en: I needed to jump out of the wagon while I still could.
paras.zh: 我得趁还来得及跳下马车。

paras.en: Run back to the safety of the forest.
paras.zh: 跑回安全的森林。

paras.en: But there, riding behind the wagon, were three Arendellian soldiers armed with sharp swords. “Do you see any of those traitors?” one of them asked the others, his eyes darting suspiciously in all directions, his voice rough from inhaling smoke. “If I did, I wouldn’t be standing here talking to you,” stated “I can’t believe it!
paras.zh: 可马车后头，正骑着三个佩着利剑的阿伦黛尔士兵。“看见那些叛徒了吗？”其中一个朝另两个问道，眼睛狐疑地四下乱瞟，声音被烟呛得沙哑。“要看见了，我就不会站在这儿跟你说话了，”另一个一口断定。“真不敢相信！

paras.en: We came in peace!
paras.zh: 我们是带着和平来的！

paras.en: We built them a dam!
paras.zh: 我们还给他们修了大坝！

paras.en: And this is how they repay us?
paras.zh: 这就是他们给我们的回报？

paras.en: With sorcery?
paras.zh: 用妖术？

paras.en: Trickery?” the third shouted, his horse dancing under him as it felt his tension.
paras.zh: 用诡计？”第三个士兵喊道，他的马感受到他的紧张，不安地踏着步。

paras.en: My heart panged in horror, refusing to believe the soldiers’ hateful words.
paras.zh: 我的心痛苦地一抽，不愿相信士兵们这些充满恨意的话。

paras.en: We were a peaceful people.
paras.zh: 我们是个和平的民族。

paras.en: We’d welcomed the Arendellians to our land.
paras.zh: 我们曾欢迎阿伦黛尔人来到我们的土地。

paras.en: Accepted their gift of the dam.
paras.zh: 接受了他们大坝的馈赠。

paras.en: Why would we rise up against them now?
paras.zh: 我们为什么要起来反抗他们？

paras.en: As for magic or sorcery—we didn’t have any.
paras.zh: 至于魔法或妖术——我们根本没有。

paras.en: We used only the gifts given to us from the spirits.
paras.zh: 我们用的，只是精灵赐予的礼物。

paras.en: The elders had been very clear on that from the first day we met the Arendellians.
paras.zh: 从我们遇见阿伦黛尔人的第一天起，长老们就把这话讲得明明白白。

paras.en: At that moment there was another gust of wind.
paras.zh: 就在这时，又起了一阵风。

paras.en: At first I thought it was Gale, maybe rushing in to save me from my fate.
paras.zh: 起初我以为那是盖尔，也许是赶来把我从这场厄运里救出。

paras.en: Instead, a thick, heavy mist seemed to drop from the sky, settling down onto the earth like a giant wall behind us.
paras.zh: 可结果，一团厚重浓密的雾似乎从天上降下，像一堵巨墙落在我们身后的大地上。

paras.en: It blocked out the forest, from sky to ground, as far as my eyes could see.
paras.zh: 它挡住了森林，从天空到地面，望不到边。

paras.en: The wagons ground to a halt.
paras.zh: 马车嘎吱一声停住了。

paras.en: The soldiers called out in alarm, staring at the shimmering gray fog in dismay. “More black magic!” one of them muttered, making strange patterns with his hands, as if to ward off whatever it was. “Evil sorcery!” “Let’s get out of here,” the other barked. “Before it comes for us, too!” My heart lurched.
paras.zh: 士兵们惊叫起来，绝望地盯着那闪着微光的灰雾。“又是黑魔法！”其中一个嘟囔着，双手胡乱比划，像要挡开那东西。“邪恶的妖术！”“快离开这儿，”另一个喝道。“趁它还没来找我们！”我的心猛地一沉。

paras.en: What was happening?
paras.zh: 到底发生了什么？

paras.en: My home!
paras.zh: 我的家！

paras.en: My family!
paras.zh: 我的家人！

paras.en: Trapped behind some kind of wall—and I was on the wrong side.
paras.zh: 被一道墙困在后面——而我却在墙的错误一侧。

paras.en: I had to return before it was too late.
paras.zh: 我得在太迟之前回去。

paras.en: Or was it already too late?
paras.zh: 还是说，已经太迟了？

paras.en: If I showed myself now, the soldiers might declare me a traitor.
paras.zh: 要是我现在现身，士兵们也许会宣布我是叛徒。

paras.en: But if I didn’t, I might lose my entire world.
paras.zh: 可要是我不现身，我也许会失去整个世界。

paras.en: Panic flared inside me.
paras.zh: 恐慌在我心里燃起。

paras.en: What should I do?
paras.zh: 我该怎么办？

paras.en: Suddenly, I felt a flutter of movement beside me.
paras.zh: 忽然，我感觉到身旁一阵轻微的动静。

paras.en: I glanced over.
paras.zh: 我侧头一看。

paras.en: Agnarr had woken—though maybe not completely.
paras.zh: 安格瑞醒了——虽说也许没完全清醒。

paras.en: He blinked, looking at me with sleepy green eyes.
paras.zh: 他眨着眼，用睡意蒙眬的绿眼睛望着我。

paras.en: For a moment our gazes locked.
paras.zh: 有那么一瞬，我们的目光锁在了一起。

paras.en: My heart thudded.
paras.zh: 我的心咚地一跳。

paras.en: I shook my head, glancing back at the growing mist and letting out a small moan.
paras.zh: 我摇摇头，回头望向越来越浓的雾，发出一声低低的呻吟。

paras.en: Agnarr took my trembling hand in his and squeezed so lightly I could barely feel it.
paras.zh: 安格瑞把我颤抖的手握进他掌心，轻轻一捏，轻得我几乎察觉不到。

paras.en: Yet at the same time, it was as if I could feel nothing else in the world. “It’s going to be okay,” he whispered.
paras.zh: 可与此同时，又好像世上其他一切都感觉不到了。“会没事的，”他低语。

paras.en: With his free hand, he reached into his pocket and pulled out a small wrapped square.
paras.zh: 他腾出另一只手，伸进口袋，掏出一个用纸包着的小方块。

paras.en: I opened the paper tentatively, revealing a tiny block of that brown stuff I’d tasted in the tents.
paras.zh: 我迟疑地打开纸包，露出一小块我在帐篷里尝过的那种褐色东西。

paras.en: Shocked, I returned my gaze to Agnarr, who smiled. “Chocolate makes everything better,” he whispered.
paras.zh: 我惊讶地抬眼望回安格瑞，他笑了。“巧克力能让一切变好，”他低语。

paras.en: Then his eyes closed again and his breathing slowed.
paras.zh: 然后他的眼睛又合上，呼吸慢了下来。

paras.en: He’d fallen back asleep.
paras.zh: 他又睡着了。

paras.en: But his hand remained in my own as the wagons rolled on, away from the mist.
paras.zh: 可马车驶离迷雾、一路向前时，他的手仍握在我的手里。

paras.en: Resigned, I settled down under my cloak, slipping the block of chocolate into my mouth.
paras.zh: 我认了命，在斗篷下安顿下来，把那块巧克力含进嘴里。

paras.en: Its sweetness could only be rivaled by the warmth of Agnarr’s hand.
paras.zh: 它的甜，只有安格瑞手心的暖意能与之相比。

paras.en: Like it or not, I was going to Arendelle.
paras.zh: 不管愿不愿意，我是要去阿伦黛尔了。

paras.en: But as to whether it would be okay?
paras.zh: 至于会不会真的没事？

paras.en: Only Ahtohallan knows.
paras.zh: 只有阿图哈兰知道。

paras.en: “THERE’S SOMEONE ELSE IN THE WAGON!” I woke in confusion as the Arendellian cloak was ripped from my head and body, the sudden burst of sunlight nearly blinding me after a night spent in darkness.
paras.zh: “车里还有别人！”阿伦黛尔斗篷被人从我和头上扯下，我迷迷糊糊地醒了；在黑暗里过了一夜之后，突然的阳光几乎刺瞎了我的眼。

paras.en: I blinked rapidly, trying to gain my bearings as my heart thudded with rising panic.
paras.zh: 我飞快地眨着眼，努力辨清方位，心随着不断升腾的恐慌咚咚直跳。

paras.en: Where was I?
paras.zh: 我在哪儿？

paras.en: Why did I ache so much?
paras.zh: 为什么我浑身这么疼？

paras.en: And who were these large, strangely dressed men leaning over me with confused looks on their bearded faces?
paras.zh: 还有，这几个身材高大、穿着古怪、留着胡子、一脸困惑地俯身看我的男人又是谁？

paras.en: I pulled the cloak back over my shoulders, huddling in fear.
paras.zh: 我把斗篷重新拉上肩，吓得缩成一团。

paras.en: It came back to me in a rush.
paras.zh: 记忆一下子全涌了回来。

paras.en: The celebration.
paras.zh: 那场庆典。

paras.en: The battle.
paras.zh: 那场战斗。

paras.en: The boy I’d saved.
paras.zh: 我救下的那个男孩。

paras.en: The trap I’d somehow found myself in.
paras.zh: 还有我不知怎的陷进去的这个困局。

paras.en: The mist falling over the forest.
paras.zh: 落向森林的那片迷雾。

paras.en: I struggled to sit up, fear raging through me like wildfire.
paras.zh: 我挣扎着想坐起来，恐惧像野火一样在我体内烧。

paras.en: Where was Agnarr?
paras.zh: 安格瑞在哪儿？

paras.en: Had I really slept through them taking him out of the wagon?
paras.zh: 我真的在他们把他抬出马车时睡死过去了吗？

paras.en: I thought back to his hand clasping mine, to his promise that everything would be okay.
paras.zh: 我想起他握着我的手，想起他许诺一切都会没事。

paras.en: But now he was gone.
paras.zh: 可现在他不见了。

paras.en: And I was with men who would rather see me dead.
paras.zh: 而我身边这些男人，巴不得我死。

paras.en: I tried to dart away, leaping from the wagon.
paras.zh: 我试图窜出去，从马车上跳下。

paras.en: But I landed wrong, on legs that had moments before been fast asleep.
paras.zh: 可我落地姿势不对，用的偏偏是刚才还麻着的腿。

paras.en: A jarring pain shot through my ankle and up my calf, and I I bit my lip, realizing I’d made a huge mistake. “Who are you, girl?” one man demanded. “Why were you trying to run?” I blinked up at them, terror making it impossible to speak.
paras.zh: 一阵钻心的痛从脚踝窜向小腿，我……我咬住嘴唇，意识到自己犯了大错。“你是谁，丫头？”一个男人喝问。“你为什么要跑？”我抬眼眨巴着看他们，恐惧堵得我说不出话。

paras.en: My mind flashed back to the soldier’s words the day before.
paras.zh: 我的脑海闪回前一天那士兵的话。

paras.en: I’d slash them all down. “You don’t think she’s one of them The first man spit on the ground, then grabbed me roughly by the arm, pulling me to my feet.
paras.zh: 我会把他们全都砍倒。“你不觉得她就是他们中的……”第一个男人往地上啐了一口，随后粗暴地一把抓住我的胳膊，把我拽起来。

paras.en: I winced as pain shot up my leg all over again, but gritted my teeth, refusing to let them see me cry.
paras.zh: 痛又顺着腿窜上来，我龇牙忍着，却咬紧牙关，不肯让他们看见我哭。

paras.en: The man clasped his meaty hands on my face, turning me left, then right. “Well, speak up, girl!” I withdrew into myself, hunching my shoulders and dropping my chin.
paras.zh: 那男人用他肉乎乎的双手捧住我的脸，左转右转。“喂，说话呀，丫头！”我缩进自己世界里，耸起肩膀，低下下巴。

paras.en: My whole body was shaking with fear.
paras.zh: 我整个人怕得发抖。

paras.en: I tried to tell myself that maybe this was simply a dream, that I’d wake up any second back in the forest, cuddled under a pile of reindeer hides.
paras.zh: 我试着告诉自己，也许这只是个梦，我随时会醒来，回到森林里，蜷在一堆驯鹿皮底下。

paras.en: But truth be told, it didn’t feel like a dream.
paras.zh: 可说真的，这不像梦。

paras.en: It felt more like a nightmare.
paras.zh: 倒更像场噩梦。

paras.en: I opened my mouth and attempted to speak, though I had no idea what I could say to save myself.
paras.zh: 我张开嘴想说话，尽管根本不知道说什么是能救自己的。

paras.en: Why, oh, why had I fallen asleep in the wagon?
paras.zh: 天哪，我为什么要在马车里睡着？

paras.en: If I had been awake when they stopped, I could have snuck away somehow.
paras.zh: 要是他们停下时我醒着，我总能想办法溜走的。

paras.en: But now I was in the center of their city, stone buildings rising up in all directions, blocking my path.
paras.zh: 可如今我在他们的城中央，石砌的楼房四面耸起，挡住了我的去路。

paras.en: And with my injured ankle?
paras.zh: 况且我的脚踝还伤着？

paras.en: There was no escaping my fate.
paras.zh: 我是逃不脱这命运的。

paras.en: Where was Gale?
paras.zh: 盖尔在哪儿？

paras.en: If Gale were here, just maybe it would distract them—give me a chance to slip away.
paras.zh: 要是盖尔在，也许能引开他们——给我一个溜走的机会。

paras.en: I whispered our song under my breath, but the air remained dead as that on a hot summer’s day, not even a hint of a breeze in this strange town’s center.
paras.zh: 我压着嗓子低声唱起我们的歌，可空气死寂得像盛夏正午，在这怪异的城中心连一丝风都没有。

paras.en: I saw no sign of any rescue from my spirit friend. “All right now, what’s the meaning of this?” demanded someone new who had suddenly burst onto the scene.
paras.zh: 没见我的精灵朋友来救我。“好了，这到底是怎么回事？”一个忽然闯进场的人发问道。

paras.en: A man with a full head of dark hair pushed his way through the others.
paras.zh: 一个满头黑发的男人从其他人中间挤了过来。

paras.en: He was wearing a fancy suit the color of lingonberries; the way the others quickly scattered as he approached told me he was in charge. “This girl, sir.
paras.zh: 他穿着一身越橘色的高级西装；旁人一见他走近就慌忙散开，这让我明白他是管事的。“这丫头，长官。

paras.en: We found her in the wagon.
paras.zh: 我们在马车里发现了她。

paras.en: But all the children who traveled to the dam with us have already been accounted for.
paras.zh: 不过跟我们到大坝去的孩子都清点过了，没有她。

paras.en: And she refuses to say who she is.” When he reached me, he stared down, searching my face with eyes the color of the brown blocks Agnarr had called chocolate.
paras.zh: 而且她不肯说自己是哪家的。”他走到我跟前，低头盯着我，用安格瑞称作巧克力的那种褐块颜色的眼睛打量我的脸。

paras.en: I let out an involuntary whimper, the fear inside me so strong I was afraid I would throw up on his shoes. “Please,” I whispered, my voice hoarse from the smoke I’d inhaled.
paras.zh: 我不受控制地呜咽了一声，内心的恐惧强得让我怕自己会吐在他鞋上。“求求您，”我低语，声音被吸进的烟呛得沙哑。

paras.en: Though I hardly knew what I was asking for.
paras.zh: 尽管我几乎不知道自己在求什么。

paras.en: Mercy?
paras.zh: 饶命？

paras.en: Why would they grant me mercy when they believed my family had slaughtered their people in cold blood?
paras.zh: 他们都以为我的族人在冷血地屠杀他们的人，又怎么会饶我？

paras.en: To them, I was a monster.
paras.zh: 在他们眼里，我是个怪物。

paras.en: A sorceress.
paras.zh: 一个女巫。

paras.en: I was— “A child!” the man exclaimed, his voice filled with wonder. “Why, you’re just a little girl.” “I’m twelve,” I blurted out before I could stop myself. “I am nearly a woman.” My voice, which I wanted to sound strong, came out more like a squeak.
paras.zh: 我是——“是个孩子！”那男人惊叹，声音里满是惊奇。“哎呀，你不过是个小姑娘。”“我十二了，”我还没来得及住嘴就冲口而出。“我都快是大人了。”我的声音本想显得有力，出口却更像一声吱吱叫。

paras.en: To my surprise, he laughed, laying a kind hand on my shoulder. “My mistake,” he told me. “Of course.
paras.zh: 出乎我意料，他笑了，温和地把手搭在我肩上。“是我弄错了，”他对我说。“当然。

paras.en: And you are quite the fine lady at that.” I swallowed hard, dropping my gaze to the ground.
paras.zh: 而且你还是位挺体面的小淑女呢。”我用力咽了下，把目光垂向地面。

paras.en: The cloak I still wore slid off my shoulders, revealing my mother’s shawl tied around my neck.
paras.zh: 我仍穿着的斗篷从肩头滑落，露出系在脖子上的、我母亲的披肩。

paras.en: The man’s eyes widened as they took in the shawl.
paras.zh: 那男人看清披肩，眼睛一下子睁大了。

paras.en: Then he quickly grabbed the cloak and dropped to his knees in front of me to settle it back on my shoulders. “What is your name?” he whispered, his face inches from mine.
paras.zh: 接着他连忙抓起斗篷，在我面前单膝跪下，把它重新搭回我肩上。“你叫什么名字？”他低语，脸离我只有几寸。

paras.en: I was surprised at the sudden gravity of his voice. “Iduna,” I whispered back, glancing worriedly at the men on either side, who were still giving me suspicious looks.
paras.zh: 他语气里忽然的郑重让我吃了一惊。“伊杜娜，”我低声回道，忧心忡忡地瞥了瞥两旁仍用怀疑目光看我的男人。

paras.en: The man in charge slapped his hand on his forehead. “Iduna!
paras.zh: 管事的男人一拍额头。“伊杜娜！

paras.en: Of course!” he cried, his voice suddenly loud as he rose back to I opened my mouth to protest.
paras.zh: 当然是你！”他喊道，声音忽然拔高，一边直起身……我张开嘴想抗议。

paras.en: Greta?
paras.zh: 葛蕾塔？

paras.en: Torra?
paras.zh: 托拉？

paras.en: The others gathered back around me, looking at me with new eyes.
paras.zh: 其他人又围拢过来，用全新的眼神打量我。

paras.en: I had been right about this man being in charge; when he spoke, they listened.
paras.zh: 我没猜错，这人确实管事；他一开口，别人就听。

paras.en: And more important, they believed. “Poor lass,” remarked the man who had dragged me off the wagon, shaking his head with sorrow. “I’m so sorry about your parents.” His face twisted. “I promise you, those Northuldra sorcerers will pay for their crimes!
paras.zh: 更重要的是，他们信了。“可怜的孩子，”那个把我从马车上拖下来的男人摇着头、满脸悲悯地说。“你父母的事，我实在难过。”他脸扭成一团。“我向你保证，那些北地女巫一定会为她们的罪行付出代价！

paras.en: If it takes me till my dying day!” He squeezed his right hand into a fist, so tight his knuckles turned white.
paras.zh: 就算追到我死那天也在所不辞！”他右手攥成拳头，攥得指节发白。

paras.en: Then he waved his fist in the air as if he was ready to take on the entire Northuldra people right that very second.
paras.zh: 接着他朝空中挥着拳头，像随时要单挑整个北地民族。

paras.en: Frightened, I edged backward to get out of his punching range.
paras.zh: 我吓坏了，往后缩想躲出他拳头的范围。

paras.en: The man in charge groaned, grabbing the angry man’s fist and lowering it back to his side with some force.
paras.zh: 管事的男人叹了口气，一把抓住那愤怒男人的拳头，用力按回他身侧。

paras.en: Then he turned back to me. “It is indeed very tragic I forced a nod, even though the lump in my throat had grown so large I felt like I would choke on it.
paras.zh: 然后他转回来看我。“这确实非常悲惨……”我勉强点了点头，尽管喉咙里的硬块已大得让我几乎要噎住。

paras.en: I wanted to protest, to declare I would never be one of them.
paras.zh: 我想抗议，想声明我绝不会是他们中的一员。

paras.en: These strange people in their strange town were as unlike me as the sun was unlike the moon.
paras.zh: 这些怪人，住在这座怪城里，跟我的差别就像太阳之不同于月亮。

paras.en: But I kept silent.
paras.zh: 可我保持沉默。

paras.en: Instead I nodded, pulling the Arendellian cloak tighter over my body. “Thank you,” I forced myself to say. “You are too kind, sir.” The man’s shoulders relaxed.
paras.zh: 我只是点头，把阿伦黛尔斗篷往身上裹紧。“谢谢您，”我逼自己说出。“您太好了，大人。”那男人的肩膀松弛下来。

paras.en: He knew I had gotten his The other men grunted but didn’t argue, scattering from the wagon to go back to their homes.
paras.zh: 他明白我听懂了他的……其他男人咕哝几句，却没反驳，从马车边散开，各自回家去了。

paras.en: The man watched them go, then turned to me. “I am Lord Peterssen,” he said in a soft voice. “And you needn’t be afraid.
paras.zh: 那男人目送他们离去，然后转向我。“我是彼得森大人，”他柔声说。“你不必害怕。

paras.en: I meant what I said.
paras.zh: 我说到做到。

paras.en: No harm will come to you.” I nodded meekly.
paras.zh: 不会有人伤你。”我温顺地点点头。

paras.en: What else could I do?
paras.zh: 我还能怎么办呢？

paras.en: He held out a hand, helping me out of the wagon. “Come,” he said. “I will take you home.”
paras.zh: 他伸出手，扶我下马车。“来，”他说。“我带你回家。”

paras.en: “AH, YOUNG PRINCE, YOU ARE AWAKE AT LAST.” I opened my eyes blearily, my vision still spotted as I looked around the room.
paras.zh: “啊，小王子，你终于醒了。”我睡眼惺忪地睁开眼，视线还带着斑点在屋里张望。

paras.en: Even so, I recognized it immediately.
paras.zh: 即便如此，我一眼就认出了这里。

paras.en: The rich greens and browns.
paras.zh: 浓重的绿与棕。

paras.en: The rosemaling scrollwork trailing down walls, embedded in doorways.
paras.zh: 顺着墙蔓延、嵌在门框里的玫瑰彩绘纹饰。

paras.en: The thick beige curtains of the canopy bed.
paras.zh: 四柱床上厚实的米色帐帘。

paras.en: The roaring fire in the hearth.
paras.zh: 壁炉里熊熊的火。

paras.en: I was home.
paras.zh: 我回家了。

paras.en: In Arendelle.
paras.zh: 在阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: In my bedroom.
paras.zh: 在我的卧室。

paras.en: Had it all been a dream?
paras.zh: 难道一切都是一场梦？

paras.en: The forest?
paras.zh: 那片森林？

paras.en: The battle?
paras.zh: 那场战斗？

paras.en: But no, my body felt as if it had been run over by a herd of reindeer.
paras.zh: 可不对，我的身体像被一群驯鹿碾过。

paras.en: And when I attempted to sit up, my head spun and I quickly collapsed back onto my feather pillow.
paras.zh: 我试着坐起来，头一阵发晕，连忙又倒回羽毛枕上。

paras.en: The castle overseer, Kai, hovered over me, clucking his tongue. “Take it easy,” he scolded. “You’ve had a rough go of it.
paras.zh: 管家凯俯身在我上方，咂着嘴。“悠着点，”他责备道。“你这一遭可够呛。

paras.en: It’s going to take a while for you to be on the mend.” I nodded slightly.
paras.zh: 你得一段时间才能康复。”我微微点头。

paras.en: Even the small movement of my head against the pillow seemed to take a herculean effort.
paras.zh: 就连头在枕上这么轻微的动一下，都像用了洪荒之力。

paras.en: I closed my eyes, trying to pull together memories of what had happened.
paras.zh: 我闭上眼，想把发生过的事拼凑起来。

paras.en: How I’d ended up here, like this.
paras.zh: 我是怎么落到这步田地的。

paras.en: A day of celebration, twisted into violence.
paras.zh: 本该庆祝的一天，扭曲成了暴力。

paras.en: Northuldra and Arendellians, fighting one another.
paras.zh: 北地人和阿伦黛尔人，互相厮杀。

paras.en: Then fire.
paras.zh: 然后是火。

paras.en: Wind.
paras.zh: 风。

paras.en: Smoke.
paras.zh: 烟。

paras.en: Papa… My eyes flew open. “Is Papa dead?” I asked, my voice raw.
paras.zh: 爸爸……我猛地睁眼。“爸爸死了吗？”我问，声音嘶哑。

paras.en: But even as I asked the question, I realized I already knew.
paras.zh: 可就连问出这话的同时，我已知道自己知道答案。

paras.en: I had seen it.
paras.zh: 我看见了。

paras.en: My father, battling the Northuldra at the side of the dam.
paras.zh: 我父亲，在大坝边与北地人搏斗。

paras.en: His foot slipping.
paras.zh: 他的脚一滑。

paras.en: His arms flailing.
paras.zh: 双臂乱挥。

paras.en: Oh, no.
paras.zh: 哦，不。

paras.en: No, no, no!
paras.zh: 不，不，不！

paras.en: Kai gave me an anguished look, turning away.
paras.zh: 凯给了我一个痛苦的眼神，转开了脸。

paras.en: His gaze shot to the back of the room as if it held all of life’s answers.
paras.zh: 他的目光射向房间后方，像那里藏着人生所有答案。

paras.en: A figure stepped from the doorway.
paras.zh: 一个身影从门口走出。

paras.en: It was Lord Peterssen, one of my father’s trusted advisors.
paras.zh: 是彼得森大人，父亲信任的顾问之一。

paras.en: To my surprise, he dropped to one knee beside my bed. “Your Highness,” he said, lowering his head in a bow. “I am sorry to be the bearer of such terrible news.” He straightened, then looked me right in the eyes.
paras.zh: 出乎我意料，他在我床边单膝跪下。“殿下，”他说着低头行礼。“很遗憾，由我带来如此可怕的消息。”他直起身，直视我的眼睛。

paras.en: His own were solemn as the grave. “Your father is lost.
paras.zh: 他的眼神庄重如墓。“你父亲已经不在了。

paras.en: Perished in the battle between us and the Northuldra.” My heart wrenched.
paras.zh: 丧生于我们与北地人的那一战中。”我的心像被拧了一下。

paras.en: It was true then.
paras.zh: 那是真的了。

paras.en: My father.
paras.zh: 我的父亲。

paras.en: Gone.
paras.zh: 没了。

paras.en: The strongest, most powerful man I’d ever met.
paras.zh: 我见过最强壮、最有力量的男人。

paras.en: The noble leader the Arendellians sang of in the taverns.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔人在酒馆里传唱的那位高贵领袖。

paras.en: The man who had devoted his entire life to keeping Arendelle safe and helping it prosper.
paras.zh: 那个把一生都献给了守护阿伦黛尔、让它繁荣的人。

paras.en: Gone.
paras.zh: 没了。

paras.en: Just like that.
paras.zh: 就这么没了。

paras.en: Guilt assailed me as my mind flashed back to our last hours together.
paras.zh: 愧疚向我袭来，脑海闪回我们最后相处的时光。

paras.en: He’d been furious at me for wandering off.
paras.zh: 他因为我乱跑而大发雷霆。

paras.en: And why had I wandered off, anyway?
paras.zh: 再说，我当初为什么要乱跑？

paras.en: I could have spent the day with him, helping him organize any loose ends with the Northuldra regarding the dam, serving as his squire.
paras.zh: 我本可以陪他一整天，帮他料理大坝方面和北地人之间没谈妥的琐碎事，当他的侍从。

paras.en: Maybe if I’d been there, I would have noticed something was wrong.
paras.zh: 也许我若在场，就能察觉出不对劲。

paras.en: I was good at that—seeing things that no one else did.
paras.zh: 我擅长这个——看见别人看不见的东西。

paras.en: Maybe I could have warned him before it was too late.
paras.zh: 也许我能在太迟之前警告他。

paras.en: But I’d failed again.
paras.zh: 可我又一次失败了。

paras.en: I’d always been such a disappointment to my father.
paras.zh: 我向来让父亲那么失望。

paras.en: Maybe it was my fault he was dead.
paras.zh: 也许他的死是我的错。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen rose to his feet, putting a fatherly hand on my shoulder. “I am so sorry,” he said again. “Arendelle has lost a good man.
paras.zh: 彼得森大人站起身，像父亲一样把手搭在我肩上。“我真的很抱歉，”他又说。“阿伦黛尔失去了一个好人。

paras.en: A good king.
paras.zh: 一位好国王。

paras.en: We will all miss him.” A sudden horrifying thought came to me. “And…” I struggled to sit up again, ignoring my aching head. “What of Lieutenant Mattias?
paras.zh: 我们都会想他的。”一个忽然冒出的可怕念头击中了我。“那……”我忍着头痛，又挣扎着坐起。“马蒂亚斯中尉呢？

paras.en: Is he…?” I trailed off, not able to form the words.
paras.zh: 他还……？”我说不下去，吐不出后面的字。

paras.en: I tried The thought of losing my father and my friend on the same day was almost too much to bear.
paras.zh: 我试着……一想到同一天失去父亲和挚友，我几乎承受不住。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen shook his head slowly. “We don’t know what happened to him,” he admitted. “Some say he was still fighting when the mist rolled in.” I squinted at him in confusion. “The mist?” He nodded. “They say it fell from the sky.
paras.zh: 彼得森大人缓缓摇头。“我们不知道他怎样了，”他坦言。“有人说迷雾卷来时他还在战斗。”我困惑地眯起眼。“迷雾？”他点头。“据说它从天而降。

paras.en: Dropping down over the forest, heavy and thick.
paras.zh: 沉沉厚厚的，落下来罩住森林。

paras.en: So thick no one could penetrate it.
paras.zh: 厚得没人能穿过去。

paras.en: Many of our people were trapped—are still trapped—on the other side.” “But that’s crazy!” I cried. “A mist can’t trap people.
paras.zh: 我们很多人在那一边被困住了——至今仍被困着。”“可这太荒唐了！”我喊道。“雾困不住人。

paras.en: It’s not solid.” “This one is,” Peterssen said solemnly. “I rode out yesterday to see it for myself.
paras.zh: 它不是实心的。”“这一团是，”彼得森庄重地说。“我昨天亲自骑马去看了。

paras.en: It’s as solid as this wall right here.” He rapped his knuckles lightly against my bedroom wall. “And from what we can tell, there’s no way in and no way out.” Fear thrummed through me.
paras.zh: 它硬得就跟这墙一样。”他用指节轻轻敲了敲我的卧室墙。“据我们所知，进不去，也出不来。”恐惧在我体内嗡嗡作响。

paras.en: My father had instilled in me from a young age awareness of the dangers of magic and sorcery.
paras.zh: 父亲从小就在我心里种下对魔法与妖术之危险的警觉。

paras.en: It was powerful.
paras.zh: 它很强大。

paras.en: Wicked.
paras.zh: 邪恶。

paras.en: A man who wielded magic did not fight fair.
paras.zh: 用魔法的人，打仗不守规矩。

paras.en: Sorcery corrupted the very soul, turning it black as night. “Was it the Northuldra who did it?
paras.zh: 妖术会腐蚀灵魂，把它染得夜一样黑。“是北地人干的吗？

paras.en: Are they magical?” I whispered, suddenly remembering the girl I’d watched in the forest.
paras.zh: 他们有魔法？”我低语，忽然想起森林里我见过的那个女孩。

paras.en: The one dancing in the wind.
paras.zh: 那个在风里起舞的。

paras.en: She’d been like a fairy from a storybook.
paras.zh: 她像故事书里飞出来的精灵。

paras.en: Lithe, ethereal.
paras.zh: 轻盈，缥缈。

paras.en: In that moment, I couldn’t have looked away.
paras.zh: 那一刻，我根本挪不开眼。

paras.en: I closed my eyes for a moment, trying to recall more details, but it was mostly a blur apart from that stirring sense I had been witnessing something—and someone—incredible.
paras.zh: 我闭眼片刻，想回想更多细节，可除了那种“正目睹某件、某人不可思议之事”的悸动，其余大多模糊一片。

paras.en: I frowned, frustrated. “Your father believed they were,” Peterssen said. “But from what I saw in my time with the Northuldra as the dam was being constructed, they were simply friends of the elements.
paras.zh: 我皱眉，懊恼。“你父亲相信他们是，”彼得森说。“但就我修大坝时和北地人相处的所见，他们不过是元素的朋友。

paras.en: They used these gifts of nature to help them in their everyday lives.
paras.zh: 他们用这些自然的馈赠来帮自己过日常的日子。

paras.en: But I never saw them use magic of their own.” “But they could have made the mist,” I pushed. “Or asked the elements to do it, right?” “Perhaps.
paras.zh: 但我从没见他们用过自己的魔法。”“可迷雾可能是他们弄的，”我追问。“或者是他们请元素去弄的，对吧？”“也许。

paras.en: Though for what gain I am not sure.
paras.zh: 不过图什么好处，我说不准。

paras.en: As far as we can tell, they were trapped inside as well.” Peterssen sighed. “I promise, Your Highness, we will put our best men on this.
paras.zh: 据我们所知，他们自己也被困在里面了。”彼得森叹气。“我向您保证，殿下，我们会派最得力的人去查这事。

paras.en: To try to answer these questions and find a way through the mist.
paras.zh: 去试着回答这些问题，找出穿过迷雾的法子。

paras.en: But for now, there’s a more pressing issue at hand.” “What’s that?” He gave me a solemn look. “The king is dead.
paras.zh: 但眼下，有更紧迫的事。”“什么事？”他神色庄重。“国王驾崩了。

paras.en: And you, Your Highness, are his only son…and therefore heir to the throne of Arendelle.” Horror shot through me.
paras.zh: 而您，殿下，是他唯一的儿子……因此也就是阿伦黛尔王位的继承人。”恐惧击穿了我。

paras.en: Of course, on some level I knew this, deep down.
paras.zh: 当然，在某种深处，我本就知道。

paras.en: But to hear it spoken aloud… “I’m too young to be king!” I blurted out before I could stop myself.
paras.zh: 可亲耳听人说出……“我太小了，当不了国王！”我没忍住就冲口而出。

paras.en: I took a deep breath, trying to focus, or at least appear focused on the outside.
paras.zh: 我深吸一口气，努力集中精神，或至少在外表上显得集中。

paras.en: This time when I spoke, I hoped I came off as calm. “I’m fourteen.
paras.zh: 这次开口，我希望自己显得镇定。“我十四岁。

paras.en: I’m not prepared to rule a kingdom.” Peterssen laid a gentle but firm hand on my arm. “Perhaps not yet,” he agreed. “Your father knew his death would come someday and stated that if you were not yet of age when it came to pass, I would serve as regent to the kingdom in your stead.
paras.zh: 我还没准备好治理一个国家。”彼得森把手温和而坚定地搭在我臂上。“也许还没准备好，”他认同。“你父亲知道终有一天他会死，也说过若到那时你还未到年纪，就由我代你摄政。

paras.en: Of course, I would not act without your approval,” he added quickly. “But if you trust me, I will do my best to keep Arendelle in peace and prosperity until you come of age.” Relief flooded through me.
paras.zh: 当然，没有你的准允我不会擅自行事，”他连忙补充。“但如果你信我，我会尽全力让阿伦黛尔在你成年前保持和平繁荣。”我如释重负。

paras.en: This was exactly what I needed to hear.
paras.zh: 这正是对我胃口的话。

paras.en: Someone besides me was still in charge. “Thank goodness,” I murmured under my breath.
paras.zh: 除了我，还有人管事。“谢天谢地，”我低声嘟囔。

paras.en: The ache in my head had returned with a vengeance, now accompanied by the bone-deep thrum of loss, and all I wanted was to close my eyes. “We can talk more when you’re fully healed,” Peterssen declared, looking at me with sympathy. “For now, do not worry about a thing.” I began to sink back into my pillow, more than willing to let sleep overtake my aching bones and heart, when a sudden thought came to me. “How did I get out of the forest?” I asked. “I don’t remember.” I squeezed my eyes shut, trying to recall To my surprise, Peterssen didn’t answer at first.
paras.zh: 头里的痛又凶猛地回来了，还伴着深入骨髓的失落嗡鸣，我只想闭上眼。“等你全好了我们再细谈，”彼得森同情地看着我说。“现在什么都别操心。”我正要陷回枕头，巴不得让睡眠盖过我酸痛的骨头和心，忽然一个念头冒出来。“我是怎么出森林的？”我问。“我不记得了。”我紧紧闭眼，想回想……出乎我意料，彼得森起初没答话。

paras.en: Then he shrugged. “We don’t actually know,” he admitted. “The soldiers lost track of you during the fighting.
paras.zh: 然后他耸耸肩。“其实我们也不太清楚，”他坦白。“战斗时士兵们把你跟丢了。

paras.en: But you were found lying in one of their wagons just before the mist rolled in.
paras.zh: 但迷雾卷来前，有人发现你躺在他们一辆马车上。

paras.en: You were hurt.
paras.zh: 你受了伤。

paras.en: Bleeding.
paras.zh: 流着血。

paras.en: Unconscious.
paras.zh: 昏迷不醒。

paras.en: Perhaps you crawled in there yourself and then passed out?” But his voice sounded doubtful, as if he didn’t really believe it.
paras.zh: 也许你自己爬进去就昏过去了？”可他的声音透着怀疑，像他自己也不信。

paras.en: Neither did I.
paras.zh: 我也不信。

paras.en: A voice rose from the deep recesses of my mind.
paras.zh: 一个声音从我心底最深处浮起。

paras.en: The most beautiful voice I’d ever heard, singing a pure, haunting, desperate song that still rang in my ears.
paras.zh: 那是我听过最美的声音，唱着一支纯净、萦绕、绝望的歌，至今还在我耳畔回响。

paras.en: I remembered hearing it back in the forest as I struggled to gain consciousness.
paras.zh: 我记得在森林里、挣扎着想恢复知觉时听过它。

paras.en: Then the feeling of being lifted, but not by human hands.
paras.zh: 然后是被人——不，不是人的手——托起的感觉。

paras.en: And suddenly I was floating….
paras.zh: 忽然，我飘了起来……

paras.en: More magic?
paras.zh: 又是魔法？

paras.en: But no.
paras.zh: 可不是。

paras.en: There was a face.
paras.zh: 有一张脸。

paras.en: Someone There was a knock at the door.
paras.zh: 有人……传来一声敲门。

paras.en: Peterssen gestured for Kai to answer it.
paras.zh: 彼得森示意凯去开门。

paras.en: Gerda, the family steward, stood on the other side, wringing her hands nervously. “Is the prince ready?” she asked. “The people are waiting outside.” I frowned. “Waiting for what?” “For you to address them, of course, Your Highness,” Gerda sputtered.
paras.zh: 管家格尔达站在门外，紧张地绞着手。“王子准备好了吗？”她问。“百姓们都在外面等着呢。”我皱眉。“等什么？”“当然是等你去向他们讲话，殿下，”格尔达语无伦次地说。

paras.en: She turned accusingly to Kai. “Didn’t you tell him?
paras.zh: 她转头责怪地看凯。“你没跟他说吗？

paras.en: They’re all out there.
paras.zh: 他们全在外面。

paras.en: They’re worried.
paras.zh: 他们很担心。

paras.en: They need to see he’s all right.” Peterssen sighed.
paras.zh: 他们得亲眼看见他平安无事。”彼得森叹了口气。

paras.en: He turned to Kai and Gerda. “Leave us,” he commanded. “I will see to it myself that His Highness is ready to address his subjects.” Gerda responded with an unhappy snort, as if this wasn’t how things were supposed to be done, but thankfully exited the room, followed by Kai.
paras.zh: 他转向凯和格尔达。“你们先退下，”他命令。“殿下见臣民的事，我自己来安排。”格尔达不乐意地哼了一声，像在说本不该这么办，不过幸好还是退了出去，凯跟在她后面。

paras.en: Peterssen walked over and closed the door behind them, then turned back to me. “What do I have to do?” I asked.
paras.zh: 彼得森走过去在他们身后关上门，再转回来看我。“我得做什么？”我问。

paras.en: My head was still pounding.
paras.zh: 我的头还在突突地痛。

paras.en: I felt as if I was going to be sick. “The people must see you,” Peterssen said. “They are scared.
paras.zh: 我觉得自己快吐了。“百姓们必须见到你，”彼得森说。“他们害怕。

paras.en: They lost loved ones.
paras.zh: 他们失去了亲人。

paras.en: They lost their king.
paras.zh: 他们失去了国王。

paras.en: They must gaze upon their prince now.
paras.zh: 现在他们必须亲眼看见他们的王子。

paras.en: See their country’s future with their own eyes.” I stared at him in horror. “No!
paras.zh: 用自己的眼睛看看国家的未来。”我惊恐地盯着他。“不！

paras.en: I can’t do that.
paras.zh: 我做不到。

paras.en: Not now.
paras.zh: 现在不行。

paras.en: Make them wait!” “They’ve waited three days already.
paras.zh: 让他们等着！”“他们已经等了三天了。

paras.en: It is time.” “Please,” I said, trying my best not to beg. “It’s too soon.” Peterssen’s face softened.
paras.zh: 是时候了。”“求您了，”我尽量不显得在哀求。“太早了。”彼得森脸色软了下来。

paras.en: He knelt down before me, taking my hand in his own. “Sometimes a king doesn’t have the luxury of grief,” he explained slowly. “He must put his people’s feelings before his own.
paras.zh: 他在我面前跪下，把我的手握进他手。“有时，国王没有哀悼的奢侈，”他缓缓解释。“他得把百姓的感受放在自己之前。

paras.en: When you go out there, you must stand taller than you are.
paras.zh: 你出去时，必须站得比你自己更高。

paras.en: Act braver than you feel.
paras.zh: 表现得比实际更勇敢。

paras.en: Show them, through every move you make, every word you say, that they have nothing to fear.” He gave me a sympathetic look. “You must show them you are not afraid.” “Even when I am,” I said, looking at the ground. “You would be a fool not to be,” Peterssen agreed. “But you must not show that fear to your people.
paras.zh: 用你的一举一动、一言一语告诉他们：没什么好怕的。”他同情地看着我。“你必须让他们看到你不怕。”“哪怕我其实怕，”我低头说。“不怕才是傻子，”彼得森认同。“但你不能把这份怕露给百姓看。

paras.en: Pull it deep inside you.
paras.zh: 把它深深压进体内。

paras.en: Conceal it in your heart.
paras.zh: 藏进心里。

paras.en: Don’t feel it.
paras.zh: 别去感受它。

paras.en: Don’t let it show.” He rose to his feet. “That is what your father did.
paras.zh: 别让它流露。”他站起身。“你父亲就是这么做的。

paras.en: And his father before him.
paras.zh: 他父亲生前也是。

paras.en: That is what kings do to protect their people.
paras.zh: 国王就是这样保护百姓的。

paras.en: And this is what you must do now.” “What if I don’t want to be king?” I blurted out, knowing I sounded like a petulant child, knowing how angry my father would be if he were there to hear me.
paras.zh: 而这也是你现在必须做的。”“要是我不想当国王呢？”我冲口而出，知道自己听着像在耍脾气的小孩，也知道若父亲在旁听见会有多生气。

paras.en: But I wasn’t ready.
paras.zh: 可我没准备好。

paras.en: I hadn’t asked for this.
paras.zh: 这又不是我要的。

paras.en: A week ago, the only thing worrying me was failing my weekly spelling lesson.
paras.zh: 一周前，我唯一操心的还是每周拼写课要挂科。

paras.en: Now I had the responsibility of an entire kingdom?
paras.zh: 现在我要为一个整个王国负责？

paras.en: Real people, with real problems—depending on me.
paras.zh: 真真切切的人，带着真真切切的难题——都指着我。

paras.en: The panic spiraled; I felt the walls closing in on me.
paras.zh: 恐慌螺旋上升；我觉得四壁正朝我压来。

paras.en: Peterssen gave me a sharp look, understanding but maybe growing a little impatient.
paras.zh: 彼得森锐利地看了我一眼，像是理解，又似乎有点不耐烦了。

paras.en: If only Lieutenant Mattias were here.
paras.zh: 要是马蒂亚斯中尉在就好了。

paras.en: What would he say?
paras.zh: 他会怎么说？

paras.en: What would he tell me to do?
paras.zh: 他会叫我怎么做？

paras.en: The next right thing.
paras.zh: 做下一件对的事。

paras.en: I swallowed hard, Mattias’s words seeming to echo in my head, as if they’d been spoken aloud.
paras.zh: 我用力咽下，马蒂亚斯的话仿佛在脑中回响，像被人说出了声。

paras.en: The advice his father had once given him.
paras.zh: 那是他父亲曾给他的忠告。

paras.en: The advice he’d then passed down to me.
paras.zh: 是他又传给了我。

paras.en: Life will sometimes throw you onto a new path, And when it does, don’t give up.
paras.zh: 生活有时会把你抛上一条新路，而那时，别放弃。

paras.en: Take it one step at a time.
paras.zh: 一步一步来。

paras.en: I took several deep breaths, pushing the panic down.
paras.zh: 我深吸几口气，把恐慌压下去。

paras.en: Then I turned to the lord regent and nodded. “All right,” I said. “I will get dressed, and I will stand before my people.
paras.zh: 然后我转向摄政大人，点了点头。“好吧，”我说。“我去换衣服，去站在我的百姓面前。

paras.en: I owe them that much at least.” Peterssen’s shoulders relaxed. “Very good, Your Highness.
paras.zh: 我至少欠他们这个。”彼得森肩膀松了。“很好，殿下。

paras.en: It will mean a lot to them.
paras.zh: 这对他们意义重大。

paras.en: Shall I send the servants in to help you dress?” “No.
paras.zh: 要我打发仆人进来帮你更衣吗？”“不用。

paras.en: I will do it myself.
paras.zh: 我自己来。

paras.en: Thank you.” The regent nodded and headed out of my bedroom, leaving me alone.
paras.zh: 谢谢。”摄政点点头，走出我的卧室，留我一人。

paras.en: For a moment I just sat there, my thoughts whirring in my head.
paras.zh: 有那么一会儿，我只是坐在那儿，念头在脑中乱转。

paras.en: Then I walked over to the mirror, staring into it.
paras.zh: 然后我走到镜子前，盯着里头的自己。

paras.en: My eyes were hollow, shadowed by black circles.
paras.zh: 我的眼窝凹陷，挂着黑眼圈。

paras.en: My skin was pale as milk.
paras.zh: 我的皮肤白得像牛奶。

paras.en: My hair had been shorn close to my head, probably so they could sew up my wound.
paras.zh: 我的头发被剃得紧贴头皮，大概是为了缝我的伤口。

paras.en: I don’t look anything like a king, I closed my eyes. “Conceal, don’t feel,” I murmured to myself, repeating Peterssen’s words. “Don’t let it show.” I opened my eyes.
paras.zh: 我一点都不像国王，我闭上眼。“隐藏，别去感受，”我对自己喃喃，重复彼得森的话。“别让它流露。”我睁开眼。

paras.en: Squared my jaw.
paras.zh: 我绷紧了下巴。

paras.en: I could do this.
paras.zh: 我能做到。

paras.en: I had It was the next right thing.
paras.zh: 我……这是下一件对的事。

chapters.title: Chapter Five: Iduna: One Month Later

paras.en: “ROAR!

I AM EVIL NORTHULDRA AND I WILL kill you deader than dead!” I startled awake from my nap as two orphan children, a boy and a girl around six years old, raced into the dormitory, one chasing the other, a wicked grin on the chaser’s face.
paras.zh: 我是邪恶的北地人，要把你杀得死透了！”我本在打盹，被猛地惊醒——两个六七岁的孤儿，一男一女，冲进宿舍，一个追着一个，追击者脸上挂着坏笑。

paras.en: The boy squealed, diving onto my bed and trying to hide behind me to escape the “evil Northuldra” while she jumped on top of him, grabbing the pillow from under my head and smashing it into his face. “I will cast a horrible spell on you!” she jeered. “You will burst into flames!” I stumbled out of bed, out of their line of destruction, still disoriented from being awoken from a deep sleep.
paras.zh: 男孩尖叫着扑到我的床上，想躲到我身后避开那“邪恶北地人”，而她跳到他身上，从我头下抽出枕头往他脸上砸。“我要对你施可怕的咒语！”她嘲笑。“你会烧成火球！”我从床上踉跄下来，躲开他们的“破坏线”，刚从深睡中被吵醒，还晕乎乎的。

paras.en: The boy grabbed my pillow from the girl, tossing it away.
paras.zh: 男孩从我（女孩）手里抢过枕头，甩到一边。

paras.en: They began wrestling madly until the boy fell off the bed, slamming his head against the wooden floor.
paras.zh: 他们疯了一样扭打，直到男孩从床上摔下，头狠狠磕在木地板上。

paras.en: He burst into tears. “Ow!” he cried, rubbing his head. “You don’t play fair!” “Yeah, well, neither do the Northuldra!” the girl declared mischievously, not looking the least bit sorry for her part in the Suddenly, there were footsteps on the stairs.
paras.zh: 他放声大哭。“嗷！”他揉着脑袋叫。“你耍赖！”“哼，北地人也不耍赖吗！”女孩淘气地宣布，对自己惹的祸一点愧疚样都没有……忽然，楼梯上传来脚步声。

paras.en: The housemother stepped into the doorway. “Aryn, Peter!” she scolded. “What did I tell you about roughhousing in the bedroom?” She clapped her hands. “Come now!
paras.zh: 女舍监出现在门口。“阿琳，彼得！”她责备道。“我怎么跟你们说的，不许在寝室里打闹？”她拍拍手。“快点儿！

paras.en: I have plenty of chores to work off that energy!” “Aw!” they moaned in unison, but did as they were told, slinking out of the bedroom to head downstairs.
paras.zh: 我有的是活儿让你们把这股劲儿耗掉！”“啊——”他们齐声哀叹，却还是听话，灰溜溜溜出寝室下楼去了。

paras.en: I was alone again.
paras.zh: 又只剩我一人。

paras.en: I drew in a breath, trying to still my racing heart.
paras.zh: 我吸了口气，想让狂跳的心平静下来。

paras.en: I reached down to collect my mother’s shawl from under the bed and press it to my cheek, relieved that the children’s antics hadn’t unearthed this lone vestige of my previous life.
paras.zh: 我伸手从床下取出母亲的披肩，贴在脸颊上，庆幸孩子们的胡闹没把这仅存的、我旧日生活的痕迹翻出来。

paras.en: A lump rose in my throat as I walked across the room to the tiny window at the far side.
paras.zh: 我走到房间另一头那扇小窗前，喉咙里涌起一个硬块。

paras.en: It had been a month, and I still couldn’t get used to sleeping in here—inside this closed-in, claustrophobic space with its rows of cots and scores of children, so far removed from nature and the elements.
paras.zh: 已经一个月了，我仍不习惯睡在这儿——在这封闭、让人喘不过气的空间里，一排排小床、几十个孩子，离自然和风雨那么远。

paras.en: Back home, the wind rustling the leaves and water tumbling over the stones in the river used to sing me to sleep.
paras.zh: 在家里，风拂过树叶、水越过河中石子的声音，曾是我入睡的摇篮曲。

paras.en: Now all I could hear were the whispers of the other children, telling each other scary stories after the lights went out, usually about the “wicked Northuldra,” as if my family were some kind of magical monsters lurking under the beds, ready to strike.
paras.zh: 现在我能听见的，只有别的孩子的低语——熄灯后他们互相讲恐怖故事，多半是关于“邪恶北地人”，好像我的家人是什么躲在床下、随时会扑出来的魔法怪物。

paras.en: Some of the children in the orphanage had been there at the dam celebration.
paras.zh: 孤儿院里有些孩子，当时也在大坝庆典上。

paras.en: Their parents had been killed, supposedly at Northuldra hands.
paras.zh: 他们的父母死了，据说是死在北地人手里。

paras.en: All they wanted to talk about was how Arendelle would get its revenge, how they would repay these traitors who were given a great gift and returned the favor with murder.
paras.zh: 他们满嘴说的，都是阿伦黛尔将如何复仇，如何回报这些“受了大礼、却以杀戮相报”的叛徒。

paras.en: Yes, their own king had been murdered that day.
paras.zh: 没错，他们自己的国王那天被杀了。

paras.en: They believed one of my elders had killed him, shoving him off a cliff by the side of the dam.
paras.zh: 他们相信是我的某位长老杀了他，把他从大坝边的悬崖推了下去。

paras.en: Which was ridiculous, of course.
paras.zh: 这当然荒唐。

paras.en: There was no way any of our gentle elders would have committed such a violent act against a fellow human.
paras.zh: 我们那些温和的长老，绝不可能对人类同胞下此毒手。

paras.en: Of course, I spoke none of this out loud.
paras.zh: 当然，这些我一句也没说出口。

paras.en: Instead, I stayed silent, minding Lord Peterssen’s warning: if I spoke up and gave Because it wasn’t just the children telling the tales.
paras.zh: 我只是沉默，记着彼得森大人的警告：要是我说出口、露了……因为讲这些故事的，不止是孩子们。

paras.en: Everyone in Arendelle was talking about the Northuldra “traitors” and what they’d do if they ever came across one.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔所有人都在议论北地“叛徒”，以及万一撞见一个会如何处置。

paras.en: If I didn’t keep this secret, I might not live long enough to find my family again.
paras.zh: 我要不守住这秘密，怕是活不到再见到家人的那天。
