paras.en: In all the years Agnarr and I had been close, he’d never once mentioned wanting to find his rescuer.
paras.zh: 这些年和安格瑞这么亲近，他从未提过想找他的救命恩人。

paras.en: I had begun to wonder if he remembered the rescue at all. “Well, of course it is,” Agnarr agreed with a laugh. “But still, I feel like we’d have met by now if they were on the outside.” He shrugged. “I think they’re still locked in the mist somewhere.
paras.zh: 我甚至开始怀疑，他到底还记不记得那场救援。“哦，那当然啦，”安格瑞笑着附和，“可我还是觉得，要是他在外头，咱们早该遇上了。”他耸耸肩。“我想他们还在迷雾里某个角落关着。

paras.en: Probably wondering if I survived.
paras.zh: 大概正猜我活没活下来。

paras.en: So if the mist parted, first thing, I’d find them and thank them.” I smiled uneasily, closing my eyes in mock weariness to avoid having to meet his gaze.
paras.zh: 所以只要迷雾散开，我要做的第一件事，就是找到他们道谢。”我不安地笑笑，假装困倦地闭上眼，好避开他的目光。

paras.en: Agnarr had no idea all that had transpired behind the scenes to make his rescue possible.
paras.zh: 安格瑞根本不知道，为了成就他的获救，背后发生了多少事。

paras.en: If I hadn’t abandoned my lessons.
paras.zh: 若我没丢下功课。

paras.en: If I hadn’t followed him to camp.
paras.zh: 若我没跟着他去营地。

paras.en: If I hadn’t left my shawl in that tree.
paras.zh: 若我没把披肩落在那棵树上。

paras.en: If I hadn’t stumbled upon him, lying there.
paras.zh: 若我没撞见躺在那里的他。

paras.en: If I hadn’t… I would be in the mist.
paras.zh: 若我没……此刻困在迷雾里的就会是我。

paras.en: And he would be dead. “I think it was one of the Northuldra,” Agnarr announced suddenly.
paras.zh: 而他已经死了。“我觉得是北地人之一，”安格瑞忽然宣布。

paras.en: My eyes flew open. “What?
paras.zh: 我猛地睁眼。“什么？

paras.en: Why do you say that?” He poked the fire with a stick. “No real reason.
paras.zh: 为什么这么说？”他拿树枝拨了拨火。“也没什么真凭实据。

paras.en: Just…a feeling.
paras.zh: 只是……一种感觉。

paras.en: After all, they were the ones who connected with the spirits of the forest.
paras.zh: 毕竟，是那群人与森林之灵相通。

paras.en: And I remember the feeling of floating at one point.” I opened my mouth to speak.
paras.zh: 而且我记得有那么一刻，自己像飘了起来。”我张嘴想说话。

paras.en: My heart was pounding so hard at this point I felt like I might crack a rib.
paras.zh: 那一刻我心怦怦狂跳，简直像要撞断肋骨。

paras.en: Should I tell him?
paras.zh: 该告诉他吗？

paras.en: What would he say if I did?
paras.zh: 若说了，他会怎么说？

paras.en: He couldn’t be mad, right?
paras.zh: 他不会生气吧？

paras.en: I mean, saving his life?
paras.zh: 我是说，救了他的命，

paras.en: That was a good thing. “Though it doesn’t make much sense now that I think about it,” he added before I could say anything. “I mean, they were trying to slaughter us.
paras.zh: 那可是好事啊。” “不过细想起来，这有点说不通，”没等我说，他就先补了一句，“我是说，他们当时可是要杀我们。

paras.en: Why would they want to kill my dad and save me?” My heart sank.
paras.zh: 干嘛要杀我父亲、却救我？”我的心直坠下去。

paras.en: I closed my mouth.
paras.zh: 我闭上嘴。

paras.en: What had I been thinking?
paras.zh: 我刚才在想什么？

paras.en: I could never tell him the truth.
paras.zh: 我永远不能告诉他真相。

paras.en: It was too dangerous.
paras.zh: 太危险了。

paras.en: Too risky.
paras.zh: 太冒险了。

paras.en: Especially not the crown prince of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 尤其不能告诉阿伦黛尔的王储。

paras.en: I awkwardly stretched my hands over my head, faking a yawn. “I’m exhausted,” I claimed, though it wasn’t exactly true. “I’m going to get some sleep.” I stood up and walked over to the wagon, busying myself with the blankets.
paras.zh: 我别扭地把双手举过头顶，假装打了个哈欠。“我累坏了，”我宣称，虽然并不尽然，“我去睡了。”我起身走向马车，忙着摆弄毯子。

paras.en: Agnarr bounded over. “Hang on,” he said, rummaging through the wagon.
paras.zh: 安格瑞蹦跳着跟过来。“等等，”他说着在马车里翻找。

paras.en: He pulled out a thick reindeer hide from somewhere inside. “This will help cushion the ground.” “Isn’t that yours?” He shrugged. “I’m fine.
paras.zh: 他从里头某处拽出一张厚实的鹿皮。“这个能垫着舒服点。”“这不是你的吗？”他耸耸肩。“我没事。

paras.en: Besides, I think I’m going to stay up for a while.
paras.zh: 再说，我想再守一会儿。

paras.en: Keep watch.” “Um, isn’t that what your regiment of guards is for?” I asked, glancing over at the company of men with swords not twenty yards away. “Hey, they might need my help, fending off wolves or something.” I raised an eyebrow. “What would you “Please.
paras.zh: 放哨。” “呃，那不正是你那一队卫兵的活儿吗？”我瞟了眼不到二十码外持剑的卫兵们，“嘿，赶狼什么的，他们说不定还需要我帮忙呢。”我挑起眉。“你又能……” “拜托。

paras.en: I’d wake you I smiled, stepping away from the wagon. “Is this your roundabout way of asking me for a song, Your Majesty?” I teased.
paras.zh: 我会叫醒你……” 我笑着从马车边走开。“陛下，您这是绕弯子想让我唱首歌吗？”我逗他。

paras.en: We were back in familiar territory.
paras.zh: 我们又回到了熟悉的气氛里。

paras.en: Agnarr always wanted a song on outdoor, fire-filled nights like these.
paras.zh: 安格瑞总想在这样户外的、围着篝火的夜晚听首歌。

paras.en: I would protest at first, but in the end, I always gave in.
paras.zh: 我开头总会推辞，可最后总会让步。

paras.en: He grinned sheepishly. “Not if you’re tired.” “I suppose I can stay awake for one song,” I allowed, hiding my pleasure at being asked.
paras.zh: 他腼腆地咧嘴。“你要是累了就不唱。”“我想为一首歌熬会儿夜还是可以的，”我应允，藏起被他邀歌的欢喜。

paras.en: I walked back over to the fire and sat down in front of it, placing the reindeer hide on my lap, then smoothing it with my hands.
paras.zh: 我走回火边坐下，把鹿皮铺在腿上，用手抚平。

paras.en: Agnarr lay down beside me, stretching out his long legs and putting his head in my lap with a contented sigh.
paras.zh: 安格瑞在我身旁躺下，伸直长腿，把头枕在我膝上，满足地叹了口气。

paras.en: It shouldn’t have felt as right as it did.
paras.zh: 这本不该如此妥帖。

paras.en: I lifted my voice to sing.
paras.zh: 我扬声唱起歌来。

paras.en: I was wobbly at first, but soon the notes poured from my throat like water from a stream as I sang an Arendellian song I’d learned in the village. “Your voice is like an angel’s,” he murmured, closing his eyes and breathing in deeply.
paras.zh: 起初还有些发颤，很快音符便如溪水般从喉咙里淌出，我唱起在村里学的那首阿伦黛尔歌谣。“你的声音像天使一样，”他闭上眼，深深呼吸，喃喃道。

paras.en: It didn’t take long before he was fast asleep.
paras.zh: 没过多久他就睡熟了。

paras.en: So much for keeping watch.
paras.zh: 还说放哨呢。

paras.en: I stroked his hair, feeling the strands slip through my fingers.
paras.zh: 我抚着他的头发，任发丝从指间滑落。

paras.en: Like sand slipping through an hourglass.
paras.zh: 像沙粒从沙漏里流走。

paras.en: This could very well be our last pilgrimage, I realized suddenly.
paras.zh: 我忽然意识到，这很可能就是我们最后一次朝圣了。

paras.en: Agnarr was now eighteen, after all.
paras.zh: 毕竟，安格瑞如今已十八岁。

paras.en: Soon he would take a bride.
paras.zh: 很快他就要娶妻。

paras.en: And no way would his new wife allow him to trek into the wilderness with some random village girl.
paras.zh: 而他新婚的妻子绝不会准许他和一个不知哪儿来的村姑钻进荒野。

paras.en: If I wanted to keep going to the mist, I would be going alone.
paras.zh: 若我还想去迷雾，只能独自前往。

paras.en: The thought made me sadder than I wanted it to.
paras.zh: 这念头比我愿意承认的更叫人难过。

paras.en: And before I even realized I was doing it, I had switched songs.
paras.zh: 而我还没意识到自己在做什么，就已经换了歌。

paras.en: To the song of my people, my real family.
paras.zh: 换成了我族人、我真正的家人的歌。

paras.en: I hummed the tune softly, the words coursing through my mind like water.
paras.zh: 我轻轻哼着曲调，歌词如水流过心间。

paras.en: Like Ahtohallan, the river of memories.
paras.zh: 像记忆之河阿托哈兰。

paras.en: Tears welled in my eyes as I gazed down at my sleeping prince.
paras.zh: 我低头望着沉睡的王子，眼眶泛起泪光。

paras.en: Because soon, I knew, memories of these nights would be all I had left.
paras.zh: 因为我知道，不久之后，这些夜晚的记忆，将是我仅剩的全部。

paras.en: “FIND ANYTHING?” I called out to Iduna, who was standing a few yards away, checking the wall of mist, careful not to miss a spot.
paras.zh: “找到什么了吗？”我朝几步开外的伊杜娜喊道，她正紧挨着迷雾的墙细细查看，生怕漏掉一处。

paras.en: She didn’t answer at first, clearly too wrapped up in her work to hear me.
paras.zh: 她起初没答话，显然太沉浸在工作里，根本没听见我。

paras.en: Typical.
paras.zh: 老样子。

paras.en: She always got like this when we came here.
paras.zh: 每次来这儿她都这样。

paras.en: As if she’d crawled down into a deep memory of the past, and the present barely registered.
paras.zh: 仿佛整个人钻进了往昔深处的某段记忆，眼前的现实都快不存在了。

paras.en: But who could blame her, really?
paras.zh: 不过话说回来，谁又能怪她呢？

paras.en: To be here.
paras.zh: 站在这里。

paras.en: To see the mist.
paras.zh: 看着迷雾。

paras.en: To touch it.
paras.zh: 触摸它。

paras.en: To know what—who—might be waiting on the other side.
paras.zh: 知道那一边，可能正等着什么——谁。

paras.en: Trapped.
paras.zh: 被困着。

paras.en: Maybe forever.
paras.zh: 也许永远。

paras.en: It made me feel pretty strange, too.
paras.zh: 这也让我觉得心里怪怪的。

paras.en: I crept over toward Iduna, who was still running her hands along the outer shell.
paras.zh: 我悄悄挪到伊杜娜身边，她还在沿着外层外壳用手摸索。

paras.en: She was concentrating so hard she didn’t hear me approach.
paras.zh: 她太专注了，竟没听见我靠近。

paras.en: When I touched her shoulder, she jumped in surprise, letting out a startled yelp. “Sorry,” I said, giving her an apologetic grin. “I didn’t mean to sneak up on you.” “It’s fine.” Her eyes did not leave the mist. “Did you finish your section?” “Yup.” “And…?” “Oh.
paras.zh: 我碰了碰她肩膀，她吓得一哆嗦，惊叫出声。“抱歉，”我歉意地笑着，“我不是故意偷袭你的。” “没事。”她的目光没离开迷雾。“你那片查完了？” “查完了。” “然后呢……？” “哦。

paras.en: There’s a big gaping hole.
paras.zh: 有个老大老大的窟窿。

paras.en: Crazy huge.
paras.zh: 大得离谱。

paras.en: Sorry, was I supposed to tell you?” She didn’t laugh. “Sorry.
paras.zh: 抱歉，我是不是该告诉你来着？”她没笑。“抱歉。

paras.en: Bad joke.” I felt dumb.
paras.zh: 烂玩笑。”我觉得自己真蠢。

paras.en: I should know better than to mess with her at the mist. “And yet somehow you manage to repeat it every year,” she grumbled, testing out another section of mist.
paras.zh: 我该懂的，不该在迷雾边逗她。“可你年年都改不了这毛病，”她嘟囔着，又去试探另一段迷雾。

paras.en: I watched as she pressed against it, holding her hands there for a moment, then released it, moving on to the next spot.
paras.zh: 我看着她贴上去，手在那儿停一会儿，再松开，挪到下一处。

paras.en: She was as thorough as ever. “You want a snack?” I asked, walking over to my satchel, which I’d left on a big rock. “I’ve got more chocolate.” “I want to finish first,” she answered, distracted. “Do you want me to help?” “I’m fine.
paras.zh: 她和往常一样一丝不苟。“要吃点点心吗？”我走到落在大石头上的背包边问，“我还有巧克力。” “我想先查完，”她心不在焉地答，“要我帮忙吗？” “不用。

paras.en: Eat your snack.” I sighed, sitting down on the rock, pulling out a section of chocolate, and crunching down on it as I watched her continue.
paras.zh: 你吃你的吧。”我叹口气，在石头上坐下，掏出一块巧克力咬得咔嚓响，看她继续。

paras.en: I wanted to tell her to stop.
paras.zh: 我想叫她别查了。

paras.en: That she’d checked it plenty—that the guards had, too.
paras.zh: 她早查够了——卫兵们也查过了。

paras.en: There were no weak spots.
paras.zh: 根本没有薄弱处。

paras.en: No holes.
paras.zh: 没有窟窿。

paras.en: No changes at all since we’d first come here four years before.
paras.zh: 自从四年前头回来，一丝变化都没有。

paras.en: What made her think it would suddenly change now?
paras.zh: 她凭什么觉得现在会忽然变？

paras.en: And yet she always seemed to hold out hope.
paras.zh: 可她总是抱着希望。

paras.en: For me, our pilgrimages had become more tradition than anything else.
paras.zh: 对我而言，这些朝圣早已成了一种传统，别的都不算。

paras.en: I was thoroughly convinced the mist would remain forever.
paras.zh: 我打心眼儿里认定，迷雾会永远留着。

paras.en: But that didn’t mean I didn’t enjoy the journey.
paras.zh: 但这不代表我不享受这趟旅程。

paras.en: Being away from the castle, out in nature, with no worries or responsibilities… Getting to spend time alone with Iduna next to a fire and under the stars. “Maybe you need a magic spell or something,” I called out to her, still munching on chocolate. “I mean, it was magic that brought the mist to begin with.
paras.zh: 远离城堡，置身自然，无忧无虑、不负重任……能在火边星空下与伊杜娜独处。“或许你需要个魔法咒语什么的，”我嚼着巧克力冲她喊，“毕竟，当初带来迷雾的就是魔法。

paras.en: Maybe magic could make it disappear.” She froze in her tracks, her hands still on the mist. “I don’t know any magic,” she snapped, her voice sharper than I usually heard it.
paras.zh: 没准魔法也能让它消失。”她猛地停住，手还贴在迷雾上。“我可不会什么魔法，”她厉声道，嗓音比平时尖。

paras.en: I cringed.
paras.zh: 我缩了缩。

paras.en: You’re such a moron.
paras.zh: 真是个大蠢货。

paras.en: In reality, I was more conflicted.
paras.zh: 其实，我自己也矛盾得很。

paras.en: Like Iduna, I was driven by wondering what might be on the other side.
paras.zh: 和伊杜娜一样，我也总忍不住想，那一边究竟有什么。

paras.en: How many Arendellians remained alive and trapped, just waiting for the mist to part so they could rejoin their loved ones.
paras.zh: 还有多少阿伦黛尔人活着、被困着，只等迷雾散开，好与亲人重逢。

paras.en: Mattias, perhaps Iduna’s parents—how wonderful would it be to reunite after all these years?
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯，也许还有伊杜娜的父母——隔了这么多年若能重聚，该多好？

paras.en: But I also worried.
paras.zh: 可我也担忧。

paras.en: For if the mist were to part, it would free more than just our loved ones.
paras.zh: 因为一旦迷雾散开，被放出来的不止是我们的亲人。

paras.en: What if the spirits still raged?
paras.zh: 万一那些精灵仍在暴怒呢？

paras.en: What if the Northuldra intended to seek revenge?
paras.zh: 万一北地人想要复仇呢？

paras.en: As ruler of Arendelle, I had to keep my people safe.
paras.zh: 作为阿伦黛尔的统治者，我必须护佑我的百姓。

paras.en: Which meant I couldn’t be selfish and hope for the mist to part just so Iduna and I could be reunited with our loved ones.
paras.zh: 这意味着我不能自私地盼着迷雾散开，只为和伊杜娜同亲人团聚。

paras.en: I looked over at Iduna.
paras.zh: 我望向伊杜娜。

paras.en: I wanted nothing more than for her to have her greatest wish come true.
paras.zh: 我最大的心愿，就是让她最深的盼望成真。

paras.en: To be reunited with those she loved.
paras.zh: 与所爱之人重逢。

paras.en: But at what cost to Arendelle?
paras.zh: 可这要以阿伦黛尔付出什么代价？

paras.en: Iduna was still checking on the mist, but her movements had become quicker now, more erratic.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜还在查迷雾，可动作明显急促了，乱了章法。

paras.en: Her hands swept over the mist in desperate motions and her face had become pale and frustrated.
paras.zh: 她的手在雾上慌乱地掠过，脸色发白、满含沮丧。

paras.en: I watched as she scowled at the mist, then swung her fist against it, crying out in pain as the mist pushed it back.
paras.zh: 我看着她冲迷雾皱眉，接着挥拳砸上去，被雾弹回时疼得叫出声。

paras.en: I leapt to my feet and ran over to her, taking her injured hand in mine.
paras.zh: 我腾地起身冲过去，握住她受伤的手。

paras.en: She tried to yank it away, but I held on tight, rubbing my fingers over her swollen knuckles.
paras.zh: 她想抽走，我却攥得紧紧的，用指腹轻揉她肿起的指节。

paras.en: With my other hand, I reached out, tipping up her chin till her eyes met my own.
paras.zh: 另一只手伸过去，托起她的下巴，直到她与我对视。

paras.en: They were wild and angry, sad and desperate.
paras.zh: 那双眼狂乱又愤怒，悲伤又绝望。

paras.en: Like every time before.
paras.zh: 和每一次一样。

paras.en: She never gave up.
paras.zh: 她从不肯放弃。

paras.en: And she always got hurt. “Stop,” I said gently. “You have to stop.” She squeezed her eyes shut, tears leaking from the corners.
paras.zh: 也总是弄伤自己。“停下，”我柔声说，“你必须停下。”她紧闭双眼，泪从眼角渗出。

paras.en: I dropped my hand to reach around the small of her back, pulling her close.
paras.zh: 我垂下手，环住她的腰，把她拉近。

paras.en: She buried her face in my chest and I stroked her hair softly, breathing in her warm scent.
paras.zh: 她把脸埋进我胸口，我轻轻抚着她的发，呼吸里全是她温暖的香气。

paras.en: Her hair still smelled like lavender and sunshine, even after spending the night by a smoky fire.
paras.zh: 即便在烟熏的火边过了一夜，她的发仍带着薰衣草与阳光的味道。

paras.en: In the meantime, I probably smelled like sweaty old socks.
paras.zh: 而我呢，大概闻起来像汗津津的旧袜子。

paras.en: Luckily, she didn’t seem to mind.
paras.zh: 所幸，她似乎并不介意。

paras.en: For a moment, we just stood there, wrapped in one another’s arms.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻，我们就那样相拥而立。

paras.en: I could feel her heartbeat, fast and fierce against my chest, her ragged breaths at my throat.
paras.zh: 我能感到她的心跳，又快又烈，撞着我的胸膛，她急促的呼吸拂过我的喉咙。

paras.en: Her hands gripping my sides, tightly at first, then relaxing a little, giving into the warmth of our embrace.
paras.zh: 她的手起初紧紧抓着我的腰侧，而后松了些，沉醉在这拥抱的暖意里。

paras.en: I kissed the top of her head, my hands stroking her back, trying to calm her with soft whispers. “Breathe,” I said. “Just breathe.” She pulled away then, tilting her face to look up at me.
paras.zh: 我吻了吻她的头顶，手抚着她的背，用低语安抚她。“呼吸，”我说，“只要呼吸。”她这才退开，仰起脸看我。

paras.en: Her cheeks were stained with tears and her face was blotchy.
paras.zh: 她脸颊挂着泪痕，花了妆。

paras.en: Her eyes were rimmed in red. “Why do I do this to myself every time?” she asked in a small voice. “Because you still hope,” I told her, reaching out to swipe a fresh tear away. “That’s not a bad thing, you know.” “Yeah, well, it’s a stupid thing.
paras.zh: 眼眶红红的。“我每次为什么要这样折磨自己？”她小声问。“因为你还在盼望，”我边说边伸手抹去她新涌出的泪，“要知道，这不算坏事。” “是啊，可这是件蠢事。

paras.en: Clearly the mist is going nowhere.
paras.zh: 迷雾明明纹丝不动。

paras.en: This is all a big waste of time.” I frowned. “No.
paras.zh: 全是浪费时间。”我皱眉。“不。

paras.en: I don’t believe that.” “What?” “It’s not a waste of time,” I told her. “Not to me anyway.” I paused, then added, “Because I get to spend it with you.” She jerked away, turning from me to stare at the vacant plain stretching out toward the horizon.
paras.zh: 我不信。” “什么？” “这不是浪费时间，”我告诉她，“至少对我不是。”我顿了顿，又道，“因为能和你一起度过。”她猛地抽身，转过脸望向远处空旷的平原。

paras.en: Worry wormed through my stomach. “What is it, Iduna?” I asked softly.
paras.zh: 一股担忧钻进我胃里。“怎么了，伊杜娜？”我轻声问。

paras.en: She’d always been a little sad after coming to the mist.
paras.zh: 每次从迷雾边回去，她总会有些低落。

paras.en: But I’d never seen her this distraught. “Whatever it is, you can tell me.
paras.zh: 可我从没见她这么崩溃过。“不管是什么，你都可以告诉我。

paras.en: You can tell me anything.” She turned back to me, her face pale and her blue eyes anguished. “How long can we keep doing this, Agnarr?” she I stared at her, shocked.
paras.zh: 什么都可以告诉我。”她转回身，脸色苍白，蓝眼里满是痛苦。“我们还能这样多久，安格瑞？”她我怔怔盯着她，震惊不已。

paras.en: Of course she wasn’t wrong.
paras.zh: 她说得当然没错。

paras.en: I knew, in the back of my mind, that once I became king, some things would have to change.
paras.zh: 我心里清楚，一旦我当了国王，有些事必须变。

paras.en: But that was three years away.
paras.zh: 可那也是三年后的事。

paras.en: Did we have to think of that now?
paras.zh: 非得现在就想吗？

paras.en: Couldn’t we enjoy the time I had left?
paras.zh: 我们就不能先享受我剩下的时光？

paras.en: I swallowed hard, trying to pull together my racing thoughts. “First,” I said firmly, “you are not some random orphan girl.
paras.zh: 我狠狠咽了口唾沫，努力拢住乱成一团的思绪。“首先，”我斩钉截铁地说，“你绝不是什么随便的孤女。

paras.en: You are my best friend.
paras.zh: 你是我的好朋友。

paras.en: And nothing will change that.
paras.zh: 这一点永不变。

paras.en: I promise.
paras.zh: 我发誓。

paras.en: Our friendship is as solid and strong as this stupid magical mist.
paras.zh: 我们的友谊，和这愚蠢的魔法迷雾一样牢固坚强。

paras.en: And I think you’ll agree this stuff is pretty resilient.” To prove my point, I charged at the mist, throwing myself full force against it.
paras.zh: 我想你也会承认，这东西可够顽固的。”为证明这点，我朝迷雾猛冲，用全身力气撞上去。

paras.en: It was a move I’d jokingly done during past trips and it had always cheered her up some to watch me bounce off the side and land sprawling on my butt in the mud.
paras.zh: 这是过去旅途里我常开玩笑做的动作，看我弹回来、一屁股摔在泥里，总能让她提起点精神。

paras.en: But this time, she just watched me with tortured eyes.
paras.zh: 可这次，她只是用饱受折磨的眼神望着我。

paras.en: So I leapt up and charged again, once more getting thrown to the ground. “Stop it, you crazy person!” she cried, her tone finally carrying a stirring of lightness. “You’re going to hurt yourself!
paras.zh: 于是我跳起来又冲一次，再次被掀翻在地。“住手，你这疯子！”她喊，语气里终于透出一丝轻快，“你会伤到自己的！

paras.en: Don’t you know it’s a crime to purposely harm the future king?” She jumped between me and the mist.
paras.zh: 你难道不知道，蓄意伤害未来的国王是犯罪吗？”她跳到我和迷雾之间。

paras.en: But I had already lunged again.
paras.zh: 可我已经又扑了上去。

paras.en: I tried to dig in my heels, to stop myself, but it was too late.
paras.zh: 我想钉住脚跟停住，却为时已晚。

paras.en: I slammed into her, shoving her back against the wall of mist.
paras.zh: 我撞上她，把她推得贴回迷雾的墙。

paras.en: Suddenly our bodies were pressed up against one another.
paras.zh: 刹那间，我们的身体贴在一起。

paras.en: Our faces inches apart.
paras.zh: 脸只差几寸。

paras.en: My breath caught in my throat.
paras.zh: 我屏住了呼吸。

paras.en: I stared down at her, suddenly mesmerized by every detail of her face.
paras.zh: 我低头望着她，忽然被她脸上每一处细节迷住。

paras.en: Her wide blue eyes, her full pink lips, her small nose, slightly turned up at the tip.
paras.zh: 她睁得大大的蓝眼睛，饱满的粉唇，小巧微翘的鼻尖。

paras.en: The light freckles dusting her cheeks.
paras.zh: 脸颊上淡淡的点点雀斑。

paras.en: Her body flush with mine.
paras.zh: 她的身体紧贴着我。

paras.en: My heart pounded, matching the beats of her own.
paras.zh: 我的心狂跳，与她的节拍相和。

paras.en: And for a moment there was nothing else.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻，世间再无他物。

paras.en: No mist, no Enchanted Forest, no guards.
paras.zh: 没有迷雾，没有魔法森林，没有卫兵。

paras.en: Just her and me, not moving.
paras.zh: 只有她和我，静止不动。

paras.en: Not able to move.
paras.zh: 动弹不得。

paras.en: And then she reached out, pushing me gently away.
paras.zh: 接着她伸手，轻轻把我推开。

paras.en: I stumbled backward, almost losing my balance again.
paras.zh: 我踉跄后退，差点又失去平衡。

paras.en: When I “You are a crazy man!” she declared, choking out a nervous laugh, clearly trying to lighten the moment. “I can’t believe they’re going to let you be king!” I grinned impishly. “Well, they still have three years to come to their senses,” I reminded her. “Maybe I’ll get lucky.” “Maybe,” she agreed. “Or maybe by then the mist will have parted.
paras.zh: 当…… “你是个疯子！”她宣告，挤出一串紧张的笑，显然想让气氛轻松些，“真不敢相信他们居然肯让你当国王！”我顽皮地咧嘴。“嗯，他们还有三年时间回心转意呢，”我提醒她，“说不定我能走运。” “也许吧，”她附和，“或者到那时迷雾已经散了。

paras.en: You never know.” “You never know,” I echoed, pleased to see her unflappable optimism returning.
paras.zh: 谁知道呢。”“谁知道呢，”我应着，很高兴见她那打不垮的乐观又回来了。

paras.en: It was one of the things I adored about Iduna.
paras.zh: 这正是我钟爱伊杜娜的一点。

paras.en: She always saw the best in the world.
paras.zh: 她总能在世界里看见最好的一面。

paras.en: She never stopped believing things could change for the better.
paras.zh: 她从不停止相信事情会向好。

paras.en: I lifted my hand to the mist, making a big show of waving goodbye.
paras.zh: 我朝迷雾举起手，夸张地挥手道别。

paras.en: Just as I had done every time before. “Till next time,” I called out to it. “You stubborn old thing.” And with that, I led Iduna over to the wagon, letting the soldiers know it was time to leave.
paras.zh: 就像每次分别时那样。“下次见，”我对它喊，“你这顽固的老家伙。”说罢，我领着伊杜娜走向马车，通知士兵们该启程了。

paras.en: She scrambled up onto the front seat and I joined her a moment later, after checking on the horses.
paras.zh: 她麻利地爬上驭座，我查看过马匹后，片刻也上了车。

paras.en: Before setting off, I gave her a searching look. “You okay?” I asked.
paras.zh: 出发前，我打量着她，目光探寻。“你没事吧？”我问。

paras.en: For a moment she said nothing, and I worried I’d lost her to the gloom of the mist once more.
paras.zh: 她沉默了片刻，我生怕她又陷进迷雾的阴郁里。

paras.en: Then a small smile emerged. “I will be,” she said. “If you share the rest of that chocolate with me.” I grinned, my shoulders slumping in relief. “I think I can manage that.”
paras.zh: 随后她露出一丝浅笑。“会好的，”她说，“只要你把剩下的巧克力分我。”我咧嘴笑了，肩膀一松，如释重负。“我想这我办得到。”

paras.en: “IDUNA!
paras.zh: “伊杜娜！

paras.en: YOU’RE BACK!” I lifted my eyes, squinting in the early morning sunshine.
paras.zh: 你回来啦！”我抬起眼，在清晨的阳光里眯起眼睛。

paras.en: Johan, the man I was apprenticing for, was running down the hill toward me, a huge smile on his face.
paras.zh: 我当学徒跟着的约翰正从山坡上朝我跑来，脸上挂着大大的笑。

paras.en: He was young—only six years older than I was.
paras.zh: 他年轻——只比我大六岁。

paras.en: And with his sparkling brown eyes and mop of curly black hair, it seemed he always had a few village girls vying for his attention.
paras.zh: 一双闪亮的棕眼，顶着一头卷曲黑发，似乎总有几个村姑争着吸引他注意。

paras.en: But he was focused on only one thing—inventing.
paras.zh: 可他心里只装着一件事——发明。

paras.en: And his invention of the moment was centered on wind. “I’m so glad you’re here,” he declared. “You’ve got to see this.” I laughed at his enthusiasm as he dragged me to the top of the hill where we’d set up our test windmills.
paras.zh: 眼下这项发明，主题是风。“真高兴你在这儿，”他说，“你一定得看看这个。”他被我的兴奋劲儿感染，笑着拖我上了我们架测试风车的山顶。

paras.en: To my surprise, the blades were rotating steadily, even though I could barely feel a breeze. “They’re working!” I cried in excitement. “How did you get them to work?” We’d been having trouble with this for months now and Johan had been getting very discouraged.
paras.zh: 出乎我意料，叶片稳稳转着，尽管我几乎感觉不到一丝风。“转起来了！”我兴奋地叫，“你怎么弄成的？”这几个月我们一直卡在这上头，约翰也愈发泄气。

paras.en: When the weather was just right, his mills worked perfectly, the blades catching Johan’s face was alight with excitement. “I used your idea,” he said. “To make them moveable.
paras.zh: 天气刚好时，他的磨坊转得完美，叶片……约翰脸上光彩焕发。“我用了你的点子，”他说，“让它们能转动。

paras.en: So the post in the middle stays in place.
paras.zh: 所以中间的立柱固定不动。

paras.en: But the blades can be rotated around the post, depending on the weather conditions.
paras.zh: 但叶片能绕着立柱转，看天气情况而定。

paras.en: This way, whichever direction the wind is coming from, they can pick it up.” “And it worked?” Johan pointed at the windmill.
paras.zh: 这样，不论风从哪个方向来，都能接住。” “成了？”约翰指着风车。

paras.en: I grinned, watching the blades spin around and around.
paras.zh: 我咧嘴笑着，看叶片一圈圈转。

paras.en: A warm feeling of pride rolled over me with each rotation.
paras.zh: 每转一圈，一股自豪的暖意便漫过我心。

paras.en: We had made it happen.
paras.zh: 是我们把它变成了现实。

paras.en: And now—who knew what the possibilities might be?
paras.zh: 而现在——谁知道还会有多少可能？

paras.en: I couldn’t wait to tell Agnarr. “Can you believe how far we’ve come, Iduna?” Johan cried, coming over to me and putting a hand on my back.
paras.zh: 我等不及要告诉安格瑞。“你能相信我们走了多远吗，伊杜娜？”约翰喊着过来，把手搭在我背上。

paras.en: He’d grown up poor in the village, with big dreams of making something of himself, but the townspeople had never taken him too seriously.
paras.zh: 他在村里长大，家境贫寒，却怀揣出人头地的大梦，可镇上人从没太把他当回事。

paras.en: Crazy Johan and his inventions, But no one would be laughing now.
paras.zh: “疯子约翰和他的发明”，可现在没人会笑了。

paras.en: Not when they saw this. “I hope you’ll put in a good word for me with your friends at the castle,” Johan added, brushing his hands against his pants to wipe off the grease that had accumulated on them. “We need them to approve these windmills before we can offer them to the citizens of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 等他们看到这个就不会。“我希望你能在城堡里的朋友面前替我说几句好话，”约翰边说边在裤子上蹭手，擦掉沾上的油污，“我们得先让他们批准这些风车，才能提供给阿伦黛尔的百姓。

paras.en: They might not like it,” he added with a warning tone. “It could detract from their own profits.” “Agnarr will love it,” I assured him, walking over to the windmill and looking at it with delight.
paras.zh: 他们也许不爱听，”他语气里带起警告，“这会影响他们自己的收益。” “安格瑞会喜欢的，”我向他保证，走到风车前欢喜地端详。

paras.en: I could feel the breeze on my face and it reminded me of Gale.
paras.zh: 脸上拂过微风，让我想起风灵。

paras.en: I hoped my dear friend would be proud of how I had put the knowledge gathered from our time together to practical use.
paras.zh: 我希望我亲爱的朋友会为我骄傲——我把与她共处所得的知识用到了实处。

paras.en: To feed the hungry.
paras.zh: 去喂饱饥饿的人。

paras.en: To empower the people.
paras.zh: 去赋予人们力量。

paras.en: It felt good.
paras.zh: 这感觉真好。

paras.en: So good. “What will I love?” I whirled around, delighted to see none other than Agnarr himself, climbing the hill, accompanied by a few of his personal “What are you doing here?” I asked. “And how are you up so early?
paras.zh: 好极了。“我会喜欢什么？”我猛地转身，惊喜地看见来人竟是安格瑞本人，正带着几名亲随上山。“你在这儿做什么？”我问，“而且你怎么起这么早？

paras.en: Why, it’s not even noon!” “Ha ha.
paras.zh: 天呐，还不到正午呢！”“哈，哈。

paras.en: I can rise early!” he protested, looking a little offended.
paras.zh: 我也能早起！”他抗议，有点被冒犯的样子。

paras.en: Not that he had any right to be—he was a notoriously late sleeper.
paras.zh: 虽说他也无权生气——他可是出了名爱睡懒觉。

paras.en: Perks of being a prince, I guess.
paras.zh: 当王子嘛，大概就是这点好。

paras.en: I smirked. “Let me guess.
paras.zh: 我坏笑。“我猜猜。

paras.en: Council meeting this morning.” “Yes.
paras.zh: 今早有议会会议。”“是啊。

paras.en: Which, so sadly, I couldn’t attend,” Agnarr agreed, with a great and regretful sigh. “Since I have already committed myself to attending to the people of Arendelle this fine morning.
paras.zh: 可惜啊，我没法出席，”安格瑞带着一声夸张又遗憾的叹息应道，“因为我今早已经承诺要来关照阿伦黛尔的百姓了。

paras.en: I cannot disappoint my loyal subjects.” “How…noble of you.” There was nothing Agnarr hated more than council meetings. “And let me guess.
paras.zh: 我不能辜负忠心的子民。”“你……真‘高尚’。”安格瑞最讨厌的就是议会会议。“我再猜猜。

paras.en: You started your very important rounds at Blodget’s Bakery?” A smile crept to his lips. “Bakeries are a very important part of any kingdom, I’ll have you know.” “Oh, I know.
paras.zh: 你这重要的巡视从布洛杰特面包房开始的吧？”他嘴角悄悄上扬。“面包房可是任何王国都极重要的一部分，这你该知道。”“哦，我知道。

paras.en: And a good prince must always avail himself to a cookie taste test, right?” “Sacrifices must be made,” Agnarr agreed solemnly. “For the good of the realm.” “Your Majesty,” Johan broke in as he bowed from the waist. “I am truly honored to have you visit my humble mill.
paras.zh: 而一位好王子，总该亲自尝块饼干，对吧？” “总得有人牺牲嘛，”安格瑞庄重地附和，“为了王国之福祉。” “陛下，”约翰插话，弯腰行礼，“您能光临我这小小的磨坊，真是莫大荣幸。

paras.en: Please let me know if I can be of any assistance in any way possible.” I resisted the urge to roll my eyes.
paras.zh: 若有任何效劳之处，请尽管吩咐。”我强忍住翻白眼的冲动。

paras.en: Johan wasn’t exactly the biggest fan of the monarchy.
paras.zh: 约翰算不上王室的粉丝。

paras.en: And he definitely didn’t like Agnarr, the spoiled prince, as he called him.
paras.zh: 他尤其不喜欢安格瑞，那个他口中的“被宠坏的王子”。

paras.en: Which was totally unfair, since Agnarr was not spoiled at all.
paras.zh: 这可太不公了，安格瑞根本一点都不娇纵。

paras.en: But any time I tried to defend him, Johan would get angry and tell me I didn’t understand.
paras.zh: 可每次我想替他辩解，约翰就生气，说我不懂。

paras.en: But now, here he was, putting on a great show.
paras.zh: 可眼下，他却在这儿大演一出。

paras.en: Probably so Agnarr would sign off on his windmills.
paras.zh: 多半是为哄安格瑞批准他的风车。

paras.en: Which was totally unnecessary.
paras.zh: 这完全没必要。

paras.en: Agnarr would always do the right thing if it helped his people.
paras.zh: 只要对百姓有益，安格瑞总会做正确的事。

paras.en: No sucking up required.
paras.zh: 用不着讨好。

paras.en: Agnarr smiled down at him, unaware of Johan’s true feelings. “You don’t have to do that,” he assured him. “Iduna has told me all about your work together.
paras.zh: 安格瑞低头朝他微笑，丝毫不知约翰的真实想法。“你不必这样，”他安抚道，“伊杜娜把你俩一起干的活都告诉我了。

paras.en: I’d love to see these mills for myself.” “Of course, Your Majesty!” Johan scrambled to his feet, his face red as a tomato.
paras.zh: 我很想亲眼看看这些磨坊。”“当然，陛下！”约翰慌忙起身，脸涨得通红。

paras.en: He turned to the post-mill, which was still rotating steadily. “It’s an important invention.
paras.zh: 他转向那座仍在稳转的立柱风车。“这是项重要发明。

paras.en: Sure to revolutionize farming from this moment forward….” He started explaining the rotating blade part of the mill.
paras.zh: 必将从此刻起革新农耕……”他讲起磨坊可转动叶片的部分。

paras.en: The part I had come up with.
paras.zh: 那部分是我想出来的。

paras.en: But to my surprise, he didn’t mention my part in it.
paras.zh: 可让我意外的是，他只字未提我的功劳。

paras.en: He took all the credit for himself—as if it had all been his idea.
paras.zh: 他把全部功劳揽在自己身上——仿佛全是他的点子。

paras.en: Not that I needed credit.
paras.zh: 倒不是我非要那功劳。

paras.en: I was just an apprentice after all.
paras.zh: 毕竟我只是个学徒。

paras.en: But still!
paras.zh: 可还是！

paras.en: At least a little acknowledgment might have been nice. “This is all very interesting,” Agnarr said when Johan had finished. “I can’t wait to see it put to practical use.
paras.zh: 哪怕稍微提一句也好啊。“这真有意思，”约翰讲完后安格瑞说，“我等不及想看它派上实际用场。

paras.en: What will you charge for these post-mills?” Johan waved a hand. “Very little,” he said. “Just enough over cost for me to live a simple life.
paras.zh: 这些立柱磨坊你打算怎么收费？”约翰摆摆手。“很少，”他说，“只比成本高一点，够我简单过活。

paras.en: After all, I do this work for the people, not my own personal gain.” He gave the prince a smug look.
paras.zh: 毕竟我做这些是为百姓，不是为私利。”他得意地看了王子一眼。

paras.en: Agnarr, to his credit, nodded sincerely. “That’s wonderful to hear,” he said. “Anything to help Arendelle and her people.
paras.zh: 安格瑞不失风度地诚恳点头。“听你这么说真高兴，”他说，“只要能帮到阿伦黛尔和她的百姓。

paras.en: Please do let me know if you need anything from me.
paras.zh: 若需要我任何帮忙，请一定告诉我。

paras.en: Anything at all that might help.” “Your Majesty is too kind,” Johan replied, bowing his head again. “But…how will I reach you?
paras.zh: 任何能帮上忙的都行。” “陛下太仁厚了，”约翰又低头行礼，“可是……我该怎么联系您？

paras.en: We commoners can’t exactly just waltz into the castle and start demanding favors of our betters, now can we?” I frowned at the tone in his voice, setting Agnarr up in a trap.
paras.zh: 我们平民总不能大摇大摆走进城堡，向贵人开口讨好处吧？”我听出他话里的刺，皱起眉——他这是给安格瑞下套。

paras.en: But the prince didn’t acknowledge the barb—if he noticed it.
paras.zh: 可王子要么没听出，要么不接这茬。

paras.en: Instead he just waved a hand. “Oh, just ask Iduna.
paras.zh: 他只是摆摆手。“哦，找伊杜娜就行。

paras.en: She’ll deliver the message, won’t you?” Agnarr smiled at me before turning back to my employer. “You know, you’re very lucky to have someone so smart in your employ.
paras.zh: 她会传话的，对吧？”安格瑞冲我一笑，转回我雇主面前。“要知道，你雇到这么聪明的人，可真走运。

paras.en: She’s really a good worker, isn’t she?” He gave Johan a knowing look.
paras.zh: 她是个好帮手，对吧？”他朝约翰使了个心照不宣的眼色。

paras.en: I groaned.
paras.zh: 我直哼哼。

paras.en: I knew exactly what he was trying to do.
paras.zh: 我清楚他打的什么算盘。

paras.en: And it wasn’t helping. “Well!
paras.zh: 可这根本帮不上忙。“那个！

paras.en: It was so all “I suppose you are right,” Agnarr replied with a mischievous look. “And when I’m finished, I believe I have some important reading Reading “Reading sounds great,” I assured him. “Perhaps I will also read something once I have finished my important work.” Agnarr shook his head, as if in amazement. “She’s such a hard worker, isn’t she, Johan?
paras.zh: 简直…… “我想你是对的，”安格瑞俏皮地答，“等我忙完，想必还有要紧书要读…… “读书听起来不错，”我向他保证，“等我把要紧活干完，说不定也读点什么。”安格瑞摇头，像被我惊到。“她真是个干活不要命的，是不是，约翰？

paras.en: So dedicated!
paras.zh: 这么投入！

paras.en: So smart.
paras.zh: 这么聪明。

paras.en: So—” “ Goodbye “Goodbye, Iduna.” He winked at me. “Work hard!
paras.zh: 这么——” “ 再见 “再见，伊杜娜。”他朝我眨眨眼。“好好干！

paras.en: Like you always do!” And with that, Agnarr and his guards rejoined the road, heading farther up into the hills.
paras.zh: 像你一贯那样！”说罢，安格瑞和卫兵们回到路上，往更深的山里去了。

paras.en: Probably to pay a visit to the farmers and shepherds above.
paras.zh: 多半是去探望山上的农夫和牧人。

paras.en: I watched him go for a moment, smiling to myself.
paras.zh: 我望着他离去，暗自微笑。

paras.en: Even if his methods were crude and completely obvious, I appreciated the sentiment.
paras.zh: 即便他的法子笨拙又明显，这份心意我仍领情。

paras.en: He knew how much I wanted this job.
paras.zh: 他知道我多想要这份工作。

paras.en: Why it was important to me. “He thinks he’s so great, doesn’t he?” Johan shared once Agnarr had departed.
paras.zh: 知道它对我为何重要。“他觉得自己挺了不起，是不是？”安格瑞一走，约翰便说道。

paras.en: I turned, not surprised to see Johan was no longer smiling.
paras.zh: 我转过身，毫不意外地发现约翰已收起笑。

paras.en: He was watching Agnarr climb the hill with a scowl on his face. “What are you talking about?” I asked with a sigh.
paras.zh: 他正皱着眉，望着安格瑞上山。“你说什么？”我叹口气问。

paras.en: Here we go again. “I don’t need his help.
paras.zh: 又来了。“我不需要他帮忙。

paras.en: Don’t you get it?” Johan retorted “Once the monarchy gets involved, it will be all about them.
paras.zh: 你还不明白？”约翰回嘴，“一旦王室掺和进来，就全成了他们的事。

paras.en: They’ll try to take over my project.
paras.zh: 他们会想接管我的项目。

paras.en: Use my invention for their own personal gain.” “Agnarr would never do that!” I protested. “You think you know him so well.
paras.zh: 拿我的发明谋私利。” “安格瑞绝不会那样！”我抗议，“你以为你很了解他。

paras.en: But trust me, all monarchy is the same.
paras.zh: 可相信我，所有王室都一样。

paras.en: They’re selfish, entitled, and they only think of themselves.
paras.zh: 他们自私、自以为是，只想着自己。

paras.en: I know he’s your friend now, Iduna,” he added. “But beware.
paras.zh: 我知道他现在是你的朋友，伊杜娜，”他补了一句，“可当心。

paras.en: When push comes to shove, he will choose his crown over his friends.
paras.zh: 真到了紧要关头，他会选王冠，而不是朋友。

paras.en: They always do.” I frowned. “You’re one to talk,” I said. “You didn’t even mention that the rotating posts were my idea.” Johan’s frown softened. “I’m sorry about that,” he replied. “I was…caught off guard by his sudden appearance.
paras.zh: 他们向来如此。”我皱起眉。“说得好听，”我说，“你连可转动的立柱是我的点子都没提。”约翰的眉头松了些。“那件事对不住，”他答，“我……被他突然出现打了个措手不及。

paras.en: I didn’t explain anything well.
paras.zh: 我什么都没解释好。

paras.en: I certainly didn’t mean to discredit all your hard work.” He stepped toward me, reaching out to take my hands in his.
paras.zh: 我绝无意抹杀你的辛苦。”他朝我走近，伸出手握住我的。

paras.en: Hands so different from Agnarr’s—rough and calloused, whereas the prince’s were strong but smooth. “You are amazing,” he told me. “I could never have done this without you.
paras.zh: 那双手和安格瑞的截然不同——粗糙、长茧，而王子的手有力却光滑。“你真了不起，”他说，“没你我绝做不到。

paras.en: And the next time I see the prince, I will tell him that.” I felt my cheeks heat up. “You don’t have to do that,” I said. “It doesn’t matter anyway.
paras.zh: 下次见到王子，我会把这告诉他。”我觉得脸颊发烫。“你不必那样，”我说，“反正也没关系。

paras.en: It wasn’t just me.
paras.zh: 不止是我。

paras.en: It was us.
paras.zh: 是我们。

paras.en: We did it together.” “We did.
paras.zh: 我们一起做到的。”“我们一起。

paras.en: We’re a great team, you and I,” he declared, looking up at the post-mill.
paras.zh: 你我是绝好的搭档，”他宣告，抬头望向立柱风车。

paras.en: Then he dropped my hands. “Now.
paras.zh: 然后他松开我的手。“好啦。

paras.en: Come.
paras.zh: 来吧。

paras.en: Unlike certain spoiled princes, we have much work to do.”
paras.zh: 不像某些被宠坏的王子，我们还有好多活要干。”

paras.en: “WHAT ARE YOU READING, YOUR MAJESTY?” I hooked my knees around the tree branch, swinging backward until I was upside down and face to face with Agnarr, who had just sat under the tree and cracked his book open.
paras.zh: “你在读什么，陛下？”我用膝盖勾住树枝，向后荡去，倒挂下来，正好与刚在树下坐定、翻开书的安格瑞脸对脸。

paras.en: He startled, clearly not having realized I was up there, lying in wait.
paras.zh: 他吓了一跳，显然没料到我在上头守着。

paras.en: Then he flashed me a grin. “Some new Danish author,” he said, holding up his book.
paras.zh: 接着他朝我咧嘴一笑。“某位丹麦新作家的书，”他举起书说。

paras.en: I swung my legs around, gracefully flipping out of the tree and landing on the ground in front of him with a flourish.
paras.zh: 我双腿一荡，优雅地从树上翻下，一个漂亮的亮相落在他面前的地上。

paras.en: He groaned. “I seriously believe you are part cat,” he declared. “How else do you always land on your feet?” “The bigger question is, how do you never He rolled his eyes, giving me a pained look.
paras.zh: 他直哼哼。“我真心觉得你一半是猫，”他宣称，“不然你怎么总能稳稳落地？” “更大的问题是，你怎么就从来不——”他翻了个白眼，一脸痛苦相。

paras.en: I shrugged impishly and plopped down beside him on the bench.
paras.zh: 我顽皮地耸耸肩，一屁股在他旁边的长椅坐下。

paras.en: I plucked the book from his hand and skimmed the cover. “‘ The Little Mermaid He grabbed the book from me. “It is.” He opened it back up, “What’s it about?” He looked up. “A mermaid.” “Wow.
paras.zh: 我从他手里抽走书，扫了眼封面。“《小美人鱼》——”他一把夺回。“就是这本。”他重新翻开，“讲什么的？”他抬头。“一条美人鱼。” “哇。

paras.en: Descriptive.” “Sorry.” His mouth quirked. “A little I groaned. “You are the worst book describer ever.” “Hey!
paras.zh: 真形象。”“抱歉。”他嘴角一抽。“有那么点——”我哼道。“你简直是史上最不会讲书的人。”“嘿！

paras.en: I just don’t want to spoil it for you,” he said with an all-too-innocent smirk. “You’re welcome to read it yourself after I’m finished.” “You’re also the slowest Agnarr closed the book. “You’re impossible, you know.” I leaned in, then lowered my voice as though we were sharing our deepest secrets. “So you’ll tell me?” “Absolutely not.
paras.zh: 我只是不想剧透给你嘛，”他露出过分无辜的坏笑，“等我看完，你自己读就是了。” “你也是读得最慢的——”安格瑞合上书。“你真拿你没办法，知道吗。”我凑近，压低声音，像在分享最深秘密。“那你会告诉我？” “绝对不。

paras.en: But let’s try to find you a second copy in the library.” I grinned. “I suppose that would be all right, too.” Agnarr stuffed the book in his satchel, and together we headed back inside the castle, down the hall, and toward the library.
paras.zh: 不过我们去图书馆再给你找本一样的。”我咧嘴。“我想那也成。”安格瑞把书塞进背包，我俩一同回城堡，穿过大厅，朝图书馆去。

paras.en: It was still my favorite room in the whole gigantean place.
paras.zh: 那仍是我在这座巨无霸宫殿里最爱的房间。

paras.en: I loved the smell of musty books and old leather.
paras.zh: 我爱那股旧书与陈年皮革的味道。

paras.en: And the treasures it held—like mermaids, little or otherwise—were only the beginning.
paras.zh: 而它藏的宝贝——比如美人鱼，小的或别的——不过是开头。

paras.en: I watched as Agnarr began to search the shelves, a familiar warmth rising in my chest.
paras.zh: 我望着安格瑞开始在书架间翻找，胸口升起一股熟悉的暖意。

paras.en: It’d been three months since we’d last traveled to the mist, and something about that journey had changed us forever.
paras.zh: 距我们上回去了迷雾，已过三个月，而那趟旅程，永远地改变了我们。

paras.en: We were still best friends, of course.
paras.zh: 我们当然还是最好的朋友。

paras.en: We still joked and bantered and teased one another with fluid ease.
paras.zh: 仍那样轻松说笑、互相打趣。

paras.en: But there was something else there now, a gravity to our friendship, lingering beneath the surface.
paras.zh: 可如今多了点别的，一种友谊的沉重感，潜伏在表面之下。

paras.en: Not to mention an unspoken desire to be near one another at When he wasn’t in meetings, and I wasn’t working, and we both didn’t need to study, we’d always find some excuse to meet up.
paras.zh: 更别提那不言说的、想靠近彼此的渴望——只要他不开会、我不干活、我俩都不必温书，总会找借口见上一面。

paras.en: Under the name of friendship, nothing more.
paras.zh: 名义上只是朋友，仅此而已。

paras.en: Except there was And I didn’t know whether to be delighted…or scared to death. “Hmm.
paras.zh: 可事实并非如此——我不知道该欢喜……还是怕得要死。“嗯。

paras.en: Now to find it…” Agnarr’s voice snapped me back to attention. “I swear I saw another copy somewhere.” He started digging into the stacks.
paras.zh: 现在去找它……”安格瑞的声音把我拉回神。“我发誓在哪儿见过另一本。”他钻进书堆翻找。

paras.en: I tiptoed behind him, careful not to be seen.
paras.zh: 我踮脚跟在他身后，小心别被发现。

paras.en: When he wasn’t looking, I plucked the book from his satchel, then made a great show of finding it in the stacks. “Oh, look!
paras.zh: 趁他没看，我从他背包里抽出那本书，接着大张旗鼓地在书架上“找到”它。“哦，看！

paras.en: Here it is!” I cried excitedly. “My very own copy.
paras.zh: 在这儿！”我兴奋地叫，“我自己的那本。

paras.en: How lucky is that?” His eyes narrowed suspiciously. “You just found that there now?
paras.zh: 多走运啊？”他眯起眼，满腹狐疑。“你刚就在这儿找到的？

paras.en: Just like that?
paras.zh: 就这么巧？

paras.en: Amongst the thousands of books in here?” “Just lucky I guess!” I beamed. “Now if you’ll excuse me, I have some important reading to do.” I plopped down into a nearby leather armchair, opening the book.
paras.zh: 在这成千上万本书里？” “大概是我运气好吧！”我眉开眼笑，“那么恕我失陪，我得读要紧书了。”我一屁股坐进旁边的皮扶手椅，翻开书。

paras.en: Agnarr watched me for a moment, then sighed, reaching into his satchel for his own copy, which, of course, was no longer there.
paras.zh: 安格瑞盯了我片刻，随即叹气，伸手进背包找自己的那本——当然，早已不在。

paras.en: I tried my best to keep a straight face, staring very seriously into the book, as, from the corner of my eye, I saw his expression morph from confusion to understanding to annoyance.
paras.zh: 我拼命绷着脸，一本正经盯着书，余光却见他表情从困惑到恍然，再到恼火。

paras.en: But then the giggles came.
paras.zh: 可随后我憋不住笑起来。

paras.en: I could never stop the giggles. “You are so dead!” he declared, diving at me.
paras.zh: 我从来止不住笑。“你死定了！”他宣告，朝我扑来。

paras.en: But I was too quick, leaping over the back of the chair and dashing through the library.
paras.zh: 可我太快，翻身越过椅背，在图书馆里飞奔。

paras.en: He gave quick pursuit and soon we were in a full-on game of chase, dodging furniture and maybe—but definitely accidentally—knocking over old things that were probably way too old and valuable to be knocked down.
paras.zh: 他紧追不舍，很快我俩就闹成一团追逐，躲着家具，还——绝对是意外地——撞倒了那些怕是又老又贵、本不该碰的东西。

paras.en: We were well beyond the age of kids who should have been playing this kind of thing, of course.
paras.zh: 当然，我们早过了该玩这种游戏的年纪。

paras.en: At least that was what Suddenly, Agnarr changed course, taking a sharp left to cut me off.
paras.zh: 至少本该如此——突然，安格瑞变向，猛地左拐来截我。

paras.en: I screeched as he lunged for the book, throwing myself to the side only to knock into a statue of a horse.
paras.zh: 我尖叫一声，他扑向书时我往旁一闪，却撞上一尊马雕像。

paras.en: A very familiar-looking horse.
paras.zh: 一匹看着十分眼熟的马。

paras.en: Wait, was that a statue of the Water Nokk?
paras.zh: 等等，那是水马（Water Nokk）的雕像？

paras.en: I dove to try to save it, but I was too late.
paras.zh: 我扑过去想救，却为时已晚。

paras.en: It fell forward with a loud… Grinding sound?
paras.zh: 它向前倒下，发出一声巨响……是齿轮转动声？

paras.en: What on earth?
paras.zh: 到底怎么回事？

paras.en: Agnarr and I both froze in our tracks.
paras.zh: 安格瑞和我都僵在原地。

paras.en: Dust billowed in the air.
paras.zh: 尘土腾起。

paras.en: The bookcase behind the statue had swung open wide, revealing an arched passageway beyond.
paras.zh: 雕像后的书架豁然敞开，露出一道拱形通道。

paras.en: I glanced over at Agnarr.
paras.zh: 我瞥向安格瑞。

paras.en: His shocked expression confirmed he’d had no idea there was a secret door in the library.
paras.zh: 他震惊的表情印证了：他根本不知图书馆里还有密门。

paras.en: He’d shown me other secret passages.
paras.zh: 他带我看过别的密道。

paras.en: Useful ones that could be used to sneak out of the castle unseen.
paras.zh: 都是能神不知鬼不觉溜出城堡的实用通道。

paras.en: But this was new. “What is this?” Agnarr asked, stepping forward to examine the bookcase.
paras.zh: 可这扇是新的。“这是什么？”安格瑞上前查看书架。

paras.en: As if that was the most interesting part about all of this.
paras.zh: 仿佛那才是整件事里最有趣的部分。

paras.en: I watched, impatiently, as he checked out the hinges, then turned to the Water Nokk, as if trying to piece the mechanics together.
paras.zh: 我焦急地看着他检查合页，又转向水马，像在琢磨机关原理。

paras.en: I nearly screamed in frustration.
paras.zh: 我差点急得叫出声。

paras.en: All I cared about was the secret room.
paras.zh: 我只在乎那间密室。

paras.en: Unwilling to wait any longer, I grabbed a candlestick off the wall and dashed through the passageway, which dead-ended into a dark, small, windowless room with a table in the center.
paras.zh: 不愿再等，我扯下墙上的烛台，冲进通道——尽头是一间黑暗、狭小、无窗的屋子，中央摆着张桌子。

paras.en: On the table was an ornate candelabra, which I lit with my small candlestick.
paras.zh: 桌上有一座华丽的烛台，我用小烛台把它点亮。

paras.en: Soon the whole room began to sparkle and shine, the light catching tiny flecks of crystals embedded in stone shelves that rose floor to ceiling on all sides.
paras.zh: 很快整间屋子开始闪闪发亮，光落在四面直达天花板的石架上嵌着的细碎水晶上。

paras.en: I drew in an admiring breath, twirling around.
paras.zh: 我惊叹着吸了口气，转了个圈。

paras.en: What a magical place!
paras.zh: 多神奇的地方！

paras.en: Magical and…messy.
paras.zh: 神奇又……凌乱。

paras.en: The shelves were covered in dusty old objects that clearly hadn’t been used for years: glass beakers, And books.
paras.zh: 架上覆满积灰的旧物，显然多年没动过：玻璃烧杯，还有书。

paras.en: So many books.
paras.zh: 好多书。

paras.en: Not ordinary books like the ones in the regular library either, which were old but not as old as these.
paras.zh: 也不是普通图书馆里那种书——那些虽旧，却没这些老。

paras.en: These books looked like they’d been in here, gathering dust, for a thousand years.
paras.zh: 这些书像在这儿落灰了一千年。

paras.en: My eyes were also drawn to a rickety old table in the center of the room.
paras.zh: 我的目光也被屋子中央一张摇摇欲坠的旧桌吸引。

paras.en: It was covered in scrolls of ancient paper that crumbled at the corners, all with writing in languages I couldn’t decipher.
paras.zh: 桌上堆着古纸卷轴，边角一碰就碎，上面写着我看不懂的文字。

paras.en: Among the scrolls were piles of old maps with drawings of foreign lands and sea monsters scrawled across their pages. “This is amazing!” I cried, twirling around the room. “How long has it been here?
paras.zh: 卷轴间还摞着旧地图，页上潦草画着异国土地和海怪。“太了不起了！”我转着圈喊，“它在这儿多久了？

paras.en: Does anyone know it exists?” “My father did, evidently,” Agnarr replied, stepping up beside me.
paras.zh: 有人知道它的存在吗？”“我父亲显然知道，”安格瑞走到我身边答。

paras.en: I whirled around, confused.
paras.zh: 我猛地转身，一脸困惑。

paras.en: He pointed to blueprints I hadn’t noticed yet, lying at the edge of the table. “That’s his handwriting,” he said flatly.
paras.zh: 他指向桌边一沓我先前没注意的蓝图。“那是他的笔迹，”他淡淡说。

paras.en: Then he turned and pointed to a dusty portrait in the corner of a woman wearing a crown. “And that’s my mother.” I stared at the portrait, surprised.
paras.zh: 接着他转身，指向角落一幅蒙尘的画像——画中女子戴着王冠。“那是我母亲。”我望着画像，惊讶。

paras.en: Agnarr never talked about his mother.
paras.zh: 安格瑞从没提过他母亲。

paras.en: I didn’t even know her name.
paras.zh: 我甚至不知她叫什么。

paras.en: I stared at the portrait, immediately identifying the resemblance between the woman and her son.
paras.zh: 我盯着画像，立刻看出那女子与她儿子的相似。

paras.en: Same reddish-blond hair.
paras.zh: 一样的红棕发。

paras.en: Same green eyes.
paras.zh: 一样的绿眼。

paras.en: But unlike Agnarr’s eyes, which always sparkled like the sun, this woman’s eyes looked unbearably sad.
paras.zh: 可不同于安格瑞总如阳光闪耀的眼睛，这女子的眼神透着难以承受的悲伤。

paras.en: As if she held a terrible secret. “You never talk about your mother,” I said softly, for the first time wondering why. “She…disappeared when I was young,” he said slowly. “They searched and searched for her, but never found her.” He shrugged impatiently, as if he didn’t care. “At least that’s what they told me.
paras.zh: 仿佛藏着可怕的秘密。“你从没提过你母亲，”我轻声说，头一回纳闷为何。“她……在我小时候就消失了，”他缓缓说，“他们找了又找，却没找到。”他不耐烦地耸肩，像不在乎。“至少他们是这么告诉我的。

paras.en: I have no idea if it’s true.” “Why wouldn’t it be true?” I asked, though I wondered if I should press him.
paras.zh: 我不知是真是假。”“为何会是假的？”我问，虽犹豫该不该逼他。

paras.en: He looked so upset, his face dark and brooding.
paras.zh: 他看起来那么难过，脸色阴沉、若有所思。

paras.en: As if he was on the verge of crying.
paras.zh: 像快要哭出来。

paras.en: Or maybe I guess we all had our secrets. “You know what, who cares?” I announced resolutely, trying to lighten his mood. “It’s just a dumb old room anyway.
paras.zh: 或许……我想，我们都有各自的秘密。“你猜怎么着，谁在乎呢？”我决然宣布，想让他振作，“反正就是个傻旧房间。

paras.en: Smelly, too.
paras.zh: 还一股味儿。

paras.en: Let’s close it up and forget we ever saw it.
paras.zh: 我们把它关上，当从没见过。

paras.en: There’s nothing interesting in here anyway.” It was the last thing I wanted to do, of course.
paras.zh: 这儿反正也没什么有趣的。”当然，这正是最违背我心愿的事。

paras.en: I mean, who knew what kind of ancient wisdom might be buried in a room like this?
paras.zh: 我是说，谁知道这屋里埋着怎样的古老智慧？

paras.en: Perhaps it even held some sort of clue to breaking through the mist.
paras.zh: 说不定还藏着什么冲破迷雾的线索。

paras.en: Some historical record of when something like the mist had happened before—and how the people of the past had dispersed it.
paras.zh: 某段从前也发生过类似迷雾、而古人如何驱散它的记载。

paras.en: But Agnarr looked so distraught.
paras.zh: 可安格瑞看起来那么痛苦。

paras.en: Like simply standing in the room was causing him physical pain.
paras.zh: 仿佛只是站在这屋里，就让他肉体生疼。

paras.en: I had to get him out of there.
paras.zh: 我得把他弄出去。

paras.en: And fast.
paras.zh: 而且得快。

paras.en: I held up The Little Mermaid But he only pushed it away, walking to the other side of the room.
paras.zh: 我举起《小美人鱼》——可他只推开，走到屋子另一头。

paras.en: He stared up at the old books, his face twisted with anger. “All these secrets!” he burst out. “My whole life!
paras.zh: 他仰头盯着旧书，脸因愤怒拧着。“这么多秘密！”他脱口而出，“我整辈子！

paras.en: No one told me anything.
paras.zh: 没一个人告诉我任何事。

paras.en: It was all secrets, secrets, secrets!
paras.zh: 全是秘密，秘密，秘密！

paras.en: And now my father’s dead.
paras.zh: 如今我父亲死了。

paras.en: And my mother’s gone.
paras.zh: 我母亲不见了。

paras.en: And all the answers are gone with them.” He slammed his fist against the wall.
paras.zh: 所有答案都随他们去了。”他一拳砸在墙上。

paras.en: Then he turned to me, his brilliant green eyes practically gleaming with misery. “Please, Iduna.
paras.zh: 然后他转向我，明亮的绿眼里几乎闪着痛苦。“求你，伊杜娜。

paras.en: Promise me now.
paras.zh: 现在就答应我。

paras.en: No secrets between us.
paras.zh: 我们之间，绝无秘密。

paras.en: Ever.” My heart suddenly gave a jolt.
paras.zh: 永远。”我的心突然一震。

paras.en: I dropped the book, which landed on the table with a heavy thud.
paras.zh: 书从我手中滑落，重重砸在桌上。

paras.en: But I couldn’t bring myself to reach down to pick it up, too afraid I’d topple over if I tried.
paras.zh: 可我下不去手去捡，生怕一弯腰就栽倒。

paras.en: No secrets?
paras.zh: 绝无秘密？

paras.en: How could he ask for that?
paras.zh: 他怎会提出这种要求？

paras.en: But then, of course, he didn’t know.
paras.zh: 可当然，他不知道。

paras.en: To him, I was an open book.
paras.zh: 在他眼里，我是一本摊开的书。

paras.en: He had no idea the depths of my deception.
paras.zh: 他全然不知我欺骗的深浅。

paras.en: How I’d lied to him every day since we’d met.
paras.zh: 不知我自相识起，日日都在对他撒谎。

paras.en: Lies stacked upon lies on top of lies, like some crazy house of cards that could come crashing down at the slightest The lump in my throat threatened to choke me.
paras.zh: 谎上叠谎，再叠谎，像座疯狂的纸牌屋，稍有风吹草动便轰然倒塌——喉头的硬块几乎要哽住我。

paras.en: But I forced myself to suck in a breath, trying desperately to channel some inner calm.
paras.zh: 可我逼自己吸进一口气，拼命想寻得一丝内心平静。

paras.en: What was it Agnarr always said before he went to address the people?
paras.zh: 安格瑞每次去见百姓前总说什么来着？

paras.en: Conceal, don’t feel. “I’ve got to go!” I blurted out, doing a particularly terrible job at the whole “concealing” thing.
paras.zh: 掩饰，别去感受。“我得走了！”我脱口而出，把“掩饰”这件事做得一塌糊涂。

paras.en: My best friend—the boy I loved more than anyone else in the world—was standing before me, asking me to tell the truth.
paras.zh: 我最好的朋友——这世上我爱过胜过一切的那个男孩——正站在我面前，要我说出真相。

paras.en: And I couldn’t do it.
paras.zh: 可我做不到。

paras.en: Even for him.
paras.zh: 即便为了他。

paras.en: Especially “Iduna, what’s wrong?” Agnarr asked, looking alarmed at my reaction.
paras.zh: 尤其…… “伊杜娜，怎么了？”安格瑞问，被我的反应吓到。

paras.en: He reached out, taking my hands in his own and squeezing them tight.
paras.zh: 他伸出手，握住我的，紧紧攥着。

paras.en: My heart fluttered as he met my eyes with his own.
paras.zh: 他与我对视时，我的心一阵乱颤。

paras.en: Eyes so deep and green and bright, but filled with such confusion.
paras.zh: 那双眼那么深、那么绿、那么亮，却满是困惑。

paras.en: He didn’t understand.
paras.zh: 他不懂。

paras.en: He’d never “What’s wrong, Iduna?” he repeated, softer this time, reaching up to trace my cheek with feathery fingers, leaving a trail of fire in their wake.
paras.zh: 他永远不会—— “怎么了，伊杜娜？”他又问，这次更轻，伸手用羽般的指尖描过我的脸颊，所过之处留下一道火痕。

paras.en: I should go.
paras.zh: 我该走。

paras.en: I should leave.
paras.zh: 我该离开。

paras.en: I should run from this room and never come back.
paras.zh: 我该逃出这房间，再不回来。

paras.en: But, of course, I couldn’t.
paras.zh: 可当然，我做不到。

paras.en: I could no more walk out of the room than I could break through the mist itself.
paras.zh: 我走不出这房间，正如我穿不透那迷雾。

paras.en: Instead, I closed my eyes.
paras.zh: 于是我闭上眼。

paras.en: Tried to still my racing heart. “Nothing,” I whispered. “I just…” I trailed off, unsure what to say.
paras.zh: 想让狂跳的心静下来。“没什么，”我低语，“我只是……”我说不下去，不知该说什么。

paras.en: Not sure if I’d ever know what to say again.
paras.zh: 不确定自己是否还能再说对话。

paras.en: Every word that came from my mouth tasted like a lie, even the ones that were true.
paras.zh: 从我口中说出的每个字，都尝着谎言的味道，连真话也是。

paras.en: What was I going to do? “I think I know.” My eyes flew open. “What?” “I know what you’re hiding.” A cold knot formed in my stomach. “What I’m hiding?” I repeated. “You…do?” I could barely get out the words.
paras.zh: 我该怎么办？“我想我知道了。”我猛地睁眼。“什么？” “我知道你在藏什么。”胃里结成一团冷硬。“我藏的？”我重复，“你……知道？”我几乎吐不出字。

paras.en: My whole world felt as if it were teetering on the edge of a cliff, ready to fall into the abyss.
paras.zh: 我的整个世界仿佛悬在悬崖边，随时要坠入深渊。

paras.en: He nodded slowly, his eyes never leaving mine.
paras.zh: 他缓缓点头，目光从未离开我。

paras.en: The “Don’t worry,” he whispered. “I feel it, too.
paras.zh: 那“别怕，”他低语，“我也感觉到了。

paras.en: I’ve been feeling it for a while now.
paras.zh: 这段日子一直有。

paras.en: Since our last journey out to the dam.” His face turned bright red. “Though I wasn’t sure at first if you did, too.
paras.zh: 从我们上回去了水坝那趟起。”他脸涨得通红。“虽起初我不敢确定你也是。

paras.en: But now…I think…” He choked out a laugh. “Wow.
paras.zh: 可现在……我想……”他呛出一声笑。“哇。

paras.en: I’m really bad at this, huh?” And suddenly I realized exactly what he was trying to say.
paras.zh: 我这方面真糟，是吧？”而我忽然完全明白了他想说什么。

paras.en: What secret of mine he’d uncovered.
paras.zh: 他窥破了我哪个秘密。

paras.en: A secret that had been bursting inside of me for months now, even though it had gone unacknowledged until that very moment.
paras.zh: 一个在我心里鼓胀了好几个月、却直到此刻才被承认的秘密。

paras.en: Relief crashed over me like a tidal wave and I found myself starting to laugh.
paras.zh: 如潮水般的释然淹没了我，我竟笑出了声。

paras.en: It was a totally wrong reaction, but I couldn’t help it.
paras.zh: 这反应全不对，可我忍不住。

paras.en: I couldn’t stop laughing.
paras.zh: 我停不下来。

paras.en: His face fell.
paras.zh: 他的脸沉了。

paras.en: His eyes clouded again. “Oh,” he said. “Maybe I was wrong—” And then my lips met his.
paras.zh: 眼神又蒙上阴翳。“哦，”他说，“也许我错了——”而那时，我的唇贴上他的。

paras.en: For a moment he stood there as if frozen in place.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻，他立在原地，像被冻住。

paras.en: Then, slowly, his hands reached out and cupped my cheeks, pulling me close to him.
paras.zh: 接着，他的手缓缓伸出，捧住我的脸，把我拉近。

paras.en: And he kissed me back.
paras.zh: 他也回吻了我。

paras.en: This was wrong.
paras.zh: 这不对。

paras.en: I knew it was wrong.
paras.zh: 我知道这不对。

paras.en: And yet—perhaps it was that very wrongness that made it feel so right.
paras.zh: 可然而——或许正是这份不对，才让它如此正确。

paras.en: So good and perfect and sweet.
paras.zh: 这么好、这么圆满、这么甜。

paras.en: We were all alone, in a secret room.
paras.zh: 我们独处在一间密室里。

paras.en: No one could see.
paras.zh: 没人能看见。

paras.en: No one would know.
paras.zh: 没人会知道。

paras.en: And we were kissing.
paras.zh: 而我们正在接吻。

paras.en: Our lips joined felt clumsy at first, but somehow that made it all the better, a new adventure we’d embarked upon together.
paras.zh: 双唇相贴，起初笨拙，却不知怎的让一切更好，像我们一同踏上的新冒险。

paras.en: His mouth moved hungrily against mine, and his hands tangled in my hair.
paras.zh: 他的唇饥渴地压着我的，双手缠进我的发。

paras.en: I clamped my hands on his hips, pulling him closer.
paras.zh: 我双手扣住他的腰，把他拉得更近。

paras.en: Our bodies seemed to melt into one another until I was unsure where I ended and he began.
paras.zh: 我们的身体仿佛融为一体，我分不清哪里是我、哪里是他。

paras.en: Thud!
paras.zh: 咚！

paras.en: We broke apart, startled by the noise.
paras.zh: 我们分开，被那声响惊到。

paras.en: It took us a moment to realize it was just the Little Mermaid “Uh…” Agnarr stammered when I rose to my feet again, as if he’d lost all power of speech. “Wow.
paras.zh: 我们过了片刻才反应过来，不过是《小美人鱼》—— “呃……”我重新站起时，安格瑞结巴着，像失了言语。“哇。

paras.en: That was…wow.” “Wow,” I agreed, daring to look at him again.
paras.zh: 那真是……哇。”“哇，”我附和，壮起胆又看向他。

paras.en: His eyes were glazed over.
paras.zh: 他眼神发直。

paras.en: But he looked happy.
paras.zh: 可他看起来开心。

paras.en: Almost as happy as I felt.
paras.zh: 几乎和我一样开心。

paras.en: Feeling brave, I leaned forward again, planting a kiss on his cheek.
paras.zh: 我鼓起勇气，又凑上前，在他脸颊印下一吻。

paras.en: Then, before he could react, I danced over to the exit, waving the Little Mermaid “I’m going to read this first,” I told him.
paras.zh: 然后趁他没反应，我舞步般跳向出口，挥着《小美人鱼》—— “我要先读这本，”我告诉他。

paras.en: Agnarr stared at me.
paras.zh: 安格瑞盯着我。

paras.en: His face was adorably flushed, redder than I’d ever seen it before.
paras.zh: 他脸可爱地泛红，比我见过的任何时都红。

paras.en: I gave a small wave before heading down the passageway, the book clutched to my chest.
paras.zh: 我轻轻一挥手，沿着通道走去，把书紧抱在胸前。

paras.en: I’d almost made it out before he finally spoke. “Iduna…” I stopped.
paras.zh: 我几乎走到头，他才终于开口。“伊杜娜……”我停住。

paras.en: Turned. “Yes, Your Majesty?” He grinned at me. “Don’t tell me how it ends.”
paras.zh: 转过身。“在，陛下？”他冲我咧嘴。“别告诉我结局。”

paras.en: SHE’D KISSED ME.
paras.zh: 她吻了我。

paras.en: SHE’D KISSED ME “Agnarr!
paras.zh: 她吻了我—— “安格瑞！

paras.en: Could you at least pretend to be paying attention?” I looked up, realizing everyone in the council meeting room was staring at me.
paras.zh: 你至少装装样子、听一听总行吧？”我抬起头，发现会议厅里所有人都盯着我说。

paras.en: We’d been having another one of those endlessly boring diplomacy meetings all afternoon, but I hadn’t been able to pay attention to anything being said.
paras.zh: 整个下午我们又开了场没完没了、无聊透顶的外交会议，可我根本没听进半个字。

paras.en: And who could blame me?
paras.zh: 这也怪不得我。

paras.en: How could one focus on politics and foreign relations when one had a memory of a perfect kiss from a perfect girl running through one’s head? “Agnarr, please.
paras.zh: 脑海里全是那个完美的女孩、那个完美的吻在回放，谁还能把心思放在政治和邦交上？“安格瑞，拜托。

paras.en: We need your input here.” Lord Peterssen was beginning to sound cross.
paras.zh: 我们需要你的意见。”彼得森大人开始有些不耐了。

paras.en: I sighed and straightened in my chair, doing my best to push thoughts of Iduna out of my brain.
paras.zh: 我叹口气，在椅子上坐直，尽力把关于伊杜娜的念头推出脑海。

paras.en: Which was impossible, of course, but at least they could dance in the back part for a while, instead of taking up my entire attention. “What are we talking about again?” I asked, trying to look like “The kingdom of Vassar.
paras.zh: 当然不可能，但至少能让它们先去后台转悠一会儿，别占着我全部的注意力。“我们在说啥来着？”我装出…… “瓦萨尔王国。

paras.en: It’s got a nice port.
paras.zh: 他们有个好港口。

paras.en: Great trade opportunities.
paras.zh: 贸易机会绝佳。

paras.en: It would be a boon for us to join our two kingdoms together in an alliance,” Peterssen said. “Uh, sure.
paras.zh: 若我们两国结盟，对彼此都大有裨益，”彼得森说。“呃，当然。

paras.en: That sounds great.” Why did I care about any of this again? “Really?
paras.zh: 听起来不错。”我干嘛要在意这些？“真的？

paras.en: Then you agree?
paras.zh: 那你同意了？

paras.en: You don’t want to think about it first?” Peterssen was peering at me curiously. “Or at least meet the girl?” I almost fell out of my chair. “Wait, what?” “The king of Vassar’s daughter?
paras.zh: 不需先想想？”彼得森好奇地打量我。“或者至少去见见那姑娘？”我差点从椅子上摔下去。“等等，什么？”“瓦萨尔国王的女儿？

paras.en: Runa?
paras.zh: 鲁娜？

paras.en: He’s offered you her hand in marriage.” Peterssen gave me a pointed look, silently scolding me for not listening earlier. “A fine lady,” piped in Frederick, one of the council members.
paras.zh: 他要把女儿许配给你。”彼得森意味深长地瞪我一眼，无声地责备我先前没听讲。“一位出色的姑娘，”议会成员弗雷德里克插话。

paras.en: He was short and burly, and had the biggest, reddest mustache I’d ever seen on a man. “Quite beautiful, too, from what I understand.
paras.zh: 他个子矮、身板壮，留着我见过最浓最红的八字胡。“据我所知，也相当美。

paras.en: Would make for a regal queen and a good mother.” Queen?
paras.zh: 会是一位威仪的王后，也是位好母亲。”王后？

paras.en: Mother?
paras.zh: 母亲？

paras.en: Peterssen sighed deeply. “Agnarr, you’re eighteen.
paras.zh: 彼得森深深叹气。“安格瑞，你十八了。

paras.en: In a few years, you’ll be taking the throne of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 再过几年，你就要继承阿伦黛尔的王位。

paras.en: Which means you need to sire an heir to the throne.
paras.zh: 这意味着你需要诞下王位继承人。

paras.en: Maybe two.
paras.zh: 也许还要两个。

paras.en: And to do that, you need a wife.
paras.zh: 要做到这点，你需要一位妻子。

paras.en: Sooner rather than later.” My mind immediately flashed to Iduna.
paras.zh: 宜早不宜迟。”我的思绪立刻飘向伊杜娜。

paras.en: Which was ridiculous, of course.
paras.zh: 这当然荒唐。

paras.en: They’d never let me marry her.
paras.zh: 他们绝不会允许我娶她。

paras.en: She was, by all rights, a commoner.
paras.zh: 按身份，她不过是个平民。

paras.en: I was supposed to marry a princess from a different kingdom to strengthen Arendelle’s position.
paras.zh: 我本该迎娶别国王室公主，以巩固阿伦黛尔的地位。

paras.en: Especially after my father’s death.
paras.zh: 尤其父亲过世之后。

paras.en: Peterssen had done his best as regent, but the wolves were always sniffing at the doors of a kingdom with a young ruler.
paras.zh: 彼得森作为摄政已竭尽全力，可狼群总在嗅着年轻君主治下王国的门缝。

paras.en: I knew all this in my head.
paras.zh: 这些我全明白。

paras.en: I had always known it, deep down.
paras.zh: 打心底里，我一直明白。

paras.en: But in my heart… Without thinking, I rubbed my thumb across my lower lip.
paras.zh: 可我心里……我不假思索，用拇指蹭过下唇。

paras.en: I could still feel the phantom bliss of her soft mouth moving against mine.
paras.zh: 仍仿佛能感到她柔软的唇贴着我的那份虚幻欢愉。

paras.en: Iduna I faked a cough.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜…… 我假装咳了一声。

paras.en: Ridiculous, certainly, but all I could come up with on short notice. “I’m not feeling well,” I announced. “I need a break.
paras.zh: 自然荒唐，可仓促间我只想得出这个。“我不舒服，”我宣布，“我得歇会儿。

paras.en: We can talk about this another day.” I started toward the door. “But, sire!” protested Peterssen.
paras.zh: 这事改天再谈。”我朝门口走去。“可是，陛下！”彼得森抗议。

paras.en: I stopped in my tracks. “I’ve gone eighteen years without a wife,” I said slowly. “Surely you gentlemen can wait a few more days to foist one on me.” “We’re not asking you to decide right now,” Frederick responded. “Just for you to keep an open mind.
paras.zh: 我停下脚步。“我过了十八年没妻子的日子，”我缓缓说，“几位大人总可以多等几天，再硬塞一个给我吧。” “我们不是要你现在就决定，”弗雷德里克答道，“只是请你敞开心扉。

paras.en: And allow the young lady to come visit us in Arendelle.
paras.zh: 并允许那位年轻小姐来阿伦黛尔做客。

paras.en: So she can experience the beauty and charm of our kingdom for herself.” “Sure.
paras.zh: 让她亲眼见识我国之美与魅力。”“行。

paras.en: That’s fine.
paras.zh: 可以。

paras.en: Whatever you want to do.” I was already halfway to the door, desperate to escape those gazes, the looks of men who expected me to lead but doubted my ability to do so.
paras.zh: 随你们安排。”我已经走到半路，一心想逃开那些目光——那些期待我领导、却又怀疑我能力的男人的目光。

paras.en: I could feel Peterssen’s eyes on me, but I refused to look in his direction.
paras.zh: 我感到彼得森的目光落在我身上，却偏不肯朝他那个方向看。

paras.en: This is your fault!
paras.zh: 都是你的错！

paras.en: You brought her here.
paras.zh: 是你把她带来的。

paras.en: The most beautiful, kind, funny girl in the world.
paras.zh: 这世上最美丽、最善良、最有趣的姑娘。

paras.en: What did you expect would happen?
paras.zh: 你指望会发生什么？

paras.en: But I couldn’t say any of that.
paras.zh: 可这些我一句也说不出口。

paras.en: They’d never understand.
paras.zh: 他们永远不会懂。

paras.en: And so, with as much dignity as I could muster, I lifted my head high and strode out of the council chambers like the king I was.
paras.zh: 于是，我竭力端起尊严，昂起头，像我身为国王那般大步走出议会厅。

paras.en: Conceal, don’t feel.
paras.zh: 掩饰，别去感受。

paras.en: Don’t let it show….
paras.zh: 别让它显露……

paras.en: “YOUR USUAL, MISS IDUNA?” ASKED MRS.
paras.zh: “老样子吗，伊杜娜小姐？”布洛杰特夫人问。

paras.en: Blodget as I practically skipped into her bakery later that day.
paras.zh: 那天下午我几乎是蹦跳着进了她的面包房。

paras.en: I peered into the glass cabinet where she kept all her special treats.
paras.zh: 我凑近她放各式点心的玻璃柜瞧。

paras.en: Flaky pastries, gigantic cookies, and, of course, chocolate.
paras.zh: 酥皮点心、巨大的曲奇，当然，还有巧克力。

paras.en: And, that right there, whatever that is,” I added impulsively, pointing to what looked like a miniature Arendelle Castle made entirely of chocolate.
paras.zh: 还有，那边那个，不管那是什么，”我一时冲动，指着那座看起来全用巧克力做的小号阿伦黛尔城堡，“我也要。”

paras.en: The cookies would be for the younger children in the orphanage.
paras.zh: 这些曲奇是给孤儿院的小孩子们的。

paras.en: Now that I was working and had an income, I liked to bring them treats.
paras.zh: 如今我有了工作、有了收入，喜欢给他们带点心。

paras.en: While the orphanage did well at stretching their budget to make sure everyone was fed, there was never much left over for desserts.
paras.zh: 孤儿院很会精打细算，保证人人吃饱，却从没多少余钱买甜点。

paras.en: The chocolate however, was for me.
paras.zh: 不过巧克力，是给我自己的。

paras.en: As Mrs.
paras.zh: 布洛杰特夫人

paras.zh: 忙活着把曲奇打包时，我在店里转悠，看着一个个柜子。

paras.en: But even as I peered through the glass, my mind was completely elsewhere.

paras.en: Namely, on Agnarr’s kiss. “You look happy today,” Mrs.
paras.zh: 确切说，飘在安格瑞的吻上。“你今天看起来挺高兴，”布洛杰特夫人

paras.en: Blodget remarked as she came over with the box of cookies, tied with a red ribbon. “Of course, “Thank you,” I said, beaming. “You didn’t have to do that.” “I know.

paras.en: I wanted to.
paras.zh: 我愿意的。

paras.en: Such a sweet thing you do for them.
paras.zh: 你为他们做的，真贴心。

paras.en: Those poor little dears.” I shrugged. “It’s the least I can do.” “Well, not all would bother to do the same, trust me,” she said, clucking her tongue. “They are lucky to have you.
paras.zh: 那些可怜的小家伙。”我耸耸肩。“这是我力所能及的最小的事。” “嗯，换成别人可不一定愿意，相信我，”她咂着舌说，“他们有你这样的运气真好。

paras.en: It was so tough, always lying to people.
paras.zh: 总是对人造假，太难受了。

paras.zh: 尤其对布洛杰特夫人

paras.zh: 这种日子还要过多久？

paras.zh: 我的思绪闪回安格瑞在图书馆说的话。

paras.en: Please, Iduna.
paras.zh: 求你，伊杜娜。

paras.en: Promise me now.
paras.zh: 现在就答应我。

paras.en: No secrets between us.
paras.zh: 我们之间，绝无秘密。

paras.en: Ever.
paras.zh: 永远。

paras.zh: 一个我永远无法许下的诺言。

paras.en: Even to the boy I loved. “Good morning, sunshine,” Johan greeted me as I entered his barn early the next morning. “You’re looking bright and cheery this morning.” I gave him a wan smile, exhaustion settling on my shoulders like a wet blanket.
paras.zh: 即便对这世上我爱的那个男孩也不行。“早晨好啊，小太阳，”第二天清晨我走进约翰的仓棚时，他招呼道，“今早你看着神清气爽。”我冲他勉强一笑，疲惫像湿毯子压上肩头。

paras.en: I hadn’t been able to sleep much the night before, tossing and turning and thinking of Agnarr.
paras.zh: 前一晚我没怎么睡，翻来覆去想着安格瑞。

paras.en: Some of it was nice—reliving our secret kisses in the library room.
paras.zh: 有些念想是甜的——回味我们在密室里的秘密之吻。

paras.en: Other parts were not, though.
paras.zh: 可有些不是。

paras.en: I tried and tried to come up with a way to tell him the truth about my past without ruining everything between us.
paras.zh: 我试了又试，想找出一个法子，把我的过去如实告诉他，又不毁掉我俩之间的一切。

paras.en: Maybe he wouldn’t care, I told myself.
paras.zh: 也许他不在乎，我对自己说。

paras.en: Maybe he would be totally fine finding out where I came from.
paras.zh: 也许得知我从哪里来，他完全能接受。

paras.en: Especially if he knew I was his rescuer.
paras.zh: 尤其若他知道我是他的救命恩人。

paras.en: How could you hate someone who saved your life?
paras.zh: 谁能恨一个救了自己命的人？

paras.en: But then I remembered his words in the library.
paras.zh: 可接着我想起他在图书馆说的话。

paras.en: How his whole life had been ensconced in secrets.
paras.zh: 他整辈子都被秘密裹着。

paras.en: If he found out I’d been lying to him this whole time, he would think me no better than anyone else.
paras.zh: 若他发现我一直以来都在骗他，会把我看得和别人一样不堪。

paras.en: He’d be so hurt.
paras.zh: 他会那么受伤。

paras.en: All the trust we’d built up between us would be lost.
paras.zh: 我们之间建立的信任将荡然无存。

paras.en: He’d probably end up hating me.
paras.zh: 他大概到头来会恨我。

paras.en: I couldn’t bear to have Agnarr hate me.
paras.zh: 我无法忍受安格瑞恨我。

paras.en: He was all I had in the world.
paras.zh: 他是我在这世上拥有的一切。

paras.en: Well, that and my job.
paras.zh: 嗯，还有我的工作。

paras.en: I realized Johan was staring at me worriedly. “What’s wrong?” he asked, putting an arm around me.
paras.zh: 我发觉约翰正担忧地盯着我。“怎么了？”他问，伸手揽住我。

paras.en: I allowed him to lead me over to a nearby bench. “You look like someone ate your pet reindeer.” I gave him a rueful smile, sinking down onto the bench. “I’m fine,” I assured him. “Just tired.” He sat down next to me. “And why wouldn’t you be?
paras.zh: 我由他领到旁边的长凳。“你那样子，像谁吃了你的宠物驯鹿。”我苦笑着，在凳上坐下。“我没事，”我向他保证，“只是累了。”他在我身旁坐下。“你当然会累。

paras.en: You’ve been working so hard,” he said, patting my knee. “Don’t think I haven’t noticed.
paras.zh: 你一直这么拼命，”他拍拍我的膝，“别以为我没看见。

paras.en: I couldn’t have asked for a better apprentice, Iduna.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜，我再挑也挑不出比你还好的学徒。

paras.en: I’m proud of all we’ve accomplished together.” He squeezed my knee.
paras.zh: 我们一起做成的事，我骄傲着呢。”他捏了捏我的膝。

paras.en: I swallowed hard, suddenly feeling slightly uncomfortable about his proximity.
paras.zh: 我狠狠咽了口唾沫，忽然对他靠得这么近有些不自在。

paras.en: Which was strange, of course.
paras.zh: 这当然奇怪。

paras.en: After all, Johan and I had been working closely together for over a year at this point.
paras.zh: 毕竟到这时，我和约翰已并肩干了一年多。

paras.en: We’d always been close.
paras.zh: 我们向来亲近。

paras.en: But something seemed different about him that day.
paras.zh: 可那天他似乎哪里不一样。

paras.en: Though I couldn’t quite put my finger on it. “I love this job,” I declared, rising to my feet, mostly to put distance between us.
paras.zh: 虽我说不清具体。

paras.en: I walked to the window, staring out at our mill.
paras.zh: “我热爱这份工作，”我宣告，站起身，多半是为了拉开距离。

paras.en: The blades were rotating steadily and I couldn’t help a swell of pride rising inside of me.
paras.zh: 我走到窗边，望着我们的磨坊。

paras.en: I had done this.
paras.zh: 叶片稳稳转着，我心里不禁涌起一股自豪。

paras.en: Something magnificent that would change Arendelle’s future. “I wouldn’t want to work anywhere else.” “I’m glad to hear it.” Johan joined me at the window, pulling me around until I faced him.
paras.zh: 这是我做到的。

paras.en: His expression was serious.
paras.zh: 一件将改变阿伦黛尔未来的了不起的事。“我哪儿也不愿去干。” “听你这么说高兴。”约翰也走到窗边，把我转过来面对他。

paras.en: Whoa.
paras.zh: 他神色认真。

paras.en: My heart started to beat faster in my chest.
paras.zh: 哇。

paras.en: Was this finally it?
paras.zh: 我的心在胸口加速跳起来。

paras.en: Was this finally the moment I’d been waiting for?
paras.zh: 终于到了吗？

paras.en: The moment he asked me to stay on with him full time? “You…want to hire me?” I asked, my voice trembling so hard I could barely get the words out.
paras.zh: 终于等到我盼的那一刻了？

paras.en: Was this really happening?
paras.zh: 他开口请我长期留下来的那一刻？“你……要雇我？”我问，声音抖得几乎吐不出字。

paras.en: Was I really getting my dream job?
paras.zh: 这真的发生了？

paras.en: To my surprise, Johan started to laugh.
paras.zh: 我真的要得到梦寐以求的工作了？

paras.en: As if I’d said the funniest thing in the world. “Iduna.” To my shock, he dropped down to one knee in front of me. “I want to marry What?
paras.zh: 出乎我意料，约翰笑了起来。

paras.en: I stared down at him, too shocked to speak.
paras.zh: 仿佛我说了世上最滑稽的话。“伊杜娜。”令我震惊的是，他在我面前单膝跪下。“我要娶 什么？

paras.en: He smiled up at me, reaching out to clasp my hands in his own.
paras.zh: 我低头盯着他，震惊得说不出话。

paras.en: Horrified, I leapt backward, instinctively putting distance between us.
paras.zh: 他抬头冲我笑，伸出手握住我的。

paras.en: His earnest expression crumbled.
paras.zh: 我吓坏了，本能地向后一跳，拉开距离。

paras.en: He scrambled back to his feet. “I…” I began, my mind racing to take back control. “I didn’t…I’m sorry.” What was I apologizing for?
paras.zh: 他诚恳的表情垮了。

paras.en: I hadn’t done anything wrong.
paras.zh: 他慌忙站起。“我……”我开口，脑子飞转想夺回主动权。“我没……对不起。”我在道什么歉？

paras.en: I was just surprised—shocked.
paras.zh: 我什么也没做错。

paras.en: I thought he was offering me a job.
paras.zh: 我只是意外——震惊。

paras.en: Not marriage!
paras.zh: 我以为他是要给我工作。

paras.en: He sucked in a deep breath and the disappointment emptied from his face, replaced by a blank mask. “I thought…” “You thought…what?” I could barely breathe. “I thought we worked well together,” he sputtered. “I thought we were a good team.” “We do.
paras.zh: 不是求婚！

paras.en: We…are.” “Then why not be more?” he asked, his eyes now pleading. “Iduna, we could be happy together.
paras.zh: 他深吸一口气，脸上的失望褪去，换上一副空白的面具。“我以为……” “你以为……什么？”我几乎喘不过气。“我以为我们配合得很好，”他结巴着，“以为我们是好搭档。” “我们是。

paras.en: You and I.” My thoughts and mind were racing so fast it was almost impossible for anything to make sense.
paras.zh: 我们……是。” “那为何不能再进一步？”他问，眼神如今带着恳求，“伊杜娜，我们能一起幸福的。

paras.en: How long had he been harboring these feelings for me?
paras.zh: 你和我。”我的思绪乱成一团，快得几乎什么都说不通。

paras.en: Had I been blind to his true intentions all this time?
paras.zh: 他把这份心意藏了多久？

paras.en: I liked Johan.
paras.zh: 难道我一直没看清他的真意？

paras.en: He was smart.
paras.zh: 我喜欢约翰。

paras.en: Creative.
paras.zh: 他聪明。

paras.en: A But not his, evidently. “I’m sorry,” I stammered, wringing my hands together in front of me. “You’re a good friend.
paras.zh: 有创意。

paras.en: And I love working with you.
paras.zh: 可显然不是那种…… “对不起，”我结巴着，双手在身前绞在一起，“你是个好朋友。

paras.en: It’s just…” I trailed off, not knowing what else to say.
paras.zh: 我也爱和你一起工作。

paras.en: This was not good.
paras.zh: 只是……”我说不下去，不知还能说什么。

paras.en: Not good at all.
paras.zh: 这可不妙。

paras.en: Sure enough, his face turned beet red, anger rising to the surface. “What, do you think you’re too good for me?” he demanded. “You, with your fancy education at the castle?
paras.zh: 一点都不妙。

paras.en: Your fancy friendship with the prince?” I felt the blood drain from my face.
paras.zh: 果然，他的脸涨成猪肝色，怒气浮上表面。“怎么，你觉得高攀了我？”他逼问，“就凭你在城堡里受的那套好教育？

paras.en: My mind flashed to Agnarr in the secret room.
paras.zh: 就凭你和王子的那点‘交情’？”我感到血色从脸上褪尽。

paras.en: His lips brushing over mine.
paras.zh: 我的思绪闪回密室里的安格瑞。

paras.en: Kisses so tender.
paras.zh: 他的唇拂过我的。

paras.en: So sweet.
paras.zh: 吻那么温柔。

paras.en: Had that only been days before?
paras.zh: 那么甜。

paras.en: Johan caught my expression.
paras.zh: 那不过是几天前的事吗？

paras.en: His eyebrows rose. “Oh.” He started to laugh. “I see. “You’re in love with the prince.” I staggered backward. “I am not!” He nodded slowly, realization dawning in his eyes. “Yes, that’s it, isn’t it?
paras.zh: 约翰捕捉到我的表情。

paras.en: That’s why you’d never lower yourself to marry a commoner like me!
paras.zh: 他挑起眉。“哦。”他笑起来。“我明白了。 “你爱上王子了。”我踉跄后退。“我才没有！”他缓缓点头，眼里渐渐了然。“对，就是这样，是不是？

paras.en: You have delusions of grandeur.
paras.zh: 所以你才不肯委屈自己，嫁给我这样的平民！

paras.en: You think he’s going to make you queen?
paras.zh: 你做着黄粱美梦。

paras.en: You are such a fool!” “I don’t think that!” I protested. “I hope not,” he shot back. “Because it will never happen.
paras.zh: 以为他会立你为后？

paras.en: People like him, they don’t care about people like us.
paras.zh: 你真是个傻瓜！” “我才不这么想！”我抗议。“但愿你没有，”他回击，“因为这绝不可能。

paras.en: Self-made people who don’t need their benevolence to survive.” He gave me a patronizing look. “And, trust me, while they may flirt with you and see fit to sully your honor, in the end they only marry their own kind.” Johan’s cruel words shot through me like a lightning bolt to the heart.
paras.zh: 他那种人，根本不在乎我们这种人。

paras.en: I knew this, of course.
paras.zh: 靠自己双手立业、不需要他们施舍也能活的人。”他居高临下地看我一眼。“而且，信我，他们或许会和你调情、玷污你的名节，可到头来只娶自己人。”约翰残酷的话如闪电劈进我心。

paras.en: I’d known it from the very first day I’d started having feelings for Agnarr.
paras.zh: 我当然知道。

paras.en: But a part of me had still held out hope, especially after our kiss.
paras.zh: 从我对安格瑞动心的第一天起就知道。

paras.en: Johan must have seen the effect his words had wrought in my shell-shocked expression, because his voice softened, relenting. “Look, I’m sorry,” he said. “I’m not trying to hurt your feelings.
paras.zh: 可我心里仍存着一丝希望，尤其在那吻之后。

paras.en: And I’m sorry if I came on too strong.
paras.zh: 约翰定是看出了他那番话在我震惊的脸上起的效果，于是语气软了下来，退让了。“听着，对不起，”他说，“我不是存心伤你感情。

paras.en: But I care about you, “I don’t have a crush!” I tried to say, but knew it was useless.
paras.zh: 要是我太唐突，也请你见谅。

paras.en: Everything he was saying was right.
paras.zh: 可我在乎你，” “我才没有那种小心思！”我想说，却知徒劳。

paras.en: Agnarr and I could never be together.
paras.zh: 他说的每句都对。

paras.en: And it would be so much smarter to turn my back on him now, before it was too late.
paras.zh: 我和安格瑞永远不可能在一起。

paras.en: To pair up with a man like Johan instead.
paras.zh: 趁还来得及，转身离开他才是明智之举。

paras.en: Someone who was my equal.
paras.zh: 转投约翰这样的男人。

paras.en: And, hey—maybe I could learn to love him someday.
paras.zh: 一个与我平等的人。

paras.en: Or at least grow old in mutual respect.
paras.zh: 嘿——说不定有朝一日我能学会爱他。

paras.en: Many marriages survived on less.
paras.zh: 或至少在相敬如宾中老去。

paras.en: But no.
paras.zh: 许多婚姻靠的还不及这些。

paras.en: It was already too late for me.
paras.zh: 可不。

paras.en: I was desperately in love with my prince.
paras.zh: 对我来说已经太迟了。

paras.en: The way he made me laugh, the way he made me think.
paras.zh: 我已无可救药地爱上我的王子。

paras.en: The way he made chills run down my spine when he reached out and caressed my cheek with his soft fingers.
paras.zh: 他逗我笑的样子，他引我思的样子。

paras.en: Agnarr made me feel things I’d never felt before.
paras.zh: 他用柔软的指尖抚过我脸颊、让我脊背窜过战栗的样子。

paras.en: And if I couldn’t have him, I wanted no one at all.
paras.zh: 安格瑞让我尝到前所未有的感觉。

paras.en: I realized Johan was still waiting for me to respond.
paras.zh: 若得不到他，我谁也不要。

paras.en: I finally found my voice. “Look, this doesn’t have to change anything,” I tried, hoping to defuse the situation as gently as I could. “We’re still friends, right?
paras.zh: 我发觉约翰还在等我说。

paras.en: We can still work together?” Johan’s face twisted. “That’s all you care about, isn’t it?” he said in an accusing voice. “The stupid windmills.” “What do you mean?” “Go home, Iduna.
paras.zh: 我终于找回声音。“听好，这不必改变什么，”我尽量温和地想缓和局势，“我们还是朋友，对吧？

paras.en: You’ve made your choice.
paras.zh: 还能一起工作？”约翰的脸扭了。“你只在乎这个，是不是？”他责问，“那破风车。” “你什么意思？” “回家吧，伊杜娜。

paras.en: I hope it gets you what you want.” I froze. “Wait, are you…firing me?” I asked, eyes wide with horror. “What do you want me to do?” he spit out. “I’ve laid out my heart to you and you’ve trampled on it.
paras.zh: 你做了选择。

paras.en: How does one go back to talking about wind after something like that?” Of course.
paras.zh: 但愿它让你得偿所愿。”我僵住。“等等，你……在炒我？”我惊恐地瞪大眼问。“你想让我怎样？”他啐道，“我把心掏给你，你却踩在脚下。

paras.en: I had rejected him, and he was going to make me pay.
paras.zh: 这种事之后，谁还有脸回头谈风车？”当然。

paras.en: With the one thing he knew mattered to me most of all.
paras.zh: 我拒绝了他，他要让我付出代价。

paras.en: My job.
paras.zh: 用那件他最清楚对我重要的事。

paras.en: I felt tears well in my eyes, but I refused to let them fall. “You know, you talk a good game about helping people become independent,” I said, trying not to let him see how upset I was. “But when it all comes down to it?
paras.zh: 我的工作。

paras.en: You’re as selfish as the rest.” “Iduna—” “Goodbye, Johan.
paras.zh: 我眼里泛起泪，却不肯让它落下。“你倒是满口助人独立，”我说，努力不让他看出我多难过，“可真到了紧要处？

paras.en: Good luck with your windmills.” And with that, I pivoted on my heel, storming down the hill.
paras.zh: 你和旁人一样自私。”“伊杜娜——” “再见，约翰。

paras.en: I could hear him calling after me, but I refused to turn around.
paras.zh: 祝你风车顺利。”说罢，我脚跟一转，冲下山坡。

paras.en: I wouldn’t give him the satisfaction.
paras.zh: 我听见他在身后喊我，却不肯回头。

paras.en: At the bottom of the hill, I turned right by force of habit.
paras.zh: 我不会让他得意。

paras.en: Headed to the castle.
paras.zh: 到坡底，我习惯性地向右拐。

paras.en: I needed to see Agnarr.
paras.zh: 朝城堡去。

paras.en: Now.
paras.zh: 我要见安格瑞。现在。

paras.en: HE WAS ALREADY IN THE TREE WHEN I GOT there.
paras.zh: 我赶到时，他已在树上。

paras.en: As if he’d been waiting, right where I needed him to be.
paras.zh: 仿佛一直在等我，就等我需要他在的地方。

paras.en: I wanted to tackle him with relief when I saw him there, curled up on a low-hanging branch, his nose buried in a thick tome.
paras.zh: 看见他蜷在低垂的枝上、鼻尖埋进一本厚书，我几乎想扑上去抱住他，松口气。

paras.en: But I held back, Johan’s voice seeming to echo in my ears.
paras.zh: 可我忍住了，约翰的声音似还在耳边回响。

paras.en: You have delusions of grandeur.
paras.zh: 你做着黄粱美梦。

paras.en: You think he’s going to make you queen?
paras.zh: 以为他会立你为后？

paras.en: What if Johan was right and Agnarr had already decided the whole thing between us had been nothing more than a big mistake?
paras.zh: 万一约翰说得对，安格瑞早已认定我俩之间不过是个天大的错误呢？

paras.en: I couldn’t bear to lose both my job and my best friend in one day.
paras.zh: 我一天里失去工作和最好的朋友，可承受不起。

paras.en: Agnarr looked up from his book, hearing me approach.
paras.zh: 安格瑞听见我走近，从书中抬起头。

paras.en: His face brightened with a huge smile that made me want to break out into tears of relief.
paras.zh: 他脸上绽开大大的笑，让我几乎喜极而泣。

paras.en: Johan had no idea what he was talking about.
paras.zh: 约翰根本不知道自己在说什么。

paras.en: Agnarr cared about me.
paras.zh: 安格瑞在乎我。

paras.en: What we had together—it was special.
paras.zh: 我俩之间的，是特别的。

paras.en: It mattered.
paras.zh: 是紧要的。

paras.en: I climbed into the tree.
paras.zh: 我爬上树。

paras.en: Agnarr’s smile faded as he caught my face. “What’s wrong?” he asked, setting aside his book I hung my head, at first not wanting to talk about it.
paras.zh: 安格瑞看清我的脸，笑容淡了。“怎么了？”他放下书问。我垂下头，起初不想说。

paras.en: I felt so ashamed—had I missed the signs?
paras.zh: 我好羞愧——难道我漏看了信号？
