paras.zh: 况且，你无法让人快乐。

paras.en: They have to find it inside themselves.” He nodded stiffly, going quiet.
paras.zh: 快乐得他们自己心里去找。」他僵硬地点点头，沉默下来。

paras.en: I didn’t want to press him, so I just stood there, holding him close.
paras.zh: 我不想逼他，只是站在那儿，把他紧紧抱住。

paras.en: But deep down, I couldn’t help wondering if he had realized the parallel of his mother’s story to his own.
paras.zh: 但心底里，我忍不住想，他是否已看出母亲的故事与他自己何其相似。

paras.en: She had been forced to marry someone she didn’t love.
paras.zh: 她曾被逼嫁给自己不爱的人。

paras.en: And now her son was being asked to do the same.
paras.zh: 如今她的儿子也被要求这样做。

paras.en: For the good of the realm.
paras.zh: 为了王国之利。

paras.en: But what would it do to Agnarr?
paras.zh: 可这对安格瑞会造成什么？

paras.en: The trolls might claim to see the future, but I saw ours clear in front of me.
paras.zh: 地精也许自称能看见未来，但我眼前的我们的未来却清晰无比。

paras.en: And it did not end with a happily ever after.
paras.zh: 而那并非以童话般的幸福收场。

paras.en: “DO YOU KNOW WHAT A PANIC YOU CAUSED, Agnarr?” Lord Peterssen demanded when we returned, exhausted and drained from our adventure, late that night.
paras.zh: 「安格瑞，你知道你惹出多大恐慌了吗？」那天深夜我们历险归来、筋疲力尽时，彼得森勋爵厉声质问。

paras.en: One of the soldiers had spotted us coming over the bridge and had dragged us both back to the castle, under strict orders from the regent. “Do you know how many men wasted their day searching for your body, thinking we’d find you dead in a ditch somewhere?
paras.zh: 一名士兵瞧见我们过桥，便奉摄政王严令把我们俩一起拽回了城堡。「你知道有多少手下白白耗了一整天找你的尸首，以为会在哪条沟里发现你死了？

paras.en: You can’t just wander off like that without telling anyone!” I slumped in my chair in the council room, wishing the floor would open up and swallow me whole as Iduna bore witness to the biggest dressing down I’d received in my life.
paras.zh: 你不能这样一声不吭就乱跑！」我瘫在议事厅的椅子里，恨不得地板裂开把我整个吞掉，而伊杜娜正亲眼目睹我有生以来挨的最狠一顿骂。

paras.en: One I totally deserved. “Look, I—” “I warn you, do not interrupt me right now, Agnarr.” Peterssen’s voice had never sounded as threatening—and disappointed—as it did in this moment.
paras.zh: 这顿骂我完全活该。「听着，我——」「我警告你，现在别打断我，安格瑞。」彼得森的声音从未像此刻这般——既威吓又失望。

paras.en: My mouth snapped shut.
paras.zh: 我猛地闭上了嘴。

paras.en: He had every right to be livid.
paras.zh: 他完全有理由暴怒。

paras.en: It was bad enough I had left the castle without my guards.
paras.zh: 我甩开护卫离开城堡，这已经够糟了。

paras.en: But also, there had been several violent attacks carried out in the nearby hills while we were gone, all targeting the additional All making threats against the prince of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 而且，我们不在时，附近山丘发生了数起暴力袭击，矛头全都指向——还扬言要加害阿伦黛尔王子。

paras.en: When I couldn’t be found, the castle assumed the worst.
paras.zh: 找不到我，城堡上下便往最坏处想。

paras.en: The council had even started working on a new plan for succession, just in case.
paras.zh: 议事会甚至已着手拟定新的继承预案，以防万一。

paras.en: All the while I had been off gallivanting with Iduna. “We didn’t go far,” I protested, guiltily trying to justify my actions.
paras.zh: 而我全程正和伊杜娜四处游荡。「我们没走远，」我辩解道，心虚地想替自己开脱。

paras.en: But there was no justification.
paras.zh: 可这毫无借口可言。

paras.en: No matter how unhappy I’d been, no matter how much I needed escape, I had broken protocol.
paras.zh: 无论我多不快乐，无论我多渴望逃离，我都违背了规矩。

paras.en: I had put people in danger and had created an emergency that wasted castle resources.
paras.zh: 我让人陷入险境，还制造了一桩耗尽城堡资源的紧急事态。

paras.en: I had been stupid and reckless.
paras.zh: 我愚蠢又鲁莽。

paras.en: Imagine what my father would say if he were still here. “It doesn’t matter,” Peterssen snapped back. “The attacks all happened in the nearby hills.
paras.zh: 想想父亲若还在，会怎么说。「这都不重要，」彼得森厉声回道，「袭击全发生在附近山丘。

paras.en: What if these masked men had found you, all alone, unprotected?” “Um…Iduna would have protected me?” I said, lamely attempting a joke to defuse the situation.
paras.zh: 万一那些蒙面人找到独自一人、毫无防护的你呢？」「呃……伊杜娜会保护我的？」我干巴巴地想用玩笑缓和气氛。

paras.en: Bad idea.
paras.zh: 坏主意。

paras.en: Peterssen raked a hand through his hair, frustrated with me. “This is not a joke, Agnarr!” he shouted. “This is not purple sheep or imaginary spirits.
paras.zh: 彼得森烦躁地用手耙了把头发。「这不是玩笑，安格瑞！」他吼道，「这可不是紫羊，也不是什么凭空想象出来的精灵。

paras.en: Our own soldiers were attacked by enemies of the crown.
paras.zh: 我们自己的士兵遭到了王室的敌人袭击。

paras.en: People were hurt.
paras.zh: 有人受伤了。

paras.en: Our citizens are terrified.
paras.zh: 我们的百姓吓坏了。

paras.en: There are even rumors swirling around the village that the Northuldra have returned for revenge.” “That’s ridiculous!” Iduna, who had been silent up to this point, burst out.
paras.zh: 镇上甚至流传起北地人归来复仇的谣言。」「荒谬！」至此一直沉默的伊杜娜爆发了。

paras.en: But Peterssen was not to be dissuaded. “Is it?
paras.zh: 但彼得森不为所动。「是吗？

paras.en: The masks they wore depicted the sun.
paras.zh: 他们戴的面具画着太阳。

paras.en: Northuldra are the people of the sun.
paras.zh: 北地人正是太阳的子民。

paras.en: It doesn’t take too much to make the connection.” “The Northuldra don’t wear masks like that!” Iduna protested.
paras.zh: 要把两者联系起来并不难。」「北地人根本不戴那种面具！」伊杜娜抗议。

paras.en: She looked panicked. “Also, they’re peaceful people.
paras.zh: 她一脸惊慌。「而且，他们是爱好和平的民族。

paras.en: They’d never attack someone unprovoked!” Peterssen’s face grew stormy. “Enough, Iduna.
paras.zh: 绝不会无端袭击别人！」彼得森脸色阴沉。「够了，伊杜娜。

paras.en: I mean it.” She glared at him, looking as if she wanted to tear him limb from limb.
paras.zh: 我是认真的。」她瞪着他，像是恨不得把他撕成碎片。

paras.en: I reached out and squeezed her hand, trying to comfort her.
paras.zh: 我伸手握住她的手，想安慰她。

paras.en: But she only yanked it away.
paras.zh: 可她一把甩开了。

paras.en: Her whole body started trembling; she was clearly alarmed at the idea of the Northuldra returning to seek revenge against the people of Arendelle—and the prince who should never have escaped that day. “Calm down, Iduna!” I tried to reassure her. “It’s all right.
paras.zh: 她浑身开始发抖；显然，一想到北地人回来向阿伦黛尔人——以及那天本不该逃生的王子——复仇，她就惊恐万状。「冷静点，伊杜娜！」我试着让她安心，「没事的。

paras.en: We’re safe.
paras.zh: 我们很安全。

paras.en: We won’t allow them to get you, or me, or anyone.” She set her gaze on me, horror in her eyes. “Wait.
paras.zh: 我们绝不会让他们伤到你、我，或是任何人。」她定定地看着我，眼里满是恐惧。「等等。

paras.en: You Peterssen cleared his throat. “We obviously don’t know who is behind the attacks.
paras.zh: 你——彼得森清了清嗓子。「我们显然还不知道袭击背后是谁。

paras.en: We can only speculate.
paras.zh: 只能推测。

paras.en: But that being said, the attacks did I wanted to protest.
paras.zh: 但话说回来，袭击确实——我想抗议。

paras.en: But I knew when Peterssen got that look in his eyes, there was no arguing with him, and I had caused enough trouble for a lifetime.
paras.zh: 但我明白，彼得森露出那种眼神时，争辩无用，而我已经惹够一辈子的麻烦了。

paras.en: But I couldn’t be cooped up in the castle like a prisoner.
paras.zh: 可我不能像囚犯一样被关在城堡里。

paras.en: At least, not alone. “Fine,” I said. “I’ll stay put.
paras.zh: 至少，不能独自关着。「行，」我说，「我会待着不动。

paras.en: As long as Iduna can join us here.” “What?” Iduna asked in surprise.
paras.zh: 只要伊杜娜能陪我待在这儿。」「什么？」伊杜娜诧异地问。

paras.en: Peterssen shook his head. “Iduna has her own home.” “Yeah.
paras.zh: 彼得森摇摇头。「伊杜娜有她自己的家。

paras.en: Outside the castle walls.
paras.zh: 是啊。

paras.en: Where you literally just told me it was unsafe to be.” “Unsafe for you “Agnarr,” Iduna began.
paras.zh: 在城堡城墙外。

paras.en: Her voice was stern. “It’s all right.
paras.zh: 你刚刚才亲口说那儿不安全。」「对你不安全——」「安格瑞，」伊杜娜开口。

paras.en: I’ll be fine.
paras.zh: 她的声音很严厉。「没关系的。

paras.en: Besides, I have work to do.
paras.zh: 我会没事的。

paras.en: The windmills, remember?
paras.zh: 况且我还有事要做。

paras.en: I have people depending on me.
paras.zh: 风车，记得吗？

paras.en: I can’t hole up here and abandon them.” “Yeah, but what if—” “I’ll be fine “You don’t know that,” I said angrily.
paras.zh: 有人指望着我呢。

paras.en: Why was she being so stubborn? “Agnarr—” I couldn’t take it anymore. “Iduna, I order “Excuse me?” Her face turned purple. “You can’t do that!” “I’m the crown prince of Arendelle, so actually, I can,” I shot back.
paras.zh: 我不能窝在这里，扔下他们不管。」「可是万一——」「我会没事的——」「你根本不知道，」我恼火地说。

paras.en: The second the words left my mouth I regretted them.
paras.zh: 她怎么这么犟？「安格瑞——」我再也忍不了。「伊杜娜，我命令——」「你说什么？」她脸涨成紫红色。「你不能这样！」「我是阿伦黛尔的王储，所以实际上，我就能，」我回呛。

paras.en: I was being stupid, ugly, cruel.
paras.zh: 话一出口我就后悔了。

paras.en: To her, of all people.
paras.zh: 我愚蠢、刻薄又残忍。

paras.en: She looked at me as if she wanted to punch me in the mouth.
paras.zh: 尤其对她这样的人。

paras.en: Peterssen chose that moment to step in. “Prince Agnarr.
paras.zh: 她看着我，像恨不得一拳揍在我嘴上。

paras.en: A word alone, please?” I let out a frustrated breath. “Fine.” I turned back to Iduna. “But we’re not done talking.” “Oh, yes we are,” she said with a short laugh completely devoid of any mirth. “We definitely are.” And with that, she pushed back in her chair and stormed off.
paras.zh: 彼得森挑了这时插话。「安格瑞王子。

paras.en: I moved to go after her, but Peterssen grabbed my arm. “Come on,” he said. “Let her go.
paras.zh: 借一步说话，可以吗？」我泄气地呼了口气。「行。」我回头对伊杜娜说。「但我们还没谈完。」「哦，谈完了，」她短促地笑了一声，毫无笑意，「绝对谈完了。」说完，她向后一靠椅背，愤然离去。

paras.en: You can apologize for being a blockhead later.
paras.zh: 我起身要追，彼得森却抓住我的胳膊。「算了，」他说，「让她走。

paras.en: Right now, you and I need to have words.
paras.zh: 你待会儿再为当傻瓜向她道歉。

paras.en: One on one.” Reluctantly, I followed him into the library.
paras.zh: 现在，你我要好好谈谈。

paras.en: Peterssen motioned for me to sit in a nearby leather armchair.
paras.zh: 单独谈。」我不情愿地跟着他进了图书室。

paras.en: I slumped down, scrubbing my face with my hands.
paras.zh: 彼得森示意我坐近旁一张皮扶手椅。

paras.en: When I looked up again, he’d sat down across from me and was leaning forward, elbows on his knees. “Agnarr.
paras.zh: 我瘫坐下去，双手搓着脸。

paras.en: We need to talk about Iduna.” “So you agree, then.
paras.zh: 再抬头时，他已坐到对面，身体前倾，手肘支在膝上。「安格瑞。

paras.en: She should stay in the castle until the threat has passed,” I said, surprised, but happy he was on my side.
paras.zh: 我们得谈谈伊杜娜。」「那么你同意了。

paras.en: But he only sighed and shook his head.
paras.zh: 威胁解除前她该留在城堡里，」我说，又惊又喜，以为他站我这边。

paras.en: Suddenly, he looked I nodded impatiently. “It was.
paras.zh: 可他只是叹气摇头。

paras.en: It is.
paras.zh: 突然，他——我急切地点点头。「是的。

paras.en: Iduna’s the best, which is why we need her to stay here.” “Iduna is wonderful,” Peterssen agreed. “And we all love her, Agnarr.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜是最棒的，所以我们才需要她留在这儿。」「伊杜娜很棒，」彼得森附和，「我们也都爱她，安格瑞。

paras.en: We do.
paras.zh: 真的。

paras.en: But…” “But what?” I asked, beginning to get exasperated.
paras.zh: 但……」「但什么？」我问，开始不耐烦了。

paras.en: What was he trying to say? “But I’m becoming concerned that you love her in a…different sense than the rest of us.” I felt my face flush.
paras.zh: 他到底想说什么？「但我开始担心，你对她的爱……和我们大家不一样。」我觉得脸上发烫。

paras.en: Not because I was embarrassed about my feelings for Iduna.
paras.zh: 不是因为我对伊杜娜的感情感到难堪。

paras.en: If anything, it had become nearly impossible not to shout about them from the rooftops.
paras.zh: 恰恰相反，我几乎忍不住想站在屋顶大声宣告。

paras.en: But at the same time, I wasn’t stupid.
paras.zh: 但与此同时，我不傻。

paras.en: I knew what the council would think if they knew about our relationship.
paras.zh: 我清楚议事会若知道我们的关系会怎么想。

paras.en: They liked her fine as my friend.
paras.zh: 他们把她当我朋友，倒还满意。

paras.en: But in their eyes, she was no princess.
paras.zh: 但在他们眼里，她不是公主。

paras.en: No future queen.
paras.zh: 不是未来的王后。

paras.en: My expression told Peterssen everything he needed to know.
paras.zh: 我的表情把彼得森想知道的都告诉了他。

paras.en: He nodded but didn’t speak.
paras.zh: 他点点头，没说话。

paras.en: For several minutes the only sound in the library was the ticking of an old clock.
paras.zh: 有好几分钟，图书室里唯一的声响是老钟的滴答声。

paras.en: Then he rose from his chair.
paras.zh: 接着他从椅上起身。

paras.en: He walked out onto the balcony and stared down at the town below. “Maybe if it were a different time,” he mused. “Maybe if things weren’t so volatile.
paras.zh: 他走到阳台上，俯瞰下方的城镇。「若换个时机或许可以，」他若有所思，「若局势没这么动荡。

paras.en: Maybe if your father hadn’t been murdered.
paras.zh: 若你父亲未被谋杀。

paras.en: If soldiers weren’t being assaulted by men in masks.” “That has nothing to do with Iduna!” “And yet it has everything to do with you.” Peterssen sounded sad now. “Arendelle lost her king overnight.
paras.zh: 若士兵没被蒙面人袭击。」「那和伊杜娜毫无关系！」「可它和你息息相关。」彼得森此刻听起来很悲伤，「阿伦黛尔一夜之间失去了国王。

paras.en: I’ve tried to be the best regent I can, but things have been unstable.
paras.zh: 我已尽力做个最好的摄政王，但局势一直不稳。

paras.en: The citizens are uneasy again.
paras.zh: 百姓再次不安。

paras.en: They’ll be more so now, after the attacks.
paras.zh: 袭击之后，他们会更不安。

paras.en: And in these times, they look to the crown to ease their fears.” He turned from the balcony to meet my gaze. “Meaning you must be the king they need you to be.
paras.zh: 而这样的时刻，他们指望王冠来安抚恐惧。」他离开阳台，迎上我的目光。「意思是，你必须成为他们需要的那位国王。

paras.en: And a big part of that is marrying into another strong royal family.
paras.zh: 而其中关键一环，就是与另一支强盛王室联姻。

paras.en: Forming an alliance that will help protect Arendelle in the years to come.” I hung my head, my heart plummeting to my knees.
paras.zh: 结成联盟，在日后护佑阿伦黛尔。」我垂下头，心直坠到膝前。

paras.en: My stomach felt as if I’d swallowed lead.
paras.zh: 胃里像吞了铅。

paras.en: But that didn’t change how I felt about Iduna.
paras.zh: 但这改变不了我对伊杜娜的感情。

paras.en: My beautiful, smart, funny best friend.
paras.zh: 我美丽、聪慧、风趣的挚友。

paras.en: How could I marry someone else?
paras.zh: 我怎能娶别人？

paras.en: Someone who was bound to be inferior to Iduna in every possible way.
paras.zh: 一个注定在方方面面都不如伊杜娜的人。

paras.en: And once I was married, what would happen to our friendship?
paras.zh: 而一旦我成婚，我们的友谊会怎样？

paras.en: It seemed unlikely we would spend time together once I had a wife, at least alone.
paras.zh: 等我有了妻子，我们似乎很难再单独相处。

paras.en: It wouldn’t be proper.
paras.zh: 那不合体统。

paras.en: If only I had been born a peasant.
paras.zh: 若我生来只是个农夫多好。

paras.en: A soldier’s son, perhaps.
paras.zh: 或许是个士兵的儿子。

paras.en: If only Mattias had been my father instead of the one I actually had.
paras.zh: 若马蒂亚斯才是我父亲，而非我真正的父亲。

paras.en: He would have loved Iduna.
paras.zh: 他定会喜爱伊杜娜。

paras.en: Especially her amazing laugh.
paras.zh: 尤其爱她那动人的笑。

paras.en: It reminded me of his.
paras.zh: 那笑声让我想起他。

paras.en: I closed my eyes for a moment, imagining the two of them together.
paras.zh: 我闭眼片刻，想象他们俩在一起的模样。

paras.en: And suddenly I understood my mother’s pain.
paras.zh: 突然间，我懂了母亲的痛。

paras.en: Why she had left as she had.
paras.zh: 懂了她为何那样离去。

paras.en: Trapped in a loveless marriage with my father.
paras.zh: 困在与父亲无爱的婚姻里。

paras.en: Maybe she, too, had loved someone out in the world once, someone her heart told her was right when everyone around her said he was wrong.
paras.zh: 或许她也曾在世间爱过某人，一个她的心说对、身边人却都说错的人。

paras.en: Maybe she had to leave him behind when she came to Arendelle to become our queen.
paras.zh: 或许她来到阿伦黛尔成为我们的王后时，也不得不抛下那人。

paras.en: Peterssen was watching me, a sorrowful look on his face.
paras.zh: 彼得森望着我，脸上带着哀伤。

paras.en: Sorrowful and…if I didn’t know better, I’d say guilty, too.
paras.zh: 哀伤，而且……若我没看错，还有愧疚。

paras.en: What was he hiding?
paras.zh: 他在隐瞒什么？

paras.en: I groaned.
paras.zh: 我闷哼一声。

paras.en: Just what I needed—more secrets. “What aren’t you telling me?” I demanded, finally feeling able to ask for the answers I had wanted for so long. “Agnarr—” But at that moment the captain of the guard rushed in, her face pale. “There’s been another attack!” she reported. “A villager this time, inside of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 正合我需——更多秘密。「有什么你没告诉我？」我逼问，终于敢索要渴盼已久的答案。「安格瑞——」可就在这时，禁卫队长冲了进来，脸色苍白。「又一起袭击！」她禀报，「这次是村民，在阿伦黛尔城内。

paras.en: He was leaving his shop when it happened.
paras.zh: 事情发生时他正要离开铺子。

paras.en: A man in a sun mask jumped out and started beating him.
paras.zh: 一个戴太阳面具的男人窜出，动手打他。

paras.en: He barely managed to fight him off, and the man ran away.” She paused, then added, “He says he’s pretty sure it was a Northuldra.” Peterssen let out a low growl. “And I suppose he’s running around, telling everyone this tale?” “He doesn’t have to.
paras.zh: 他勉强挣脱，那男人逃走了。」她顿了顿，又道，「他说他相当确定那是北地人。」彼得森低低吼了一声。「我猜他正到处跑去把这事告诉所有人吧？」「他不必那样。

paras.en: Everyone’s already gathered in the town “This must stop!” Peterssen exploded.
paras.zh: 镇上的人都已聚——「必须制止！」彼得森爆发了。

paras.en: He pushed off the balcony railing and strode across the library to the guard.
paras.zh: 他推开阳台栏杆，大步穿过图书室走向卫兵。

paras.en: For a moment, they conferred softly so I couldn’t hear.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻，他们低声商议，我听不见。

paras.en: Then Peterssen turned back to me. “Agnarr, it’s past time you go and address your people.
paras.zh: 接着彼得森转回身面对我。「安格瑞，你该去对百姓讲话了，早该如此。

paras.en: You need to promise them that you will take action.
paras.zh: 你得向他们承诺你会采取行动。

paras.en: That you will do everything within your power to keep them safe.” I nodded stiffly. “Just tell me where and when.” Peterssen’s shoulders relaxed.
paras.zh: 承诺你会倾尽全力护他们平安。」我僵硬地点头。「告诉我时间地点就行。」彼得森紧绷的肩膀松了松。

paras.en: He spoke again to the guard. “Tell everyone that the prince will address the people in ten minutes.
paras.zh: 他又对卫兵说。「通知所有人，王子十分钟后向民众讲话。

paras.en: Be sure they gather to listen.” The guard gave a salute, then disappeared out the door, trailed by Peterssen.
paras.zh: 务必让他们聚来听。」卫兵敬礼，随后消失在门外，彼得森跟了出去。

paras.en: I ventured to the library’s windows and looked down onto the streets below.
paras.zh: 我大着胆子走到图书室窗边，俯看下面的街道。

paras.en: The citizens of Arendelle were milling about anxiously.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔的百姓正焦躁地徘徊。

paras.en: They all looked afraid.
paras.zh: 他们都面露惧色。

paras.en: Peterssen wasn’t wrong.
paras.zh: 彼得森没说错。

paras.en: They needed a leader.
paras.zh: 他们需要领袖。

paras.en: They needed a king.
paras.zh: 他们需要国王。

paras.en: I just wasn’t certain anymore that I wanted it to be me. “Conceal, don’t feel,” I whispered to myself.
paras.zh: 我只是不再确定，那是否该是我。「掩饰，别去感受，」我对自己低语。

paras.en: It was the only thing left to do.
paras.zh: 这是仅剩能做的事。

paras.en: “AND THEY ALL LIVED HAPPILY EVER AFTER!” I closed the book, smiling at the children who sat on a colorful rug in the warm, cozy Arendelle library.
paras.zh: “从此以后，他们幸福地生活在一起！”我合上书，微笑着望向围坐在暖洋洋、舒适惬意的阿伦黛尔图书馆里那块彩色地毯上的孩子们。

paras.en: There were only a handful today, though usually at least a dozen came to my weekly story time after school let out.
paras.zh: 今天只来了寥寥几个孩子，虽然平日里放学后至少会有十几个来参加我每周一次的故事时间。

paras.en: I guessed the rest of their parents had kept them home, too afraid of going out onto the streets of Arendelle after all the recent violence.
paras.zh: 我猜其余孩子的父母都把他们留在了家里，因为最近接连发生的暴力事件，他们不敢让孩子走上阿伦黛尔的街道。

paras.en: It had been a week since the first attacks, but the seemingly random acts had continued with alarming frequency.
paras.zh: 第一次袭击已经过去一周了，可那些看似随机的袭击仍在以惊人的频率不断发生。

paras.en: The people of Arendelle were living in fear—never knowing what was around the corner.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔的百姓正生活在恐惧之中——永远不知道拐角处藏着什么。

paras.en: The castle had closed its gates.
paras.zh: 城堡已经关闭了大门。

paras.en: No one was allowed to enter or leave until they determined what was going on.
paras.zh: 在查明真相之前，任何人都不准进出。

paras.en: Soldiers stepped up their patrols, but they seemed to do no good.
paras.zh: 士兵们加强了巡逻，可似乎毫无作用。

paras.en: The attacks continued.
paras.zh: 袭击仍在继续。

paras.en: And no one knew who was behind them.
paras.zh: 没有人知道幕后主使是谁。

paras.en: It was a scary time.
paras.zh: 那是一段令人惶恐的日子。

paras.en: But I kept a brave face, continuing to meet with the farmers to help them with their windmills.
paras.zh: 但我依然装作勇敢，继续去见那些农人，帮他们修理风车。

paras.en: They always commented on how brave I was, a woman traveling alone in times of such unrest.
paras.zh: 他们总夸我勇敢，说这样一个女人在如此动荡的时局里独自奔波。

paras.en: But fear wasn’t going to power their mills, pump their I also kept up with story time.
paras.zh: 但恐惧既发动不了他们的磨坊，也抽不动他们的水。我也照样坚持着故事时间。

paras.en: I knew it was something the children—especially the orphans—looked forward to each week.
paras.zh: 我知道这是孩子们——尤其是那些孤儿——每个星期都盼着的事。

paras.en: Their lives had been turned upside down.
paras.zh: 他们的生活已经被彻底打乱了。

paras.en: I wanted to give them something happy and safe to enjoy.
paras.zh: 我想给他们一些快乐又安心的东西去享受。

paras.en: I smiled at my small group now. “Any questions?” I asked, setting the book on my lap.
paras.zh: 我朝眼前这群小听众笑了笑。“有什么问题吗？”我把书放在膝上，问道。

paras.en: A boy of about seven raised his hand. “Are the bad guys in masks going to kill us all?” I sighed.
paras.zh: 一个约莫七岁的男孩举起手。“那些戴面具的坏人要把我们全杀光吗？”我叹了口气。

paras.en: I had meant questions about the story I had just finished.
paras.zh: 我本来指的是关于刚讲完的故事的问题。

paras.en: But I knew it was hard to concentrate on fairy tales right now, when real life had become so scary. “Of course not,” I assured him. “They won’t even be able to get close.
paras.zh: 但我知道，在现实生活变得如此可怕的当下，要专心听童话很难。“当然不会，”我安慰他，“他们连靠近都做不到。

paras.en: Not when we have such wonderful, brave soldiers patrolling the streets of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 我们有这么出色又勇敢的士兵在阿伦黛尔的街道上巡逻，他们做不到的。

paras.en: They are smart and strong and they will keep us safe.” A little girl around four raised her hand. “I’m scared, Miss Iduna,” she said; then she stuck her thumb in her mouth. “It’s okay to be scared,” I assured her. “You know, I get scared sometimes, too.” The children stared at me, so wide-eyed that I almost laughed.
paras.zh: 他们聪明又强壮，会保护我们安全的。”一个约四岁的小女孩举起手。“我害怕，伊杜娜小姐，”她说着，把大拇指塞进了嘴里。“害怕也没关系，”我安慰她，“你知道吗，我有时候也会害怕。”孩子们瞪大眼睛望着我，那副模样让我差点笑出来。

paras.en: To them, I was a grown-up.
paras.zh: 在他们眼里，我是个大人。

paras.en: And grown-ups weren’t supposed to be scared.
paras.zh: 而大人是不该害怕的。

paras.en: If only they knew. “You know what I do when I’m scared?” I asked, setting down my book by my side. “I sing.” I smiled down at them. “Anyone want to sing with me now?” They all did, of course, and so I taught them a silly song about reindeer and carrots and a really stubborn pig.
paras.zh: 要是他们知道就好了。“你们知道我害怕的时候会做什么吗？”我边问边把书放到身旁。“我会唱歌。”我低头冲他们笑了笑。“现在有人想和我一起唱吗？”他们当然都想，于是我教了他们一首傻乎乎的歌，讲的是驯鹿、胡萝卜和一头倔得要命的猪。

paras.en: By the end of it, they were laughing hysterically and no one looked afraid anymore. “Okay,” I said, rising to my feet. “I hope to see you next week!” They filed out, talking among themselves.
paras.zh: 到歌快唱完时，他们已经笑得前仰后合，再也看不出害怕的模样了。“好了，”我站起来说，“下周见！”他们三三两两往外走，互相说着话。

paras.en: Some were even still singing.
paras.zh: 有几个甚至还在接着唱。

paras.en: I watched them go, feeling a warmth in my heart. “You’re so good with them,” Mrs.
paras.zh: 我望着他们离去，心里涌起一阵暖意。“你跟他们相处得真好，”里

paras.en: Reedy, the librarian, complimented me, coming over to stand beside me. “They’re “I’m lucky to have them,” I assured her. “They always make me smile.” “Our Iduna, what would we do without you?” Mrs.
paras.zh: 迪夫人——图书管理员——走过来站到我身边，说道：“他们是——”“有他们在我很幸运，”我向她保证，“他们总让我笑。”“我们的伊杜娜，要是没了你我们可怎么办？”里

paras.en: Reedy declared, drawing me in for a hug. “You are a true gift to Arendelle.
paras.zh: 迪夫人说着把我拉过去拥抱了一下。“你是阿伦黛尔真正的礼物。

paras.en: A princess of the people!” I laughed her off, even though her comment stung a little more than I wanted to admit.
paras.zh: 人民的好公主！”我笑着把这话岔开，尽管她的话比我自己愿意承认的更让我心头一颤。

paras.en: Not that she would realize it, of course. “Oh yes!
paras.zh: 当然，她并没有察觉。“噢，没错！

paras.en: A true princess,” I joked, “in mud-stained boots.” After we exchanged goodbyes, I headed out of the library.
paras.zh: 真正的公主，”我打趣道，“穿着沾满泥巴的靴子。”我们道别后，我走出了图书馆。

paras.en: My plan was to bake bread for some of the older ladies and men around town who were too sick or too worried to go to the market.
paras.zh: 我打算给镇上几位因生病或忧心而没法去市场的老奶奶、老爷爷烤些面包。

paras.en: I was still learning to bake, now that I had my kitchen.
paras.zh: 如今我有了自己的厨房，可还在学烘焙。

paras.en: And some of my results had been…questionable.
paras.zh: 而且我做出来的有些东西……实在有待商榷。

paras.en: But still, there was something about it that always put my troubled mind at rest.
paras.zh: 但无论如何，这其中总有什么能让我烦乱的心安定下来。

paras.en: The act of measuring each ingredient out so exactly and creating something entirely new somehow put me at ease.
paras.zh: 把每种配料精确地称量出来、创造出全新的东西，这过程不知怎的让我安心。

paras.en: Made me forget, for a moment, even about Agnarr.
paras.zh: 让我能暂时把安格瑞也抛到脑后。

paras.en: I hadn’t seen him since the night they’d closed the castle gates, the night of Peterssen’s stern reminder and our fight.
paras.zh: 我自从城堡关上大门那一夜——也就是彼得森严肃提醒、我们大吵一架的那一夜——我就再没见过他。

paras.en: He’d been hustled to a makeshift stage in the town square, surrounded by a ridiculous number of guards and dressed in his official Arendelle military uniform.
paras.zh: 那天他被匆匆带上镇广场上一个临时搭起的台子，被多得荒唐的卫兵团团围住，身穿阿伦黛尔正式的军装。

paras.en: I’d fled the castle after our argument, enraged at how entitled and privileged he’d acted, and watched from far back in the crowd as he gave a grand speech about working to root out the enemy and keep Arendelle safe.
paras.zh: 争吵后我愤然离开城堡，气他摆出那副理所当然、高高在上的样子，于是在人群远远的后方望着他发表了一番豪言壮语，说要揪出敌人、护阿伦黛尔周全。

paras.en: It was his number one priority.
paras.zh: 这是他的头等大事。

paras.en: And I had to admit he looked and sounded like a true king.
paras.zh: 而我得承认，他的模样和言辞都真像一位君王。

paras.en: I missed him more than I wanted to, but I was still upset about our last conversation, when he’d all but bought into the idea that the gentle, peaceful Northuldra could be responsible for these attacks.
paras.zh: 我比自己愿意承认的更想他，但仍为我们上次的谈话耿耿于怀——那时他几乎完全相信了那个念头：温和、爱好和平的北地人竟会是这些袭击的元凶。

paras.en: I’d thought he was different, the only one who believed, like I did, that there was more to the story about that day by the dam.
paras.zh: 我原以为他不一样，是和我一样相信水坝边那天的真相另有隐情的人。

paras.en: But it turned out that when push came to shove, he was just like everyone else, letting fear and rumors lead him.
paras.zh: 可到头来，事态紧迫时，他和旁人并无二致，任由恐惧和谣言牵着走。

paras.en: I sighed, reaching for my key to open the front door to my small haven.
paras.zh: 我叹了口气，伸手去拿钥匙，开我这小避风港的前门。

paras.en: It was for the best, I told myself.
paras.zh: 这样最好，我对自己说。

paras.en: Agnarr and I never had a future anyway.
paras.zh: 反正我和安格瑞从来就没有未来。

paras.en: Everything we’d shared was nothing more than a beautiful dream.
paras.zh: 我们共有的一切不过是一场美丽的梦。

paras.en: And it was high time I woke up and faced reality.
paras.zh: 是时候醒来面对现实了。

paras.en: I had just pulled my final loaf of steaming hot fresh bread from the oven when I heard a knock on my door.
paras.zh: 我刚把最后一条热气腾腾的鲜面包从炉里取出，就听见有人敲门。

paras.en: I was surprised to see Lord Peterssen on the other side.
paras.zh: 门外的彼得森勋爵让我吃了一惊。

paras.en: From what I understood, he didn’t leave the castle very often anymore, especially now, with the gates closed.
paras.zh: 据我所知，他如今已不常离开城堡了，尤其现在大门紧闭。

paras.en: But he stood alone, without even any guards, waiting at my front door.
paras.zh: 可他独自一人站在我家门前，连个卫兵都没带。

paras.en: I ushered him in quickly. “Sorry to come unannounced,” he said, taking off his hat and setting it down on the table.
paras.zh: 我连忙把他请进屋。“抱歉不请自来，”他说着摘下帽子放到桌上。

paras.en: His hair had begun to thin, I noticed.
paras.zh: 我注意到，他的头发已经开始稀疏了。

paras.en: And I could see shadows of strain on his face. “Not a problem,” I assured him. “Would you like some tea?” It wasn’t the question I was dying to ask, of course.
paras.zh: 他脸上也显出了疲惫的阴影。“没关系，”我安慰他，“要喝点茶吗？”当然，这不是我最迫切想问的问题。

paras.en: I wanted to ask if they’d made any headway in figuring out who was behind the attacks.
paras.zh: 我想问的是，他们可曾查清袭击的幕后主使。

paras.en: And I wanted to ask about Agnarr.
paras.zh: 我还想问安格瑞的情况。

paras.en: How was he holding up?
paras.zh: 他撑得怎么样？

paras.en: Did he miss me?
paras.zh: 他会想我吗？

paras.en: Peterssen shook his head. “No thank you,” he said.
paras.zh: 彼得森摇了摇头。“不用了，谢谢，”他说。

paras.en: I caught him glancing toward the door. “Look, I need to tell you something important.
paras.zh: 我瞥见他朝门口望了一眼。“听着，我有件要紧事要告诉你。

paras.en: May I speak frankly?” Fear shot through me at his words, but I kept my tone level. “Yes.
paras.zh: 我能直说吗？”他的话让我心头一紧，可我仍保持语气平静。“当然。

paras.en: Of course,” I said. “In an attempt to root out the source of the recent attacks, the council has enlisted the help of a specialist.
paras.zh: 当然可以，”我说，“为了查清近来袭击的源头，议会请了一位专家来帮忙。

paras.en: His name is Sorenson and he’s a scientist of some regard.
paras.zh: 他叫索伦森，是个颇有名望的科学家。

paras.en: He claims he’s created a foolproof test to uncover lies.
paras.zh: 他声称自己发明了一种万无一失的测谎方法。

paras.en: The council plans to use it on every citizen of Arendelle to find out what they might know about the men with the sun masks.” He looked regretful. “They’re going to be asking questions.
paras.zh: 议会打算把它用在每一个阿伦黛尔臣民身上，好查明他们对那些戴太阳面具的人知道些什么。”他面露懊悔。“他们会问很多问题。

paras.en: Lots of questions.
paras.zh: 很多问题。

paras.en: I stared at him in horror. “ Everyone “No.
paras.zh: 我惊恐地瞪着他。“所有人——”“不。

paras.en: Not me.
paras.zh: 不是我。

paras.en: And likely Agnarr will also be spared.
paras.zh: 安格瑞大概也会被豁免。

paras.en: You, however…” He trailed off, giving me a knowing look.
paras.zh: 但你嘛……”他欲言又止，意味深长地看了我一眼。

paras.en: He didn’t have to go on for me to get his meaning. “I haven’t done anything wrong,” I protested, my heart pounding in my chest. “I was only a child when it all happened.” “I know that, of course.
paras.zh: 不用他说完我就懂了他的意思。“我没做错任何事，”我抗议道，心在胸口怦怦直跳，“事情发生时我还只是个孩子。”“这个我当然知道。

paras.en: But the townspeople are on a rampage.
paras.zh: 可镇上的百姓正在失控暴怒。

paras.en: Their fear flies through the streets.
paras.zh: 他们的恐惧在街巷间飞窜。

paras.en: It’s irrational, but real.
paras.zh: 那是不理智的，却很真实。

paras.en: And dangerous.
paras.zh: 而且危险。

paras.en: If they learned that the crown has been harboring a Northuldra for the last five years…if they knew their future king was in love with one…” I stared at him in surprise.
paras.zh: 要是他们得知，王冠之下这五年来一直庇护着一个北地人……要是他们知道他们未来的国王爱上的正是这样一个……”我惊讶地瞪着他。

paras.en: We’d gone to such great lengths to be careful. “Lord Peterssen—I—” He waved me off, looking tired. “I’m not blind, all right?
paras.zh: 我们那么费心地谨慎行事。“彼得森勋爵——我——”他疲惫地挥手打断我。“我又不是瞎子，行了吧？

paras.en: I know about you and Agnarr.
paras.zh: 你和安格瑞的事我都知道。

paras.en: I may have known before you knew it yourselves.
paras.zh: 说不定比你们自己察觉还早。

paras.en: Your secret is written all over your faces.
paras.zh: 你们的秘密全写在脸上了。

paras.en: In the glances you give one another when you think no one’s looking.” He sighed deeply. “I should have never brought you to the castle.
paras.zh: 在你们以为没人注意时彼此交换的眼神里。”他深深叹了口气。“我真不该把你带进城堡。

paras.en: It was folly!
paras.zh: 真是糊涂！

paras.en: I only wanted to help you.
paras.zh: 我只是想帮你。

paras.en: And to give the prince a chance at a true friend.
paras.zh: 也给王子一个拥有真正朋友的机会。

paras.en: If I had any inkling of what would happen…” He stared down at his hands. “I was oblivious, obviously.
paras.zh: 要是我早有一丝预感……”他低头盯着自己的手。“我显然太天真了。

paras.en: And now…” My heart slammed against my rib cage.
paras.zh: 而现在……”我的心猛地撞上肋骨。

paras.en: Every beat felt like a punch. “What do I do?” I asked, my voice hoarse. “Should I leave town?” “No.
paras.zh: 每一次跳动都像一记重拳。“我该怎么办？”我声音沙哑地问，“我该离开镇子吗？”“不。

paras.en: The guards are asking so many questions of people going in and out of the village that if you leave now, you’ll only arouse suspicion.
paras.zh: 卫兵对进出村子的每个人都要问很多问题，你现在走了反而只会惹人疑心。

paras.en: But if you stay, I cannot guarantee you won’t be called in for an interview.
paras.zh: 但如果你留下，我可保证不了你不会被叫去问话。

paras.en: I’ll do my best to shield you.
paras.zh: 我会尽力护着你。

paras.en: You’re the prince’s best friend.
paras.zh: 你是王子最好的朋友。

paras.en: Beyond suspicion.
paras.zh: 绝无嫌疑。

paras.en: Whatever it takes.
paras.zh: 无论如何。

paras.en: But if they start to dig, they may begin to realize the inconsistencies in your story.” He rushed through his next sentence, as though it pained him to say the words out loud. “And if they discover who you truly are?
paras.zh: 可要是他们开始深挖，或许就会察觉你身世里的矛盾。”他急促地说出下一句，仿佛把那些字说出口令他痛苦。“要是他们发现你真正的身份呢？

paras.en: Well, I’m afraid there’s not much I can do.” I lifted my chin defiantly. “Well, maybe it’s time the truth came out, anyway.
paras.zh: 唉，那我怕是也无能为力了。”我倔强地抬起下巴。“哼，也许真相本就该浮出水面了。

paras.en: I’m not ashamed of who I am.
paras.zh: 我并不以自己为耻。

paras.en: Where I came from.
paras.zh: 也不以我的来历为耻。

paras.en: Maybe it’s time I come clean.
paras.zh: 也许是我坦白的时候了。

paras.en: Let them judge me as they will.” “That’s very noble,” Peterssen replied with a wry smile, almost as if he had expected that to be my answer. “And under other circumstances, I’d agree it would be the best plan.
paras.zh: 随他们评判吧。” “很高尚，”彼得森苦笑着回答，仿佛早料到我会这么答，“换作别的情形，我也觉得这是上策。

paras.en: Unfortunately, in this case, you alone are not at risk of losing everything.
paras.zh: 可惜眼下，面临失去一切的并不止你一人。

paras.en: It won’t take them long to realize my involvement in the matter.
paras.zh: 他们很快就会发现我卷进了这件事。

paras.en: They will strip me of my title.
paras.zh: 他们会剥夺我的头衔。

paras.en: And possibly begin a challenge to Agnarr’s claim to the throne as well.
paras.zh: 甚至可能开始质疑安格瑞的王位继承权。

paras.en: How can he effectively rule a kingdom, they’ll ask, if he is in love with their number one enemy?” “But that’s ridiculous,” I sputtered. “Northuldra are not the enemy!
paras.zh: 他们会问，既然他爱着头号敌人，还怎么有效治理王国？”“可这太荒唐了，”我急急地说，“北地人不是敌人！

paras.en: I’ve never seen even one of them in my entire time here!
paras.zh: 我在这儿这么久，连一个北地人都没见过！

paras.en: Whoever is behind the attacks is pretending to be them.
paras.zh: 躲在袭击背后的家伙是在假冒他们。

paras.en: Agnarr and I visit the mist twice every year.
paras.zh: 我和安格瑞每年都要去迷雾两次。

paras.en: They’re all still trapped!” “I know that as well as you do,” Peterssen assured me. “But it makes no difference.
paras.zh: 他们全还被困在里面呢！”“这点我跟你一样清楚，”彼得森向我保证，“可这没用。

paras.en: Fear will make them act without reason.
paras.zh: 恐惧会让他们不理智地行事。

paras.en: And if Agnarr is found unfit to rule, the kingdom will fall into further chaos.
paras.zh: 而若安格瑞被认定不配统治，王国将陷入更深的混乱。

paras.en: There would be no clear heir to the throne.
paras.zh: 王位将没有明确的继承人。

paras.en: And with me gone as well, there would be no one to step in to lead.
paras.zh: 连我如果也不在了，就更没人能挺身出来领导。

paras.en: The neighboring kingdoms would certainly see an opportunity open up.
paras.zh: 邻国肯定会看到可乘之机。

paras.en: The Southern Isles, for example, have always envied our position on Arenfjord.
paras.zh: 比如南境群岛，向来觊觎我们在阿伦峡湾的地利。

paras.en: The Kingdom of Vassar is a valued trade partner, but they won’t hesitate to move for an advantage if they see a chance to do so.” I squeezed my eyes shut. “I don’t want to hear anymore,” I said.
paras.zh: 瓦萨尔王国是宝贵的贸易伙伴，可只要有机会谋取好处，他们也绝不会迟疑。”我紧紧闭上眼睛。“我不想再听了，”我说。

paras.en: I could accept responsibility for my own fate, but it seemed unfair to place the entire future of Arendelle on my shoulders. “I should have never agreed to any of this.
paras.zh: 我能对自己的命运负责，可把阿伦黛尔整个未来压在我肩上，似乎太不公平。“我本就不该答应这一切。

paras.en: You should have left me in that orphanage.
paras.zh: 你该把我留在那家孤儿院的。

paras.en: Or better yet, had me arrested that first day and tried me as a traitor.” “No.” Peterssen’s expression was fierce. “I refuse to regret my decision to save an innocent child.
paras.zh: 或者更好，第一天就把我抓起来，以叛徒论处。”“不。”彼得森神色严厉。“我绝不后悔救下一个无辜孩子的决定。

paras.en: You have been a wonderful gift to this kingdom.
paras.zh: 你一直是这个王国美好的馈赠。

paras.en: An asset, not a danger.
paras.zh: 是财富，不是威胁。

paras.en: The work you’ve done with the farmers and their windmills?
paras.zh: 你帮农人修风车的事？

paras.en: Iduna, I He rose to his feet. “I should get going.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜，我——他站起身。“我该走了。

paras.en: I have a meeting with the council to discuss this lie-detection test they want to use.
paras.zh: 我要去和议会碰头，商量他们想用的那个测谎法。

paras.en: I will do what I can to shelter you, as I always have.
paras.zh: 我会一如既往，尽我所能庇护你。

paras.en: But you must stay on your guard.
paras.zh: 但你必须保持警惕。

paras.en: If you care about Agnarr like I think you do, say nothing.
paras.zh: 要是你像我以为的那样在乎安格瑞，就什么都别说。

paras.en: Trust no one.
paras.zh: 谁也别信。

paras.en: His security lies in your hands.” He headed out, his steps heavy and slow.
paras.zh: 他的安危握在你手里。”他迈着沉重缓慢的步子走了出去。

paras.en: I watched him go, feeling tears streaking down my face.
paras.zh: 我望着他离去，感到泪水顺着脸颊滑落。

paras.en: I didn’t bother to wipe them away.
paras.zh: 我懒得去擦。

paras.en: What was I going to do?
paras.zh: 我该怎么办？

paras.en: I’d all but trapped myself in an impossible situation.
paras.zh: 我几乎把自己困进了一个无解的境地。

paras.en: A situation that would destroy not only me, but possibly the entire kingdom of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 一个不仅会毁了我、还可能毁掉整个阿伦黛尔王国的境地。

paras.en: Not to mention Agnarr himself.
paras.zh: 更别提安格瑞本人了。

paras.en: I sighed, feeling the weight of the world on my shoulders.
paras.zh: 我叹了口气，感到整个世界都压在肩上。

paras.en: I wandered back to the kitchen to drape some tea towels over the cooling bread loaves when I heard yet another knock on the door.
paras.zh: 我晃回厨房，想把茶巾搭在晾凉的面包上，这时又听见一声敲门。

paras.en: Was Peterssen back?
paras.zh: 是彼得森回来了吗？

paras.en: Or perhaps the guards with their lie test?
paras.zh: 还是带着测谎法的卫兵？

paras.en: I walked over to the door, drawing in a shaky breath.
paras.zh: 我走到门边，深吸一口发颤的气。

paras.en: Whatever it was, I could handle it, I told myself.
paras.zh: 不管是什么，我都能应付，我对自己说。

paras.en: Somehow.
paras.zh: 总能应付的。

paras.en: Some way… I pulled open the door.
paras.zh: 总有办法……我拉开了门。

paras.en: Agnarr stood on the other side.
paras.zh: 安格瑞站在门外。

paras.en: AGNARR STRODE INTO MY HOUSE. “WE NEED to talk,” he declared.
paras.zh: 安格瑞大步走进我家。“我们得谈谈，”他宣布道。

paras.en: I went and hastily shut the door behind him. “Aren’t you supposed to be in the castle?” I asked, annoyance at his imperial tone mixed with the relief of seeing him again.
paras.zh: 我赶过去匆忙关上门。“你不是该待在城堡里吗？”我问，对他那副命令口吻的恼火，混杂着重见他的释然。

paras.en: He was dressed unusually, in a plain black shirt and matching pants.
paras.zh: 他穿得不同寻常，一件朴素的黑衬衫配同色长裤。

paras.en: A large hat had been pulled low over his eyes.
paras.zh: 一顶大帽子压得很低，遮住了眼睛。

paras.en: Not exactly his usual regal attire. “Also, what on earth are you wearing?” “I’m in disguise, obviously.” “Obviously,” I repeated, a hint of sarcasm to my tone.
paras.zh: 可不太像他往常的王者装束。“还有，你到底穿的什么？”“我当然是在伪装啦。”“当然，”我重复道，语气里带着几分讽刺。

paras.en: I knew I should tell him to go away.
paras.zh: 我知道我该让他走开。

paras.en: He was putting himself in danger by coming here.
paras.zh: 他来这儿是在把自己置于险境。

paras.en: Not to mention I was still mad about our fight—his assumptions about the Northuldra, his bravado.
paras.zh: 更别说我还在为那场架生气——他对北地人的臆断，他那副逞强模样。

paras.en: But as much as I knew I should shove him back out the door, I found I didn’t have the strength.
paras.zh: 可尽管明知该把他推出门去，我却发现自己没有那个力气。

paras.en: It was too good to see him.
paras.zh: 见到他实在太好了。

paras.en: I had missed him so much it hurt.
paras.zh: 我太想他了，想得心口发疼。

paras.en: And the ache that had settled in my stomach now felt both terrible and wonderful at the same time. “What’s wrong?” Agnarr asked, coming over to me, his green eyes glowing with concern. “Are you crying?” “No!” I retorted just as a sob escaped my throat.
paras.zh: 而窝在胃里的那份酸楚，此刻竟同时叫人痛苦又甜蜜。“怎么了？”安格瑞走过来问我，绿眼睛里满是关切。“你在哭吗？”“没有！”我刚反驳，喉咙里却泄出一声呜咽。

paras.en: He gave me Agnarr nodded. “This is my fault,” he said. “I’m so sorry I haven’t come sooner.
paras.zh: 他朝我——安格瑞点了点头。“是我的错，”他说，“很抱歉我没早点来。

paras.en: I wanted to.
paras.zh: 我本想来的。

paras.en: You know that, right?” He searched my face for confirmation.
paras.zh: 你知道的，对吧？”他在我脸上寻找确认。

paras.en: I nodded. “I do.” “Also, I’m sorry I was such a pig back at the castle.
paras.zh: 我点点头。“我知道。”“还有，抱歉我在城堡里那副猪样的德行。

paras.en: I should have never ordered you to stay.
paras.zh: 我不该命令你留下。

paras.en: You are your own person, Iduna.
paras.zh: 你就是你自己的，伊杜娜。

paras.en: You always have been.
paras.zh: 一向如此。

paras.en: It’s one of the million qualities I love about you.
paras.zh: 这是我爱你的千万种特质之一。

paras.en: It was wrong of me to push that aside for my own self-interest.” He gave me a pleading look. “I was just scared.
paras.zh: 我为了私利把它抛到一边，是我不对。”他露出恳求的眼神。“我只是害怕。

paras.en: People have been beaten in my name.” “By the evil Northuldra,” I couldn’t help muttering.
paras.zh: 有人打着我的名号挨了打。”“被邪恶的北地人，”我忍不住小声嘀咕。

paras.en: Agnarr stopped, looking at me carefully. “I don’t think it’s them, actually.” I looked up, surprised. “You don’t?
paras.zh: 安格瑞停住，仔细打量我。“其实，我觉得不是他们。”我抬起头，又惊又疑。“你不觉得？

paras.en: But you said—” He waved his hand. “I know.
paras.zh: 可你说过——”他摆摆手。“我知道。

paras.en: I was panicking.
paras.zh: 我当时慌了神。

paras.en: Jumping to conclusions.
paras.zh: 妄下结论。

paras.en: But now that I’ve had time to think it through, it doesn’t make sense.
paras.zh: 可如今我有时间想明白了，这说不通。

paras.en: It’s just like the evil spirits.
paras.zh: 这就跟那些恶灵一样。

paras.en: People need someone to blame.
paras.zh: 人总得找个替罪羊。

paras.en: But there’s no evidence to support that it’s them.
paras.zh: 可没有证据能证明是他们。

paras.en: I did some digging in the library, too.
paras.zh: 我还在图书馆里翻查了一番。

paras.en: These attackers use swords.
paras.zh: 这些袭击者用刀剑。

paras.en: And nothing I’ve read ever claimed the Northuldra had swords.
paras.zh: 而我读过的记载里，从没说北地人有刀剑。

paras.en: And their clothes!
paras.zh: 还有他们的衣着！

paras.en: I don’t know if you remember, but Northuldra dress similar to the ice harvesters.
paras.zh: 不知你还记不记得，北地人的穿着和采冰人很像。

paras.en: The attackers wore shirts with buttons on them.” He raked a hand through his short hair. “It doesn’t add up.” Relief flooded me at his words.
paras.zh: 而袭击者穿的是有纽扣的衬衫。”他用手耙过短发。“对不上。”听到这话，我如释重负。

paras.en: I wanted to throw my arms around him.
paras.zh: 我想张开双臂抱住他。

paras.en: The fact that he hadn’t given in to the fearmongering.
paras.zh: 他没有向那些制造恐慌的言论低头。

paras.en: That he’d done research and had come to his own conclusions based on actual evidence rather than fear or fantasy.
paras.zh: 他做了研究，基于确凿证据而非恐惧或臆想得出了自己的结论。

paras.en: He was going to make a great king. “Who do you think it is, then,” I asked carefully, “if not the Northuldra?” “I don’t know,” he answered. “It could be another kingdom wanting to weaken us.
paras.zh: 他会成为一位伟大的国王。“那要不是北地人，你觉得会是谁？”我谨慎地问。“我不知道，”他答，“可能是另一个想削弱我们的王国。

paras.en: It could be someone here on the inside who wants to challenge my claim to the throne.
paras.zh: 也可能是内部有人想动摇我的王位继承权。

paras.en: Or even me “I’ve missed you,” I admitted. “And I appreciate the apology.
paras.zh: 甚至——”“我很想你，”我承认，“也很感激你的道歉。

paras.en: I’m sorry, too.” I gave him a rueful smile. “Truthfully, it probably would have been safer for me to stay at the castle.
paras.zh: 我也很抱歉。”我给他一个苦笑。“说真的，我留在城堡里或许更安全。

paras.en: I was being stubborn.” He bit his lower lip. “So, you forgive me?” “I forgive you.
paras.zh: 是我太倔了。”他咬着下唇。“那么，你原谅我了？”“我原谅你。

paras.en: And I will come to stay with you at the castle.
paras.zh: 而且我会去城堡和你同住。

paras.en: If you’ll still have me.” Agnarr’s face brightened and I suddenly felt a little guilty for my ulterior motive.
paras.zh: 要是你还愿意收留我。”安格瑞的脸亮了起来，而我突然为自己那点私心生出一丝愧疚。

paras.en: If I was in the castle, the belly of the proverbial beast, I would more likely be spared from these lie-detecting interviews and all the fallout that would come from them.
paras.zh: 若我在城堡里——正所谓野兽的腹心——就更可能逃过那些测谎问话，以及随之而来的种种麻烦。

paras.en: I could hide in plain sight. “Really?
paras.zh: 我可以明目张胆地藏身。“真的？

paras.en: Are you sure?” he asked, hope spreading over his face. “You don’t have to….” “I know.” I swallowed hard.
paras.zh: 你确定吗？”他问，脸上漾开希望。“你不必——”“我知道。”我用力咽了口唾沫。

paras.en: He looked so happy, which made what I had to say next that much harder.
paras.zh: 他看起来那么开心，反倒让我接下来要说的话更难出口。

paras.en: But it needed to be said, painful as it was.
paras.zh: 可再痛苦也得说。

paras.en: Peterssen’s earlier words had driven that point home. “I will come,” I repeated. “But I have one condition.” Agnarr grinned widely.
paras.zh: 彼得森先前的话已把这点说透。“我会来的，”我重复道，“但我有一个条件。”安格瑞咧嘴大笑。

paras.en: His voice took on a jovial tone. “What is it, fair maiden?
paras.zh: 他语调欢快起来。“是什么，美丽的姑娘？

paras.en: Be it half my kingdom, it shall be yours!” he declared in a grand voice, grabbing my hand and kissing it reverently. “In fact, all my kingdom, if you wish!
paras.zh: 哪怕是半个王国，也归你！”他朗声宣布，一把抓住我的手毕恭毕敬地亲了一下。“其实，只要你愿意，整个王国都给你！

paras.en: Simply say the word.” With effort, I managed to pull my hand away.
paras.zh: 只要你开口。”我费了些力气才把手抽回来。

paras.en: I cleared my throat. “We need to stop this, Agnarr.
paras.zh: 我清了清嗓子。“我们得停了，安格瑞。

paras.en: Whatever this is.” The smile fell from his lips. “What?
paras.zh: 不管这是什么。”笑容从他唇边褪去。“什么？

paras.en: What are you talking about?” “This thing—between you and me.
paras.zh: 你在说什么？”“你和我之间的这件事。

paras.en: It can’t go on.
paras.zh: 不能再继续了。

paras.en: We must end it.
paras.zh: 我们必须结束它。

paras.en: Today.” Or you stand to lose more than you can imagine….
paras.zh: 就今天。”否则你失去的会比你想象的多得多……

paras.en: He looked horrified. “You can’t be serious.
paras.zh: 他一脸惊恐。“你不是认真的。

paras.en: Iduna—” “I am.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜——”“我是认真的。

paras.en: We’ve gone too far with this whole thing.
paras.zh: 我们在这整件事上已经走得太远了。

paras.en: It was fun, Fun “You’re the prince, Agnarr,” I said, pushing on. “You have to marry a princess.
paras.zh: 曾经是好玩的——”“你是王子，安格瑞，”我继续说，“你必须娶一位公主。

paras.en: We should have never started this to begin with.
paras.zh: 我们当初就不该开始。

paras.en: And the deeper we go, the harder it will be to crawl out.
paras.zh: 而且我们陷得越深，就越难爬出来。

paras.en: The more painful.” “Don’t you love me?” I hung my head.
paras.zh: 也越痛苦。”“你不爱我吗？”我垂下头。

paras.en: Part of me wanted to lie, say I never loved him, this was all a game.
paras.zh: 我有一丝念头想撒谎，说从未爱过他，这一切只是场游戏。

paras.en: Push him away, hurt him so badly he’d stay away.
paras.zh: 推开他，把他伤得够呛，好让他离远点。

paras.en: But I couldn’t do that.
paras.zh: 可我做不到。

paras.en: Because I did love him.
paras.zh: 因为我确实爱他。

paras.en: I loved him more than anything in the world. “Of course I do, Agnarr,” I said in a soft voice. “I love you with everything I have.
paras.zh: 我对他的爱胜过世上一切。“我当然爱你，安格瑞，”我轻声说，“我倾尽所有爱着你。

paras.en: But I also have to be realistic.
paras.zh: 可我也得现实一点。

paras.en: We can never be together.
paras.zh: 我们永远不可能在一起。

paras.en: The kingdom wouldn’t accept it.” “Blast the kingdom.” “You don’t mean that.
paras.zh: 王国不会接受的。”“去它的王国。”“你不是真心的。

paras.en: I know you love your people.
paras.zh: 我知道你爱你的百姓。

paras.en: And they need you.
paras.zh: 他们需要你。

paras.en: Especially now.
paras.zh: 尤其现在。

paras.en: We can’t be selfish.” He closed his eyes, clearly trying to wrest control of his emotions.
paras.zh: 我们不能自私。”他闭上眼睛，显然在竭力控制情绪。

paras.en: I could hear the refrain ringing through his head clear as if he were shouting it at the top of his lungs.
paras.zh: 我仿佛听见那句老调在他脑中回响，清楚得像他在放声大喊。

paras.en: Conceal, don’t feel.
paras.zh: 隐藏起来，别去感受。

paras.en: He opened his eyes.
paras.zh: 他睁开眼睛。

paras.en: His face took on a look of determination. “Fine.
paras.zh: 脸上露出决然的神色。“好。

paras.en: I will agree to your terms for now.
paras.zh: 眼下我答应你的条件。

paras.en: But I do not agree that our love is hopeless.
paras.zh: 但我不认同我们的爱没有希望。

paras.en: Our love is powerful.
paras.zh: 我们的爱很有力量。

paras.en: It can move glaciers.
paras.zh: 它能推动冰川。

paras.en: I will not let it simply wither and die.
paras.zh: 我不会任它枯萎消亡。

paras.en: I will find a way for the council to accept this.
paras.zh: 我会找到办法让议会接受这一切。

paras.en: For this to work between us.” He grabbed me then, pressing his lips against mine, cupping my face with his strong hands.
paras.zh: 让我们之间修成正果。”随即他一把抱住我，用强健的双手捧住我的脸，唇压上我的唇。

paras.en: A hard, desperate kiss.
paras.zh: 一个用力而绝望的吻。

paras.en: For a moment, I considered trying to pull away—but in the end, I found I couldn’t.
paras.zh: 有那么一瞬我想挣脱——可到头来，我发现我做不到。

paras.en: Because this might be our last kiss for a long time.
paras.zh: 因为这可能是我们长久以来最后一个吻。

paras.en: Maybe forever.
paras.zh: 也许永远。

paras.en: “YOU LOOK LOVELY, MY DEAR!
paras.zh: “你看起来真美，亲爱的！

paras.en: LIKE A TRUE lady of the castle!” Gerda clapped her hands in excitement as I slipped out from behind the dressing screen.
paras.zh: 真像城堡里的贵妇人！”我从更衣屏风后走出来时，歌尔达兴奋地拍起手。

paras.en: I felt my cheeks heat up as I stepped in front of the full-length mirror and caught a glimpse of my reflection in the glass.
paras.zh: 当我站到落地镜前，瞥见镜中的自己，脸颊一阵发烫。

paras.en: The dress the castle steward had selected for me was a deep blue hue that matched my eyes.
paras.zh: 城堡管家为我挑的礼服是深蓝色，正好衬我的眼睛。

paras.en: It clung to my waist and then fell loose to my feet in sweeping swaths of soft, rich silk.
paras.zh: 它贴着我的腰身，随后化作大片柔软华贵的丝绸，松垂到脚边。

paras.en: It was the most beautiful dress I’d ever worn, and I couldn’t help wondering what Agnarr would think when he saw it.
paras.zh: 这是我穿过最美的裙子，我不禁猜想安格瑞见到时会怎么想。

paras.en: Not that it mattered anymore.
paras.zh: 尽管这已经不重要了。

paras.en: I’d been at the castle for two weeks now, though it felt like an eternity.
paras.zh: 我来城堡已两周了，却恍如隔世。

paras.en: Though it was an immense structure, somehow it seemed that no matter where I chose to go, I was always running into Agnarr.
paras.zh: 虽说城堡宏伟，可不知怎的，无论我走到哪儿，总会撞见安格瑞。

paras.en: And while we tried to be pleasant to one another, there was an unbearable awkwardness growing between us.
paras.zh: 我们努力对彼此客气，可之间却生出一股难以承受的尴尬。

paras.en: The way he looked at me with those hurt eyes.
paras.zh: 他那一双受伤的眼睛望着我的模样。

paras.en: The way I forced myself to turn away, even though all I wanted to do was throw myself into his arms and never let him go.
paras.zh: 我强迫自己转过身的模样，哪怕我满心只想扑进他怀里再不放开。

paras.en: But that wouldn’t happen.
paras.zh: 可那不会发生。

paras.en: That couldn’t happen, especially not after tonight.
paras.zh: 那不可能发生，尤其今晚之后更不可能。

paras.en: The kingdom was throwing a huge ball to celebrate the arrival of Princess Runa and her father, King Nicholas of the kingdom of Vassar.
paras.zh: 王国要办一场盛大的舞会，庆祝鲁娜公主和她父亲、瓦萨尔王国的尼古拉斯国王到来。

paras.en: I’d been dreading the visit since Agnarr first told me about Runa, and I’d thought up all sorts of excuses to get out of going to the ball.
paras.zh: 自从安格瑞第一次跟我提起鲁娜，我就一直害怕这次来访，还编出各种借口想躲开舞会。

paras.en: It was one thing to know they were meeting at last, yet quite another to watch it happen with my very own eyes.
paras.zh: 知道他们终于要见是一回事，亲眼看着它发生又是另一回事。

paras.en: But in the end, I decided to go.
paras.zh: 可最终，我决定去。

paras.en: To prove to myself that I could.
paras.zh: 向自己证明我能做到。

paras.en: That I was strong enough to get through this. “Are you all right, love?” Gerda asked, peering at me with concern.
paras.zh: 证明我足够坚强熬过这一关。“你还好吗，亲爱的？”歌尔达关切地端详着我问。

paras.en: I realized, belatedly, I’d let a few tears slip down my cheeks.
paras.zh: 我迟了才发觉，自己已让几滴泪滑下脸颊。

paras.en: I’d cried a lot lately, hidden away in my small guestchamber at the far end of the castle.
paras.zh: 近来我常哭，躲在这城堡尽头的小客房里。

paras.en: For I’d lost not only my true love, but also my best friend.
paras.zh: 因为我失去的不只是挚爱，还有最好的朋友。

paras.en: I didn’t want it to hurt as much as it did. “I’m fine,” I said, resolvedly wiping at my tears. “I’m just overcome…the dress…thank you.” I started to push off the shoulders to take it off.
paras.zh: 我不想它这么令人心碎。“我没事，”我边说边毅然抹去眼泪，“只是太激动了……这裙子……谢谢你。”我伸手去褪肩上的裙子，想把它脱下。

paras.en: But Gerda stopped me, a stern look in her eye.
paras.zh: 可歌尔达拦住了我，眼神严厉。

paras.en: I watched as she walked over to the door and turned the key in the lock, gesturing for me to sit.
paras.zh: 我看着她走到门边，转动锁里的钥匙，示意我坐下。

paras.en: I groaned inwardly; I should have realized Gerda knew me too well to believe I would be moved to tears by a dress, no matter how beautiful. “My sweet girl,” she said, walking back over to me and leading me to the bed, “I’ve been the castle steward for years now.
paras.zh: 我在心里暗叹；早该想到歌尔达太了解我，绝不会信我会被一条裙子——再美也不会——惹哭。“我甜美的姑娘，”她走回来，引我到床边，说，“我当城堡管家有些年头了。

paras.en: There’s not much I don’t see.” She gave me a knowing look. “You and Agnarr.
paras.zh: 什么事瞒得过我。”她意味深长地看我一眼。“你和安格瑞。

paras.en: Did you have a fight?” I shook my head, staring down at my lap. “Not exactly.” “But you’re avoiding one another.” I could feel Gerda’s eyes on me. “Does this have something to do with our arriving guests?” My head jerked in her direction before I could stop it.
paras.zh: 吵架了？”我摇摇头，盯着膝头。“不算吧。”“可你们在躲着彼此。”我能感觉到歌尔达的目光落在我身上。“这跟我们来的客人有关？”我还没反应过来，头已猛地转向了她。

paras.en: She gave me a kindly smile. “I’m not blind, sweetheart,” she said, reaching over to clasp my hands in hers. “I know what’s been going on between you two.” My heart pounded with fear. “Please don’t say anything!” I begged. “It’s over, anyway.
paras.zh: 她温柔地笑了笑。“我不瞎，宝贝，”她说着伸手把我的手攥进她手里，“我知道你们俩之间发生了什么。”我的心因恐惧而狂跳。“求你别声张！”我恳求，“反正都已经结束了。

paras.en: We’re not together anymore.” Gerda gave me a pitying look. “I’m so sorry to hear that, dear.
paras.zh: 我们不再在一起了。”歌尔达露出怜悯的神色。“听到这个我真难过，亲爱的。

paras.en: We were all really rooting for you.
paras.zh: 我们大家伙都真在为你俩加油呢。

paras.en: You made such a great pair.
paras.zh: 你们多般配的一对。

paras.en: And you were so good for our Agnarr.” The tears welled in my eyes again.
paras.zh: 而且你对我们安格瑞那样好。”泪水又涌上我的眼眶。

paras.en: This time I didn’t bother to stop them. “He was good for me, too,” I admitted. “But it was never going to work out.
paras.zh: 这次我没去拦。“他对我也好，”我承认，“可这事儿从来就成不了。

paras.en: He has to marry a princess.
paras.zh: 他必须娶一位公主。

paras.en: And I am definitely not a princess,” I added with emphasis.
paras.zh: 而我绝对不是什么公主，”我加重语气补了一句。

paras.en: Gerda’s face slipped into a scowl. “Ah, yes.
paras.zh: 歌尔达的脸沉了下来。“啊，对。

paras.en: That rot again.
paras.zh: 又是那套鬼话。

paras.en: I can’t believe the council still abides by that nonsense.
paras.zh: 真不敢信议会还在守着那套胡说八道。

paras.en: After it worked out so well I cocked my head. “Rita?” “Agnarr’s mother,” Gerda said with a wistful smile. “She was such a sweet soul.
paras.zh: 明明上次就挺好——”我偏了偏头。“丽塔？”“安格瑞的母亲，”歌尔达带着怀念的微笑说，“她是个那样温柔的灵魂。

paras.en: So smart, creative.
paras.zh: 那样聪慧，那样富有创意。

paras.en: When she laughed, you couldn’t help but laugh with her.” Her eyes grew distant as she remembered. “But as the years passed, her laughter began to fade.
paras.zh: 她一笑，你也忍不住跟着笑。”她陷入回忆，目光变得悠远。“可岁月流逝，她的笑声渐渐淡了。

paras.en: She was so sad.
paras.zh: 她那样悲伤。

paras.en: She missed her home so much.
paras.zh: 她那样思念家乡。

paras.en: But Runeard never understood,” she added. “He tried to give her everything, but she wanted nothing.
paras.zh: 可鲁尼尔德从不明白，”她补道，“他想给她一切，她却什么都不要。

paras.en: Nothing except the one thing she could never have.
paras.zh: 只除了那件她永远得不到的东西。

paras.en: Freedom.” My heart ached at her words.
paras.zh: 自由。”听到这话，我的心一阵刺痛。

paras.en: So what the trolls had said was true. “Why does no one ever talk about her?” I asked.
paras.zh: 原来地精说的都是真的。“怎么从没人提起她？”我问。

paras.en: Gerda’s face darkened. “Runeard forbade it.
paras.zh: 歌尔达脸色一沉。“鲁尼尔德下令禁止。

paras.en: When she ran away, he locked away all her things.
paras.zh: 她出走后，他把她所有东西都锁了起来。

paras.en: Barred her bedroom door.
paras.zh: 封了她的卧室门。

paras.en: No one was to speak her name again, under penalty of banishment.” “That’s terrible,” I said. “Poor Agnarr.
paras.zh: 任何人不得再提她的名字，违者流放。”“太可怕了，”我说，“可怜的安格瑞。

paras.en: It’s bad enough he lost his mother.
paras.zh: 他失去母亲已经够糟了。

paras.en: But to be denied all memories of her as well…” Gerda rose to her feet and walked over to a small wardrobe.
paras.zh: 可连关于她的记忆也被一并剥夺……”歌尔达站起身，走到一个小衣柜前。

paras.en: She reached into it, then pulled out a wooden chest.
paras.zh: 她伸手进去，取出一只木箱。

paras.en: I watched, curious, as she brought it back over to me.
paras.zh: 我好奇地看着她把箱子拿回我身边。

paras.en: Her voice lowered. “I did manage to save one thing,” she confided. “I don’t think Runeard knew about it.” I watched, breathless, as she lifted the lid of the box.
paras.zh: 她压低声音。“我确实偷偷留住了一样东西，”她吐露，“我想鲁尼尔德不知道。”我屏息看着她掀开箱盖。

paras.en: Inside was a small stuffed puffin with one big button eye, wearing a light blue cape. “Rita made him for Agnarr,” Gerda explained. “When he was Warmth coursed through me as I pictured Agnarr as a small child, playing on the floor with this little puffin, his mother smiling down at him.
paras.zh: 里面是一只小毛绒海鹦，只有一只大纽扣眼睛，披着浅蓝小披风。“这是丽塔给安格瑞做的，”歌尔达解释，“在他还是——”我脑中浮现出小安格瑞在地板上玩这只小海鹦、母亲含笑望他的画面，一股暖意涌遍全身。

paras.en: I wondered if Agnarr would remember it. “You should give this to him,” I said. “And tell him about his mother.
paras.zh: 我想知道安格瑞还记不记得它。“你该把这个给他，”我说，“并告诉他母亲的事。

paras.en: He deserves that at least.” “He does,” Gerda agreed, looking suddenly far off again. “It’s time he knows everything.
paras.zh: 至少那点他该有。”“是该，”歌尔达应道，忽又望向远方，“是时候让他知道一切了。

paras.en: And perhaps…” She trailed off. “Perhaps what?” She gave me a hard look. “Perhaps knowing what happened to his parents will prevent him from making the same mistakes.”
paras.zh: 而且也许……”她没说下去。“也许什么？”她定定看了我一眼。“也许知道父母身上发生了什么，能让他别再犯同样的错。”

paras.en: “PRESENTING NICHOLAS, KING OF VASSAR, and his daughter Princess Runa.” The room erupted in applause as a tall, broad-shouldered man, dressed in a highly decorated military uniform, stepped into the Great Hall, which was masquerading as a ballroom for the evening.
paras.zh: “有请瓦萨尔国王尼古拉斯，及其女儿鲁娜公主。”当一位身形高大、肩宽体阔、身着盛装军装的男子步入大厅——今夜它伪装成了舞厅——全场爆发出掌声。

paras.en: He was hand in hand with a petite-boned girl around my age, who was wearing a dramatic deep purple off-the-shoulder gown, trimmed with lace and finished with a matching bow at her chest.
paras.zh: 他手牵着一位娇小、与我年纪相仿的女孩，她穿着一袭夺目的深紫露肩礼服，缀着蕾丝，胸前别着同色蝴蝶结。

paras.en: She had sparkling green eyes and a large mess of light blond hair, artfully piled on top of her head.
paras.zh: 她有一双闪亮的绿眼睛，一头浅金色的乱发巧妙地堆在头顶。

paras.en: She was pretty, graceful, walking into the ballroom as comfortably as someone would come to their kitchen table: like she’d been born to do it.
paras.zh: 她美丽、优雅，走进舞厅就像回自己餐桌般自在：仿佛生来就该如此。

paras.en: Unlike…some guests.
paras.zh: 不像……某些客人。

paras.en: I fought back a laugh as I caught sight of Iduna across the room.
paras.zh: 我瞧见屋子那头的伊杜娜，忍住了笑。

paras.en: She was attempting to sneak a piece of chocolate off of the treat table.
paras.zh: 她正试图从甜点桌上偷拿一块巧克力。

paras.en: She shoved it in her mouth, trying to chew it without anyone noticing, but she must have swallowed too quickly, because she began to cough in a loud, sputtering fashion, causing several guests to turn and give her bemused looks.
paras.zh: 她把巧克力塞进嘴里，想不动声色地嚼，可准是咽得太急，竟大声呛咳起来，惹得几位客人转头投来又好气又好笑的眼神。

paras.en: She looked so beautiful that night, wearing a gown of the most searing blue that perfectly matched her eyes and fell to the floor like a ripple of water from a crystal clear stream.
paras.zh: 那晚她美极了，身着最灼亮的蓝色礼服，正好衬她的眼睛，垂落地面的裙摆如清溪涟漪。

paras.en: No jewelry, no fancy lace or embroidery for my Iduna.
paras.zh: 我的伊杜娜不戴首饰，不饰蕾丝与刺绣。

paras.en: She was a simple bluebird in a field of prancing peacocks.
paras.zh: 她是群开屏孔雀中一只朴素的蓝鸟。

paras.en: And yet the most stunning creature I’d ever laid eyes on.
paras.zh: 却是我见过最惊艳的生灵。

paras.en: The past few weeks had been torturous.
paras.zh: 过去几周简直煎熬。

paras.en: Iduna had done as she’d promised, moved into a spare bedroom in a vacant wing in the castle—about as far away from me as was possible without climbing out a window.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜信守承诺，搬进了城堡空置侧楼的一间客房——离我尽可能远，除非翻窗才更远。

paras.en: And she had been resolute, determined to keep our relationship platonic.
paras.zh: 而且她一意孤行，决意让我们的关系只停留在柏拉图式。

paras.en: We could be friends, but not lovers.
paras.zh: 我们可做朋友，却不可做恋人。

paras.en: Now, though, our friendship felt strained, our former ease around one another replaced by a too-careful awkwardness, as though we feared either of us might shatter and break if we said the wrong thing.
paras.zh: 可如今，我们的友谊变得紧绷，往日的自然被过分小心的尴尬取代，仿佛说错一句，谁就会碎掉。

paras.en: But still we kept on the charade, because that was what she wanted.
paras.zh: 但我们仍维持着这出戏，因为那是她要的。

paras.en: At least, that was what she said “Your Majesty?” I startled as I realized the princess—Runa—had made her way over to me and was holding out her hand.
paras.zh: 至少，那是她说的——“陛下？”我猛然回神，才发现公主——鲁娜——已走到我面前，伸出手来。

paras.en: I took it awkwardly, bringing it to my lips as was custom, kissing the back of it.
paras.zh: 我有些笨拙地握住，依礼送到唇边，亲了亲手背。

paras.en: She curtsied before me.
paras.zh: 她在我面前行了个屈膝礼。

paras.en: I gave her a stiff bow in return. “Aw!
paras.zh: 我生硬地回了一礼。“哎呀！

paras.en: I see the two of you have already become inseparable!” cried her father, joining us.
paras.zh: 我看你们俩已经形影不离啦！”她父亲凑过来喊道。

paras.en: He placed a hand on the small of her back and pushed her a little closer to me. “Why, Prince Agnarr, it appears you can barely restrain yourself from asking my daughter to dance!” he added, giving me a wink.
paras.zh: 他把手搭在她腰窝，把她往我这边推了推。“哎哟，安格瑞王子，看来你都快忍不住要邀我女儿跳舞了！”他又朝我眨眨眼。

paras.en: Oh.
paras.zh: 哦。

paras.en: Right. “My prince, there is nothing in the world I would like to do more,” she replied politely, her cheeks coloring a little, her voice as sweet and clear as a bell.
paras.zh: 对。“我的王子，世上再没有比这更让我乐意的事了，”她礼貌地答，脸颊泛红，声音如铃般甜脆。

paras.en: The king slapped me hard on the back so that I nearly stumbled forward. “Well then!
paras.zh: 国王重重拍了下我的背，我差点往前踉跄。“那还等什么！

paras.en: There’s no time like the present!
paras.zh: 此刻正是良辰！

paras.en: Get thee to a dance floor!” I resisted the urge to roll my eyes.
paras.zh: 快上舞池去！”我忍住翻白眼的冲动。

paras.en: Instead, I took Runa’s small, cool hand in my own and led her out to where the others were dancing.
paras.zh: 我反而握住鲁娜小巧凉凉的手，带她走向他人起舞处。

paras.en: I could feel half the room’s eyes on me as she tucked herself into my arms and began to sway.
paras.zh: 她偎进我臂弯、开始轻摆时，我感到半屋子人的目光落在我身上。

paras.en: The band took note and launched into a beautiful waltz.
paras.zh: 乐队会意，奏起一支优美的华尔兹。

paras.en: But my legs felt like wood as I mechanically performed the steps.
paras.zh: 可我双腿像木头，机械地迈着步。

paras.en: I flashed back to when I’d learned this particular waltz—with Iduna, back when we were kids, as part of our weekly lessons.
paras.zh: 我闪回到初学这支华尔兹时——和伊杜娜，小时候，作为每周课程的一部分。

paras.en: And it was her I thought of now.
paras.zh: 而此刻我想的是她。

paras.en: Particularly the moment she’d accidentally stomped on my foot so hard I’d gotten a bruise.
paras.zh: 尤其她不小心狠狠踩我脚、踩出淤青的那一刻。

paras.en: We’d laughed heartily and our dance teacher had given up in a fit of annoyance, telling us he’d come back when we were ready to take this seriously.
paras.zh: 我们笑得前仰后合，舞蹈老师气恼地放弃，说等我们认真了再来。

paras.en: Once alone, we’d started making up new dances—better dances.
paras.zh: 一独处，我们就编起新舞——更好的舞。

paras.en: Each one sillier than the last.
paras.zh: 一个比一个滑稽。

paras.en: There was a chicken dance, a prancing peacock dance, and my personal favorite, “the reindeer who had to pee really badly but was stuck inside a fancy ballroom” dance.
paras.zh: 有小鸡舞、开屏孔雀舞，还有我的最爱——“急着撒尿却被困在豪华舞厅里的驯鹿”舞。

paras.en: Iduna had come up with that one, of course, and I’d laughed so hard my stomach ended up hurting more than my bruised toe.
paras.zh: 那支自然是伊杜娜想出来的，我笑得肚子比淤青的脚趾还疼。

paras.en: Iduna.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜。

paras.en: Suddenly I spotted her, dancing on the other side of the ballroom with a partner who I recognized as a few years older than her.
paras.zh: 忽然我瞥见她，在舞池另一头和一位舞伴起舞，我看得出那人比她大几岁。

paras.en: Some random noble’s son I barely knew.
paras.zh: 某个我几乎不认识的贵族子弟。

paras.en: She was leading the dance, twirling him around as if he were the lady and Suddenly I realized what they were doing.
paras.zh: 她领着舞，把他转得团团转，仿佛他才是女子——忽然我明白他们在跳什么了。

paras.en: It was the “reindeer who had to pee really badly but was stuck inside a fancy ballroom” dance!
paras.zh: 那是“急着撒尿却被困在豪华舞厅里的驯鹿”舞！

paras.en: Our She’d taught it to a stranger.
paras.zh: 我们的——她竟把它教给了一个陌生人。

paras.en: My stomach filled with lead. “Well, that’s certainly an interesting Startled, I turned back to my own dance partner.
paras.zh: 我的胃沉得像灌了铅。“嗯，那确实挺有意思——”我惊了一下，转回自己的舞伴。

paras.en: Runa had noticed me watching Iduna and the young man and had misinterpreted my expression of longing as one of disdain.
paras.zh: 鲁娜注意到我在看伊杜娜和那青年，把我流露的渴望误读成了不屑。

paras.en: I opened my mouth, wanting to tell her Iduna could dance circles around anyone here—and was it a crime, suddenly, to want to have fun?
paras.zh: 我张嘴，想告诉她伊杜娜能绕着这儿任何人跳圈——而且想玩得开心，难道突然成罪过了？

paras.en: But in the end, I just nodded and smiled thinly.
paras.zh: 可到头来，我只淡淡点头笑了笑。

paras.en: I had to be polite.
paras.zh: 我得礼貌。

paras.en: Conceal, don’t feel….
paras.zh: 隐藏起来，别去感受……

paras.en: Her expression faltered. “Is…something wrong, Your Majesty?” she asked. “No.” I swallowed hard. “It’s nothing.
paras.zh: 她的表情僵了。“是……有什么不对吗，陛下？”她问。“没有。”我用力咽唾沫。“没什么。

paras.en: It’s just…” My mind whirled for an acceptable excuse. “Everyone’s watching us,” I finally confided in a low voice.
paras.zh: 只是……”我脑子飞转，想找个过得去的借口。“大家都在看我们，”我终于低声吐露。

paras.en: She looked around, her green eyes sparkling. “It seems you are right,” she whispered mischievously. “Perhaps then we should give them a show!” As though on cue, the band struck up a lively tune.
paras.zh: 她环顾四周，绿眼睛闪闪发亮。“看来你说得对，”她俏皮地耳语，“那或许我们该给他们演一场！”仿佛接到暗号，乐队奏起欢快的曲子。

paras.en: I twirled Runa around, trying to play the good partner.
paras.zh: 我旋起鲁娜，努力做个好舞伴。

paras.en: Her skirts swirled gaily and her mouth lifted into a happy smile as she allowed me to spin her, dip her, then pull her back in.
paras.zh: 她的裙摆欢快飞旋，嘴角扬起快乐的笑，任由我旋她、俯她、再把她揽回。

paras.en: She was the perfect dancer, her steps pretty and poised, not a hair out of place.
paras.zh: 她是完美的舞者，步法优美端庄，一丝不乱。

paras.en: She would never step on anyone’s toes, never dance like a reindeer who had to pee. “Shall we get a drink?” I asked her as soon as the song ended.
paras.zh: 她绝不会踩任何人脚趾，绝不会跳得像只急着撒尿的驯鹿。“我们去喝点东西？”曲子一停我就问她。

paras.en: Any excuse to get off the dance floor. “That would be lovely, Your Majesty.” “You don’t have to call me that,” I told her as we headed over to the buffet. “Agnarr is just fine.” “Oh, I’m sorry,” she said, blushing prettily. “Agnarr.
paras.zh: 只要能离开舞池，什么借口都行。“那太好了，陛下。”“你不必那么叫我，”我们走向自助餐台时我对她说，“叫安格瑞就好。”“噢，抱歉，”她娇羞地红了脸，“安格瑞。

paras.en: You can “Runa,” I repeated, then smiled at her. “Let’s get that drink.” We found Lord Peterssen and King Nicholas at the table, filling their glasses.
paras.zh: 你——”“鲁娜，”我重复，朝她笑笑，“我们去喝一杯。”我们在桌边找到了彼得森勋爵和尼古拉斯国王，他们正斟着酒。

paras.en: When they saw us together, they beamed in tandem. “Ah, Prince Agnarr.
paras.zh: 见我们一道，他们同时绽开笑颜。“啊，安格瑞王子。

paras.en: Princess Runa,” Peterssen greeted us. “How was your dance?” “It was lovely, sir,” Runa gushed before I could reply. “You have such a beautiful ballroom here in Arendelle.
paras.zh: 鲁娜公主，”彼得森向我们问候，“跳得可好？”“很美妙，先生，”我还没答，鲁娜就滔滔说，“你们阿伦黛尔的舞厅真美。

paras.en: And such a lovely castle, too.
paras.zh: 城堡也这般可爱。

paras.en: It puts our little manor house back home to shame.” “Castles!
paras.zh: 把我们家乡的小庄园比得无地自容。”“城堡！

paras.en: Bah!
paras.zh: 呸！

paras.en: But you should see our military barracks,” her father interrupted, looking a little annoyed. “Far more useful than some silly ballroom.
paras.zh: 你该看看我们的军营，”她父亲插嘴，略显不悦，“比这傻舞厅有用多了。

paras.en: No offense, of course.” There was a hardness to his voice.
paras.zh: 当然，无意冒犯。”他语气里却有一股生硬。

paras.en: I was fairly sure he had meant offense.
paras.zh: 我相当确定他本就是存心冒犯。

paras.en: But I nodded politely anyway.
paras.zh: 可我还是礼貌地点头。

paras.en: The perfectly poised prince. “Well, we’re still working on building our military back up,” Peterssen replied. “We lost so many good soldiers at the Battle of the Dam.” “Ah, yes!
paras.zh: 那位完美端庄的王子。“我们还在重整军备，”彼得森答，“水坝之战我们折了太多好兵。”“啊，对！

paras.en: Such an unfortunate event!” the king of Vassar boomed.
paras.zh: 多不幸的事！”瓦萨尔国王轰然道。

paras.en: He made a great show of looking around the ballroom before speaking again, this time with a lowered voice. “Also, I heard a rumor that you’ve experienced multiple violent incidents around town recently.” He shook his head, as if very disturbed by this fact. “Why, I was even told that up until today you’ve had the castle gates closed to protect your poor young prince here.” He gave me a concerned look, but his eyes looked hungry for information.
paras.zh: 他夸张地环顾舞厅，才又压低声音开口。“还有，我听到传言，说你们镇上近来发生了多起暴力事件。”他摇摇头，仿佛为此深感不安。“哎呀，我甚至听说，直到今天你们还紧闭城堡大门，来保护你们这位可怜的小王子。”他关切地看我，眼睛却渴求着消息。

paras.en: Peterssen stiffened. “We have taken precautions, yes.
paras.zh: 彼得森僵住了。“我们确已采取防范，是的。

paras.en: But I am confident we have matters under control.” “Of course “We’re doing just fine,” I broke in brusquely, starting to get a little angry.
paras.zh: 但我相信局势已在掌控。”“当然——”“我们好得很，”我粗声打断，开始有点恼火。

paras.en: We had hit a rough patch, surely, just as every Weren’t we? “As I mentioned before, we pride ourselves on our excellent military,” the king added. “And if our kingdoms were to be united, well, we would certainly step in when our new family needed us.” He gave me, then Runa a meaningful look.
paras.zh: 我们确实遇了坎，正如每个——难道不是吗？“如我先前所言，我们以出色的军备为傲，”国王补道，“若两国联姻，自家新亲有难，我们定会出手。”他意味深长地看了看我和鲁娜。

paras.en: The picture of discretion, surely.
paras.zh: 真是谨慎的典范，没错了。

paras.en: I waited for Peterssen to argue, but instead, he surprised me by nodding. “Agreed,” he said. “Our two kingdoms would complement one another nicely.
paras.zh: 我等着彼得森反驳，他却意外地点了头。“同意，”他说，“我们两国能相得益彰。

paras.en: You have the military.
paras.zh: 你们有军备。

paras.en: We have the port.
paras.zh: 我们有港口。

paras.en: And with no threats to our trade routes, both kingdoms would prosper.” “And these two would make some handsome babies,” the king chortled. “Eh, Peterssen?” I nearly spit out my drink.
paras.zh: 贸易航线无忧，两国都将繁荣。”“而这俩会生出漂亮娃娃，”国王咯咯笑，“嗯，彼得森？”我差点喷酒。

paras.en: I needed to get away from here.
paras.zh: 我得离这远点。

paras.en: It was then that I spotted Iduna, standing by the hot chocolate bowl, filling her cup with a ladle.
paras.zh: 就在这时，我瞧见伊杜娜站在热巧克力锅旁，用勺往杯里舀。

paras.en: Or, more precisely, missing the cup completely and coating her arm in chocolate as she observed us in dismay, clearly having overheard everything.
paras.zh: 更确切说，她完全没对准杯子，巧克力浇了满臂，她沮丧地望着我们，显然什么都听到了。

paras.en: Our eyes locked and I tried to send her an impish look, like we were both in on the secret that this was all a farce, but she didn’t smile back.
paras.zh: 我们目光相锁，我试着朝她递个顽皮的眼神，仿佛我俩都心知这不过一场闹剧，可她没回以微笑。

paras.en: Instead, her lips flattened.
paras.zh: 相反，她抿紧了唇。

paras.en: She gave me the most courteous nod—the kind you’d give to a complete stranger—then lifted her chin high.
paras.zh: 她朝我极礼貌地点了下头——那种给全然陌生人的点头——随后高高抬起下巴。

paras.en: It was then that she noticed her arm was getting a chocolate drizzle.
paras.zh: 就在这时她才发觉手臂上正淋着巧克力。

paras.en: She dropped the ladle back into the bowl as though it had burned her, accidentally splashing several ladies standing nearby.
paras.zh: 她像被烫到似的把勺丢回锅，不小心溅了旁边几位女士一身。

paras.en: They gasped in dismay as big brown splotches of chocolate speckled their fancy gowns.
paras.zh: 她们惊呼，大块棕色巧克力斑点在华服上星罗棋布。

paras.en: Iduna stared at them, horrified, then fled the room, dripping a trail of liquid chocolate in her wake.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜惊恐地瞪着她们，随即逃出大厅，身后拖出一道液态巧克力的痕。

paras.en: The ladies clucked their tongues, scandalized.
paras.zh: 女士们咂舌，又惊又恼。

paras.en: Several of the men started to laugh. “What on earth?” Runa began.
paras.zh: 几个男人笑了起来。“这到底——”鲁娜开口。

paras.en: But I had already untangled myself from her arm. “Excuse me,” I said. “I need to…I mean, I…I’ll be back!” “Agnarr!” Behind Peterssen’s jovial tone, there was steel.
paras.zh: 可我已从她臂弯里抽身。“失陪，”我说，“我得——我是说，我——我马上回来！”“安格瑞！”彼得森欢快语调背后藏着钢。

paras.en: I didn’t answer.
paras.zh: 我没答。

paras.en: Instead, I ran from the Great Hall, following the trail of chocolate.
paras.zh: 我反而跑出大厅，顺着那道巧克力痕追去。

paras.en: IT WASN’T EASY TO CLIMB A TREE IN A BALL GOWN.
paras.zh: 穿着舞会礼服爬树可不容易。

paras.en: But then, that was my fault, I thought as I knotted the dress to free my legs, then swung myself up into the tree, to hide in the thick canopy of leaves.
paras.zh: 可话说回来，怪我自己，我边想边把裙子打了个结好让腿自由，随后荡身上了树，藏进浓密的叶冠。

paras.en: I was the one who had agreed to put on a ball gown, even if it was at Gerda’s urging.
paras.zh: 答应穿上舞会礼服的是我，哪怕是被歌尔达劝的。

paras.en: To attend a ball I had no business attending in the first place.
paras.zh: 去参加一场本就不该去的舞会。

paras.en: I closed my eyes, trying to slow my racing heart.
paras.zh: 我闭上眼，想让狂跳的心慢下来。

paras.en: I’d known watching Agnarr move on was going to be hard, but I’d told myself it would be good for me.
paras.zh: 我知道看着安格瑞向前走会很难，却告诉自己这对我有好处。

paras.en: It had started out so well, too, with recruiting one of the other guests to dance with me while Agnarr entertained the princess.
paras.zh: 起初也确实挺好，我邀了另一位客人共舞，安格瑞则陪着公主。

paras.en: I felt strong and confident out on the dance floor, forcing myself to have fun and proving to myself that I could get past him—get past all of this.
paras.zh: 在舞池里我感到坚强又自信，逼自己享受，向自己证明我能跨过他——跨过这一切。

paras.en: But then I got a better glimpse of the girl in question.
paras.zh: 可随后我更看清了那女孩。

paras.en: The beautiful, graceful, perfect girl who looked exactly like what a princess should be—at least according to any Arendellian storybook.
paras.zh: 那美丽、优雅、完美的女孩，正合故事书里公主的模样——至少按任何阿伦黛尔童话本该如此。

paras.en: Regal, proper, dainty.
paras.zh: 高贵、得体、娇巧。

paras.en: Why, I bet she’d never climbed a tree in her life!
paras.zh: 哎呀，我打赌她这辈子从没爬过树！

paras.en: And the way she danced!
paras.zh: 还有她跳舞的模样！

paras.en: She was fluid, effortless, somehow managing to be both relaxed and precise in her movements at the same time.
paras.zh: 她行云流水、毫不费力，一举手一投足竟同时兼顾松弛与精准。

paras.en: But still, I’d managed to keep it together until I’d overheard that king, talking about babies.
paras.zh: 可我还是撑住了，直到听见那位国王谈起娃娃。

paras.en: Runa and Agnarr’s future babies.
paras.zh: 鲁娜和安格瑞未来的娃娃。

paras.en: And suddenly my mind flashed back to the trolls talking about our But they wouldn’t be mine.
paras.zh: 忽然我脑中闪回地精谈论我们的——可那不会是我的了。

paras.en: They would be hers.
paras.zh: 会是她的。

paras.en: It was too much.
paras.zh: 这太过了。

paras.en: Now here I was, covered in sticky chocolate, having embarrassed myself in front of a crowd of upper-class Arendellians, hiding in a tree, while the love of my life was inside, dancing the night away with his perfect princess.
paras.zh: 此刻我满身黏糊糊的巧克力，在众阿伦黛尔上流面前出了丑，躲在树上，而我此生所爱却在屋内，与他的完美公主跳了一整夜。

paras.en: Yes, I was the one who had told him to do it.
paras.zh: 是的，叫他这么做的正是我。

paras.en: But I hadn’t realized how hard it would be for me when he did.
paras.zh: 可我没料到他照做时我会这么难受。

paras.en: What was I going to do?
paras.zh: 我该怎么办？

paras.en: This was beyond torture.
paras.zh: 这比酷刑还甚。

paras.en: And it would only get worse.
paras.zh: 而且只会更糟。

paras.en: Agnarr might marry Runa.
paras.zh: 安格瑞也许会娶鲁娜。

paras.en: Or he might entertain a dozen girls at a dozen balls before he made his decision.
paras.zh: 或在他做决定前，在十几场舞会上应付十几个女孩。

paras.en: But eventually he’d have to pick someone.
paras.zh: 可他终归得选一个人。

paras.en: And it couldn’t be me. “I wish I’d never met you,” I whispered, anger rising inside me, my only defense against my anguish and fear. “I wish I’d been trapped in the mist like everyone else.” The tears came then.
paras.zh: 而那人不会是我。“真希望我从没遇见过你，”我低语，怒火在胸中升起，那是我对抗痛苦与恐惧唯一的盾。“真希望我也像别人一样困在迷雾里。”泪水随即涌来。

paras.en: Big, fat tears, soon followed by loud choking sobs.
paras.zh: 大颗的泪，继而响亮的哽咽抽泣。

paras.en: An ugly cry, not like the dainty princess cry Runa probably had when something didn’t go her way.
paras.zh: 难看的哭，不像鲁娜事事顺心、偶尔不顺时那种娇滴滴的公主哭。

paras.en: Though what had ever not gone her way?
paras.zh: 虽说她有什么不顺过？

paras.en: This was the real thing—a stuffy-nosed, blotchy-faced, swollen-eyed kind of cry.
paras.zh: 这是真正的哭——鼻塞、花脸、眼肿的那种。

paras.en: My heart had been broken into a million pieces, then laid out on the dance floor to be stomped on over and over again. “There you are!” I looked down, startled.
paras.zh: 我的心碎成千万片，摊在舞池上任人反复踩踏。“你在这儿！”我吃惊地低头。

paras.en: Agnarr had poked his head through the foliage, his eyes locking on me.
paras.zh: 安格瑞从枝叶间探出头，目光锁住我。

paras.en: A moment later, he boosted himself into the tree, crawling over to where I sat.
paras.zh: 片刻后，他撑身上树，爬到我坐着的地方。

paras.en: I tried to hide my tearstained face, but it was no use.
paras.zh: 我想藏起泪痕斑斑的脸，却无用。

paras.en: He reached into his pocket and pulled out a silk handkerchief.
paras.zh: 他伸手进口袋，掏出一方丝帕。

paras.en: I blew my nose loudly, giving up on appearances.
paras.zh: 我大声擤了擤鼻子，不再顾形象。

paras.en: I was gross and snotty and covered in chocolate.
paras.zh: 我又是脏又是鼻涕邋遢，还满身巧克力。

paras.en: But that was who I was. “Iduna, why are you crying?” Agnarr asked, peering at me in the inky darkness. “What can I do to cheer you up?” A wicked grin spread over his face. “Maybe some more chocolate?” He nudged my shoulder with his.
paras.zh: 但那才是我。“伊杜娜，你为什么哭？”安格瑞在墨色夜色里端详着我问，“我能怎么让你开心？”一抹狡黠的笑在他脸上展开。“再来点巧克力？”他用自己的肩碰了碰我的。

paras.en: I smiled despite myself and held out my dessert-covered arm. “I think I’ve had my fill of chocolate.
paras.zh: 我忍不住笑了，伸出沾满甜点的胳膊。“我想巧克力我已经吃够了。

paras.en: Seeing as I’ve basically bathed in it tonight.” He smiled gently, then took my hand in his, dragging his finger down my arm.
paras.zh: 毕竟今晚我基本是泡在巧克力里了。”他温柔地笑，然后握住我的手，指尖顺着我的手臂滑下。

paras.en: I tried not to shiver at the delicious feeling of his light touch against my skin.
paras.zh: 他轻触皮肤的销魂之感让我竭力不颤。

paras.en: It had been too long since I’d felt his hands on my body, and I hadn’t realized how much I missed them.
paras.zh: 太久没感受他的手在我身上，我竟没意识到自己多想念。

paras.en: I watched, breathless, as he brought his finger slowly to his mouth, making a great show of licking the chocolate away. “Delicious,” he whispered, his eyes never leaving mine.
paras.zh: 我屏息看着他把手指缓缓送向嘴边，夸张地舔去巧克力。“美味，”他低语，目光从未离开我。

paras.en: And suddenly I got the feeling he wasn’t talking about chocolate anymore. “Don’t,” I protested, but it came out sounding weak, even to me. “I can’t.” His eyes turned ultraserious. “I’m sorry,” he said. “Oh, Iduna, you have no idea how sorry I am.” “You have nothing to be sorry about, Your Majesty.” “That’s not true and you know it!
paras.zh: 忽然我觉得他说的已不是巧克力了。“别，”我抗议，可连自己都听出软弱。“我不能。”他的眼神变得极认真。“对不起，”他说，“噢，伊杜娜，你根本不知道我多抱歉。”“你没什么好抱歉的，陛下。”“那不是真的，你心里清楚！

paras.en: And don’t call me that.
paras.zh: 也别那么叫我。

paras.en: It just doesn’t seem right coming from you.
paras.zh: 从你嘴里说出来就是不对劲。

paras.en: I shouldn’t have let them do this.
paras.zh: 我不该任由他们这么干。

paras.en: I should have refused to go to the ball.
paras.zh: 我该拒绝来这舞会。

paras.en: To meet that girl.
paras.zh: 去见那女孩。

paras.en: To dance with her.” “She was a lovely dancer.” “Who cares?
paras.zh: 和她跳舞。”“她舞跳得真好。”“谁在乎？

paras.en: She could be the best dancer in the world.
paras.zh: 她就算是世界第一舞者又怎样。

paras.en: She isn’t you.” I stopped breathing at the fierceness I heard in his voice.
paras.zh: 她也不是你。”他话里的炽烈让我屏住了呼吸。

paras.en: The look on his face.
paras.zh: 他脸上的神情。

paras.en: The desperation in his eyes.
paras.zh: 他眼底的绝望。

paras.en: He was going to break me.
paras.zh: 他要击垮我了。

paras.en: Right here, right now, in our favorite tree.
paras.zh: 就在此刻，在我们最爱的树上。

paras.en: But worse, if we kept doing this, I would break him, too.
paras.zh: 可更糟的是，若我们继续，我也会击垮他。

paras.en: No.
paras.zh: 不。

paras.en: I had to be strong. “Please stop,” I begged. “I can’t.
paras.zh: 我必须坚强。“求你停下，”我恳求，“我不能。

paras.en: We He grabbed my hands, squeezing them so hard I was half afraid he’d break my bones. “We can “You have to be, Agnarr.
paras.zh: 我们——”他抓住我的手，握得那样紧，我几乎怕他捏碎我的骨头。“我们——”“你必须坚强，安格瑞。

paras.en: It’s for the good of the realm.
paras.zh: 这是为了王国好。

paras.en: You know that.
paras.zh: 你知道的。

paras.en: We can’t be selfish.
paras.zh: 我们不能自私。

paras.en: Your people need a king and queen.” “Doesn’t it matter at all what I I had no answer.
paras.zh: 你的百姓需要国王和王后。”“我想要的就一点也不重要吗？”我答不上来。

paras.en: Instead, I watched as he rummaged through his satchel and produced a strange half-carved chunk of wood that mildly resembled a spoon.
paras.zh: 我反而看着他从挎包里翻出一块奇怪的半雕木块，隐约像个勺子。

paras.en: I frowned, puzzled.
paras.zh: 我皱眉，不解。

paras.en: He gave me a grave look. “It’s a love spoon,” he said. “Or…it will be, anyway.” Oh.
paras.zh: 他神色郑重。“这是爱情木勺，”他说，“或者说……终会是。”哦。

paras.en: I tried to breathe, but it proved almost impossible to pull any air into my lungs.
paras.zh: 我想呼吸，却几乎吸不进一丝空气。

paras.en: A love spoon. “It’s for you,” he said in almost a whisper. “It can only ever be for you.” It was too much.
paras.zh: 爱情木勺。“这是给你的，”他几乎是耳语，“它只可能给你。”这太过了。

paras.en: The desperate, hopeful look in his eyes was going to be my undoing.
paras.zh: 他眼中那绝望又满怀希望的眼神，会毁了我。

paras.en: Why can’t you see?
paras.zh: 你为什么看不透？

paras.en: Why can’t you understand this can’t happen?
paras.zh: 为什么不懂这不可能发生？

paras.en: Because you lied to him from the start, He has no idea who you really are.
paras.zh: 因为你从一开始就骗了他，他根本不知你真实是谁。

paras.en: I could tell him now.
paras.zh: 我现在可以告诉他。

paras.en: But I knew deep down in my heart it wouldn’t change a thing.
paras.zh: 可我心里深知这改变不了什么。

paras.en: He wouldn’t care that I had kept a secret.
paras.zh: 他不会在乎我藏过秘密。

paras.en: He wouldn’t care that I had come from another place, even the home of Arendelle’s supposed enemy.
paras.zh: 他不会在乎我来自别处，甚至来自阿伦黛尔所谓敌人的家园。

paras.en: That I wasn’t the Iduna he thought he knew and loved.
paras.zh: 不在乎我并非他所认识所爱的那个伊杜娜。

paras.en: Because he loved me.
paras.zh: 因为他爱我。

paras.en: The real me.
paras.zh: 真实的我。

paras.en: All of me.
paras.zh: 全部的我。

paras.en: And with that love he would destroy a kingdom.
paras.zh: 而凭着这份爱，他会毁掉一个王国。

paras.en: Cause war.
paras.zh: 引发战争。

paras.en: Destruction.
paras.zh: 毁灭。

paras.en: Death.
paras.zh: 死亡。

paras.en: No.
paras.zh: 不。

paras.en: I couldn’t be that selfish.
paras.zh: 我不能那么自私。

paras.en: I wouldn’t I squared my shoulders.
paras.zh: 我不会——”我挺直肩膀。

paras.en: Lifted my chin.
paras.zh: 抬起下巴。

paras.en: Forced a cold look to my face.
paras.zh: 在脸上挤出冷峻的神情。

paras.en: Conceal, don’t feel.
paras.zh: 隐藏起来，别去感受。

paras.en: He was strong.
paras.zh: 他很强。

paras.en: But I had to be stronger.
paras.zh: 可我得比他更强。

paras.en: Strong enough to put “Iduna, come on!” He tried to reach for me, but I pulled away.
paras.zh: 强到能——”伊杜娜，别这样！”他想抓我，我却抽身退开。

paras.en: Only a few inches, and yet it was the hardest move I’d ever had to make. “You should go back to the party.” My voice was ice. “You should apologize to that poor girl.” “But—” “Listen to me, Agnarr.
paras.zh: 不过几寸，却是我做过最难的动作。“你该回舞会去。”我的声音冷如冰。“你该向那可怜女孩道歉。”“可是——”“听我说，安格瑞。

paras.en: We can’t be around each other and just be friends.
