paras.zh: 我们没法相处在彼此身边、只做朋友。

paras.en: That’s become clear to me after tonight.” I softened my voice a little to deliver the next blow. “So I’ve decided that I am leaving Arendelle tomorrow, and you will never see me again.” Unshed tears pulsed behind my eyelids, but I willed them away. “It is for the best.” He dropped the spoon.
paras.zh: 今晚之后这就清楚了。”我稍稍放软声音，说出下一记重击。“所以我决定，明天就离开阿伦黛尔，你再也见不到我。”未落的泪在眼睑后跳动，我强压下去。“这样最好。”他丢下了勺子。

paras.en: It clattered against the tree’s branches as it fell, eventually hitting the ground with a whisper.
paras.zh: 它落下时磕在树枝上，哗啦作响，最终轻响一声落地。

paras.en: Such a little noise.
paras.zh: 那样轻微的一声。

paras.en: But it echoed in my ears like a thunderclap.
paras.zh: 却如雷霆般在我耳中回响。

paras.en: And something inside me felt as if it had died forever.
paras.zh: 而我体内有什么仿佛永远死了。

paras.en: Agnarr opened his mouth to speak.
paras.zh: 安格瑞张口要说话。

paras.en: But I never got a chance to hear his words.
paras.zh: 可我始终没机会听他说出。

paras.en: For at that moment there was a thundering boom in the distance.
paras.zh: 因为那一刻，远处传来一声轰然巨响。

paras.en: Followed by a flash of white light.
paras.zh: 继之以一道白光。

paras.en: We looked at each other, confused.
paras.zh: 我们困惑地对望。

paras.en: Then we turned back toward the castle.
paras.zh: 随后我们转头望向城堡。

paras.en: And saw the smoke.
paras.zh: 看见了烟。

paras.en: THERE WAS CHAOS EVERYWHERE WHEN WE ran back inside the castle.
paras.zh: 我们跑回城堡里时，到处一片混乱。

paras.en: Well-dressed guests, huddling together in the Great Hall, talking in urgent voices.
paras.zh: 衣着体面的宾客们挤在大厅里，压低声音急切地交谈着。

paras.en: It was hard, at first, to figure out what had happened.
paras.zh: 起初，我们很难弄清到底发生了什么。

paras.en: I smelled smoke but saw no fire. “There you are!” Peterssen and a group of guards surrounded Iduna and me.
paras.zh: 我闻到了烟味，却没看到火。“可算找到你们了！”彼得森和一群卫兵把我和伊杜娜围了起来。

paras.en: The regent hugged me fiercely. “We thought they had you!” “Who?
paras.zh: 摄政紧紧抱住了我。“我们还以为你们被抓走了呢！”“谁抓我们？

paras.en: What happened?” I asked.
paras.zh: 发生了什么事？”我问。

paras.en: King Nicholas answered, looking quite rattled. “There was an explosion in the Great Hall.” “An explosion?” “By the dessert table.
paras.zh: 尼古拉斯国王答道，面色相当慌乱。“大厅里发生了爆炸。”“爆炸？”“就在甜点桌旁边。

paras.en: It was a miracle no one was hurt.
paras.zh: 万幸的是没有人受伤。

paras.en: Evidently someone had spilled chocolate on the floor earlier, so everyone was staying clear of the area until it could be wiped up.” At my side, Iduna gave a small squeak. “I had men posted outside,” added King Nicholas. “They informed me they saw a lone figure, dressed in black and wearing a sun mask, fleeing the castle, right before the explosion.
paras.zh: 显然早些时候有人把巧克力洒在了地上，所以大家都离那片区域远远的，等它干掉再擦。”伊杜娜在我身旁轻轻惊叫了一声。“我在外面派了人手，”尼古拉斯国王补充道，“他们告诉我，爆炸前看到一个独自一人的身影，穿着黑衣、戴着太阳面具，正逃离城堡。

paras.en: They tried to follow him, but he slipped away into the I frowned, my mind racing.
paras.zh: 他们想追上去，可他溜进了……”我皱起眉头，思绪飞转。

paras.en: More attacks.
paras.zh: 又一轮袭击。

paras.en: This one far more brazen than the others.
paras.zh: 这一回比以往任何一次都更明目张胆。

paras.en: The culprit had snuck into the castle.
paras.zh: 凶手已经溜进了城堡内部。

paras.en: Maybe disguised as one of the guests.
paras.zh: 也许伪装成了某位宾客。

paras.en: Or maybe it was “Do not worry, Your Grace,” King Nicholas added, seeing the look on my face. “I have assigned men to posts around your castle.
paras.zh: 或者也许只是……“别担心，陛下，”尼古拉斯国王看着我的表情，又开口道，“我已在您的城堡四周布下人手。

paras.en: Others are sweeping each room for any additional incendiary devices.
paras.zh: 另一些人正在逐个房间搜寻是否还有别的燃烧装置。

paras.en: We will not stop until we can be sure your kingdom is safe.” I knew the right thing to do was express enthusiastic gratitude for the king’s efforts, but I couldn’t find the words.
paras.zh: 在确保您的王国安全之前，我们不会停手。”我知道理应热情地感谢国王的周全，却一句话也说不出来。

paras.en: All I could think of was that there could be someone among us at this very moment who was a traitor to the kingdom. “Thank you,” Peterssen cut in smoothly, casting me a sharp glance. “That is very generous of you.” He turned to me. “Agnarr, why don’t you go check on Runa?” he said pointedly. “She seemed a bit shaken up by the sudden turn of events.
paras.zh: 我满脑子只想着：此刻我们之中，没准就藏着背叛王国的人。“谢谢您，”彼得森不动声色地插话，朝我锐利地瞥了一眼，“您真是太慷慨了。”他转向我：“安格瑞，你不去看看露娜吗？”他意有所指地说，“这场突如其来的变故，似乎让她有些慌了神。

paras.en: I led her to the sitting room to spend some time in the quiet.” He addressed Iduna. “Why don’t you go see how you might help inside the Great Hall.” His firm tone did not pose this as a choice.
paras.zh: 我带她去了休息室，想让她安静待会儿。”他接着对伊杜娜说：“你去大厅看看能帮上什么忙吧。”他语气坚定，根本不容商量。

paras.en: Reluctantly, I left Iduna to her task, heading up the stairs to the sitting room.
paras.zh: 我不情愿地留下伊杜娜去忙她的，自己拾级而上，朝休息室走去。

paras.en: We’d have to deal with all that had transpired between us later; first the people needed our help.
paras.zh: 我们之间发生的一切，只能留待日后解决；眼下，百姓们更需要我们的帮助。

paras.en: The next day I could go to Peterssen and state my case.
paras.zh: 明天，我就可以去找彼得森，把我的理由说个明白。

paras.en: Tell him all the reasons I needed to marry Iduna.
paras.zh: 告诉他我非娶伊杜娜不可的种种缘由。

paras.en: And if he didn’t want Iduna as my queen?
paras.zh: 可要是他不愿让伊杜娜做我的王后呢？

paras.en: Well, maybe I “Your Majesty!” Runa cried, rising from her seat as I entered the sitting room. “You’re all right!” “Yes.
paras.zh: 那也许我……“陛下！”我走进休息室时，露娜从座位上猛地站起，喊道，“您没事！”“嗯。

paras.en: I’m fine.
paras.zh: 我没事。

paras.en: I was…outside the castle when it happened,” I finished lamely. “And, uh…how are you?
paras.zh: 出事的时候，我……在城堡外面，”我笨嘴拙舌地补了一句，“那个，你……还好吗？

paras.en: Are you all right?” “Well, to be honest, I’m still a little shook up,” she admitted. “I’d been standing quite close to the desserts.
paras.zh: 你没事吧？”“说实话，我这会儿还有点惊魂未定，”她坦承，“当时我就站在甜点桌不远的地方。

paras.en: It was lucky my father had called me for a dance just before it happened.” “Wow,” I said, a little taken aback.
paras.zh: 幸好出事前父亲刚好叫我跳了支舞。”“哇，”我有些意外地说。

paras.en: I’d been so distracted by everything, until this moment I hadn’t thought all of this But did someone else?
paras.zh: 我被这一桩桩事搅得心神不宁，直到这一刻才想起所有这些——可会不会还有别的人？

paras.en: Someone who didn’t want her me I realized Runa was still staring at me, an uncertain expression on her face. “I’m sorry,” I said ruefully, walking over to her. “We’re really not giving you the best first impression of our kingdom, are we?
paras.zh: 一个不希望她……我这才意识到，露娜仍盯着我，脸上带着几分不安。“抱歉，”我懊恼地走过去，对她说，“我们对贵国的第一印象，实在算不上好，对吧？

paras.en: I promise you, it’s usually a lot more peaceful.
paras.zh: 我向你保证，平日里这儿要安宁得多。

paras.en: Almost boring, to be honest.” Maybe this would all be a blessing in disguise.
paras.zh: 说真的，几乎有些无聊。”也许这一切反而是塞翁失马，焉知非福。

paras.en: She’d be too frightened to stay.
paras.zh: 她会被吓得失了留下的勇气。

paras.en: Who would want to be queen of such a dangerous country?
paras.zh: 谁会愿意做这样一个危机四伏国度的王后呢？

paras.en: Between the recent attacks and now the explosion…To think once we were concerned about purple sheep… “Don’t worry,” she said, giving me a shy smile. “I like what I’ve seen of Arendelle so far.
paras.zh: 一边是最近的连番袭击，一边是如今的爆炸……想当初我们还在为紫色的羊发愁呢……“别担心，”她羞涩地一笑，对我说，“阿伦黛尔给我的印象，目前还算不错。

paras.en: All it needs is a little…discipline.
paras.zh: 它只需一点点……规矩。

paras.en: Like my father says, you just have to set an example.
paras.zh: 就像我父亲说的，只要做个表率就行了。

paras.en: Once people see what happens when you challenge the crown, they tend not to challenge you anymore.” “I guess,” I said hesitantly, though the approach sounded a bit ruthless to me.
paras.zh: 一旦人们见识了挑战王权的下场，便不敢再挑衅了。”“也许吧，”我迟疑道，尽管这法子在我听来有几分冷酷。

paras.en: Arendelle had always been a peaceful kingdom.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔向来是个和平的王国。

paras.en: I didn’t want to see it turn into a military state.
paras.zh: 我不想看它变成一座军营。

paras.en: There had to be another way.
paras.zh: 一定还有别的路可走。

paras.en: Runa lay a hand on my arm. “May I speak frankly?” “Um, yes.
paras.zh: 露娜把手搭在我的手臂上。“我能说句心里话吗？”“嗯，好。

paras.en: Of course.” Something inside me quivered, and not in a good way.
paras.zh: 当然。”我心底某处微微一颤——却不是什么好兆头。

paras.en: Her shoulders seemed to relax. “Look, I know this is hard, okay?” she said. “I just wanted you to know it’s hard for me, too.” “What?” I was confused. “You mean…the explosion?” She shook her head. “No,” she said. “I’m not talking about the explosion.” She turned for a moment, staring at the back of the room, as if thinking.
paras.zh: 她似乎放松了肩膀。“听着，我知道这很难，好吗？”她说，“我只是想让你知道，对我来说同样不容易。”“什么？”我一头雾水，“你是说……爆炸？”她摇了摇头：“不，”她说，“我说的不是爆炸。”她转过身，望着房间深处，像是在思忖什么。

paras.en: Then she turned back to me, her expression I felt my cheeks flush. “I was nervous about meeting you, too,” I confessed. “It’s only natural,” she agreed. “But I want you to know I am not worried anymore,” she continued. “I can tell you are no monster.
paras.zh: 接着她转回身，神色……我不由得脸颊发烫。“其实我也很紧张，怕见你，”我坦白道。“这再正常不过了，”她表示认同，“但我想让你知道，我不再担心了，”她接着说，“我能看出你绝不是什么怪物。

paras.en: You are kind, smart.
paras.zh: 你善良，又聪慧。

paras.en: You care about people.
paras.zh: 你在乎身边的人。

paras.en: Trust me, I’ve made the rounds to various kingdoms.
paras.zh: 信我没错，我可是走访过不少王国。

paras.en: I cannot say the same for all men in positions of power.” “I appreciate that,” I said, unsure of where this was heading, and even more uncertain I wanted to stick around to find out.
paras.zh: 但对那些身居高位的人，我可不敢都这么评价。”“多谢你这么说，”我说，摸不准她要讲向何处，更不确定自己是否想留下来听个究竟。

paras.en: She reached up, turning my chin gently so I was facing her again.
paras.zh: 她抬起手，轻轻托起我的下巴，让我重新面向她。

paras.en: Her green eyes met mine.
paras.zh: 她那双绿眸与我的目光相遇。

paras.en: There was no doubt in them.
paras.zh: 其中没有半分犹疑。

paras.en: No fear.
paras.zh: 没有恐惧。

paras.en: No confusion.
paras.zh: 没有困惑。

paras.en: She knew what she wanted.
paras.zh: 她清楚自己想要什么。

paras.en: And she wasn’t shy about asking for it. “Forget about them,” she said firmly. “You and I—we can do this our way.
paras.zh: 也毫不羞于开口索取。“把他们抛到脑后吧，”她坚定地说，“你和我——我们可以按自己的方式来。

paras.en: On our terms.” Then, to my shock, she rose up on her toes, pressing her lips against mine.
paras.zh: 按我们的心意。”接着，令我震惊的是，她踮起脚尖，将双唇贴上了我的。

paras.en: They were soft and warm as they roamed my mouth, coaxing me to kiss her back.
paras.zh: 那唇柔软而温暖，在我的唇上辗转，诱着我也回吻她。

paras.en: To show her I agreed.
paras.zh: 好让她知道我应允了。

paras.en: That we could find a way to make this work together.
paras.zh: 我们能一起找到走下去的办法。

paras.en: But I couldn’t do it.
paras.zh: 可我做不出。

paras.en: Her lips were full and pliant, but they were the lips of a stranger.
paras.zh: 她的唇丰润柔嫩，可那是陌生人的唇。

paras.en: There was no passion behind Runa’s act—the kiss was not given in love, but out of duty and honor.
paras.zh: 露娜的举动里没有一丝热忱——这一吻不是出于爱，而是出于责任与荣耀。

paras.en: She was doing what she was raised to do.
paras.zh: 她只是在履行自幼被教养的使命。

paras.en: Stepping into the role she was born to play.
paras.zh: 步入那生来属于她的角色。

paras.en: But I didn’t want to play anymore.
paras.zh: 可我不想再演下去了。

paras.en: And while maybe someday we could learn to love one another—or at least live in a respectful partnership—there was always the chance we wouldn’t.
paras.zh: 虽说也许有朝一日我们能学会相爱——或至少相敬如宾地共度一生——可也总有可能，我们永远做不到。

paras.en: The chance I would end up like my mother—so sad she couldn’t breathe, trapped in a life she never wanted to live.
paras.zh: 我也许会落得和母亲同样的下场——悲伤得无法呼吸，困在一生都不想要的生活里。

paras.en: But I had one thing my mother didn’t have.
paras.zh: 可我拥有母亲没有的一件东西。

paras.en: A best friend.
paras.zh: 一个最好的朋友。

paras.en: A true love.
paras.zh: 一份真挚的爱。

paras.en: Someone worth fighting for.
paras.zh: 一个值得为之抗争的人。

paras.en: Someone worth risking Iduna.
paras.zh: 一个值得为她赌上伊杜娜的人。

paras.en: I broke away from Runa, stepping back from her arms. “I’m sorry,” I said. “I can’t.
paras.zh: 我从露娜怀里挣脱，向后退开。“对不起，”我说，“我做不到。

paras.en: I just…I can’t.” “Why not?” she asked, looking crestfallen. “I would be a good wife, Agnarr.
paras.zh: 我真的……做不到。”“为什么？”她问，神色黯然，“我会是个好妻子的，安格瑞。

paras.en: I would be faithful to you.
paras.zh: 我会对你忠贞不渝。

paras.en: I would be a good mother to your children.” “I believe all that,” I said. “I truly do.
paras.zh: 我会当你孩子们的慈母。”“这些我都信，”我说，“我真心信。

paras.en: But I can’t be a good husband to you.
paras.zh: 可我当不了你的好丈夫。

paras.en: Not when I am in love with someone else.” This was dangerous territory: one word from Runa, and King Nicholas could be tempted to pull back all of the help he had just offered, and more.
paras.zh: 尤其当我心里装着别人时。”这话可是在走钢丝：只要露娜吐露一字，尼古拉斯国王便可能收回方才答应的所有援助，甚至更多。

paras.en: I treaded carefully. “You deserve so much more, Runa.
paras.zh: 我步步留心。“你值得好得多的人，露娜。

paras.en: You deserve a man who will love you with all his heart.
paras.zh: 你值得一个全心全意爱你的男人。

paras.en: Who will marry you because he can’t bear to wake up in the morning without you by his side—not because of some ridiculous idea of it being good for the kingdoms.” I sighed. “Alliances can be built by other means.
paras.zh: 一个因清晨醒来没有你在身边便无法忍受、因而娶你的人——而不是出于什么'于两国都好'的荒唐念头。”我叹了口气，“联盟大可用别的方式缔结。

paras.en: Partnerships, trade—all that can be worked out.
paras.zh: 伙伴之谊、贸易往来——那些都好商量。

paras.en: But at the end of the day, what really matters is that you are happy.
paras.zh: 可说到底，真正紧要的是你过得快乐。

paras.en: That you are loved.
paras.zh: 是你被人所爱。

paras.en: Whether it be by the richest prince or the son of the butcher.” Runa stared at me for a moment.
paras.zh: 无论那人是再富有的王子，还是屠夫的儿子。”露娜盯了我片刻。

paras.en: I could practically see the gears turning in her head.
paras.zh: 我几乎能看见她脑中齿轮在转动。

paras.en: For a moment, I wondered if she’d slap me.
paras.zh: 有那么一瞬，我甚至想她会不会扇我一巴掌。

paras.en: But instead, a slow, grateful smile began to spread across her face.
paras.zh: 可她没有，脸上反倒缓缓漾开一抹感激的微笑。

paras.en: She reached out and gave me a tight hug. “I hope this girl knows how lucky she is to have someone like you,” she whispered in my ear. “And I hope someday I’ll be that lucky, too.”
paras.zh: 她伸出手，紧紧拥抱了我。“但愿那个女孩知道，能有你这样的人在身边，她是多么幸运，”她在我耳边低语，“也但愿有一天，我也能那般幸运。

paras.en: I RAN INTO THE SECRET ROOM IN THE library, slamming the door shut behind me.
paras.zh: 我冲进图书馆里的密室，随手把门在身后重重关上。

paras.en: Leaning against the stone shelves, I sucked in a shaky breath.
paras.zh: 我靠着石制书架，喘息着吸进一口发颤的气。

paras.en: I could feel the tears streaming down my cheeks, but I didn’t bother to swipe them away.
paras.zh: 我觉出泪水流下脸颊，却懒得去擦。

paras.en: Agnarr and Runa, all alone, in the sitting room.
paras.zh: 安格瑞和露娜，独处一室，在休息室里。

paras.en: Kissing.
paras.zh: 在接吻。

paras.en: I’d slipped out of the Great Hall earlier, sneaking past Peterssen to go check on Agnarr.
paras.zh: 早些时候，我从大厅溜了出来，绕过彼得森，想去看看安格瑞。

paras.en: I’d told myself I was just making sure he was all right.
paras.zh: 我告诉自己，只是去确认他平安无事。

paras.en: But if I was being honest with myself, I was worried about him and Runa being alone together, despite my brave words in the tree.
paras.zh: 可若老实面对自己，尽管在树下说过那样勇敢的话，我还是担心他和露娜单独待在一起。

paras.en: As it turned out, my worries were well founded.
paras.zh: 结果证明，我的担心并非多余。

paras.en: I closed my eyes and saw Runa’s dainty hand snaking behind Agnarr’s neck, pulling him close.
paras.zh: 我闭上眼，眼前却是露娜纤巧的手绕到安格瑞颈后，将他拉近。

paras.en: His strong hands at her waist.
paras.zh: 他有力的双手揽着她的腰。

paras.en: Bile rose to my throat. “This is what you wanted,” I reminded myself. “He’s just doing what you told him.
paras.zh: 一阵酸苦涌上喉咙。“这正是你想要的啊，”我提醒自己，“他不过是在照你说的做。

paras.en: He tried to ask you to marry him.
paras.zh: 他本想开口求你嫁给他。

paras.en: And you turned him down before he could even manage to get the words out.
paras.zh: 你却抢在他把话说出口前就拒绝了。

paras.en: You told him you were leaving.
paras.zh: 你告诉他你要离开。

paras.en: What was he supposed to do?” But none of that logic could squash the pain searing in my soul.
paras.zh: 叫他还能如何？”可再怎么讲道理，也压不下灼烧我灵魂的痛。

paras.en: Bearing witness to Agnarr taking that next step.
paras.zh: 眼睁睁看着安格瑞迈出那下一步。

paras.en: Leaving me behind forever.
paras.zh: 永远将我抛下。

paras.en: And so quickly, too.
paras.zh: 而且这么快。

paras.en: He was literally begging me to stay—he’d carved me a love spoon, for goodness’ sake—when the explosion hit.
paras.zh: 爆炸响起时，他几乎是在哀求我留下——老天作证，他还为我刻了一把爱情木勺呢。

paras.en: And not twenty minutes later, he’d already moved on to another.
paras.zh: 可不到二十分钟，他就已经移情别恋。

paras.en: I reached into the bodice of my gown and pulled out the half-carved spoon.
paras.zh: 我伸手探入裙襟，掏出那把只刻了一半的木勺。

paras.en: I ran my fingers along its still-rough edges.
paras.zh: 我用手指抚过它仍显粗糙的边缘。

paras.en: Unbeknownst to Agnarr, I’d picked it up off the ground as we’d run back inside the castle.
paras.zh: 安格瑞并不知情——我们跑回城堡时，是我从地上把它捡了起来。

paras.en: Maybe I should leave it here for him.
paras.zh: 也许我该把它留在这儿给他。

paras.en: Maybe he could finish it and present it to Runa instead.
paras.zh: 也许他能把剩下的刻完，改赠给露娜。

paras.en: Despair rose inside me.
paras.zh: 绝望在我心底升起。

paras.en: What was I going to do?
paras.zh: 我该怎么办？

paras.en: I’d told Agnarr I was leaving, but where was I supposed to go?
paras.zh: 我告诉安格瑞我要走，可我又能去哪儿？

paras.en: My life was here, in Arendelle.
paras.zh: 我的生活在这里，在阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: And even if I did manage to find some other safe haven, I knew the memories would follow me like restless ghosts.
paras.zh: 就算真能找到别的安身之所，我也知道那些记忆会如不安的幽灵，紧紧相随。

paras.en: Anywhere I went, Agnarr would remain there, in my heart.
paras.zh: 无论我去往何处，安格瑞都会留在那里，留在我心里。

paras.en: Anger rose inside me, displacing my fear.
paras.zh: 怒火在我心头腾起，盖过了恐惧。

paras.en: I kicked a nearby chair, only succeeding in hurting my foot.
paras.zh: 我踢了一脚旁边的椅子，结果只伤到了自己的脚。

paras.en: I gritted my teeth, hopping up and down in pain a few times, managing to knock over a stack of papers in the process.
paras.zh: 我咬紧牙关，疼得单脚跳了几下，顺带碰倒了一摞纸。

paras.en: Typical clumsy Iduna.
paras.zh: 典型的笨手笨脚伊杜娜。

paras.en: I bet Runa had never knocked anything over accidentally in her life.
paras.zh: 我敢打赌，露娜这辈子从没失手碰倒过任何东西。

paras.en: When I reached down to scoop them back up, I realized a map sat on top of the pile.
paras.zh: 我弯腰去捡那些纸时，才发现纸堆最上面放着一张地图。

paras.en: Not just any map.
paras.zh: 那可不是普通的地图。

paras.en: The map to the mountain trolls.
paras.zh: 是通往山地地精的地图。

paras.en: I stared down it, my heart thumping as a thought began to take form in my mind.
paras.zh: 我低头盯着它，心跳如擂鼓，一个念头在脑中渐渐成形。

paras.en: Could this be the answer I was looking for?
paras.zh: 莫非这就是我一直在寻的答案？

paras.en: The one sure way to absolve me of my pain?
paras.zh: 那唯一能让我解脱痛苦的法子？

paras.en: The trolls had wiped the ice harvester’s memory, to give her peace.
paras.zh: 地精曾抹去那位采冰人的记忆，好让她安宁。

paras.en: And Agnarr’s mother’s memory, too.
paras.zh: 还有安格瑞母亲的记忆。

paras.en: Could they do the same for me?
paras.zh: 他们能对我也如法炮制吗？

paras.en: A thread of hope wound through me.
paras.zh: 一丝希望在心中缠绕开来。

paras.en: Was it possible?
paras.zh: 这真的可行吗？

paras.en: Could the trolls really help me forget my love for the prince?
paras.zh: 地精真能帮我忘掉对王子的爱吗？

paras.en: If so, I could stay in Arendelle, keep working with the farmers.
paras.zh: 若真能如此，我就可以留在阿伦黛尔，继续和农户们一起干活。

paras.en: Maybe make some new friends.
paras.zh: 也许还能交些新朋友。

paras.en: Maybe even find someone new.
paras.zh: 也许甚至能遇见新的人。

paras.en: Part of me hated the idea.
paras.zh: 我的一部分讨厌这个念头。

paras.en: Part of me wanted to jealously hold on to the time spent with Agnarr, painful as it was.
paras.zh: 我的一部分想要死死抓住与安格瑞共度的时光，哪怕它满是痛楚。

paras.en: But another part of me, the more sensible part, told me that until the pain was gone, I would never be able to move forward with my life.
paras.zh: 可我的另一面，那更理智的一面，告诉我：只要痛还在，我就永远无法继续前行。

paras.en: And I had so much more to live for.
paras.zh: 而我还有那么多值得活下去的理由。

paras.en: So much more to do.
paras.zh: 那么多事要做。

paras.en: Memories faded eventually.
paras.zh: 记忆终会褪去。

paras.en: I would just be…speeding up the process a bit.
paras.zh: 我不过是在……稍稍加快这个过程罢了。

paras.en: I grabbed the map and rolled it up in my hands.
paras.zh: 我抓起地图，在手里卷成一卷。

paras.en: My whole body was trembling as I slipped out from behind the bookcase again, leaving the secret room behind.
paras.zh: 我浑身发抖，再次从书架后溜出，将密室抛在身后。

paras.en: Next time I was here, I wouldn’t remember it at all.
paras.zh: 下次再到这里时，我对此将毫无记忆。

paras.en: And the pain would be gone for good.
paras.zh: 而那痛楚也将永远消散。

paras.en: “ANY SIGN OF HER?” Kai closed the door to my chambers behind him, shaking his head. “I’m sorry, sir.
paras.zh: 有她的踪影吗？“凯随手关上我寝殿的门，摇了摇头，”抱歉，陛下。

paras.en: I checked the entire castle.
paras.zh: 我搜遍了整座城堡。

paras.en: Lady Iduna is not here.” I scowled, wanting to slam my fist against the wall.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜小姐不在这里。“我皱起眉，恨不得一拳砸在墙上。

paras.en: Where had she gone?
paras.zh: 她究竟去了哪里？

paras.en: I’d returned to the Great Hall right after parting with Runa, but Iduna was nowhere to be seen.
paras.zh: 和露娜分开后，我立刻回到了大厅，却哪里都不见伊杜娜的身影。

paras.en: I’d questioned all the guards, but in the chaos of the incident at the ball, no one had seen her go.
paras.zh: 我盘问了所有卫兵，可舞会那场骚乱中，谁也没见她离开。

paras.en: Had she made good on her threat to leave Arendelle forever?
paras.zh: 她当真兑现了永远离开阿伦黛尔的威胁？

paras.en: Despair rose inside me.
paras.zh: 绝望在我心底升起。

paras.en: I sat down in the chair next to my bed, scrubbing my face with my hands. “Are you all right, sire?” Kai asked, his voice sounding troubled. “Are you worried about her?
paras.zh: 我在床边的椅子上坐下，双手搓着脸。”陛下，您还好吗？“凯问，声音里透着不安，”您在担心她吗？

paras.en: Shall I send the guards out to track her down?” I shook my head slowly. “Don’t bother.
paras.zh: 要我派卫兵出去寻她吗？“我缓缓摇头：”不必了。

paras.en: She’s gone.
paras.zh: 她走了。

paras.en: She’s probably never coming back.” “That would be a real shame, sire.” Kai pressed his lips together. “We all love Lady Iduna.
paras.zh: 她大概再也不会回来了。“”那可真叫人遗憾，陛下。“凯抿紧嘴唇，”我们都爱着伊杜娜小姐。

paras.en: She brings so much life to this castle.” “Yeah, well, I don’t blame her for leaving,” I muttered. “Though I wish she had at least come to say goodbye.” Kai came over and put a warm hand on my shoulder. “Agnarr—” he started, but was interrupted by a knock at the door.
paras.zh: 她给这座城堡带来太多生机了。“”是啊，不过她走，我也不怪她，“我嘟囔着，”只盼她至少来道个别。“凯走过来，把手温暖地搭在我肩上：”安格瑞——“他刚开口，就被敲门声打断。

paras.en: For a moment I had a wild idea it might be Iduna, coming back to say that she could never leave me—that she loved me too much for us to be apart.
paras.zh: 有那么一瞬，我冒出荒唐的念头：也许是伊杜娜回来了，说她绝离不开我——说她爱我太深，无法与我分离。

paras.en: But instead, it was Gerda who poked her head inside. “Would Your Majesty like some supper?” she asked. “I brought you a sandwich.” She entered and set a tray on the table.
paras.zh: 可探进头的却是格尔达。”陛下想用些夜宵吗？“她问，”我给您带了三明治。“她走进来，把托盘摆在桌上。

paras.en: Then she looked from Kai to me. “Is everything all right?” she asked. “Iduna’s gone,” Kai told her when I didn’t immediately answer. “The prince is…concerned.” “Do you think she’s not safe?” Gerda asked, her face turning pale. “No!” I practically shouted. “She just doesn’t want to be with me!” Gerda was at my side in an instant, pulling me into a tight hug as she used to do when I was a boy. “That is not true,” she said firmly. “I know for a fact Iduna loves you.” “A blind man would know that,” Kai added with a chuckle.
paras.zh: 接着她看看凯，又看看我：”一切都还好吧？“她问。”伊杜娜走了，“见我没立刻答话，凯替我说，”王子他……很担心。“”你觉得她不安全吗？“格尔达问，脸色发白。”不是！“我几乎喊出来，”她只是不愿跟我在一起！“格尔达转眼就到了我身边，像我小时候那样紧紧抱住我。”才不是那样，“她坚定地说，”我清楚得很，伊杜娜爱你。“”瞎子都看得出来，“凯笑着补了一句。

paras.en: I struggled out of the hug. “You don’t understand.
paras.zh: 我从拥抱里挣出来：”你们不明白。

paras.en: I was about to ask her to marry me.
paras.zh: 我正要开口向她求婚。

paras.en: I carved a love spoon for her and everything!
paras.zh: 我还为她刻了爱情木勺，什么都准备好了！

paras.en: But she says I’m supposed to marry a princess.
paras.zh: 可她说，我该娶的是一位公主。

paras.en: Like Runa.” My hands curled into fists. “I’m so sick of people telling me what I should do.
paras.zh: 比如露娜。“我攥紧双拳：”我受够了别人对我指手画脚，告诉我该怎么做。

paras.en: Whom I should marry.
paras.zh: 该娶谁。

paras.en: Sometimes I wish I could renounce my crown altogether.
paras.zh: 有时我真想干脆不要这顶王冠。

paras.en: So I could marry the person I love.” Gerda exchanged looks with Kai. “But you can,” she told me, her voice low and careful. “I don’t mean renouncing your birthright,” she clarified quickly. “But marrying the person you love?
paras.zh: 好去娶我爱的人。“格尔达与凯交换了个眼神。”可你办得到，“她低声而谨慎地对我说，”我不是说放弃你与生俱来的权利，“她赶紧解释，”而是说，娶你爱的人——

paras.en: That’s your choice in the end.” I frowned at her words. “You don’t understand.
paras.zh: 那终究是你自己的选择。“我被她的话弄得一皱眉：”你不明白。

paras.en: The council said—” Kai waved a hand dismissively. “The council likes to say many things.
paras.zh: 议会说过——“凯不以为然地挥了挥手：”议会就爱说三道四。

paras.en: But there’s nothing in the Arendelle lawbooks that says you must marry someone of royal blood.” I stared at him in disbelief. “How do you know that?” Guilty smiles crept to their lips. “We may have done a little research,” Gerda confessed, “when we saw you two suffering so much from that ridiculous council trying to force you into a marriage you didn’t want, to a girl who was completely wrong for you.” “We spent hours in the library,” Kai added. “Scoured all the books we could find on the subject.” “And we found nothing!” Gerda exclaimed, excitedly clapping her hands together. “There is no Arendelle law—now or ever—that says the prince must marry into another royal family.” “Are you serious?” I asked, astounded at the news and more than a little surprised that Gerda and Kai had gone to such lengths on my behalf.
paras.zh: 可阿伦黛尔的法典里，根本没有规定你必须娶王室血统的人。“我难以置信地盯着他：”你怎会知道？“他们嘴角浮起几分心虚的笑。”我们或许做了一点小小的调查，“格尔达坦白，”看到你们俩被那荒唐的议会强迫结一门你根本不情愿、对象也完全不合的亲事，受尽煎熬，我们就动了手。“”我们在图书馆泡了好几个时辰，“凯补充，”翻遍了能找到的相关典籍。“”结果一无所获！“格尔达兴奋地拍起手，”阿伦黛尔从来、从来没有哪条法律规定王子必须娶别国王室的人。“”此话当真？“我问，既为这消息震惊，更惊讶于格尔达和凯竟为我做到这般地步。

paras.en: I’d had no idea that they cared so much.
paras.zh: 我从未想过他们竟如此上心。

paras.en: That they had been rooting for Iduna and me from the sidelines all this time.
paras.zh: 这一路，他们竟一直在旁默默为我们俩加油。

paras.en: Kai grinned. “The council may not like it.
paras.zh: 凯咧嘴一笑：”议会或许不爱听。

paras.en: But you, as their monarch, have the final say.
paras.zh: 可你身为君主，拥有最终决定权。

paras.en: You can marry whoever you want.
paras.zh: 你想娶谁，便娶谁。

paras.en: A princess, an orphan—it’s your choice.” “I think that choice has already been made,” Gerda added with a teasing smile.
paras.zh: 公主也好，孤儿也罢——由你定。“”我觉得这选择早已做好了，“格尔达带几分调侃地笑道。

paras.en: I felt a lump rise in my throat. “Thank you,” I said sincerely.
paras.zh: 我喉头一紧：”谢谢你们，“我由衷地说。

paras.en: Gerda gave me a soft look. “Agnarr, we both care about you greatly.” She took a deep breath. “And we don’t want to see you end up like your mother.
paras.zh: 格尔达温柔地望着我：”安格瑞，我们俩都十分在乎你。“她深吸一口气，”我们不愿见你落得和母亲同样的下场。

paras.en: That would be the worst thing in the world.” My mother.
paras.zh: 那会是世上最可怕的事。“我的母亲。

paras.en: I nodded slowly, thinking back to the trolls’ story.
paras.zh: 我缓缓点头，想起地精讲过的那个故事。

paras.en: I had been so close to the same thing happening to me.
paras.zh: 我差点就重蹈她的覆辙。

paras.en: If not for Iduna… Gerda reached into her bag and pulled out a small stuffed puffin with a blue cape and a button eye.
paras.zh: 若不是因为伊杜娜……格尔达伸手从包里掏出一只小小的毛绒海鹦，披着蓝披风，眼睛是一颗纽扣。

paras.en: For a moment, I didn’t recognize it.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻，我没认出它。

paras.en: Then, slowly, a warm memory floated to the surface. “Sir JörgenBjörgen!” I cried, grabbing it from her and just staring. “I forgot all about him!
paras.zh: 接着，一段温暖的记忆缓缓浮上心头。”耶尔根·比约根爵士！“我喊出声，从她手里一把抢过它，只是盯着，”我把他全忘了！

paras.en: Where’s he been all these years?” “Your father packed away everything that reminded him of your mother after she left.
paras.zh: 这些年来他一直搁在哪儿？“”你母亲走后，你父亲把一切令他想起她的东西都收了起来。

paras.en: And we have no idea where he put it.
paras.zh: 我们也不知他放到哪儿了。

paras.en: He also forbade anyone to speak of her,” Gerda explained. “But I saved this—because he was your favorite.
paras.zh: 他还禁止任何人提起她，“格尔达解释，”可这只我留下了——因为他曾是你的最爱。

paras.en: I’m sorry I kept him hidden from you all these years.
paras.zh: 抱歉，这些年我一直把他藏着，没给你。

paras.en: But it’s high time you had him back.” Tears misted my eyes as I gazed down at the raggedy stuffed animal, memories now pouring back into me as if a dam had burst.
paras.zh: 可现在，你早该把他拿回来了。“我低头望着这只破旧的毛绒玩偶，眼眶泛起泪雾，记忆如决堤般涌回心头。

paras.en: All those years I’d kept locked away after being shamed by my father for weeping when my mother left.
paras.zh: 那些年，我因母亲离去时落泪而遭父亲羞辱，从此把记忆锁了起来。

paras.en: But now I remembered.
paras.zh: 可此刻，我想起来了。

paras.en: The way she’d get on the floor and play with me, even if it was unbecoming of a queen.
paras.zh: 记得她会趴到地上陪我玩，哪怕那有失王后的体统。

paras.en: The way she’d tickle me until I couldn’t stop laughing.
paras.zh: 记得她挠我痒痒，直到我笑个不停。

paras.en: The great games of hide-and-go-seek through the castle.
paras.zh: 记得我们在城堡里玩的那一场场盛大捉迷藏。

paras.en: Happy memories of our time together.
paras.zh: 那些与她共度的快乐时光。

paras.en: Before it had all screeched to a halt.
paras.zh: 在一切戛然而止之前。

paras.en: What would she think if she saw me now, at the crossroads of the same decision she’d once been forced to make?
paras.zh: 若她看见此刻的我，站在她当年被迫做出同样抉择的十字路口，会怎么想？

paras.en: She wouldn’t want me to marry a princess for the good of the realm.
paras.zh: 她不会愿我为王国之利去娶一位公主。

paras.en: She’d want me to marry Iduna.
paras.zh: 她会要我娶伊杜娜。

paras.en: Because I loved Iduna.
paras.zh: 因为我爱伊杜娜。

paras.en: Iduna made me happy.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜让我快乐。

paras.en: Iduna made me whole.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜让我完整。

paras.en: With Iduna I would be a better man.
paras.zh: 有伊杜娜在，我会成为更好的人。

paras.en: A better king.
paras.zh: 更好的国王。

paras.en: And now nothing was standing in my way.
paras.zh: 而如今，再没有什么能挡住我的路。

paras.en: “SERIOUSLY, COULD IT BE ANY COLDER?” I muttered as I trudged through the falling snow, map still clutched in my hand.
paras.zh: 说真的，还能更冷一点吗？“我一边嘟囔，一边在落雪中深一脚浅一脚地走着，手里仍攥着那张地图。

paras.en: It had been almost balmy when I slipped out of Arendelle Castle through the secret passage early that morning.
paras.zh: 那天清晨我顺着密道溜出阿伦黛尔城堡时，天气还近乎温和。

paras.en: I knew I was taking a risk, but I had run home to grab a few hours of sleep, change clothes, and grab a few supplies.
paras.zh: 我明知这是在冒险，却还是跑回家睡了几个时辰，换了身衣服，又抓了些补给。

paras.en: And with the harsh turn the weather had taken, I was glad I did.
paras.zh: 如今天气骤然变坏，我真庆幸自己那么做了。

paras.en: The wind howled through the trees, and snow fell in thick clumps.
paras.zh: 风在林间呼啸，雪成团成团地砸下。

paras.en: It was only a dusting at first, but now it was at least a foot deep.
paras.zh: 起初只是薄薄一层，如今却起码有一尺来深。

paras.en: With no signs of stopping anytime soon.
paras.zh: 而且丝毫没有要停的意思。

paras.en: I knew I should probably turn around.
paras.zh: 我知道，也许该掉头回去。

paras.en: Go back to the village and wait it out.
paras.zh: 回村子去，等风雪过去。

paras.en: But I was on a mission.
paras.zh: 可我身负使命。

paras.en: And I was afraid if I abandoned it now, I would never get the courage to try again.
paras.zh: 我怕若此刻放弃，便再也没勇气重来一次。

paras.en: I pushed on, through what was now looking to be a very intense blizzard.
paras.zh: 我继续前行，闯入眼下这场来势汹汹的暴风雪。

paras.en: Worse still, I was on foot.
paras.zh: 更糟的是，我是步行。

paras.en: Last time we’d journeyed here, Agnarr and I had ridden horses up the steep, winding trails.
paras.zh: 上回我们来这儿，我和安格瑞是骑马沿着陡峭蜿蜒的小径上来的。

paras.en: But I hadn’t dared ask anyone to loan me one, afraid it would bring up too many questions, and I didn’t want to risk being caught borrowing one without permission. “Argh!” I stumbled over a boulder that was completely obscured by the snow.
paras.zh: 可我不敢向人借马，怕招来太多盘问，也不愿冒险被人发现擅自借走。”啊！“我被一块完全被雪盖住的大石绊了个趔趄。

paras.en: Flailing, I tried to keep my balance but ended up falling face-first into a large drift.
paras.zh: 我胡乱挥舞手臂想稳住身子，却一头栽进一大堆雪里。

paras.en: I scrambled to my feet, attempting to brush the snow away, but the flakes were heavy, wet, clinging to my neck and cloak and soaking me to the bone.
paras.zh: 我手忙脚乱地爬起，想拍掉身上的雪，可雪又沉又湿，粘在脖子和斗篷上，把我浸得透心凉。

paras.en: I shivered, beginning to get scared.
paras.zh: 我打着寒颤，开始害怕起来。

paras.en: This storm was no joke, and even with my outdoor skills, I was no match for its power.
paras.zh: 这风暴绝非儿戏，即便我有些野外本事，也绝非它威力的对手。

paras.en: Looking back the way I’d come, I realized I’d already traveled too far to turn around.
paras.zh: 回头望向来路，我才发觉已走得太远，无法折返。

paras.en: In fact, Arendelle Castle was so far below at this point that it looked like a toy.
paras.zh: 事实上，此刻阿伦黛尔城堡已在脚下很远，远远望去像个玩具。

paras.en: The ships in the fjord’s harbor were ant-sized.
paras.zh: 峡湾港口里的船只小得像蚂蚁。

paras.en: Would I even make it back down the hill in these icy conditions?
paras.zh: 在这冰天雪地里，我还能不能下得去这座山？

paras.en: My teeth chattered.
paras.zh: 我牙齿直打颤。

paras.en: Looking at my hands, I realized they had a strange blue tinge.
paras.zh: 低头看自己的手，我才发现它们泛着一种奇怪的青蓝色。

paras.en: The wind whipped at my cloak, snapping it against my legs so hard it hurt.
paras.zh: 风抽打着我的斗篷，狠狠拍在腿上，疼得我直咧嘴。

paras.en: I needed to get under cover—fast.
paras.zh: 我得赶紧找个遮蔽处——快。

paras.en: Or I wouldn’t make it through the day.
paras.zh: 否则我撑不过今天。

paras.en: I drew in a breath, my Northuldra instincts kicking in as I scanned the mountainside for shelter.
paras.zh: 我深吸一口气，北地人的本能苏醒，目光扫过山坡，寻找庇护之所。

paras.en: I could try to build one out of fallen trees, but that would take too long.
paras.zh: 我可以试着用倒木搭一个，可那样太费时。

paras.en: What I really needed was a small cave or at least an outcropping of some sort to protect me from the wind and snow.
paras.zh: 我真正需要的是一个小洞穴，或至少某种能挡风遮雪的岩壁。

paras.en: Nothing but whiteness surrounded me.
paras.zh: 四周除了白茫茫一片，什么也没有。

paras.en: My heart pounded with fear.
paras.zh: 我心头狂跳，满是恐惧。

paras.en: What was I doing out here?
paras.zh: 我跑到这荒山野岭来做什么？

paras.en: All alone, not having told anyone where I’d gone.
paras.zh: 孤身一人，没告诉任何人我去向何方。

paras.en: If I died out here, which seemed more likely by the moment, no one would ever find my body.
paras.zh: 若我就此冻死在这里——这似乎每过一刻便更可能——没人会找到我的尸体。

paras.en: It would be impossible before spring.
paras.zh: 在春天到来前，根本不可能。

paras.en: And the wolves would have taken care of me long before that.
paras.zh: 而早在那之前，狼群便已把我收拾干净。

paras.en: Once someone noticed I was gone, they’d probably assume I’d fled the kingdom.
paras.zh: 一旦有人发现我不见了，大概会以为我逃离了王国。

paras.en: Or maybe they’d wonder if one of the masked attackers had kidnapped me.
paras.zh: 或者，他们会不会疑心是被某个戴面具的袭击者掳走了？

paras.en: In any case, I’d never be heard from again.
paras.zh: 无论如何，我将从此杳无音讯。

paras.en: What would Agnarr think when he realized I was gone?
paras.zh: 安格瑞发现我不见了，会怎么想？

paras.en: I had told him I was leaving and never coming back.
paras.zh: 我告诉过他，我要走，永不回来。

paras.en: But he’d lost so many people in his life…I hated the idea of him suffering over the loss of yet another.
paras.zh: 可他一生已失去太多人……我厌恶这念头：他要为又一个人的离去而痛苦。

paras.en: The wind whipped up in a large gust, almost knocking me On a last impulse, I lifted my voice in song.
paras.zh: 风猛地刮起一阵大旋风，几乎将我掀倒。最后一股冲动下，我扬声唱了起来。

paras.en: That was what I told the children I did when I was scared, after all, and I couldn’t remember ever being as scared as this—except maybe the day of the dam celebration when the spirits rose up in anger.
paras.zh: 毕竟我告诉过孩子们，害怕时就这样唱；而我不记得自己何时这样怕过——或许除了水坝庆典那天，精灵们怒而崛起之时。

paras.en: But I had sung that day, too, calling Gale to my side to help me.
paras.zh: 可那天我也唱了，呼唤风灵来到我身边助我。

paras.en: Gale had always helped me when I was a child, to get out of whatever scrape I’d gotten myself into.
paras.zh: 小时候，无论我惹上什么麻烦，风灵总会出手帮我脱身。

paras.en: Of course, I hadn’t seen Gale in years; for all I knew, the spirit had been trapped in the mist like everyone else.
paras.zh: 当然，我已多年未见风灵；据我所知，它或许也和众人一样，被困在了迷雾之中。

paras.en: But something inside me still told me to try. “Ah ah ah ah…” “Ah ah ah ah.” And yet, still I sang.
paras.zh: 可心底仍有声音叫我试试。”啊——啊——啊——啊……“”啊——啊——啊——啊。“可我还是唱着。

paras.en: What choice did I have?
paras.zh: 我还有别的选择吗？

paras.en: What else could I do? “Ah ah ah ah.” I collapsed into the snow, unable to move.
paras.zh: 我还能做什么？”啊——啊——啊——啊。“我瘫倒在雪地里，动弹不得。

paras.en: A great tiredness came over me.
paras.zh: 一股巨大的倦意袭来。

paras.en: Maybe I could rest here.
paras.zh: 也许我能在这儿歇歇。

paras.en: Just for a moment… I closed my eyes and let the darkness in.
paras.zh: 就一会儿……我闭上眼，任黑暗将自己吞没。

paras.en: Ah ah ah ah… What was that?
paras.zh: 啊——啊——啊……那是什么声音？

paras.en: My eyes flew open at the sudden sound.
paras.zh: 突来的声响让我猛地睁眼。

paras.en: I scrambled to my feet, weak and confused.
paras.zh: 我虚弱又茫然地挣扎起身。

paras.en: I looked around, suddenly spotting a strange little whirlwind a few feet away.
paras.zh: 我环顾四周，忽然看见几步之外有个奇怪的小旋风。

paras.en: Leaves were dancing above the snow.
paras.zh: 雪花之上，几片叶子在翩翩起舞。

paras.en: Where had they come from?
paras.zh: 它们从哪儿来？

paras.en: The trees were bare and the ground was covered with snow.
paras.zh: 树木光秃秃的，地面覆着雪。

paras.en: I rubbed my eyes, thinking at first it must be a hallucination.
paras.zh: 我揉揉眼，起初以为那定是幻觉。

paras.en: But no, the leaves were still dancing when I pulled my hands away.
paras.zh: 可没有，我把手移开时，叶子仍在舞动。

paras.en: I opened my mouth, senseless hope rising in my chest. “Gale?” I whispered.
paras.zh: 我张开嘴，胸中升起一丝没来由的希望。”风灵？“我轻声唤道。

paras.en: The leaves whipped away, up the mountain.
paras.zh: 叶子倏地卷走，朝山上去了。

paras.en: They stopped for a moment, swirling in a circle, as if waiting for me to follow, With a surge of adrenaline, I started to climb.
paras.zh: 它们停了片刻，打着旋，仿佛在等我跟上。一股肾上腺素涌起，我开始了攀爬。

paras.en: I didn’t know if it was really Gale or merely an illusion brought on by the cold.
paras.zh: 我不知那真是风灵，还是严寒诱发的幻象。

paras.en: But a moment later I stumbled across a small rocky cave cut into the hillside.
paras.zh: 可片刻之后，我撞见了一个凿在山腰的小岩洞。

paras.en: My heart lifted.
paras.zh: 我的心为之一振。

paras.en: I rushed into the cave, ducking under the low-hanging entrance.
paras.zh: 我冲进洞里，低头钻过低矮的洞口。

paras.en: The storm howled angrily outside, but inside, the cave was dry.
paras.zh: 洞外风暴怒号，洞内却干爽。

paras.en: I drew a shaky breath, still shivering like crazy and soaking wet, but it was better than being out there.
paras.zh: 我颤巍巍地吸了口气，仍冷得发抖、浑身湿透，但总比待在外头强。

paras.en: If I was smart, I might have a chance.
paras.zh: 若我够清醒，或许还有一线生机。

paras.en: Forcing my stiffened limbs onto hands and knees, I searched the cave for wood.
paras.zh: 我强撑着僵直的四肢，手脚并用地在洞里翻找木柴。

paras.en: There wasn’t a lot, but I did find a few stray pieces.
paras.zh: 不多，但我到底寻着几块零碎。

paras.en: Pulling my flint from my pocket, I shakily tried to light a fire, near the entrance to ensure proper ventilation.
paras.zh: 我从兜里掏出火石，颤着手想点堆火，位置选在洞口以确保通风。

paras.en: I missed the first few tries, my hands too freezing to properly strike the stones together.
paras.zh: 头几下都落空，我的手冻得几乎敲不响石头。

paras.en: My despair rose.
paras.zh: 绝望涌上心头。

paras.en: Then an idea struck me.
paras.zh: 接着，一个念头闪过。

paras.en: I looked out the mouth of the cave. “Bruni?” I called softly for the Fire Spirit.
paras.zh: 我望向洞口：”火灵？“我轻声唤那火之精灵。

paras.en: If Gale had found its way here, maybe Bruni could, too. “I could use a little help.” I hadn’t asked the spirits for anything in years.
paras.zh: 若风灵能寻到这里，火灵也许也行。”我需要些帮忙。“多年来，我从未向精灵们祈求过什么。

paras.en: I’d tried to do it all on my own.
paras.zh: 我一向想凭一己之力撑过去。

paras.en: And I’d been successful for the most part.
paras.zh: 大体上也算顺利。

paras.en: For years I’d stood on my own two feet.
paras.zh: 多少年，我靠自己的双脚站立。

paras.en: Made my own way.
paras.zh: 走自己的路。

paras.en: But, I realized, it wasn’t shameful to ask for help when you truly needed it.
paras.zh: 可我意识到，真正需要时开口求助，并不丢人。

paras.en: And I needed it that day.
paras.zh: 而那天，我正需要。

paras.en: I struck the flint once more.
paras.zh: 我再次敲击火石。

paras.en: This time, I was able to make a spark.
paras.zh: 这一次，迸出了火星。

paras.en: I didn’t know whether it was by my own hands or if Bruni had intervened, but the leaves caught the spark, igniting.
paras.zh: 我不清楚那是凭我自己的手，还是火灵暗中相助，总之叶子接住了火星，燃了起来。

paras.en: I blew on them gently until those flames spread to the wood.
paras.zh: 我轻轻吹气，直到火苗蔓延到木柴上。

paras.en: I held my hands over the small fire gratefully, warming them until my skin felt as though it were covered in small pinpricks, a sign the cold was retreating.
paras.zh: 我感激地将双手伸向小火堆取暖，直到皮肤像被细针轻刺——那是寒意退去的好兆头。

paras.en: My eyelids felt heavy, and I no longer struggled to keep my eyes open as I had one last thought: maybe, just maybe, I would live through this day after all.
paras.zh: 眼皮沉得厉害，我不再强撑着睁眼，脑海中浮起最后一个念头：也许，只是也许，我终究能熬过这一天。

paras.en: I AM A NEWBORN BABY.
paras.zh: 我是个初生的婴孩。

paras.en: My father cradles me in his arms in our small tent.
paras.zh: 父亲在小帐篷里将我轻轻抱在怀中。

paras.en: My mother is near; I can smell her warm, earthy scent.
paras.zh: 母亲就在近旁；我能闻到她身上温暖的、带着泥土气息的味道。

paras.en: She’s carefully finishing up knitting a berry-colored shawl while humming the familiar Ahtohallan lullaby.
paras.zh: 她正仔细织完一条莓色披肩，一边哼着那首熟悉的阿托哈兰摇篮曲。

paras.en: She will give me this shawl when she is finished.
paras.zh: 织完后，她便要把这条披肩送给我。

paras.en: It will change the course of my life, forever.
paras.zh: 它将永远改变我生命的轨迹。

paras.en: The entrance to our tent parts.
paras.zh: 帐篷的门帘向两边分开。

paras.en: A village elder ducks inside and sits down with my parents.
paras.zh: 一位村中长老弓身进帐，在父母身旁坐下。

paras.en: He is old, the oldest of our family, and he has lived long and seen many things.
paras.zh: 他年事已高，是族中最年长的，阅历丰厚，见多识广。

paras.en: My father smiles at him and greets him with respect.
paras.zh: 父亲朝他微笑，恭敬地相迎。

paras.en: The elder nods solemnly and lays a hand on my forehead.
paras.zh: 长老庄重地点头，将手轻轻按在我的额头。

paras.en: His fingers are rough, calloused, but gentle. “You may be small,” he says in a deep voice, “but you are already one of us.
paras.zh: 他的手指粗糙、布满厚茧，却很温柔。“你虽还小，”他用低沉的声音说，“却已是我们中的一员。

paras.en: A blessed child of the sun.
paras.zh: 太阳庇佑的孩子。

paras.en: As such, the spirits will always be with you.
paras.zh: 因此，精灵将永远与你同在。

paras.en: They will protect you.
paras.zh: 他们会守护你。

paras.en: They will keep you safe.” My mother and father exchange warm smiles. “But you must do your part,” he adds, “to be worthy of the spirits’ gifts.
paras.zh: 他们会使你平安。”父母交换了一个温暖的微笑。“可你也须尽自己的本分，”他补充道，“才配得上精灵的馈赠。

paras.en: To respect the land we walk on.
paras.zh: 敬重我们脚下的土地。

paras.en: To listen to nature Then he smiles, his watery blue eyes crinkling at the corners. “But for now, little one, all you have to be is yourself.
paras.zh: 聆听自然。”接着他笑了，那双水蓝的眼在眼角起了皱。“可眼下嘛，小家伙，你只需做你自己。

paras.en: Your very adorable self,” he adds, winking at my mother.
paras.zh: 做那个可爱至极的你，”他朝母亲挤了挤眼，补了一句。

paras.en: My parents beam with pride.
paras.zh: 父母骄傲地眉开眼笑。

paras.en: The elder says goodbye, exiting the hut.
paras.zh: 长老道别后，走出帐篷。

paras.en: My mother sets down her knitting.
paras.zh: 母亲放下手中的针线。

paras.en: The shawl that has taken her weeks is finally done.
paras.zh: 那条耗去她数周的披肩，终于完工。

paras.en: She inches closer to my father and me, cuddling up against us.
paras.zh: 她一点点挪近父亲和我，依偎过来。

paras.en: She takes the shawl that she has filled with love at every stitch and wraps it carefully around my body until I feel warm and snug and secure. “My sweet girl,” she murmurs, gently stroking my nose with her finger.
paras.zh: 她拿起那条一针一线都注满爱的披肩，小心裹住我的身子，直到我觉得温暖、妥帖而安稳。“我的甜心，”她低语，用指尖轻轻蹭我的鼻子。

paras.en: It tickles a little but also makes me sleepy. “May the spirits always protect you.
paras.zh: 那有点痒，却也让我犯困。“愿精灵永远守护你。

paras.en: And may you grow to do great things.” I am a small child.
paras.zh: 愿你长大，成就不凡。”我是个小孩子了。

paras.en: No more than five years old.
paras.zh: 不过五岁。

paras.en: I’m huddled in my family’s tent, now terrified and alone, hiding under the same berry-colored shawl my mother made for me when I was a newborn.
paras.zh: 我蜷缩在自家的帐篷里，惊恐而孤单，躲在那条母亲为我出生时织的莓色披肩下。

paras.en: My mother and father instructed me to stay here, hidden, as they led would-be invaders from our encampment.
paras.zh: 父母嘱咐我藏在这里别动，随即引开来犯之敌，离开营地。

paras.en: They would come back, they promised.
paras.zh: 他们承诺，一定会回来。

paras.en: They haven’t come back.
paras.zh: 他们却没有回来。

paras.en: Light suddenly pours in from outside.
paras.zh: 忽然，外面透进一道光。

paras.en: I shrink in fear, trying to make myself as small as possible under the cover of the shawl, as a stranger steps into the tent.
paras.zh: 我吓得缩成一团，躲在披肩下尽量把自己缩到最小，这时一个陌生人迈进了帐篷。

paras.en: She looks around, her eyes searching.
paras.zh: 她四下张望，目光搜寻着什么。

paras.en: I can’t help emitting a small squeak of terror as she inches closer.
paras.zh: 她越走越近，我忍不住发出一声恐惧的轻叫。

paras.en: She freezes at the sound.
paras.zh: 她闻声僵住。

paras.en: I cower in fear as she reaches down, lifts up the shawl, and discovers me hiding underneath.
paras.zh: 我畏缩着，看她俯身掀开披肩，发现了躲在下面的我。

paras.en: She gasps in surprise; then her face softens.
paras.zh: 她惊讶地倒吸一口气，随即神色柔和下来。

paras.en: She drops to her knees and pulls me into her arms.
paras.zh: 她跪下来，将我揽入怀中。

paras.en: I should be frightened, but “Sweet little girl,” she whispers, “are you here all alone?” I let out a small sob.
paras.zh: 我本该害怕，可——“乖小孩，”她低声问，“就你一个人在这儿吗？”我发出一声小小的啜泣。

paras.en: The first one I’ve dared since my parents disappeared. “They told me to hide,” I explain in a wobbly voice, pulling the shawl around me and hugging it tight. “They said bad men were coming.
paras.zh: 那是父母失踪后，我头一回敢哭出声。“他们叫我躲起来，”我声音发颤地解释，把披肩拢紧、紧紧抱住，“说坏人要来了。

paras.en: But that I would be safe.” “You are safe,” she assures me.
paras.zh: 但说我会平安。”“你很安全，”她向我保证。

paras.en: She carries me out of the tent.
paras.zh: 她把我抱出帐篷。

paras.en: More people are outside, milling about.
paras.zh: 外头还有更多人，来回走动着。

paras.en: They are dressed like my family—but they are all strangers to me.
paras.zh: 他们衣着和我族人类似——可全是我不认得的生人。

paras.en: Still, they look kind.
paras.zh: 不过，他们看来都很和善。

paras.en: My fear begins to fade. “She was hiding in the tent,” the woman explains when they turn to look at me. “I think she’s the only one left.” Fear once again grips my heart with icy fingers. “Where’s my mother?” I cry. “Where’s my father?
paras.zh: 我的恐惧渐渐消退。“她躲在帐篷里，”那女人见众人转头看我，解释道，“我想，就剩她一个了。”恐惧再次用冰冷的手攥紧我的心。“我妈妈呢？”我喊道，“我爸爸呢？

paras.en: I want to see them—now!” The woman sets me gently on the ground, then kneels before me.
paras.zh: 我要见他们——现在就要！”女人轻轻把我放到地上，然后在我面前跪下。

paras.en: She takes my hands in hers.
paras.zh: 她把我的小手握在掌心。

paras.en: They are coarse, hardened, but her touch is somehow soft. “I am sorry,” she says, seeming genuinely distraught. “I am afraid they are not coming back.” I stare at her in horror. “No!” I shake my head. “You’re wrong!
paras.zh: 那双手粗糙、结实，可她的触碰莫名温柔。“我很抱歉，”她说，真切地显得悲痛，“只怕他们回不来了。”我惊恐地瞪着她：“不！”我摇着头，“你错了！

paras.en: My mother would never leave me!
paras.zh: 我妈妈绝不会丢下我！

paras.en: She promised never to leave me.” I clutch the shawl around my body.
paras.zh: 她答应过绝不离开我。”我把披肩紧紧攥在身上。

paras.en: It still smells like her.
paras.zh: 它还带着她的气味。

paras.en: It still feels like her. “Sometimes we make promises we cannot keep,” the woman says slowly. “But do not fear.
paras.zh: 还像她就在身边。“有时我们许下无法兑现的诺言，”女人缓缓说道，“可别怕。

paras.en: You are not alone, little one.
paras.zh: 你并不孤单，小家伙。

paras.en: You may have lost your family today, but you have also found a new one.” “How?” “The Northuldra are made up of many groups, but in the end, we are one family.
paras.zh: 你今日虽失去了家人，却也寻得了新家。”“怎么讲？”“北地人由许多部族组成，可说到底，我们是一家人。

paras.en: One people under the sun.” She smiles at me. “What’s your name?” I am around nine years old.
paras.zh: 沐浴同一轮阳光下的族人。”她朝我微笑，“你叫什么名字？”我大约九岁了。

paras.en: I’m wandering through our camp, “Go pick on someone your own size!” I scold the Wind Spirit playfully.
paras.zh: 我在营地里闲逛，“去找个和你个头相当的欺负吧！”我顽皮地嗔怪风灵。

paras.en: Gale obliges, sweeping over to tease a young woman as she cooks by the fire.
paras.zh: 风灵从命，卷过去逗弄一位在火边做饭的年轻女子。

paras.en: When she shoos it away, it heads over to an older man, stealing the carrot he’s about to feed to his reindeer.
paras.zh: 她把风灵赶走，它便飘向一位老者，偷走他正要喂给驯鹿的胡萝卜。

paras.en: Then it sweeps under Yelana, who’s busy knitting a shawl.
paras.zh: 接着它刮过耶莲娜身下，她正忙着织披肩。

paras.en: The Wind Spirit steals the nearly finished project straight from her hands and drops it on her head.
paras.zh: 风灵从她手里直接夺过那快织好的活计，扣在她头上。

paras.en: She starts scolding the spirit in a loud voice, but I can tell she’s not really mad.
paras.zh: 她大声嗔怪起精灵来，可我看得出，她并非真生气。

paras.en: My heart swells as I watch them all.
paras.zh: 望着他们，我的心满满涨起暖意。

paras.en: My family.
paras.zh: 我的家人。

paras.en: Maybe not the one I was born to, but the ones who now hold my heart.
paras.zh: 也许不是生我养我的那一族，却是如今占据我心的这一群。

paras.en: I still miss my mother and father, but the pain has dulled over time to a slow ache. “May the spirits protect you,” I remember my mother saying each night as she’d tuck me in. “May you grow to do great things.” I don’t know if I’ll do great things.
paras.zh: 我仍想念父母，可痛楚已随岁月钝化为绵长的酸楚。“愿精灵守护你，”我记起母亲每夜哄我入睡时总这样说，“愿你长大，成就不凡。”我不知自己能否成就不凡。

paras.en: But I have done this thing.
paras.zh: 可我已然做到了这件事。

paras.en: Made a new life, found a new family to call my own.
paras.zh: 重获新生，找到了属于我的新家人。

paras.en: Not of blood this time, but of love, friendship, and respect.
paras.zh: 这一回不是血缘相连，而是以爱、友情与敬重相系。

paras.en: I hug the shawl my mother made me close to my chest.
paras.zh: 我把母亲为我织的披肩紧紧抱在胸前。

paras.en: I think she would be proud of me if she saw me now.
paras.zh: 我想，若她见我现在这般，定会为我骄傲。

paras.en: I think she would be happy that I found a new peace.
paras.zh: 我想，她会为我找到新的安宁而欣慰。

paras.en: Gale swirls around me again, tossing me into the air.
paras.zh: 风灵又绕着我打转，把我抛向半空。

paras.en: This time I don’t scold it or send it away.
paras.zh: 这一回，我没嗔它，也没赶它走。

paras.en: Instead, I let it take me high into the sky, then look down at my family below.
paras.zh: 相反，我任它带我高飞入云，俯瞰下方我的家人。

paras.en: My heart soars.
paras.zh: 我的心也随之飞扬。

paras.en: I am home.
paras.zh: 我回到家了。

paras.en: The peaceful scene in the village shatters.
paras.zh: 村中祥和的景象骤然破碎。

paras.en: The forest has erupted in violence.
paras.zh: 森林里骤然爆发了暴力。

paras.en: Wind, fire, smoke.
paras.zh: 风、火、烟。

paras.en: The ground is buckling under my feet.
paras.zh: 脚下大地在龟裂。

paras.en: I am twelve.
paras.zh: 我十二岁。

paras.en: Agnarr is fourteen.
paras.zh: 安格瑞十四岁。

paras.en: And he’s lying on the I stare down at him, feeling the conflict rise inside of me.
paras.zh: 他躺在……我低头望着他，心底升起一阵挣扎。

paras.en: I should leave him here.
paras.zh: 我该把他留在这儿。

paras.en: Go back to my family.
paras.zh: 回到我的族人身边。

paras.en: The longer I stay, the more I risk not being able to go back.
paras.zh: 我逗留越久，便越可能再也无法返回。

paras.en: The fires are fierce.
paras.zh: 火势凶猛。

paras.en: I may get cut off, trapped.
paras.zh: 我也许会被切断退路，困死此地。

paras.en: I turn to leave.
paras.zh: 我转身欲走。

paras.en: But not before I catch his face again.
paras.zh: 却先又瞥见他的脸。

paras.en: Pale, anguished, eyes fluttering.
paras.zh: 苍白、痛苦，眼皮颤动。

paras.en: A soft moan escapes his lips.
paras.zh: 他唇间逸出一声轻吟。

paras.en: He’s clearly in pain.
paras.zh: 他显然痛苦不堪。

paras.en: And no one else is around to help.
paras.zh: 周遭再无旁人能相助。

paras.en: Only me.
paras.zh: 只有我。

paras.en: My mother’s words once again echo through my head. “May you grow to do great things.” I don’t know if this is a great thing.
paras.zh: 母亲的话再次在脑海回响：“愿你长大，成就不凡。”我不确知这算不算不凡之举。

paras.en: This could be a stupid thing.
paras.zh: 这或许是桩蠢事。

paras.en: A terrible thing.
paras.zh: 一桩坏事。

paras.en: The worst thing I could do.
paras.zh: 我所能做的最糟的事。

paras.en: But then I remember how I felt back in that tent, the day my family was killed.
paras.zh: 可接着，我想起那顶帐篷里、家人遇害那日自己的感受。

paras.en: How scared I was.
paras.zh: 那时我多害怕。

paras.en: How alone.
paras.zh: 多孤单。

paras.en: If I hadn’t been found, I would never have survived.
paras.zh: 若无人发现我，我绝活不下来。

paras.en: Found by someone who didn’t know me.
paras.zh: 被一个不认得我的人所发现。

paras.en: But saved me anyway.
paras.zh: 却仍救了我。

paras.en: As I will save this boy.
paras.zh: 正如我将救下这个男孩。

paras.en: I call out to Gale.
paras.zh: 我呼唤风灵。

paras.en: The Wind Spirit sweeps in, taking Agnarr and me, cradling us gently in its breezy embrace.
paras.zh: 风灵卷袭而来，托起我和安格瑞，以它轻柔的风之怀抱将我们拢住。

paras.en: As it carries us away, I just want to make sure he gets to his people safely.
paras.zh: 它带我们离去时，我只盼他能安然回到他的族人身边。

paras.en: I don’t know if I’ll ever do great things.
paras.zh: 我不确知自己能否成就不凡。

paras.en: But I will do this thing.
paras.zh: 可我会做成这件事。

paras.en: Hopefully it will be enough.
paras.zh: 但愿这就足够。

paras.en: I awoke in the cave later that evening.
paras.zh: 那天傍晚晚些时候，我在洞中醒来。

paras.en: The storm had vanished and the setting sun was painting its last pictures before dipping below the horizon.
paras.zh: 风暴已散，落日正为天际涂抹最后一抹色彩，旋即沉入地平线。

paras.en: I sat up groggily, examining myself for any injuries.
paras.zh: 我迷迷糊糊坐起，检查自己是否受伤。

paras.en: But the spirits had protected me.
paras.zh: 可精灵守护了我。

paras.en: And maybe spoken to me, through my strange dreams.
paras.zh: 或许也借着奇异的梦，与我交谈。

paras.en: I thought over the dreams as I took stock of my surroundings, noticed the still-smoking heap of ash that had been my blazing fire, acknowledged the hunger roiling deep in My mind flashed back to the village elder’s mandate when I was just a newborn baby.
paras.zh: 我回想那些梦，同时打量周遭，注意到曾熊熊燃烧、如今仍冒烟的灰烬堆，也察觉到腹中翻涌的饥饿——脑中闪回我初生那日，村中长老立下的训诫。

paras.en: To seek out peace whenever possible.
paras.zh: 只要可能，便追寻和平。

paras.en: To love even when it might be easier to hate.
paras.zh: 即便憎恨更易，也要选择去爱。

paras.en: I thought of Agnarr lying on the forest floor.
paras.zh: 我想起倒在林间的安格瑞。

paras.en: Me, calling out to Gale.
paras.zh: 想起我，呼唤风灵。

paras.en: A simple act of love, powerful enough to change the very course of the world.
paras.zh: 一个朴素的爱的举动，却有力量改变世界的走向。

paras.en: May you grow to do great things. “Iduna!” I looked up, startled by the sudden voice.
paras.zh: 愿你长大，成就不凡。“伊杜娜！”我抬头，被这突来的声音惊到。

paras.en: To my surprise, I was no longer alone.
paras.zh: 出乎意料，我不再孤身一人。

paras.en: The mountain trolls I’d been seeking.
paras.zh: 我一路找寻的山地地精。

paras.en: They’d found me.
paras.zh: 他们找到了我。

paras.en: BULDA RUSHED OVER TO ME, CHECKING ME out carefully for any injuries.
paras.zh: 布尔达冲到我身边，仔细地上下打量我，看我有没有受伤。

paras.en: Grand Pabbie looked at me solemnly. “You are awake,” he said.
paras.zh: 皮比神情肃穆地看着我。“你醒了。”他说道。

paras.en: I scrunched up my face, confused. “What are you doing here?
paras.zh: 我困惑地皱起脸。“你们怎么会在这里？

paras.en: How did you find me?” “We trolls have our ways.” “Are you all right, dear?” Bulda asked, grabbing my arm and sniffing it. “It’s too cold for a human to be outdoors, even if you are in a cave.
paras.zh: 你是怎么找到我的？”“我们地精自有办法。”“你没事吧，亲爱的？”布尔达抓起我的胳膊闻了闻，问道。“对人类来说，外面太冷了，就算待在山洞里也一样。

paras.en: Where is your husband, dear Agnarr?
paras.zh: 你丈夫呢，亲爱的安格瑞？

paras.en: Does he know you’re out here?” “Do you have any daughters yet?” added the younger female troll curiously.
paras.zh: 他知道你在外面吗？”“你们已经有女儿了吗？”那只年轻些的母地精好奇地补了一句。

paras.en: My heart ached at their words.
paras.zh: 听了他们的话，我的心一阵刺痛。

paras.en: Husband, daughters… “He is not my husband, and there will be no daughters,” I corrected them wearily. “Agnarr is to marry a princess of another kingdom.
paras.zh: 丈夫，女儿……“他不是我丈夫，也不会有女儿，”我疲惫地纠正他们。“安格瑞要娶的是另一个王国的公主。

paras.en: She will have his daughters, not me.” “But the vision said—” “I guess the vision was wrong.
paras.zh: 替他生女儿的是她，不是我。”“可预言说过——”“看来预言错了。

paras.en: Agnarr must marry a princess.” I walked over to a nearby rock and brushed off the snow to settle on its unforgiving surface. “And I am no “Bah!” Bulda blurted out in disdain. “What is a princess, anyway?
paras.zh: 安格瑞必须娶一位公主。”我走到旁边一块石头前，拂去上面的雪，在那硬邦邦的表面上坐下。“而我根本算不上——”“呸！”布尔达不屑地脱口而出。“公主到底算什么？

paras.en: Some silly title made up at birth?
paras.zh: 不过是出生时就封的傻头衔？

paras.en: Because their great-great-ancestor was good with a sword?
paras.zh: 就因为他们老祖宗很会耍剑？

paras.en: Royal or common, your blood runs red.
paras.zh: 无论王室还是平民，流的血都是红的。

paras.en: And it has nothing to do with one’s ability to help one’s people.” “Yeah, well, tell that to the Arendellian council,” I muttered. “They are very set on Agnarr being married for the good of the kingdom.” “And you don’t think you’d be good for the kingdom?” Bulda pressed.
paras.zh: 这跟一个人能不能帮助自己的子民毫无关系。”“是啊，那你跟阿伦黛尔的议会去说吧。”我嘟囔道。“他们一门心思认定，安格瑞为了王国着想必须结婚。”“你觉得自己对王国不好吗？”布尔达追问。

paras.en: I opened my mouth to argue the point, then closed it.
paras.zh: 我张开嘴想反驳，却又闭上了。

paras.en: I thought of my years in Arendelle.
paras.zh: 我想起了自己在阿伦黛尔度过的那些年。

paras.en: Inventing the turning blades on the windmill to help the farmers with their output and better feed their families.
paras.zh: 我发明了风车上的翻转叶片，帮农民提高产量，让他们的家人吃得更好。

paras.en: Reading to the children.
paras.zh: 给孩子们读书。

paras.en: Baking for the elders.
paras.zh: 为长辈们烤点心。

paras.en: They weren’t the grand acts of a king or queen, but they had the potential to be life-changing all the same.
paras.zh: 这些不是国王或王后那种惊天动地的壮举，却同样有可能改变许多人的一生。

paras.en: To bring people together.
paras.zh: 把人们凝聚在一起。

paras.en: To make them feel safe and cared for.
paras.zh: 让他们感到安全、被关怀。

paras.en: Loved.
paras.zh: 被爱。

paras.en: Respected.
paras.zh: 被尊重。

paras.en: But it wasn’t enough.
paras.zh: 但这还不够。

paras.en: I shook my head sadly. “They want to create an alliance between two nations.” “And would not your marriage do that?” Grand Pabbie suddenly broke in.
paras.zh: 我难过地摇了摇头。“他们想在两个国家之间建立联盟。”“难道你的婚姻做不到吗？”皮比突然插话道。

paras.en: He gave me a knowing look. “I know where you come from, Iduna.
paras.zh: 他意味深长地看了我一眼。“我知道你来自哪里，伊杜娜。

paras.en: And I know what you did that day to save Agnarr.
paras.zh: 也知道你那天为了救安格瑞所做的事。

paras.en: An act of love, saving one’s enemy.
paras.zh: 那是一桩出于爱的行为——救了你的敌人。

paras.en: Don’t you think the spirits know the same?” I stared at him, unable to speak.
paras.zh: 你不觉得精灵们也知道这一点吗？”我盯着他，说不出话来。

paras.en: He wasn’t wrong.
paras.zh: 他没说错。

paras.en: I had saved Agnarr in an act of love—even before I fell in love with him.
paras.zh: 我确实是出于爱救了安格瑞——甚至在我爱上他之前。

paras.en: In that moment in the forest, there had been no Northuldra, no Arendelle—just two people who needed one another coming together.
paras.zh: 在森林里那一刻，没有北地人，没有阿伦黛尔——只有两个彼此需要的人走到了一起。

paras.en: Forming an alliance all our own.
paras.zh: 结成了一份只属于我们自己的联盟。

paras.en: And even though the spirits had been angry that day, raging through the forest, Gale had still seen fit to help me save Agnarr’s life.
paras.zh: 即便那天精灵们愤怒地席卷了森林，风灵盖尔仍然愿意帮我救下安格瑞的命。

paras.en: That had to mean something, right? “Also, this may not be written in the Northern Lights or all I giggled.
paras.zh: 这总该意味着什么吧，对不对？”再说了，这也许没写在北极光里……”我不由得咯咯笑了起来。

paras.en: I couldn’t help it.
paras.zh: 我实在忍不住。

paras.en: Grand Pabbie’s eyes settled on me.
paras.zh: 皮比的目光落在我身上。

paras.en: They were kind and knowing. “Iduna, do not sell yourself short.
paras.zh: 那目光温柔而睿智。“伊杜娜，别看轻自己。

paras.en: You are one of the people of the sun.
paras.zh: 你是太阳之子的一员。

paras.en: You are more than worthy of an Arendellian prince.” He smiled, his eyes crinkling at the corners. “You have saved his life.
paras.zh: 你完全配得上一位阿伦黛尔的王子。”他微笑着，眼角泛起皱纹。“你救过他的命。

paras.en: You have won his heart.
paras.zh: 你赢得了他的心。

paras.en: All that’s left now is for you to take his hand.” Tears streamed down my cheeks as I gazed at the trolls. “It’s funny,” I said. “I came up here to ask you to help me forget.
paras.zh: 现在只差你伸出手去牵住他了。”我望着地精们，泪水顺着脸颊滑落。“真可笑，”我说，“我上山来是请你们帮我忘掉。

paras.en: Instead, you helped me remember.” I drew in a breath. “Thank you.” “The pleasure is all ours,” Grand Pabbie assured me. “Now go, Iduna.
paras.zh: 结果你们却帮我记起。”我深吸一口气。“谢谢你们。”“该说谢谢的是我们。”皮比向我保证道。“现在去吧，伊杜娜。

paras.en: Go back to Arendelle.
paras.zh: 回到阿伦黛尔去。

paras.en: And forget about the council.
paras.zh: 把议会抛到脑后。

paras.en: Agnarr is the only one who matters in the end.” “And get that boy to grow out his mustache!” Bulda added. “Tell him Bulda said he’ll look utterly dashing with it!” And with that, the trolls popped back into boulder shape and rolled up the hill to return to the Valley of the Living Rock.
paras.zh: 说到底，安格瑞才是唯一重要的那个人。”“再让那小子把胡子留长！”布尔达补了一句。“告诉他布尔达说的，留起胡子来一定帅极了！”说完，地精们“噗”地变回石头模样，朝山上滚去，回到了活石山谷。

paras.en: I watched them go, feeling a warmth rise inside me, despite the cold weather outside.
paras.zh: 我目送他们离去，尽管外面天寒地冻，心里却涌起一股暖意。

paras.en: It was an almost giddy happiness I could barely contain.
paras.zh: 那是一种几乎让我抑制不住的、飘飘然的喜悦。

paras.en: For so long I’d lived in fear.
paras.zh: 长久以来，我一直活在恐惧之中。

paras.en: Not sure who I was.
paras.zh: 不确定自己是谁。

paras.en: But now I realized that what really mattered was who I could And there was only one way to defeat that fear for good.
paras.zh: 但此刻我明白了，真正重要的，是我能成为谁——而要彻底战胜那份恐惧，只有一个办法。

paras.en: We didn’t need an army to bring peace to Arendelle.
paras.zh: 我们不需要一支军队来给阿伦黛尔带来和平。

paras.en: We only needed love.
paras.zh: 我们只需要爱。

paras.en: And what could be stronger than my love for Agnarr?
paras.zh: 而还有什么，能比我对安格瑞的爱更强大呢？

paras.en: I PRACTICALLY RACED DOWN THE MOUNTAIN, the exhilaration inside me thrumming through my body, propelling me forward.
paras.zh: 我几乎是飞奔下山，内心的狂喜在身体里奔涌，推着我一路向前。

paras.en: Down the pathway, to the lower altitudes, where the snow had already melted except in small, random clumps.
paras.zh: 顺着小路往下，到了海拔较低的地方，那里雪已经化尽，只剩零零星星几小堆。

paras.en: It was hard to believe I’d almost frozen to death on my way up.
paras.zh: 真难相信，我来时差点冻死在半路上。

paras.en: When I neared the town, I looked out over the hillside, smiling at all the windmills spinning contently in the morning breeze.
paras.zh: 临近小镇时，我望向山坡，看着所有风车在晨风中怡然自得地转动，不禁微笑起来。

paras.en: There were so many now; each farm had wanted their own.
paras.zh: 如今风车可真多；每家农场都想要一座属于自己的。

paras.en: And grain production had been up so much this year, we were able to send some by ship to neighboring kingdoms that weren’t so lucky. “Iduna!” a farmer called, waving to me.
paras.zh: 今年粮食产量大增，我们还能用船把一些运往没这么走运的邻国。“伊杜娜！”一位农夫朝我挥手喊道。

paras.en: I waved back, a feeling of joy washing over me. “Hey, Mr.
paras.zh: 我也挥手回应，一股喜悦涌上心头。“嘿，汉

paras.en: Hansen!” I greeted him. “How’s everything going?” “Wonderful!” he declared. “My farm has never produced so much.
paras.zh: 森先生！”我跟他打招呼。“一切都好吗？”“好极了！”他说道。“我的农场从没产出过这么多。

paras.en: And now that we’re not reliant on horses to do all the heavy work in the mill, we’ve started breeding them instead.
paras.zh: 而且现在我们不再靠马来做磨坊里那些重活了，反倒开始繁殖马匹。

paras.en: We’ll have a whole new stable of foals soon, ready to be sold.” As he spoke, a small white colt skittered across the field on spindly legs.
paras.zh: 很快我们就会有一整棚待售的小马驹了。”他说着，一匹白色的小马驹正用细长的腿在地里蹦跳着跑过。

paras.en: I laughed as he darted toward me, then stopped in “Here you go, boy,” I said, stroking him softly.
paras.zh: 我笑起来，看它朝我飞奔而来，又停住——“给你，小家伙。”我轻轻抚摸着它说。

paras.en: As he chomped down on the treat, I looked up at the farmer. “What’s his name?” “We called him Havski,” the farmer replied. “It means handsome.” “He certainly is a handsome boy,” I agreed. “When he’s ready to be sold, will you come to me first?
paras.zh: 它大口嚼着零食，我抬头看向农夫。“它叫什么名字？”“我们叫它哈夫斯基，”农夫回答，“意思是‘英俊’。”“它确实是个英俊的小伙子。”我赞同道。“等它要卖的时候，能先来找我吗？

paras.en: I’ve never had my own horse before.
paras.zh: 我以前从没拥有过自己的马。

paras.en: Maybe it’s time.” “Iduna, you can have him for nothing!” Mr.
paras.zh: 也许是时候了。”“伊杜娜，你白拿去都行！”汉

paras.en: Hansen exclaimed. “After all you’ve done for us, it’s the least I could do.” I grinned, happiness washing over me. “Thank you,” I said.
paras.zh: 森先生大声说。“你为我们做了那么多，这是我起码能做的。”我咧嘴一笑，满心欢喜。“谢谢你。”我说。

paras.en: I knelt down in front of the colt, who was already sniffing my satchel for another carrot. “I’ll see you soon, Kjekk,” I whispered. “And I promise, you’ll have all the carrots you can eat.” I rose and headed down the hill toward Arendelle, feeling proud and content.
paras.zh: 我在小马驹面前单膝跪下，它已经嗅着我的袋子找另一根胡萝卜了。“很快再见，谢克。”我轻声说。“我保证，你会吃到吃不完的胡萝卜。”我站起身，朝山下的阿伦黛尔走去，心里又骄傲又满足。

paras.en: Like the trolls said, what was a princess, anyway?
paras.zh: 就像地精说的，公主到底算什么？

paras.en: Someone who was born lucky.
paras.zh: 不过是生来走运的人。

paras.en: But I had made my own luck over the years.
paras.zh: 可这些年来，运气是我自己挣来的。

paras.en: That had to count for something, right?
paras.zh: 这总该算点什么吧，对不对？

paras.en: Agnarr didn’t want to marry Runa.
paras.zh: 安格瑞不想娶茹娜。

paras.en: He’d made that perfectly clear.
paras.zh: 这一点他说得明明白白。

paras.en: He was only trying to do what was right, what was expected of him as king.
paras.zh: 他只是想做正确的事，做身为国王该做的事。

paras.en: Now all I had to do was prove that we could be right together, too.
paras.zh: 现在我要做的，就是证明我们俩在一起也同样是对的。

paras.en: Just in an unexpected way.
paras.zh: 只是以出乎意料的方式。

paras.en: It might not be easy to convince the council.
paras.zh: 说服议会也许不容易。

paras.en: But between the two of us, our love had the power to move mountains.
paras.zh: 但我们两个人的爱，有移山的力量。

paras.en: Surely we could move a few minds to our side as well.
paras.zh: 总也能把几个人的心拉到我们这边来。

paras.en: And King Nicholas and his daughter could go back home where they belonged.
paras.zh: 那样，尼古拉斯国王和他的女儿就能回到他们该回的家。

paras.en: Speaking of King Nicholas…I stopped, realizing I was not far from the Vassar encampment just outside of town, colorful pavilions dotting the clearing, their country’s flags waving from the tops.
paras.zh: 说到尼古拉斯国王……我停下脚步，意识到自己离镇外瓦萨尔人的营地已经不远了，空地上点缀着彩色的帐篷，他们国家的旗帜在顶端飘扬。

paras.en: I knew King Nicholas had refused Peterssen’s offer to stay within the city walls, saying as soldiers they were used to fresh air, not the confines of city life.
paras.zh: 我知道尼古拉斯国王拒绝了彼得森让他驻进城墙里的提议，说身为士兵，他们习惯新鲜空气，而不是城市的束缚。

paras.en: At the moment, the place I frowned.
paras.zh: 此刻，那地方让我皱起了眉头。

paras.en: That was the only downside to all of this.
paras.zh: 这是整件事唯一的坏处。

paras.en: Agnarr would have to publicly reject Runa if he were to marry me.
paras.zh: 安格瑞若要娶我，就必须在众人面前拒绝茹娜。

paras.en: That would be an insult to King Nicholas.
paras.zh: 那是对尼古拉斯国王的侮辱。

paras.en: Would he withdraw his patrols?
paras.zh: 他会撤走他的巡逻队吗？

paras.en: Would that lead to an escalation of attacks?
paras.zh: 那会导致袭击升级吗？

paras.en: Would it put people’s lives in danger?
paras.zh: 会让人们的生命陷入危险吗？

paras.en: We had been so fortunate Vassar had come to town with their army just as things were getting bad….
paras.zh: 在局势刚变糟的时候，瓦萨尔人带着军队来到镇上，我们一直那么幸运……

paras.en: Fortunate.
paras.zh: 幸运。

paras.en: Or… I frowned, a sudden disturbing thought prickling at the back of my brain.
paras.zh: 还是说……我皱起眉头，一个令人不安的念头在脑后悄悄刺痛了我。

paras.en: I glanced over at the camp, my eyes locking on a clothesline just outside the perimeter, filled with Vassar cloaks, hanging out to dry…just like I had found cloaks at the Arendelle camp that fateful day in the Enchanted Forest.
paras.zh: 我瞥向营地，目光锁在营地外围一条晾衣绳上——上面挂满了瓦萨尔人的斗篷，正晾着滴水……就像我在魔法森林里那命中注定的一天，在阿伦黛尔营地发现的那些斗篷一样。

paras.en: I shook my head.
paras.zh: 我摇了摇头。

paras.en: No.
paras.zh: 不。

paras.en: This was crazy.
paras.zh: 这太疯了。

paras.en: Absolutely crazy.
paras.zh: 简直疯到家了。

paras.en: And likely dangerous, too.
paras.zh: 而且很可能也很危险。

paras.en: But then… I set my jaw, tiptoeing over to the clothesline. “For Arendelle,” I whispered to myself.
paras.zh: 可接着……我咬紧牙关，踮着脚走向晾衣绳。“为了阿伦黛尔。”我对自己低声说。

paras.en: “YOUR MAJESTY!
paras.zh: “陛下！

paras.en: THE PEOPLE ARE WAITING for you.
paras.zh: 大家在等您了。

paras.en: You’re not even dressed?” Kai clucked disapprovingly. “Why, it’s almost noon!” I groaned, yanking the covers over my head, wishing he’d go away.
paras.zh: 您连衣服都没穿好？”凯不满地咂着嘴。“天哪，都快中午了！”我呻吟着，把被子拉过头顶，巴不得他走开。

paras.en: The last thing I wanted that day was to face the council, as well as the people of Arendelle at the weekly petitioner session.
paras.zh: 那天我最不想做的事，就是面对议会，还有每周请愿会上阿伦黛尔的百姓。

paras.en: Not to mention have to look at the smug face of King Nicholas and have him try to foist his daughter on me once again.
paras.zh: 更别提还得看着尼古拉斯国王那副得意洋洋的脸，让他再一次把女儿硬塞给我。

paras.en: Ever since learning from Kai and Gerda that there was no official rule requiring me to marry a princess, I’d been trying to figure out a way to get Runa and her father to go home.
paras.zh: 自从从凯和格尔达那儿得知，并没有哪条官方法规要求我必须娶公主，我就一直在想办法让茹娜和她父亲回家去。

paras.en: Once they were out of the way, I could make my case for Iduna.
paras.zh: 只要他们一走，我就能为伊杜娜说话了。

paras.en: It was going to be difficult, seeing as I had no idea where Iduna had gone.
paras.zh: 这可不容易，因为我根本不知道伊杜娜去了哪里。

paras.en: No one had seen her since the night of the explosion.
paras.zh: 自从爆炸那晚之后，就再没人见过她。

paras.en: To make matters worse, King Nicholas wouldn’t take the hint to go home.
paras.zh: 更糟的是，尼古拉斯国王根本不接“该回家”的暗示。

paras.en: If anything, he’d dug in even deeper since the night of the ball, assigning his soldiers to patrol the streets and guard the castle.
paras.zh: 不仅如此，自舞会那晚起，他反而扎得更深了，派出士兵巡逻街道、守卫城堡。

paras.en: And Peterssen had let him get away with it all, because it meant Arendelle would be safer.
paras.zh: 而彼得森由着他胡来，因为这意味着阿伦黛尔会更安全。

paras.en: That was the number one In other words, my love life would have to wait. “Your Majesty—” “I’m up, I’m up!” I grumbled, forcing myself out of bed.
paras.zh: 这是头等大事——换句话说，我的感情生活只能往后放。“陛下——”“我起来了，起来了！”我嘟囔着，强迫自己下床。

paras.en: Kai helped me with my green suit, then assisted with flattening my bed head hair.
paras.zh: 凯帮我穿好绿色礼服，又帮我把乱蓬蓬的头发抚平。

paras.en: I usually protested that I could do this myself, but today I didn’t have the energy to argue. “Your Majesty seems out of sorts,” Kai remarked casually, though his eyes held a knowing look.
paras.zh: 我平时会抗议说这些我自己能做，可今天没力气争辩了。“陛下看起来有些心不在焉。”凯随意地说道，可眼里却透着了然。

paras.en: He escorted me to the mirror and had me sit down on a stool in front of it as he worked a brush through my hair.
paras.zh: 他陪我走到镜子前，让我在镜前的小凳上坐下，拿起梳子梳理我的头发。

paras.en: I sighed. “Arendelle has become like a prison, thanks to King Nicholas.
paras.zh: 我叹了口气。“多亏了尼古拉斯国王，阿伦黛尔简直成了监狱。

paras.en: Did you know he even canceled the annual holiday ringing of the yule bell?” “Yes.
paras.zh: 你知道吗，他连每年节日里敲响圣诞钟的传统都取消了？”“是的。

paras.en: I was sorry to hear that.
paras.zh: 我很遗憾听到这个消息。

paras.en: I always enjoyed that tradition,” Kai agreed politely, dabbing sticky goop onto my hair to smooth any unruly flyaways into place. “But if it is for Arendelle’s safety, I suppose it is for the best.” “I suppose,” I muttered, sick of hearing that line.
paras.zh: 我一直很喜欢那个传统。”凯礼貌地附和，一边往我头发上抹着黏糊糊的发膏，把不听话的碎发抚平。“但只要是为了阿伦黛尔的安全，我想那也是最好的安排。”“我想是吧。”我嘟囔道，听这句台词听得都腻了。

paras.en: It wasn’t as if I didn’t care about keeping Arendelle safe.
paras.zh: 我又不是不在乎阿伦黛尔的安全。

paras.en: I did.
paras.zh: 我在乎。

paras.en: It was just something about the way King Nicholas went about it all….
paras.zh: 只是尼古拉斯国王那一整套做派，让我心里有点……

paras.en: Suddenly, Gerda burst into the room so abruptly that I jumped and Kai dropped his brush. “Now see here, Gerda!” he scolded. “You really need to learn to knock before—” “She’s back!” Gerda interrupted, a huge grin on her face.
paras.zh: 突然，格尔达猛地冲进房间，吓我一跳，凯的梳子也掉在了地上。“你看看，格尔达！”他斥责道，“你真得学着先敲门再——”“她回来了！”格尔达打断他，脸上绽开大大的笑容。

paras.en: I stood up, knocking over my stool. “Who?” I asked, hardly daring to breathe.
paras.zh: 我站了起来，撞翻了凳子。“谁？”我问，几乎不敢呼吸。

paras.en: But even as I asked the question, I knew there was only one person whose reappearance could get Gerda this excited.
paras.zh: 可即便我问出声，也知道只有一个人再次出现，才能让格尔达这么激动。

paras.en: Her eyes gleamed with happiness. “Lady Iduna,” she said, clutching her hands to her chest. “She’s here.
paras.zh: 她眼里闪着喜悦。“伊杜娜小姐，”她双手贴在胸前说道，“她在这里。

paras.en: In the Great Hall.
paras.zh: 在大会堂里。

paras.en: The First Great Hall.
paras.zh: 第一大会堂。

paras.en: Not the Second Great Hall.
paras.zh: 不是第二大会堂。

paras.en: I saw her waiting with the other petitioners.” My heart thumped.
paras.zh: 我看见她和别的请愿者一起等着。”我的心怦怦直跳。

paras.en: Kai reached down for his comb, but I waved him away. “My hair’s fine,” I told him. “I’ve got to go!” I dashed to the door.
paras.zh: 凯弯腰去捡梳子，我挥手让他别管。“我头发没事，”我告诉他，“我得走了！”我冲向门口。

paras.en: When I reached it, I turned around, “Thank you,” I said simply, even though I wanted to say so much more.
paras.zh: 到了门口，我转过身，“谢谢你。”我简简单单地说，尽管想说的远不止这些。

paras.en: Gerda shooed me away with her hands. “Are you still here?” she scolded. “Go and get that girl of yours!” “And this time,” Kai added with a toothy grin, “don’t let her go.” I bolted from my bedroom and ran down the hall, down the stairs, toward the Great Hall, where the meeting would be taking place.
paras.zh: 格尔达用手把我赶走。“你还在这儿？”她斥道，“去把你的姑娘追回来！”“这次啊，”凯咧嘴一笑，补了一句，“可别再让她跑了。”我从卧室冲出去，跑过走廊，跑下楼梯，朝即将开会的大会堂奔去。

paras.en: When I arrived, there was already a line out the door.
paras.zh: 我到的时候，门口已经排起了长队。

paras.en: Not surprising, I supposed, given the recent attacks.
paras.zh: 考虑到最近的袭击，这也并不意外。

paras.en: I wondered how many of them knew about the ballroom explosion.
paras.zh: 我猜想着他们中有多少知道舞厅爆炸的事。

paras.en: News traveled fast in our kingdom. “Those monsters!” a short, thin woman in an embroidered gray dress was saying to King Nicholas as I made my way to the front of the room, trying to scan it for a glimpse of Iduna.
paras.zh: 在我们的王国里，消息传得飞快。“那些怪物！”一个穿着绣花灰裙、又矮又瘦的女人正对尼古拉斯国王说着，而我则朝房间前面挤去，想扫一眼找找伊杜娜的身影。

paras.en: The woman thrust a half-eaten cabbage at the regent. “Is there no low they will not stoop to?
paras.zh: 那女人把半棵吃剩的白菜杵到摄政王面前。“还有什么事是他们做不出来的？

paras.en: They came to my house!
paras.zh: 他们跑到我家来！

paras.en: Ate half my vegetable garden!” “Terrible!” King Nicholas declared.
paras.zh: 吃了我半个菜园！”“太可怕了！”尼古拉斯国王宣称。

paras.en: He had evidently found a nice comfy spot right next to Peterssen himself, and his daughter Runa was standing by his side, obedient as ever. “But not surprising.
paras.zh: 他显然在彼得森身旁找了个舒服的好位置，女儿茹娜则乖乖站在他身边。“但这不意外。

paras.en: The Northuldra are simply notorious for vegetable stealing!” “As are rabbits,” Peterssen interjected, looking weary. “Did you witness the Northuldra doing this, by any chance, Miss Nillson?” “Well, no!” she sputtered. “But of course it was them!
paras.zh: 北地人偷菜可是出了名的！”“兔子也出名啊。”彼得森疲惫地插嘴道，“尼尔森小姐，你碰巧亲眼看见是北地人干的吗？”“呃，没有！”她结巴着说，“可那当然就是他们！

paras.en: They are everywhere.
paras.zh: 他们无处不在。

paras.en: I am quite afraid to close my eyes at night for fear I might be murdered in my sleep!” “And my sheep are now pink Gunnar stepped forward, crossing his arms over his chest. “Forget the sheep and the vegetables.
paras.zh: 我夜里都不敢闭眼，怕睡着了被人谋杀！”“我的羊现在变成粉色了——”贡纳尔双臂交叉在胸前走上前。“别管羊和蔬菜了。

paras.en: The rest of us want to know about the explosion,” he declared. “What are you doing about these attacks?
paras.zh: 我们其他人想知道爆炸的事。”他宣称，“这些袭击你们打算怎么办？

paras.en: How will you stop them?
paras.zh: 你们要怎么阻止？

paras.en: If the monarchy can’t keep its own castle safe, how can we expect it to protect its people?” A roar of agreement rolled through the crowd.
paras.zh: 如果王室连自己的城堡都守不住，我们怎么指望它保护百姓？”人群中爆发出一片赞同的吼声。

paras.en: Everyone started talking at once.
paras.zh: 大家一下子七嘴八舌地说起来。

paras.en: I caught King Nicholas giving his guard a small smirk.
paras.zh: 我瞥见尼古拉斯国王冲他的卫兵微微坏笑了一下。

paras.en: He seemed to be enjoying this way too much for someone who had gone to the trouble of posting his own army around the castle for our protection.
paras.zh: 他似乎太享受这一幕了，可当初正是他不嫌麻烦，在城堡周围布下自己的军队来“保护”我们。

paras.en: I stepped onto the dais, turning to face the crowd. “Silence!” I demanded in my loudest voice. “I will not have this chaos in my court!
paras.zh: 我踏上高台，转身面对人群。“安静！”我用最大的声音命令道，“在我的宫廷里，绝不允许这种混乱！

paras.en: If you cannot be respectful, then I will dismiss you all.” The crowd grumbled a little but eventually settled.
paras.zh: 如果你们不能保持礼貌，我就把你们全都赶出去。”人群嘟囔了几句，最终安静下来。

paras.en: Peterssen gave me an encouraging nod.
paras.zh: 彼得森朝我鼓励地点了点头。

paras.en: I cleared my throat and continued. “Now, has anyone actually seen an individual or group committing these crimes?” I asked, still half scanning the room for Iduna.
paras.zh: 我清了清嗓子，继续道。“那么，有没有人真的看见某个人或某伙人犯下这些罪行？”我问道，目光仍有一半在房间里搜寻伊杜娜。

paras.en: Where was she? “Does anyone have a real idea of who might be behind them?” I held up my hand to stop them before they could speak. “I’m talking facts.
paras.zh: 她在哪里？“有谁真正知道背后是谁干的吗？”我抬起手，在他们开口前拦住。“我说的是事实。

paras.en: Firsthand accounts.
paras.zh: 第一手的证词。

paras.en: I don’t wish to hear suspicious stories of monsters hiding under children’s beds.
paras.zh: 我不爱听那些怪物藏在孩子床底下的捕风捉影。

paras.en: We’re better than that.” I waited.
paras.zh: 我们比那强。”我等着。

paras.en: Everyone was glancing uneasily at each other.
paras.zh: 大家都惴惴不安地互相张望。

paras.en: But no one stepped forward.
paras.zh: 可没有人站出来。

paras.en: Until a lone voice came from the back of the room. “I do.” Everyone wore a look of surprise—me included—as Iduna finally stepped out from the crowd.
paras.zh: 直到房间后面传来一个孤独的声音。“我知道。”所有人——包括我在内——都露出惊讶的神色，伊杜娜终于从人群中走了出来。

paras.en: She was wearing a simple woolen dress, with half of her beautiful glossy hair up in a braid, while the rest cascaded down her back.
paras.zh: 她穿着一条朴素的羊毛裙，美丽油亮的头发一半编成辫子，其余的瀑布般垂在背后。

paras.en: Iduna wove her way to the front of the room and stopped before the dais.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜穿过人群走到房间前面，在高台前停下。

paras.en: She was carrying a sack, whose contents she proceeded to dump out onto the table.
paras.zh: 她拎着一个麻袋，把里面的东西一股脑倒在桌上。

paras.en: To my surprise, nails, chunks of metal, and what “What is the meaning of this?” King Nicholas sputtered. “This is a castle of high regard, young lady!
paras.zh: 出乎我意料的是，袋里是钉子、金属块，还有——“这算什么意思？”尼古拉斯国王结巴着说，“这是一座受人敬重的城堡，姑娘！

paras.en: Not your garbage dump!” “You asked for evidence of criminal activity,” she explained. “I have found supplies used for making explosive devices.
paras.zh: 不是你的垃圾堆！”“是你要犯罪活动的证据。”她解释道，“我找到了制造爆炸装置用的材料。

paras.en: Likely the same type that were used in the castle the night of the ball.” King Nicholas frowned, suddenly looking uneasy. “What did I tell you?” He turned to the crowd. “This is why you need a strong army to protect Arendelle!
paras.zh: 很可能和舞会那晚城堡里用的是同一类。”尼古拉斯国王皱起眉，突然显得不安。“我早说过什么？”他转向人群。“这就是为什么你们需要一支强兵来保护阿伦黛尔！

paras.en: The Northuldra will stop at nothing to destroy your way of life!” Iduna’s eyes locked on to the king’s face.
paras.zh: 北地人会不择手段毁掉你们的生活方式！”伊杜娜的目光锁在国王脸上。

paras.en: There was a fierceness in her gaze that I recognized all too well.
paras.zh: 那目光里的锐利，我再熟悉不过。

paras.en: What was she doing? “I didn’t say they were from the Northuldra,” she said. “But who else could they be from?” King Nicholas sputtered. “We all know the Northuldra have been attacking your people for months now!” “Have they, though?” Iduna asked, her voice calm. “Or could it be someone else?” She arched an eyebrow at the king. “Someone with a vested interest in Arendelle needing an army to protect it, perhaps?” Her tone was neutral, but her eyes blazed. “What are you saying, Iduna?” Peterssen demanded.
paras.zh: 她在做什么？“我没说这是北地人干的。”她说，“可还能是谁干的呢？”尼古拉斯国王结巴道。“我们都知道北地人这几个月来一直在袭击你们的百姓！”“是吗？”伊杜娜平静地问，“还是说，可能是别人？”她冲国王挑了挑眉。“也许是某个在阿伦黛尔‘需要军队保护’这件事上有既得利益的人？”她的语气平淡，眼睛却燃着怒火。“你到底在说什么，伊杜娜？”彼得森厉声问道。

paras.en: Iduna looked at me. “Your Majesty, I found these in the tents of the Vassar soldiers,” she said. “Along with these.” She reached into the sack again and pulled out several all-too-familiar-looking sun masks.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜看向我。“陛下，我在瓦萨尔士兵的帐篷里发现了这些东西。”她说，“还有这些。”她又把手伸进麻袋，掏出几只再熟悉不过的太阳面具。

paras.en: THE CROWD GASPED.
paras.zh: 人群倒吸一口凉气。

paras.en: EVERYONE STARTED talking at once.
paras.zh: 大家一下子同时说起话来。

paras.en: King Nicholas looked down at the masks, then up at Iduna, his face red and his eyes furious. “What is this?” he responded. “What are you trying to say?
paras.zh: 尼古拉斯国王低头看看面具，又抬头看看伊杜娜，脸涨得通红，眼里怒火中烧。“这是什么？”他反问道，“你想说什么？

paras.en: Who is this girl, anyway?
paras.zh: 这姑娘到底是谁？

paras.en: Some peasant?
paras.zh: 某个乡下丫头？

paras.en: Maybe she’s “Enough!” I boomed, stepping to Iduna’s side.
paras.zh: 说不定她是——“够了！”我一声大喝，走到伊杜娜身边。

paras.en: I reached out and grabbed her hand in mine, squeezing it tight.
paras.zh: 我伸出手，紧紧握住她的手。

paras.en: It was then that I realized she was trembling.
paras.zh: 直到这时我才发现，她在发抖。

paras.en: This had taken all her courage, opening herself to risk like this.
paras.zh: 要做到这样把自己置于险境，她用尽了全部勇气。

paras.en: But she had done it.
paras.zh: 可她做到了。

paras.en: And maybe saved us all in the process. “You will not speak to Lady Iduna like that,” I declared. “And you will be taken under custody until we can determine the truth.
paras.zh: 而且说不定还救了我们所有人。“你不许那样跟伊杜娜小姐说话。”我宣告道，“在查明真相之前，你会被拘押起来。

paras.en: Lord Peterssen, please call Sorenson with his lie test.
paras.zh: 彼得森大人，请叫索伦森带上他的测谎术来。

paras.en: We will be in need of his services.” “There’s no need for that.” Suddenly, Runa stepped forward.
paras.zh: 我们会用上他的本事。”“不必了。”突然，茹娜走上前。

paras.en: Her face was pale and her voice was shaking, but her posture was rigid and determined. “You don’t have to interrogate,” she said in a low voice.
paras.zh: 她脸色苍白，声音发颤，但身姿僵硬而坚决。“你们不必审问了。”她低声说。

paras.en: Another gasp went through the crowd.
paras.zh: 人群中又是一阵倒吸凉气。

paras.en: The king’s face turned purple. “What are you saying, Runa?” he demanded. “Clearly my daughter does not feel well at the moment and—” “I’m not going to lie for you anymore, Father,” Runa spit out. “This is your doing, not mine.
paras.zh: 国王的脸涨成紫色。“你在说什么，茹娜？”他厉声道，“显然我女儿这会儿身体不舒服，而且——”“我不会再替你撒谎了，父亲。”茹娜脱口而出，“这是你干的，不是我。

paras.en: You didn’t trust me enough to win the prince on my own merits.
paras.zh: 你根本不信我凭自己的本事能赢得王子。

paras.en: You had to have insurance—to make Arendelle appear weak so that you could look strong.
paras.zh: 你非要留一手后路——让阿伦黛尔显得软弱，好显得你自己强大。

paras.en: Ready to step in and help.
paras.zh: 随时准备插手帮忙。

paras.en: Too bad it was you King Nicholas’s face twisted in rage. “Why, you traitor!” He lunged for his daughter.
paras.zh: 可惜动手的正是你——“尼古拉斯国王的脸因狂怒而扭曲。“你这个叛徒！”他扑向女儿。

paras.en: But the Arendelle guards jumped in, quickly blocking his path. “Take him away,” I ordered.
paras.zh: 可阿伦黛尔的卫兵冲上前，迅速挡住他的去路。“把他带走。”我命令道。

paras.en: The guards began dragging him to the exit while the people of Arendelle booed and hissed at him. “You need me!” he cried, trying to fight off the guards, to no avail. “You are making a big mistake!” Mistake or not, King Nicholas was soon gone.
