paras.zh: 卫兵开始把他拖向出口，阿伦黛尔的百姓对他嘘声一片、喝着倒彩。“你们需要我！”他喊着，想挣脱卫兵，却徒劳无功。“你们犯大错了！”不管是不是错，尼古拉斯国王很快就被带走了。

paras.en: I turned to Runa, who was still standing there, shoulders back, head held high.
paras.zh: 我转向茹娜，她还站在那里，肩背挺直，昂着头。

paras.en: A regal princess to the very end.
paras.zh: 一直到最后，都是一位高贵的公主。

paras.en: When she caught me watching her, she gave me a sad smile. “You may have them take me away as well,” she said. “I won’t put up a fight.” The remaining guards started to move in her direction.
paras.zh: 当她发现我在看她，朝我露出一丝苦笑。“你们也可以把我一起带走。”她说，“我不会反抗。”剩下的卫兵开始朝她走去。

paras.en: But I stepped forward. “No,” I said. “Runa, I won’t make you pay for your father’s crimes.
paras.zh: 可我上前一步。“不，”我说，“茹娜，我不会让你替你父亲的罪行付出代价。

paras.en: You stood up to him and told me the truth.
paras.zh: 你站出来反抗他，告诉了我真相。

paras.en: Runa beamed up at me. “I’m sure we can work something out.” And with that, she headed from the throne room.
paras.zh: 茹娜冲我眉开眼笑。“我相信我们能想出办法的。”说完，她走出了王座厅。

paras.en: I watched her go, thinking of my mother.
paras.zh: 我目送她离开，想起了我的母亲。

paras.en: Hopefully now, with her father gone, Runa would be able to find her own happiness.
paras.zh: 但愿现在父亲走了，茹娜能找到属于自己的幸福。

paras.en: Her own true love.
paras.zh: 属于自己的真爱。

paras.en: I turned to the people of Arendelle, who were watching the scene unfold with utter bemusement and fascination.
paras.zh: 我转向阿伦黛尔的百姓，他们正又惊又奇地看着这一幕展开。

paras.en: I knew it would be all over town the second they left the castle. “Thank you all for your patience,” I said. “We will continue to work on this new…development.
paras.zh: 我知道他们一离开城堡，消息就会传遍全城。“谢谢大家耐心等待。”我说，“我们会继续处理这个新的……进展。

paras.en: But I believe it is safe to say we won’t have to worry about men in sun masks again.” “What about pink sheep?” demanded Aksel, holding up his lamb.
paras.zh: 但我想可以放心地说，我们不必再担心戴太阳面具的人了。”“那粉色的羊怎么办？”阿克塞尔举着他的羊羔质问道。

paras.en: I groaned. “Let’s table that till next week, shall we?” “Or…” Iduna suddenly interjected, a wicked gleam in her sky-blue eyes, “we could all start wearing pink shawls?
paras.zh: 我呻吟一声。“那个留到下周再说，好吗？”“或者……”伊杜娜突然插嘴，天蓝色的眼睛里闪过顽皮的光，“我们干脆都开始披粉色披肩？

paras.en: I mean, who here would love a beautiful bright pink shawl?” The hands of pretty much all the women in the room shot up at once.
paras.zh: 我是说，在座有谁会不喜欢一条漂亮亮粉色的披肩呢？”屋里几乎所有女人的手一下子齐刷刷举了起来。

paras.en: Aksel’s eyes lit up.
paras.zh: 阿克塞尔的眼睛亮了。

paras.en: He hugged the pink lamb tight to his chest, looking proud. “Pink shawls it is!” he cried. “Purple, too!
paras.zh: 他把粉色羊羔紧紧搂在胸前，一脸骄傲。“那就粉色披肩！”他喊道，“还要紫色！

paras.en: I’ll start taking orders immediately.” The crowd surrounded him, everyone talking at once.
paras.zh: 我马上就开始接订单。”人群围住他，大家一下子说起话来。

paras.en: Iduna smiled triumphantly.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜得意地笑了。

paras.en: I watched her, my heart in my throat.
paras.zh: 我望着她，心提到了嗓子眼。

paras.en: She hadn’t been gone long, but I’d missed her with my entire being.
paras.zh: 她离开不久，可我用整个身心想念她。

paras.en: And there was no way I was letting her go ever again. “We should talk,” I whispered.
paras.zh: 我绝不会再让她离开。“我们得谈谈。”我低声说。

paras.en: She nodded. “We should.” “Library or tree?” “Tree.” She grinned mischievously, as though she had “Now?” She glanced over at Peterssen, who was watching from a few feet away. “No,” she said. “You’re needed here.
paras.zh: 她点点头。“是该谈谈。”“书房还是老树？”“老树。”她调皮地咧嘴一笑，像是有什么——“现在？”她瞥了眼几步外看着这边的彼得森。“不行，”她说，“这里还需要你。

paras.en: Finish up and find me tonight.
paras.zh: 把这里收尾，今晚来找我。

paras.en: Eight o’clock sharp.” She briefly touched her hand to mine on her way out the door. “Don’t be late.”
paras.zh: 八点整。”出门时，她用手轻轻碰了碰我的手。“别迟到。”

paras.en: “PRINCE AGNARR!” Iduna’s voice rang out right as I heard the clocks chiming 8:00 p.m. on the dot.
paras.zh: “安格瑞王子！”就在钟表正好敲响晚八点的瞬间，伊杜娜的声音响了起来。

paras.en: I walked into the courtyard, toward our favorite tree.
paras.zh: 我走进庭院，朝我们最爱的那棵树走去。

paras.en: It’d been a long day, full of council meetings where everyone tried to figure out what to do with the disgraced King Nicholas.
paras.zh: 这一天真漫长，满是议会会议，大家都在琢磨怎么处置丢尽脸面的尼古拉斯国王。

paras.en: But in the back of my mind, I hadn’t been able to stop thinking of Iduna.
paras.zh: 可在我心底，始终止不住地想着伊杜娜。

paras.en: Was she going to give me the second chance I’d prayed for?
paras.zh: 她会给我祈盼已久的第二次机会吗？

paras.en: I stopped short, doing a double take.
paras.zh: 我猛地停住，又惊又疑地回头再看。

paras.en: She wasn’t in the tree.
paras.zh: 她不在树上。

paras.en: Instead, she was standing on our bench.
paras.zh: 相反，她站在我们的长椅上。

paras.en: Flanked by two…reindeer?
paras.zh: 身边还有两只……驯鹿？

paras.en: As I watched, dumbfounded, the reindeer on the ground at her right pressed his hoof down on a small wooden box, setting free a swarm of purple butterflies.
paras.zh: 我目瞪口呆地看着，她右边地上的那只驯鹿用蹄子踩下一个小木盒，放出一群紫色蝴蝶。

paras.en: At the same time, the reindeer on the ground at her left released a cloud of those little helicopter seeds, which whirled through the air like brown smoke.
paras.zh: 与此同时，她左边地上的那只驯鹿放出一团小直升种子，像棕色烟雾一样在空中打着旋儿。

paras.en: Iduna lifted her chin, standing tall and proud as she addressed me in a clear voice. “Prince Agnarr of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜扬起下巴，站得挺拔而骄傲，用清亮的声音对我说。“阿伦黛尔的安格瑞王子。

paras.en: My kind, handsome, fearless I stared at her in disbelief.
paras.zh: 我善良、英俊、无畏的——”我难以置信地盯着她。

paras.en: Iduna grinned sheepishly, a giggle escaping her lips.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜不好意思地咧嘴一笑，从唇间漏出一声轻笑。

paras.en: She jumped off the bench and approached me, reaching into her pocket and pulling out something small.
paras.zh: 她跳下长椅走向我，从口袋里掏出个小东西。

paras.en: It took me a moment before I realized what it was.
paras.zh: 我过了一会儿才认出那是什么。

paras.en: The love spoon.
paras.zh: 是那把爱情木勺。

paras.en: The one I thought I’d lost forever. “You finished it,” I whispered. “Yup.” She beamed. “Though I had a little help.
paras.zh: 那把我以为永远失去了的。“你做完了。”我轻声说。“嗯。”她眉开眼笑，“不过我得了点帮忙。

paras.en: Who knew Olina was a master woodworker as well as a master chef?” I ran to her and pulled her into my arms.
paras.zh: 谁知道奥莉娜既是大厨又是木工高手？”我跑到她面前，将她搂进怀里。

paras.en: The reindeer surrounded us, snorting and huffing, but I shooed them away, holding her close, until her face was inches from mine.
paras.zh: 驯鹿把我们围住，喷着鼻息，可我把它们赶开，紧紧抱着她，直到她的脸离我只有几寸。

paras.en: She looked at me with those big blue eyes of hers.
paras.zh: 她用那双蓝色的大眼睛望着我。

paras.en: Eyes I could lose myself in.
paras.zh: 那双我能沉溺其中的眼睛。

paras.en: And find myself in, too. “I love you,” I whispered. “I love you, too,” she replied, her eyes teeming with affection.
paras.zh: 也能在其中找回自己的眼睛。“我爱你。”我轻声说。“我也爱你。”她回答，眼里满是柔情。

paras.en: Then she added, “Look, Agnarr, I’ve been giving this a lot of thought.
paras.zh: 接着她又说：“听我说，安格瑞，我想这件事想了很久。

paras.en: You were right all along.
paras.zh: 你一直都是对的。

paras.en: We love each other.
paras.zh: 我们彼此相爱。

paras.en: That’s all that matters in the end.
paras.zh: 说到底，这才是最重要的。

paras.en: We can go to the council and make our case.
paras.zh: 我们可以去议会，把我们的理由说清楚。

paras.en: Or go to the people, even.
paras.zh: 或者甚至直接去找百姓。

paras.en: What can Peterssen say if everyone in Arendelle is behind us?
paras.zh: 如果全阿伦黛尔都站在我们这边，彼得森还能说什么？

paras.en: They’re the ones who matter, right?
paras.zh: 他们才是真正重要的，对不对？

paras.en: Not just the council.” She smiled bravely at me. “You said our love was worth fighting for.
paras.zh: 不只是议会。”她朝我勇敢地一笑。“你说过，我们的爱值得去争取。

paras.en: Well, I’m ready to fight.
paras.zh: 嗯，我已经准备好去争取了。

paras.en: I want you to marry me.” I raised my hand, brushing her soft cheek with my fingers. “And I definitely can “What?” Her eyes clouded with confusion. “I don’t understand.” “You’ll never believe this, but it turns out there’s no official rule in the Arendelle lawbooks saying I have to marry royalty.” I grinned broadly. “You can thank Kai and Gerda for that.” “Really?” Her eyes grew wide. “There’s no rule?” My hand snaked around her neck. “None at all,” I whispered.
paras.zh: 我要你娶我。”我抬起手，用指尖拂过她柔软的脸颊。“而我绝对可以——”“什么？”她眼里浮起困惑的迷雾。“我不明白。”“你绝不会相信，但事实证明，阿伦黛尔的法典里根本没有哪条规定我必须娶王室成员。”我咧嘴大笑。“这你得谢凯和格尔达。”“真的？”她睁大眼睛。“没有规定？”我的手绕到她颈后。“一条也没有。”我低声说。

paras.en: Our lips met.
paras.zh: 我们的唇相触。

paras.en: My hands dropped to her hips and pulled her flush against me.
paras.zh: 我的手滑到她的腰间，把她紧紧贴向我。

paras.en: I could feel every curve of her body as her mouth moved hungrily against mine.
paras.zh: 当她的唇饥渴地压上我的，我能感到她身体的每一处曲线。

paras.en: I pulled away for a moment to rest my forehead against hers. “Are you sure this is what you want?” I asked in a low voice. “You’ve seen what my life is like—and I’m not even king yet.” “I know,” she said solemnly. “And I don’t expect it to be easy.
paras.zh: 我稍稍退开，把额头抵在她的额上。“你确定这就是你想要的？”我低声问，“你见过我的生活是什么样——而且我还没当上国王呢。”“我知道，”她郑重地说，“我也不指望会轻松。

paras.en: Don’t get me wrong; there’s a part of me that wants to ask you to just run away with me.
paras.zh: 别误会；我心底有部分是想求你干脆跟我私奔。

paras.en: To live a simple life of farmers in a field.
paras.zh: 去过田园里农夫般简单的生活。

paras.en: But Arendelle needs you as much as I do.
paras.zh: 但阿伦黛尔和你一样需要你。

paras.en: So I’m okay with sharing.” “I think Arendelle needs you Her blue eyes sparkled. “Seems unlikely, Your Majesty.” “I am glad to hear it, my queen.”
paras.zh: 所以，我愿意分享。”“我觉得阿伦黛尔需要你——”她的蓝眼睛闪着光。“这怕是不太可能，陛下。”“听到这话我很高兴，我的王后。”

paras.en: “IDUNA?
paras.zh: “伊杜娜？

paras.en: MAY I SPEAK WITH YOU FOR A moment?” Peterssen’s voice cut through the happy daze I was in as I gazed out at the royal gardens turning colors in the waning light of early dusk.
paras.zh: 我能跟你谈一会儿吗？”彼得森的声音穿透了我幸福迷离的状态——我正望着皇家花园在暮色渐暗的余光里变换着颜色。

paras.en: Agnarr had been pulled away by another group of well-wishers, and I had been basking in the glow of our love and all that had happened over the past two days to cement it.
paras.zh: 安格瑞被另一群道贺的人拉走了，而我正沉浸在爱的光辉里，回味着过去两天发生的一切如何让这份爱更加坚定。

paras.en: When Agnarr had stated his case to the council the day following my proposal, they didn’t put up much of a fight.
paras.zh: 在我求婚后的第二天，安格瑞向议会陈述理由时，他们没怎么反对。

paras.en: I think they were embarrassed by the publicity of the botched courtship with Runa and her scheming father.
paras.zh: 我想他们是因茹娜和她那图谋不轨的父亲那段闹得满城风雨的失败求亲而觉得难堪。

paras.en: And when we soon after announced our betrothal to the people of Arendelle, they were thrilled at the idea. “The castle may have its head in the sand,” declared Halima as Agnarr and I shared the good news over a cup of tea at Hudson’s Hearth. “But we have all been paying attention.
paras.zh: 不久后我们向阿伦黛尔百姓宣布订婚时，他们为此兴奋不已。“城堡里的人也许把头埋在沙里，”哈丽玛在哈德逊壁炉茶馆里和安格瑞、我边喝茶边分享喜讯时说道，“可我们大家一直都看在眼里。

paras.en: And I can’t think of anyone who would be better for our prince—and our people—than our sweet, talented Iduna.
paras.zh: 我想不出有谁比我们甜美又有才华的伊杜娜更适合我们的王子——和我们的百姓。

paras.en: Mattias would be so proud if he was here.” Agnarr had beamed in pride.
paras.zh: 如果马蒂亚斯在这儿，他一定会骄傲极了。”安格瑞自豪得满脸放光。

paras.en: Mattias might well have been.
paras.zh: 马蒂亚斯多半也会如此。

paras.en: But the look on Peterssen’s face now told me perhaps the sentiment was not universal.
paras.zh: 可此刻彼得森脸上的神情告诉我，这种情绪也许并非人人都有。

paras.en: I followed him to a quiet alcove, a small feeling of unease gnawing at my stomach.
paras.zh: 我跟着他走到一处安静的凹室，一丝不安在胃里啃噬。

paras.en: When we were out of earshot, he turned to face me, a grim look on his face. “I am happy you and the prince have found each other,” Peterssen began. “I truly am.
paras.zh: 等听不见别人了，他转过身面对我，神情严峻。“我很高兴你和王子走到了一起，”彼得森开口道，“我是真心的。

paras.en: And I know you will make a wonderful pair.
paras.zh: 而且我知道你们会是一对佳偶。

paras.en: You will make a wonderful queen.
paras.zh: 你会是一位出色的王后。

paras.en: But, Iduna, if you go through with this, I must warn you: it’s more important than ever for you to keep your past a secret—at least for now.” “But why?” I asked, aggrieved.
paras.zh: 但是，伊杜娜，如果你执意要走下去，我必须警告你：把你的过去保密，比以往任何时候都更重要——至少现在如此。”“可为什么？”我委屈地问。

paras.en: I had actually been planning to come clean to Agnarr about everything later that evening, when it was just the two of us.
paras.zh: 其实我原本打算当晚晚些时候，只有我们俩的时候，把一切都向安格瑞坦白。

paras.en: I wanted to move forward with him with no more secrets between us, only openness and truth.
paras.zh: 我想和他一起向前走，彼此之间再无秘密，只有坦荡与真情。

paras.en: Peterssen looked troubled. “You just implicated the king of Vassar in violent acts against Arendelle while basically vindicating the Northuldra.
paras.zh: 彼得森面露难色。“你刚刚把瓦萨尔国王牵扯进袭击阿伦黛尔的暴力行径，同时又基本洗清了北地人的嫌疑。

paras.en: If the people ever learn that you’re secretly Northuldra, don’t you think they might wonder if you and Runa worked together and schemed to plant the evidence in the Vassar tents in order to exonerate your own people and win the prince for yourself?” I stared at him, crushed by his words.
paras.zh: 如果百姓有朝一日知道你秘密是北地人，你不觉得他们会怀疑你和茹娜串通一气，设局把证据塞进瓦萨尔人的帐篷，好为你的同胞洗脱罪名、把王子揽到自己手里吗？”我盯着他，被他的话击垮了。

paras.en: I knew what he said made sense.
paras.zh: 我知道他说得有道理。

paras.en: But why did I also have to keep it from Agnarr?
paras.zh: 可为什么连安格瑞我也要瞒？

paras.en: Surely he wouldn’t jump to such conclusions. “Agnarr loves me,” I insisted. “He would keep my secret.” “Are you so sure?” Peterssen asked quietly. “For I never knew anyone who hated secrets as much as our prince.
paras.zh: 他总不至于一下子下这种结论。“安格瑞爱你，”我坚持道，“他会替我保密的。”“你这么确定？”彼得森轻声问，“因为我从没见过谁比我们的王子更恨秘密。

paras.en: And if the truth were to come out—whether by his own mouth, in a misguided attempt to defend your honor, or by some other means—it would be disastrous to his rule.
paras.zh: 而一旦真相败露——无论是他为了维护你的名誉而失言，还是通过别的什么途径——都会给他的统治带来灾难。

paras.en: People learning he willingly married you, knowing you were the daughter of Arendelle’s enemy, might cost him the throne.
paras.zh: 百姓若知道他明知你是阿伦黛尔敌人的女儿，还心甘情愿娶了你，可能会让他丢掉王位。

paras.en: Better he does not know.
paras.zh: 最好他什么都不知道。

paras.en: Then if something were to happen, he could use his ignorance as a shield. “Vassar is gone,” he continued. “But there are plenty of others who watch carefully for an opportunity to gain such a rich trade route.
paras.zh: 那样万一出事，他还能以‘不知情’为盾。”“瓦萨尔人走了，”他继续说，“但还有的是别人在虎视眈眈，想找机会夺下这么一条富庶的贸易路线。

paras.en: To discover weakness, to plant seeds of discontent and fear.
paras.zh: 他们要找出弱点，播下不满与恐惧的种子。

paras.en: We need a strong king.
paras.zh: 我们需要一位强有力的国王。

paras.en: A king whose rule will never fall under question.
paras.zh: 一位统治永不受质疑的国王。

paras.en: If you care about Arendelle, you Ah, yes.
paras.zh: 如果你在乎阿伦黛尔，你——啊，对了。

paras.en: There it was, the duty to country that was now my obligation as much as it was Agnarr’s.
paras.zh: 这就是对国家的责任，如今它既是安格瑞的义务，也是我的义务。

paras.en: I would not be keeping the secret for myself, or even for the sake of my and Agnarr’s relationship.
paras.zh: 我保守这个秘密，不是为了自己，甚至不是为了我和安格瑞的感情。

paras.en: It would be for Arendelle.
paras.zh: 而是为了阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: And for the Northuldra, too.
paras.zh: 也为了北地人。

paras.en: As queen I would have the power to protect the Northuldra, to finally put to bed the rumors of their supposed magic and misdeeds once and for all.
paras.zh: 身为王后，我将有能力保护北地人，终于能一劳永逸地平息关于他们所谓魔法和罪行的谣言。

paras.en: And if the mist ever were to part, my family and the others could emerge protected, their lands safe.
paras.zh: 而如果迷雾有朝一日散开，我的家人和族人便能受到保护地走出来，他们的土地安然无恙。

paras.en: My voice might seem silent.
paras.zh: 我的声音也许看似沉默。

paras.en: But it would be strong, persistent, and persuasive.
paras.zh: 却会坚定、执着而充满说服力。

paras.en: It would be a powerful one. “Iduna!
paras.zh: 它会很有力量。“伊杜娜！

paras.en: Come over here!” I turned my head, my eyes locking on Agnarr, who was beckoning me back to our well-wishers.
paras.zh: 过来一下！”我转过头，目光锁在安格瑞身上，他正招手让我回到道贺的人群中。

paras.en: Mrs.
paras.zh: 布

paras.en: Blodget was standing next to him, holding the most enormous block of chocolate I had ever seen and grinning happily.
paras.zh: 洛杰特太太站在他身旁，举着我见过最大的一块巧克力，开心地笑着。

paras.en: I gave them a small smile and waved, then turned back to Peterssen. “Very well,” I said, lifting my chin as I fought to keep the tremble from my voice. “I will do as you ask.
paras.zh: 我朝他们微微一笑，挥了挥手，又转回面对彼得森。“好吧，”我说，扬起下巴，努力让声音不颤抖，“我会照你说的做。

paras.en: At least for now.
paras.zh: 至少现在如此。

paras.en: But someday I will tell my story.
paras.zh: 但总有一天，我会说出我的故事。

paras.en: Agnarr will know the whole truth.” And with that, I walked back to the celebration, not waiting for his response.
paras.zh: 安格瑞会知道全部的真相。”说完，我走回庆祝人群，没等他回应。

paras.en: Shoulders back, head held high.
paras.zh: 肩背挺直，昂首阔步。

paras.en: A perfectly poised soon-to-be Arendellian queen.
paras.zh: 一位仪态万方的准阿伦黛尔王后。

paras.en: Conceal, don’t feel.
paras.zh: 隐藏，别去感受。

paras.en: Don’t let it show.
paras.zh: 别让它显露出来。

chapters.title: Chapter Forty-One: Iduna: Six Months Later

paras.en: I STARED AT MYSELF IN THE MIRROR AS Gerda affixed the jeweled silver wedding crown to my head.
paras.zh: 我盯着镜子里的自己，格尔达正把镶宝石的银色婚礼王冠戴到我头上。

paras.en: I was not yet a queen, of course, but the Arendelle wedding tradition sure made me feel like one, along with this sweeping silver gown that cinched at my waist, then billowed out around me like a cloud.
paras.zh: 我当然还没成为王后，但阿伦黛尔的婚俗，加上这条在腰间收束、又像云一样在我周身铺开的银色长裙，确实让我有了王后的感觉。

paras.en: Me, Iduna, Northuldra orphan.
paras.zh: 我，伊杜娜，北地人的孤儿。

paras.en: Soon-to-be queen of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 即将成为阿伦黛尔的王后。

paras.en: It was the stuff of those fairy tales I had read about in the books the Arendellians had brought to the dam.
paras.zh: 这正是那些阿伦黛尔人带到水坝的书里，我所读到的童话情节。

paras.en: Now come to life.
paras.zh: 如今成了真。

paras.en: Who would have thought it? “Are you ready, my dear?” Gerda asked, her eyes shining. “I think it’s time.” I drew in a breath, my heart pounding, as Gerda led me to the chapel inside the castle.
paras.zh: 谁能想到呢？“准备好了吗，亲爱的？”格尔达问道，眼里闪着光。“我想是时候了。”我深吸一口气，心怦怦直跳，格尔达领着我走向城堡里的小教堂。

paras.en: The place was packed, but instead of inviting dignitaries from neighboring kingdoms, we’d filled the vast space with all the townspeople of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 那里挤满了人，但我们没有邀请邻国的显贵，而是让阿伦黛尔所有的镇民填满了这个广阔的空间。

paras.en: They cheered as I entered the room, and I felt my cheeks heat in a blush.
paras.zh: 我走进去时他们欢呼起来，我感到脸颊因羞涩而发烫。

paras.en: The music swelled.
paras.zh: 音乐渐强。

paras.en: I started down the aisle.
paras.zh: 我沿着通道向前走。

paras.en: As I walked, I saw Agnarr standing at the end, dressed in his formal Arendelle But it wasn’t his outfit or his new facial hair that had my heart pumping madly.
paras.zh: 走着走着，我看见安格瑞站在尽头，穿着阿伦黛尔的正式礼服——可让我心跳狂乱的，不是他的礼服，也不是他新留的胡须。

paras.en: It was the nervous smile on his face. “Well, hello, you,” I whispered as I stepped to his side. “Hello yourself,” he whispered back. “You look…incredible, Iduna.” I beamed. “You clean up pretty nice yourself.” He blushed, holding out his arm. “You ready?” he asked softly.
paras.zh: 而是他脸上那局促的微笑。“嘿，你好呀。”我走到他身边，轻声说。“你好呀。”他轻声回道，“你看起来……美得不可思议，伊杜娜。”我眉开眼笑。“你把自己收拾得也挺不错嘛。”他红了脸，伸出手臂。“准备好了？”他柔声问。

paras.en: My heart brimmed over with the look I saw in his eyes.
paras.zh: 我看进他眼里的神色，心都要溢出来了。

paras.en: No doubt.
paras.zh: 没有疑虑。

paras.en: No fear.
paras.zh: 没有恐惧。

paras.en: Just love. “So ready,” I declared.
paras.zh: 只有爱。“完全准备好了。”我宣告。

paras.en: The reception was held in the streets of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 婚宴在阿伦黛尔的街道上举行。

paras.en: The musicians played merry tunes and we danced every dance under the sun, including “the reindeer who had to pee really badly but was stuck in a ballroom”—which had turned out to be a crowd favorite.
paras.zh: 乐师们奏起欢快的曲子，我们跳遍了各式各样的舞，包括那支“急得要尿裤子却被困在舞厅里的驯鹿”——结果它成了最受欢迎的舞。

paras.en: We feasted on an endless array of delicacies, including a traditional wedding kransekake—a tower of sweet bread topped with cheese, cream, and syrup.
paras.zh: 我们享用着各式各样的美食，包括传统的婚礼克拉萨卡蛋糕——一座甜面包塔，顶上铺着奶酪、奶油和糖浆。

paras.en: As a special touch, Mrs.
paras.zh: 作为特别点缀，布

paras.en: Blodget had added two little figures to the top of the tower—to represent Agnarr and me.
paras.zh: 洛杰特太太在塔顶加了两个小像——代表安格瑞和我。

paras.en: They were made of solid chocolate.
paras.zh: 它们是纯巧克力做的。

paras.en: We couldn’t stop smiling through it all, our giddy grins disappearing only for the space of a kiss.
paras.zh: 整个过程我们都笑个不停，只有接吻时才暂且收起傻笑。

paras.en: We were so ridiculously happy to finally be together, out in the open, without fear of getting caught.
paras.zh: 终于能光明正大地在一起、不必担心被撞见，我们幸福得简直荒唐。

paras.en: After years of stolen glances and secret moments, we no longer had to hide our love. “You look so beautiful,” Agnarr told me for probably the fiftieth time since the reception began, taking me into his arms for yet another dance.
paras.zh: 在多年偷瞄和秘密相会之后，我们不必再隐藏爱意。“你真美。”婚宴开始后这大概已是第五十次，安格瑞把我搂进怀里，又跳起一支舞。

paras.en: I could feel the crowd watching us in “I think you might have mentioned that already,” I teased. “Are you sick of hearing it?” “Not at all, Your Majesty.” “Good.
paras.zh: 我能感觉到人群正看着我们——“我想这话你大概已经说过了。”我逗他，“听腻了吗？”“一点也没有，陛下。”“好。

paras.en: Because I plan to repeat it every day of your life from this point on… Your Majesty I groaned. “Are you really going to start calling me that?” “Absolutely,” he declared. “If only to get back at you for all the times you’ve Your Majesty I sighed in mock dismay. “Great.
paras.zh: 因为从今往后，我打算你生命里的每一天都重复这句话……陛下”我呻吟一声。“你真要开始这么叫我了？”“绝对要，”他宣称，“就当是报复你那些次——”“陛下”我故作沮丧地叹气。“妙极了。

paras.en: I’ve created a monster.” “No.” His eyes grew soft. “You’ve created a king.” He reached up, cupping my face in his hands, meeting my eyes with that green gaze I would never in a million years tire of. “I could never have done this without you, Iduna,” he whispered. “And I want you to continue to be a part of it.
paras.zh: 我造了个怪物。”“不。”他的目光柔和下来。“你造就了一位国王。”他抬起手，用双手捧住我的脸，用那双我永远看不厌的绿色眼睛望着我。“没有你，我绝做不到这些，伊杜娜。”他轻声说，“而我希望你继续成为其中一部分。

paras.en: You’re to be Arendelle’s queen now.
paras.zh: 如今你就是阿伦黛尔的王后了。

paras.en: And I want you to rule with me.
paras.zh: 而我要你与我共同统治。

paras.en: Equally.
paras.zh: 平等地。

paras.en: Side by side.” “I love you,” I whispered, feeling a little overwhelmed by his words.
paras.zh: 并肩携手。”“我爱你。”我轻声说，被他的话微微触动。

paras.en: Me, a wife, a queen.
paras.zh: 我，一个妻子，一位王后。

paras.en: I’d been preparing for this moment for a long time now, but it still seemed so crazy to have it actually come to pass.
paras.zh: 为了这一刻我准备了很久，可它真的发生时，仍显得那么不真实。

paras.en: Olina bustled toward us then, clapping her hands briskly. “What are you waiting for, Your Majesties?” she asked with a twinkle in her eyes. “It’s time for the kransekake!” I smiled shyly at Agnarr, remembering how the chef had explained the Arendellian wedding tradition to me.
paras.zh: 这时奥莉娜匆匆朝我们走来，利落地拍着手。“两位陛下还在等什么？”她眼睛闪着光问道，“到克拉萨卡蛋糕时间了！”我羞涩地对安格瑞一笑，想起厨师曾向我解释过阿伦黛尔的婚俗。

paras.en: Together, we’d lift up the top ring of the kransekake, and however many lower rings were lifted with it would predict how many children we’d have together. “Are you ready?” Agnarr asked, giving me a wink.
paras.zh: 我们一起抬起克拉萨卡蛋糕最上面的一圈，跟着被带起来的下面几圈有多少，就预示我们将来会有几个孩子。“准备好了吗？”安格瑞朝我眨眨眼问。

paras.en: I giggled, suddenly a little nervous. “I think so?” Together we reached down and slowly lifted the top ring of the cake as pretty much all of Arendelle watched, holding their collective breath.
paras.zh: 我咯咯笑着，突然有点紧张。“我想是吧？”我们同时俯身，缓缓抬起蛋糕最上面的一圈，几乎全阿伦黛尔的人都屏息看着。

paras.en: The top ring rose.
paras.zh: 顶圈升了起来。

paras.en: Two lower rings came right along with it.
paras.zh: 两圈下面的也跟着一起来了。

paras.en: The crowd burst into cheers and applause.
paras.zh: 人群爆发出欢呼和掌声。

paras.en: Olina clapped her hands and jumped up and down.
paras.zh: 奥莉娜拍着手又蹦又跳。

paras.en: Kai and Gerda hugged each “Two rings!” Olina declared. “That means two blessed royal children!” I turned back to Agnarr. “Wow,” I said in a low voice, meant only for him. “Guess Grand Pabbie was right.” He nodded, looking like a proud papa already. “Two children,” he said, his voice hushed with awe. “Two daughters And somehow, at that moment, I knew it to be true.
paras.zh: 凯和格尔达互相拥抱——“两圈！”奥莉娜宣布，“那意味着两个有福的皇室孩子！”我转回看安格瑞。“哇，”我低声说，只说给他听，“看来皮比是对的。”他点点头，已经一副骄傲爸爸的模样。“两个孩子，”他轻声惊叹，“两个女儿——”不知为何，那一刻我确信那就是真的。

chapters.title: Chapter Forty-Two: Iduna: Three Year Later

paras.en: “AND NOW, LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, MAY I present to you your new princess, Elsa of Arendelle!” The roar from the crowd below was almost deafening as I stepped out onto the balcony, cradling my newborn daughter in my arms, her tiny form swathed in a soft blue nightgown that matched her crystal blue eyes.
paras.zh: “现在，女士们先生们，请允许我向你们介绍阿伦黛尔的新公主，艾莎！”当我抱着刚出生的女儿走上阳台时，下面人群的欢呼几乎震耳欲聋——她娇小的身躯裹在柔软的蓝色睡袍里，正好配她水晶般的蓝眼睛。

paras.en: I knew the people were almost as impatient to meet her as I had been.
paras.zh: 我知道百姓几乎和我一样迫不及待想见她。

paras.en: Agnarr stood beside me, placing a hand at the small of my back.
paras.zh: 安格瑞站在我身旁，把手放在我后腰上。

paras.en: He looked down at me, an adoring smile on his face. “Are you ready, my love?” he asked.
paras.zh: 他低头看我，脸上挂着宠溺的笑。“准备好了吗，我的爱？”他问。

paras.en: I nodded, stretching out my arms and passing Elsa to Agnarr.
paras.zh: 我点点头，伸出双臂把艾莎递给安格瑞。

paras.en: He fumbled for a moment—we were both still getting used to handling such a small package—then took her into his arms, holding her up for the crowd to see. “Long live the princess!” shouted Gunnar, the florist.
paras.zh: 他笨手笨脚地接了一下——我们俩都还没习惯抱这么小的包裹——然后才把她抱进怀里，举起来让人群看。“公主万岁！”花匠贡纳尔喊道。

paras.en: Everyone laughed and cheered.
paras.zh: 大家都笑着欢呼。

paras.en: In fact, they were so loud and excited they must have given little Elsa a start, as she began to wail loudly, shaking her tiny fists in dismay.
paras.zh: 事实上，他们又吵又兴奋，准是吓了小艾莎一跳，她开始大声啼哭，懊恼地挥着小拳头。

paras.en: I quickly took her back from Agnarr, surprised to find that for some reason, her skin was suddenly ice cold.
paras.zh: 我赶紧从安格瑞手里把她接回来，惊讶地发现，不知为何，她的皮肤忽然冰凉。

paras.en: My heart stirred with concern.
paras.zh: 我心里涌起担忧。

paras.en: Was “I’m going to take her back inside.” Agnarr nodded and planted a kiss on my forehead before turning to the crowd.
paras.zh: 是——“我带她回屋里去。”安格瑞点点头，在我额头印下一吻，才转向人群。

paras.en: He clapped his hands. “Please help yourself to food and beverages.
paras.zh: 他拍拍手。“请大家随意享用食物和饮料。

paras.en: There is plenty for all.
paras.zh: 人人都有份。

paras.en: Musicians, will you give us a tune?” The band burst into a merry song while the crowd dashed toward the food and drink stations.
paras.zh: 乐师们，来一段曲子好吗？”乐队骤然奏起欢快的歌，人群则冲向食物和饮料摊位。

paras.en: Some started to dance.
paras.zh: 有些人开始跳舞。

paras.en: All were still excitedly chattering about the beautiful baby.
paras.zh: 大家仍兴奋地聊着那个美丽的婴儿。

paras.en: Her sweet mama.
paras.zh: 她甜美的妈妈。

paras.en: Her doting papa.
paras.zh: 她宠她的爸爸。

paras.en: The perfect royal family for Arendelle.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔完美的王室家庭。

paras.en: But I shut out all the noise, concentrating on getting Elsa wrapped back up in my shawl.
paras.zh: 可我屏蔽掉所有喧闹，专心把艾莎重新裹进披肩。

paras.en: She was still wailing, near inconsolable.
paras.zh: 她还在哭，几乎哄不住。

paras.en: Not sure what to do, I gently placed her back in her crib, twirling her little mobile in an attempt to distract her.
paras.zh: 不知怎么办，我轻轻把她放回摇篮，转动她的小吊饰，想分散她的注意。

paras.en: Gerda had made it for her and it featured the most adorable white-painted stars that swirled in a circle when spun.
paras.zh: 那是格尔达给她做的，上面有最可爱的白色涂绘星星，转动时绕着圈打转。

paras.en: Elsa’s eyes began to track the motion of the spinning stars.
paras.zh: 艾莎的眼睛开始追着旋转星星的轨迹。

paras.en: For a moment, she watched them as though mesmerized, her sobs fortunately subsiding.
paras.zh: 有那么一会儿，她像被迷住一样看着，抽泣总算平息下来。

paras.en: I let out a breath of relief.
paras.zh: 我松了口气。

paras.en: But when the mobile began to slow, she grew angry again, her tiny face scrunching up with rage.
paras.zh: 可当吊饰开始慢下来，她又生气了，小脸气得皱成一团。

paras.en: I watched, amused, as she reached up as if to try to grab the mobile and spin it herself.
paras.zh: 我好笑地看着，她伸出小手，像是要自己去抓吊饰、自己转动它。

paras.en: Instead, to my shock, a streak of what looked like ice shot from her fingers, blasting the mobile straight on.
paras.zh: 结果，令我震惊的是，一道像是冰的东西从她指尖射出，直直击中了吊饰。

paras.en: What on earth?
paras.zh: 这到底是怎么回事？

paras.en: The mobile started spinning again, but it now appeared to be crusted in ice.
paras.zh: 吊饰又开始转了，可这回它似乎结上了一层冰壳。

paras.en: I reached out with shaky fingers to touch it.
paras.zh: 我伸出发抖的手指去碰它。

paras.en: Sure enough, it was freezing cold.
paras.zh: 果然，它冰冷刺骨。

paras.en: Elsa giggled, happy again.
paras.zh: 艾莎咯咯笑起来，又开心了。

paras.en: I stared down at her, my pulse skittering.
paras.zh: 我低头盯着她，脉搏乱跳。

paras.en: Had she really done that?
paras.zh: 真是她干的吗？

paras.en: Shot ice from her fingertips?
paras.zh: 从指尖射出冰？

paras.en: But that was impossible.
paras.zh: 可那不可能。

paras.en: Unless… Magic. “How are my girls?” Agnarr asked, leaving the balcony to come up beside me.
paras.zh: 除非……魔法的。“我的两个姑娘还好吗？”安格瑞离开阳台，走到我身边问。

paras.en: He stopped as he caught the look of fear that must have been written on my face. “What’s wrong?” he I swallowed hard. “Watch,” I said, reaching out to stop the mobile.
paras.zh: 他停下来，显然看到了我脸上写满的恐惧。“怎么了？”他——我使劲咽了口唾沫。“看。”我说，伸手停住吊饰。

paras.en: I held my breath, waiting to see if she’d do it again.
paras.zh: 我屏住呼吸，等着看她会不会再来一次。

paras.en: Elsa stared up at the mobile, her nose wrinkling in frustration.
paras.zh: 艾莎抬头盯着吊饰，鼻尖因挫败而皱起。

paras.en: As the two of us watched, she reached her finger up and pointed.
paras.zh: 我们俩看着，她抬起手指，指了过去。

paras.en: Another blast of ice shot through the air and the mobile began to twirl again.
paras.zh: 又一道冰射过空中，吊饰又开始转了。

paras.en: I looked up at Agnarr.
paras.zh: 我抬起头看安格瑞。

paras.en: His eyes were like saucers. “How is this possible?” he whispered. “I don’t know,” I answered helplessly.
paras.zh: 他的眼睛瞪得像碟子大。“这怎么可能？”他轻声说。“我不知道。”我无助地回答。

paras.en: And I didn’t.
paras.zh: 我真的不知道。

paras.en: Sure, she was half Northuldra, like me, but contrary to popular belief, we didn’t possess any magic.
paras.zh: 没错，她有一半北地血统，像我一样，但和人们以为的相反，我们并不拥有任何魔法。

paras.en: Except Elsa somehow did.
paras.zh: 可艾莎不知怎么就有了。

paras.en: Agnarr stood as though frozen himself.
paras.zh: 安格瑞站着，像自己也冻住了一样。

paras.en: I could practically see the thoughts whirling through his brain.
paras.zh: 我几乎能看到思绪在他脑中打转。

paras.en: Even after all this time, was he still fearful of magic because of his father’s influence?
paras.zh: 过了这么久，他是不是仍因父亲的影响而对魔法心怀恐惧？

paras.en: Frustration rose inside me.
paras.zh: 我心里升起一股烦躁。

paras.en: I scooped Elsa from her crib into my arms.
paras.zh: 我把艾莎从摇篮里抱起来。

paras.en: Then I went to Agnarr, holding her out toward him. “Look at her, Agnarr,” I commanded, my voice leaving no room for argument. “She’s our daughter.
paras.zh: 然后我走向安格瑞，把她朝他举过去。“看看她，安格瑞，”我命令道，声音不容置疑，“她是我们的女儿。

paras.en: We created her, you and I.
paras.zh: 是你和我一起创造了她。

paras.en: Whatever powers she might possess, they were born out of love.
paras.zh: 无论她拥有什么力量，都源自爱。

paras.en: Which makes them a gift, not a curse.” As my heart beat furiously in my chest, Agnarr said nothing.
paras.zh: 所以那是恩赐，不是诅咒。”我心在胸腔里狂跳，安格瑞一言不发。

paras.en: Then he looked down at Elsa.
paras.zh: 接着他低头看艾莎。

paras.en: I could see his whole body was shaking. “ I “They will say For a moment, Agnarr did nothing.
paras.zh: 我看到他整个人都在发抖。“我——”他们会说——”有那么一刻，安格瑞一动不动。

paras.en: Then he slowly reached out, his hands still unsteady, gently brushing the fuzz of Elsa’s Agnarr’s face crumpled.
paras.zh: 然后他缓缓伸出手，手还在抖，轻轻拂过艾莎的绒发——安格瑞的脸皱了起来。

paras.en: He took her from me and cradled her close.
paras.zh: 他把她从我手里接过去，紧紧搂在怀里。

paras.en: Elsa snuggled against his chest, cooing contentedly as Agnarr gently stroked her head.
paras.zh: 艾莎依偎在他胸前，满足地咕哝着，安格瑞轻轻抚摸她的头。

paras.en: My heart melted as I watched the two of them.
paras.zh: 看着他们俩，我的心都化了。

paras.en: Maybe this would be all right after all.
paras.zh: 也许，结局终究会好。

paras.en: Agnarr looked up at me then, his expression solemn. “Look,” he said. “We have to be smart here.
paras.zh: 安格瑞抬头看我，神情郑重。“听我说，”他说，“我们必须理智应对。

paras.en: And cautious.
paras.zh: 也要谨慎。

paras.en: Until we understand what’s going on, and the extent of these powers, we must keep this quiet.
paras.zh: 在弄清状况、弄清这些力量的程度之前，我们必须保密。

paras.en: For Elsa’s own safety.” I nodded slowly, my heart sinking once again.
paras.zh: 为了艾莎自身的安全。”我缓缓点头，心又一次沉了下去。

paras.en: I knew he was right.
paras.zh: 我知道他是对的。

paras.en: And I would do anything to keep our daughter safe.
paras.zh: 而为了女儿的安全，我愿做一切。

paras.en: But how could I bear keeping yet another secret?
paras.zh: 可我怎么能再承受一个秘密？

paras.en: Especially one as big as this?
paras.zh: 尤其还是这么大一个？

chapters.title: Chapter Forty-Three: Iduna: Eight Years Later

paras.en: “AND THEY ALL GOT MARRIED!” Agnarr shot me an amused smile, then cleared his throat, making our presence known to the girls, who were playing on the floor in their nightgowns just before bed.
paras.zh: “然后他们都结婚了！”安格瑞冲我好玩地一笑，清了清嗓子，让正穿着睡袍在地板上玩耍、快要睡觉的姑娘们注意到我们来了。

paras.en: He stepped further into the room. “What are you playing?” he asked, observing the small pile of snow and the ice figurines eight-year-old Elsa had whipped up for their game.
paras.zh: 他再往屋里走。“你们在玩什么？”他问，看着八岁的艾莎为游戏随手变出的一小堆雪和冰雕小人。

paras.en: Anna was always begging her older sister to conjure up ice-skating rinks and snowmen and other forms of icy entertainment for her enjoyment—sometimes being rather persistent about it, as five-year-olds could be.
paras.zh: 安娜总缠着姐姐给她变出溜冰场、雪人之类冰上玩意儿来乐呵——有时还挺死缠烂打，五岁小孩嘛，就是这样。

paras.en: But to her credit, Elsa always obliged.
paras.zh: 不过话说回来，艾莎总是依着她。

paras.en: She liked nothing better than making her little sister smile.
paras.zh: 她最爱的就是逗小妹妹笑。

paras.en: We only let her do it indoors, of course.
paras.zh: 当然，我们只许她在室内这么做。

paras.en: Within the safety of the castle walls, on days when we had no visitors.
paras.zh: 在城堡围墙的安全里，在没有访客的日子。

paras.en: Even after eight years, Agnarr held firm to the belief that we should keep her powers a secret—which I understood, even if it made me a little sad.
paras.zh: 即使过了八年，安格瑞仍坚定认为该对她的力量保密——这我理解，尽管它让我有点难过。

paras.en: I hated the idea that Elsa would have to grow up thinking her beautiful gift was something to be kept hidden.
paras.zh: 我讨厌让艾莎在成长中以为，自己美丽的禀赋是见不得人的东西。

paras.en: I knew all too well what it felt like not to be able to be yourself.
paras.zh: 我太清楚不能做自己的滋味了。

paras.en: At least she had her sister’s full adoration. “Enchanted Forest!” Anna crowed, answering her father’s question with her usual exuberance.
paras.zh: 至少她有姐姐全身心的宠爱。“魔法森林！”安娜得意地叫道，用她一贯的活力回答父亲的问题。

paras.en: Though Anna did not have magic like Elsa’s, her special nature came through in her boundless energy, insatiable curiosity, and genuine love for all things fun.
paras.zh: 虽然安娜没有艾莎那样的魔法，她特别的天性却体现在用不完的精力、无法满足的好奇心，以及对一切好玩事物的真心喜爱上。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Elsa had always been a cautious, careful child, almost guarded at times.
paras.zh: 而艾莎一直是个谨慎小心、甚至有时近乎防范的孩子。

paras.en: She reminded me of the man her father had become, whereas Anna was more like the child I had been.
paras.zh: 她让我想起她父亲如今的样子，而安娜更像当年的我。

paras.en: Different as the summer and winter—but close as could be. “That doesn’t look like any enchanted forest I’ve ever seen,” Agnarr teased them, sitting down on the bed.
paras.zh: 像夏天和冬天一样不同——却又亲密无间。“那可不像我见过的任何魔法森林。”安格瑞坐在床上逗她们。

paras.en: Immediately, he had their attention. “You’ve seen an enchanted forest?” Anna asked, looking up at him in awe.
paras.zh: 他立刻抓住了她们的注意力。“你见过魔法森林？”安娜抬头崇拜地看着他问。

paras.en: I frowned, something stirring deep inside me.
paras.zh: 我皱起眉，心底有什么被触动。

paras.en: Agnarr loved telling his girls bedtime stories.
paras.zh: 安格瑞爱给姑娘们讲睡前故事。

paras.en: But I wasn’t sure it was wise to tread where this story went.
paras.zh: 但我不确定，往这个故事的方向走是否明智。

paras.en: They were still so young.
paras.zh: 她们还太小。

paras.en: Especially little Anna. “Are you sure about this?” I asked Agnarr, shooting him a concerned look.
paras.zh: 尤其是小安娜。“你确定要讲？”我问安格瑞，投去担忧的一瞥。

paras.en: He gave me a slight nod. “It’s time they knew.” I sighed.
paras.zh: 他微微点头。“她们该知道了。”我叹了口气。

paras.en: I supposed he was right.
paras.zh: 我想他是对的。

paras.en: It was part of Arendelle’s story, painful as it was for me.
paras.zh: 这是阿伦黛尔故事的一部分，尽管对我而言很痛。

paras.en: They’d hear it someday, from someone.
paras.zh: 她们迟早会从谁那里听到。

paras.en: Might as well be from their father, who had actually been there to see it firsthand.
paras.zh: 不如从她们父亲这儿听，他毕竟是亲眼目睹的人。

paras.en: Well, some of it, anyway.
paras.zh: 嗯，至少一部分是。

paras.en: The girls and I sat down on the bed.
paras.zh: 姑娘们和我坐到床上。

paras.en: Anna leaned toward her sister, whispering something in her ear.
paras.zh: 安娜凑近姐姐，在她耳边说了什么。

paras.en: Typical of Anna’s attention span: she’d probably already forgotten about the forest.
paras.zh: 这正是安娜注意力时长的典型表现：她大概已经把森林的事忘了。

paras.en: Agnarr raised an eyebrow. “ If I stifled a laugh as they both immediately snapped their mouths shut. “Far away,” he began, “as far north as we could go…” And so he began to tell the tale, his storyteller voice soft but It had been years since Agnarr and I talked about the forest.
paras.zh: 安格瑞挑了挑眉。“——”我憋住笑，看她们俩立刻闭了嘴。“在很远的地方，”他开口，“能往北走多远就多远……”于是他开始讲述，讲故事的声音轻柔却——安格瑞和我已有多年没聊过那片森林了。

paras.en: Even longer since we’d traveled out to the mist itself to check on it.
paras.zh: 我们远行到迷雾边上去查看，更是多年以前的事。

paras.en: Now we were busy, ruling a kingdom, parenting two little girls.
paras.zh: 如今我们忙着治理王国，养育两个小姑娘。

paras.en: We did still send a patrol to the mists every six months, but they always came back with the same news.
paras.zh: 我们仍每半年派一支巡逻队去迷雾边，可他们带回的总是同样的消息。

paras.en: The mist still held.
paras.zh: 迷雾依旧未散。

paras.en: I turned my attention back to the story, realizing Agnarr was almost done. “And someone saved me,” he explained. “I’m told that the spirits then vanished and a powerful mist came over the forest, locking everyone else out and keeping others in.” He looked solemnly at the girls. “And that night, I came home king of Arendelle.” I smiled a little at the hyperbole, remembering all the intervening years he’d been the crown prince, not yet anointed, rolling his eyes through every council meeting and running off to our tree every chance he got.
paras.zh: 我把注意力转回故事，发现安格瑞快讲完了。“有人救了我，”他解释，“据说那时精灵消失，一股强力的迷雾笼罩了森林，把其他人挡在外面，也把一些人留在里面。”他郑重地看着姑娘们。“那一夜，我回到阿伦黛尔，成了国王。”我对这夸张微微一笑，想起中间那些年他还是没加冕的储君，每次议会都翻白眼，一有机会就溜去我们的老树。

paras.en: But that didn’t make for a good story. “Whoa, Papa!” Anna breathed. “That was epic!
paras.zh: 可那编不成一个好故事。“哇，爸爸！”安娜轻声惊叹，“太史诗了！

paras.en: Whoever saved you, I love them!” She fell back into my lap in a dramatic swoon.
paras.zh: 不管谁救了你，我都爱死他了！”她夸张地往后一倒，瘫进我怀里。

paras.en: I couldn’t help a small smile.
paras.zh: 我忍不住微微一笑。

paras.en: If only she knew….
paras.zh: 要是她知道就好了……

paras.en: My smile faded as Agnarr responded seriously, “I wish I knew who it was.” If only he My heart ached.
paras.zh: 我的笑淡了，安格瑞认真答道：“我多希望知道那是谁。”要是他知道——我的心一疼。

paras.en: All these years had passed between us.
paras.zh: 我们之间已过去这么多年。

paras.en: A loving marriage, two beautiful girls, a peaceful kingdom.
paras.zh: 一段恩爱的婚姻，两个美丽的女儿，一个和平的王国。

paras.en: And I’d still never found the right moment to tell him everything, still bound by the night Peterssen had pulled me aside and bidden me to keep my secret.
paras.zh: 可我还是没找到合适的时机把一切告诉他，仍被那一夜彼得森把我拉到一旁、要我保守秘密所束缚。

paras.en: I set my resolve.
paras.zh: 我下定决心。

paras.en: Maybe tonight.
paras.zh: 也许就今晚。

paras.en: After we got the girls to sleep. “What happened to the spirits?
paras.zh: 等把姑娘们哄睡了。“精灵们怎么了？

paras.en: What’s in the forest now?” “I don’t know.
paras.zh: 森林里现在有什么？”“我不知道。

paras.en: The mist still stands.
paras.zh: 迷雾还立着。

paras.en: No one can get in.
paras.zh: 没人能进去。

paras.en: And no one has since come out,” Agnarr responded. “So we’re safe,” I added, shooting him a stern look. “Yes,” he said. “But the forest could wake again.
paras.zh: 也没人再出来过。”安格瑞回答。“所以我们安全。”我补了一句，投去严厉的一瞥。“是的，”他说，“但森林可能再度苏醒。

paras.en: And we must be prepared for whatever danger we might face.” “And on that note, how about we say good night to your father?” I interrupted, laying a gentle hand on Agnarr’s arm—even though at this point I wanted to shove him off the bed.
paras.zh: 我们必须为可能面临的任何危险做好准备。”“既然说到这儿，跟爸爸说晚安好不好？”我打断道，轻轻把手放在安格瑞臂上——尽管此刻我真想把他从床上推下去。

paras.en: Why did he think getting his children all riled up right before bedtime with his stories was always such a good idea? “Aw, but I still have so many questions!” Anna pouted. “Save them for another night, Anna,” Agnarr teased, tugging on her toe.
paras.zh: 他怎么总觉得睡前用故事把孩子搅得兴奋是好事？“啊，可我还有好多问题！”安娜撅嘴。“留到别的晚上吧，安娜。”安格瑞逗她，拉了拉她的脚趾。

paras.en: He rose and headed out the door, leaving me alone with the girls.
paras.zh: 他起身走出门，留下我和姑娘们独处。

paras.en: I sighed.
paras.zh: 我叹了口气。

paras.en: Time for damage control if I wanted them to get any “You know I don’t have that kind of patience!” Anna said, scowling after her father.
paras.zh: 要想她们睡得着，得做点补救——“你知道我没那个耐心！”安娜冲父亲背影皱眉说道。

paras.en: Then she turned to me. “Why did the Northuldra attack us, anyway?
paras.zh: 然后她转向我。“话说回来，北地人为什么要攻击我们？

paras.en: Who attacks people who give them gifts?” “Do you think the forest will wake again?” Elsa added, still looking concerned. “Only Ahtohallan knows,” I murmured before I could stop myself. “Ah-to-who-what?” Anna asked, her big eyes growing even wider.
paras.zh: 谁会攻击送自己礼物的人啊？”“你觉得森林会再醒过来吗？”艾莎仍担忧地补问。“只有阿托哈兰知道。”我没忍住，低声脱口而出。“阿—托—什—么？”安娜问，大眼睛睁得更圆了。

paras.en: I startled a little.
paras.zh: 我微微一惊。

paras.en: Had I just said that out loud?
paras.zh: 我刚是说出声了吗？

paras.en: And here I hadn’t wanted Agnarr to tell his story.
paras.zh: 而我本来还不愿让安格瑞讲他的故事。

paras.en: Was I really about to tell them mine? “When I was little,” I said slowly, unsure of the best way to start, “my mother would sing a song about a special river called Ahtohallan that was said to hold all the answers about the past and what we are a part of.” “Whoa!” Anna breathed. “Can you sing it to us?” Elsa asked.
paras.zh: 我真的要讲我的故事了吗？“我小的时候，”我慢慢说，不确定怎么开头最好，“我母亲会唱一首歌，关于一条叫阿托哈兰的特别的河，据说它藏着关于过去、以及我们身属何物的一切答案。”“哇！”安娜轻声惊叹，“你能唱给我们听吗？”艾莎问。

paras.en: My breath caught.
paras.zh: 我屏住了呼吸。

paras.en: Could I?
paras.zh: 我能吗？

paras.en: But then I looked down at them, their sweet faces, their large eyes.
paras.zh: 可接着我低下头看她们，看她们甜美的脸蛋、大大的眼睛。

paras.en: Anna curious, Elsa a little more reserved.
paras.zh: 安娜好奇，艾莎更含蓄些。

paras.en: And something inside me gave, for the first time in many years.
paras.zh: 而我内心有什么东西，在许多年来第一次松动了。

paras.en: Maybe it was “Okay,” I said, gathering them into my arms. “Cuddle close, scooch in,” I urged them, as I used to say to their father many years before.
paras.zh: 也许是因为——“好吧，”我说，把她们搂进怀里，“贴紧点，挤过来，”我催她们，就像多年前对她父亲说的那样。

paras.en: Just as my mother used to say to me.
paras.zh: 就像我母亲当年对我说的那样。

paras.en: And then I began to sing.
paras.zh: 然后我开始唱起来。

paras.en: “WOW.
WE HAVEN’T BEEN IN HERE FOR AGES!” I stifled a sneeze as I slipped into the now very dusty secret library, memories flooding through me as I looked around, everything still in its place.
paras.zh: 我们好久没来这儿了！”我溜进如今落满灰尘的秘密书房，憋住一个喷嚏，环顾四周，记忆涌上心头，一切都还在原处。

paras.en: I thought back to all the hours Iduna and I had spent in here, hiding out from the world.
paras.zh: 我回想起我和伊杜娜在这里共度的那些时光，躲开整个世界。

paras.en: As I glanced back at her now, closing the door behind me, an impulsive urge rose over me.
paras.zh: 当我回头看正关门的她，一股冲动涌上我。

paras.en: I grabbed her and swung her around, kissing her hard on the mouth.
paras.zh: 我一把抱住她转圈，狠狠吻上她的唇。

paras.en: She kissed me back, laughing. “Wow.
paras.zh: 她笑着回吻我。“哇。

paras.en: This place really does it for you,” she teased. “ You “You’d better watch it,” she said, pushing me away gently. “After that story you told?
paras.zh: 这地方真让你来劲。”她逗我。“你——”你最好小心点。”她说，轻轻把我推开，“讲了那么个故事之后？

paras.en: The girls are bound to be up all night, worried about monsters in the mist.
paras.zh: 姑娘们今晚准会整夜不睡，担心迷雾里的怪物。

paras.en: We’ll find them both in our bed when we get back, I bet.” I groaned. “Too much?” “ Epically “Yes,” I agreed. “They need to know the truth, even when its unpleasant.
paras.zh: 我打赌我们回去时，俩人都会在咱床上。”我呻吟一声。“过了头？”“惊天地泣鬼神地——”“是的，”我承认，“他们需要知道真相，哪怕不好受。

paras.en: I don’t want them growing up as I did.
paras.zh: 我不愿他们像我那样长大。

paras.en: With all those secrets.” I watched the playful smile disappear from Iduna’s face as she visibly paled.
paras.zh: 带着那些秘密。”我看着伊杜娜脸上顽皮的笑消失了，她明显脸色发白。

paras.en: I cocked my head in question. “Are you all right?” Iduna shook her head, blue eyes welling with tears. “What’s wrong?” I asked, reaching down to clasp her hands in mine. “Agnarr.
paras.zh: 我偏头问道。“你还好吗？”伊杜娜摇摇头，蓝眼睛里涌上泪水。“怎么了？”我问，伸手把她的手攥进我手里。“安格瑞。

paras.en: There’s something—” “Mama!
paras.zh: 有件事——”“妈妈！

paras.en: Papa!” The sharp cry roared through the room, as if it came from right outside.
paras.zh: 爸爸！”一声尖锐的哭喊在房间里炸开，像是从门外传来。

paras.en: Loud screeching, hysterical.
paras.zh: 又尖又厉，歇斯底里。

paras.en: Iduna turned stark white. “Elsa!” she whispered.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜顿时脸色惨白。“艾莎！”她低声说。

paras.en: We dove out of the room, following the sound of her voice.
paras.zh: 我们冲出房间，循着她的声音跑去。

paras.en: We headed past the girls’ now empty bedroom, down the stairs, to the Great Hall.
paras.zh: 我们经过姑娘们如今空着的卧室，下楼，奔向大会堂。

paras.en: I could hear sobbing coming from behind the closed doors and my heart seized with panic.
paras.zh: 我听见紧闭的门后传来啜泣，心因恐慌而揪紧。

paras.en: What were they doing down here?
paras.zh: 她们跑这儿来干什么？

paras.en: They were supposed to be in bed!
paras.zh: 她们本该在床上！

paras.en: I threw open the doors wide, then stopped short, horrified at what I saw.
paras.zh: 我猛地推开门，却猛地停住，被眼前的景象吓呆了。

paras.en: Mountains of snow, piled high.
paras.zh: 高高的雪堆，像山一样。

paras.en: The walls crawling with ice.
paras.zh: 墙壁爬满了冰。

paras.en: Elsa cradling her sister in her arms.
paras.zh: 艾莎把妹妹搂在怀里。

paras.en: No!
paras.zh: 不！

paras.en: My heart leapt in my chest. “Elsa!” I cried. “What have you done?
paras.zh: 我的心在胸口一跳。“艾莎！”我喊道，“你做了什么？

paras.en: This is getting out of hand!” The second I spoke the words, I regretted them.
paras.zh: 这太失控了！”话一出口，我就后悔了。

paras.en: Especially when I caught the agonized look on my eldest daughter’s face. “It was an accident!” Elsa wailed, looking down at her sister. “I’m sorry, Anna.” Iduna dropped to her knees, pulling Anna away from Elsa and into her own arms.
paras.zh: 尤其当我看到大女儿脸上那痛苦的表情。“是意外！”艾莎哭着，低头看着妹妹，“对不起，安娜。”伊杜娜跪下来，把安娜从艾莎身边拉开，搂进自己怀里。

paras.en: Anna lay so still.
paras.zh: 安娜躺得一动不动。

paras.en: Was she even breathing?
paras.zh: 她还在呼吸吗？

paras.en: Iduna looked up at me, her eyes wide and frightened. “She’s ice cold,” she whispered.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜抬头看我，眼睛睁大、充满恐惧。“她浑身冰冷。”她低声说。

paras.en: I did everything in my power to keep it together, even I shook my head.
paras.zh: 我竭尽全力稳住自己，可我摇了摇头。

paras.en: Those thoughts didn’t help.
paras.zh: 那些念头无济于事。

paras.en: Right now my family needed me.
paras.zh: 此刻我的家人需要我。

paras.en: I needed to stay strong.
paras.zh: 我必须坚强。

paras.en: For them.
paras.zh: 为了他们。

paras.en: I froze, an idea suddenly forming in my mind.
paras.zh: 我僵住，一个念头突然在脑中成形。

paras.en: The trolls We had no choice but to try. “I know where we have to go,” I said. “Take the girls to the stable.
paras.zh: 地精们——我们别无选择，只能一试。“我知道该去哪儿，”我说，“带姑娘们去马厩。

paras.en: Have them saddle up two horses.
paras.zh: 让他们备好两匹马。

paras.en: I will meet you there.” Tears slipped down Iduna’s cheeks. “All right.
paras.zh: 我在那儿跟你们会合。”泪水从伊杜娜脸颊滑落。“好吧。

paras.en: But hurry….” I rose to my feet.
paras.zh: 但快点……”我站起身。

paras.en: Iduna lifted Anna, cradling her like a baby.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜抱起安娜，像抱婴儿一样搂着。

paras.en: Elsa was still crying hard, clinging to her mother’s skirt.
paras.zh: 艾莎还在大哭，死死抓着母亲的裙角。

paras.en: I gave them one last look and then ran straight to the library, heading back into the secret room.
paras.zh: 我最后看了她们一眼，然后直奔图书馆，回到那间密室。

paras.en: Where I’d hidden the map.
paras.zh: 我藏地图的地方。

paras.en: With trembling hands, I reached up to a high shelf, pulled the old folklore book down, and paged through it until I found the map, tucked away.
paras.zh: 我颤抖着手伸向高处的书架，取下那本旧民俗书，翻找起来，直到找到夹在里面的地图。

paras.en: I smoothed it out on the table, refreshing the route in my mind.
paras.zh: 我把地图在桌上铺平，在心里温习路线。

paras.en: Then I stuffed it in my satchel and ran to meet my girls at the stable.
paras.zh: 然后把它塞进背包，跑向马厩与姑娘们会合。

paras.en: We rode out into the night.
paras.zh: 我们骑马冲入夜色。

paras.en: Iduna was white-faced and quiet, cradling the still-motionless Anna in her arms.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜脸色苍白，沉默不语，怀里仍抱着一动不动的安娜。

paras.en: Elsa was with me on my horse, sobbing her eyes out.
paras.zh: 艾莎和我同乘一匹马，哭得稀里哗啦。

paras.en: She kept glancing over at her sister longingly.
paras.zh: 她不停渴望地瞟着妹妹。

paras.en: My heart ached at the pain I saw her on face. “I’m really sorry, Papa,” she whimpered. “I’m so, so sorry!” “It’s not your fault,” I said wearily. “I’m sorry I shouted.
paras.zh: 看她脸上的痛苦，我心都疼了。“我真的对不起，爸爸。”她呜咽着，“我太、太对不起了！”“不是你的错，”我疲惫地说，“对不起，我刚才吼了你。

paras.en: I was scared, that’s all.” “I’m scared, too.” I reached out to touch Elsa’s shoulder, wanting to comfort her.
paras.zh: 我只是害怕。”“我也害怕。”我伸手想碰艾莎的肩膀，想安慰她。

paras.en: But she recoiled from me.
paras.zh: 可她却躲开了我。

paras.en: A sob escaped her throat. “Please don’t!
paras.zh: 一声呜咽从她喉咙里漏出。“求你别！

paras.en: I don’t want to hurt you, too.” Pain shot through my heart at the anguish I saw on her face.
paras.zh: 我也不想伤到你。”看她脸上的痛苦，一阵刺痛穿过我心。

paras.en: As angry as I was, my rage was never directed at my daughter.
paras.zh: 我再生气，怒火也从不冲着我女儿。

paras.en: It wasn’t her fault.
paras.zh: 不是她的错。

paras.en: She was a good girl.
paras.zh: 她是个好姑娘。

paras.en: She loved her sister.
paras.zh: 她爱妹妹。

paras.en: She would never willingly hurt her. “Don’t worry,” I said, trying to make my voice sound reassuring. “I’m taking you to someone who can help.
paras.zh: 绝不会故意伤害她。“别担心，”我尽量让声音听起来令人安心，“我带你们去一个能帮忙的人那里。

paras.en: We’re going to fix this.
paras.zh: 我们会解决这件事。

paras.en: I promise.
paras.zh: 我保证。

paras.en: Anna will be okay.” But even as I said the words, I wondered.
paras.zh: 安娜会没事的。”可即便我说出这话，我心里仍存疑。

paras.en: Would anything be okay, ever again?
paras.zh: 还有什么会好起来吗，从此以后？

chapters.title: Chapter Forty: Five: Agnarr: Later That Night

paras.en: “WHAT DO I DO, PAPA?
paras.zh: “我该怎么办，爸爸？

paras.en: WHAT IF I CAN’T CONTROL IT?” “Shhh, sweet girl,” I whispered, tucking Elsa into her bed, pulling the blanket over her shivering frame.
paras.zh: 要是我控制不住怎么办？”“嘘，好姑娘，”我轻声说，把艾莎塞进被窝，拉过毯子盖住她发抖的身子。

paras.en: Iduna was doing the same with Anna a few rooms away.
paras.zh: 伊杜娜在几间房外对安娜做着同样的事。

paras.en: Though Anna had not yet woken, she was breathing easier, and her skin was once again flushed with warmth.
paras.zh: 尽管安娜还没醒，呼吸却平稳了些，皮肤也重新泛起温暖的红润。

paras.en: The only lasting effect of the incident seemed to be a strange streak of white in her auburn hair.
paras.zh: 这件事唯一持久的影响，似乎是她赤褐色头发里多出了一道奇怪的白色。

paras.en: Something she would likely keep, the trolls said.
paras.zh: 地精说，这大概会留下来。

paras.en: But it was not dangerous.
paras.zh: 但并不危险。

paras.en: She would be okay.
paras.zh: 她会没事的。

paras.en: This time. “Just try to get some sleep,” I said. “We can talk more in the morning.
paras.zh: 这次。“尽量睡会儿吧，”我说，“早上我们再细谈。

paras.en: Form a plan.” “Will Anna be okay?” Elsa whimpered. “She will,” I assured her. “And you will be, too.” I forced the words past the lump in my throat, hoping that if I said them with enough conviction, I could convince myself of their truth, too.
paras.zh: 定个计划。”“安娜会好吗？”艾莎呜咽。“会的，”我向她保证，“你也会的。”我把话硬从喉头的哽咽中挤出来，希望说得够坚定，就能连自己也说服。

paras.en: Her face crumpled. “I wish I never had magic!” I stroked her forehead. “I know,” I told her gently. “Unfortunately, we can’t simply wish away who we are.
paras.zh: 她的脸皱成一团。“我真希望自己从没拥有过魔法！”我抚摸她的额头。“我知道，”我轻柔地说，“可惜，我们无法简单地许愿抹掉自己是谁。

paras.en: But, She nodded her little head resolutely.
paras.zh: 但是——”她坚定地小脑袋一点。

paras.en: I rose to my feet and started toward the door. “Papa!” she called out after me.
paras.zh: 我站起身，朝门口走去。“爸爸！”她在身后喊我。

paras.en: I stopped. “Yes, Elsa?” “Please!
paras.zh: 我停下。“怎么了，艾莎？”“求你了！

paras.en: I don’t want to be alone!” For a moment, I just stood there, not sure what to do.
paras.zh: 我不想一个人！”有那么一刻，我只是站在那儿，不知如何是好。

paras.en: Then a sudden thought struck me.
paras.zh: 然后一个念头突然击中我。

paras.en: I turned to my daughter. “Hang on,” I said. “I’ll be right back.” I left her room and raced down the hall to my chambers.
paras.zh: 我转向女儿。“等一下，”我说，“我马上回来。”我离开她的房间，沿走廊跑向我的寝殿。

paras.en: I reached to the back of the wardrobe and pulled out a wooden chest.
paras.zh: 我伸手到衣橱后面，拖出一个木箱。

paras.en: After opening it, I reached in and unwrapped the small object I’d placed on top.
paras.zh: 打开后，我伸手取出裹着的小物件——那是我放在箱顶的东西。

paras.en: Then I returned to Elsa’s room. “Hello!” I said, making my voice as silly as possible. “Allow me to introduce myself!
paras.zh: 然后我回到艾莎的房间。“你好呀！”我尽量把声音装得滑稽，“请允许我自我介绍！

paras.en: I am Sir JörgenBjörgen.
paras.zh: 我是约根·比约根爵士。

paras.en: And I am a protector puffin!” I waved the little stuffed animal in front of me, as if it were waddling in her direction.
paras.zh: 我是一只守护海鹦！”我挥着那只小毛绒玩具，像它正朝她一摇一摆走过去。

paras.en: Elsa stared at the puffin. “Nice to meet you…JörgenBjörgen?” she said, her voice still no more than a whisper.
paras.zh: 艾莎盯着海鹦。“很高兴认识你……约根·比约根？”她说，声音仍细若耳语。

paras.en: But I could see the childish interest piqued in her wide blue eyes and it gave me hope. “That’s Sir I tossed the puffin in her direction.
paras.zh: 可我看得出她那双大蓝眼里被激起的孩子气兴趣，这给了我希望。“那是爵士——”我把海鹦朝她扔过去。

paras.en: She caught it in her arms and cuddled it to her chest. “Thank you, Sir JörgenBjörgen,” she said softly, stroking his fur. “Now I don’t have to be alone.” I crept toward the doorway. “Try to get some sleep,” I said again. “We’ll talk more in the morning.” I closed the door gently behind me, finding Iduna standing in the hallway.
paras.zh: 她接住它，搂在胸前。“谢谢你，约根·比约根爵士。”她轻声说，抚摸着它的毛，“现在我不用人陪了。”我蹑手蹑脚走到门口。“试着睡会儿，”我又说，“早上再细谈。”我轻轻关上门，发现伊杜娜站在走廊里。

paras.en: She gave me a sad smile. “That was a good idea,” she said. “Giving her your stuffed animal.” “Sir JörgenBjörgen got me through some tough times,” I admitted. “Hopefully he can help Elsa, too.” Iduna’s shoulders slumped.
paras.zh: 她朝我苦笑。“这主意不错，”她说，“把你的毛绒玩具给她。”“约根·比约根爵士陪我熬过了不少艰难时刻，”我承认，“希望他也能帮到艾莎。”伊杜娜的肩膀垮了下来。

paras.en: With the adrenaline of the evening fading, exhaustion was setting in.
paras.zh: 随着夜晚的肾上腺素退去，疲惫袭来。

paras.en: I pulled her into my arms and held her close.
paras.zh: 我把她搂进怀里，紧紧抱着。

paras.en: I could feel her heartbeat against my chest as she snuggled into the crook of my shoulder. “Do you think we’re doing the right thing?” she whispered. “Separating them like this?
paras.zh: 她依偎在我肩窝里，我能感到她的心跳贴着我的胸口。“你觉得我们做得对吗？”她轻声问，“这样把他们分开？

paras.en: I mean, they’re sisters!
paras.zh: 我是说，她们是姐妹啊！

paras.en: They’re so close.” “Which is part of the problem,” I said. “From what we’ve seen, joy seems to bring out Elsa’s powers as much as fear.
paras.zh: 她们那么亲密。”“这恰恰也是问题的一部分，”我说，“从我们看到的来看，喜悦和恐惧一样，都会引发艾莎的力量。

paras.en: Which makes it dangerous for us to keep them together.
paras.zh: 所以让他们在一起反而危险。

paras.en: At least for right now.” I shuddered, thinking back to Anna’s pale face.
paras.zh: 至少现在如此。”我打了个寒颤，想起安娜苍白的脸。

paras.en: Her little body, so cold.
paras.zh: 她小小的身子，那么冷。

paras.en: If we had lost her… I felt Iduna’s reluctant nod.
paras.zh: 如果我们失去了她……我感到伊杜娜不情愿地点了点头。

paras.en: It wasn’t what she wanted, but she knew it was for the best. “It won’t be forever,” I said, trying to soothe her. “I’ll work with Elsa every day.
paras.zh: 那不是她想要的，可她知道这是最好的安排。“不会永远这样，”我试图安慰她，“我会每天陪艾莎练习。

paras.en: We’ll figure out a way for her to control her power.
paras.zh: 我们会找到让她控制力量的办法。

paras.en: Once she does, there will no longer be any reason to keep them apart.” Iduna pulled away from my embrace, meeting my eyes with her own. “And Arendelle?
paras.zh: 一旦她做到，就没理由再把他们分开了。”伊杜娜从我的拥抱中退开，直视我的眼睛。“那阿伦黛尔呢？

paras.en: Did you mean what you said to Grand Pabbie about closing the gates?
paras.zh: 你对皮比说的关上城门，是认真的吗？

paras.en: Shutting the people out, too?” I flinched at the note of accusation I heard in her voice.
paras.zh: 把百姓也关在外面？”听她声音里的责备，我缩了一下。

paras.en: But I had to do what was best for Elsa, what would keep her safe. “Just temporarily,” I assured her. “To protect Elsa.
paras.zh: 可我必须做对艾莎最好、能护她安全的事。“只是暂时的，”我向她保证，“为了护住艾莎。

paras.en: You know how the people of Arendelle react to magic.
paras.zh: 你知道阿伦黛尔的百姓对魔法是什么反应。

paras.en: If they learned what her magic did to Anna, they’d think her a monster.
paras.zh: 若他们知道她的魔法对安娜做了什么，会把她当成怪物。

paras.en: They’d never allow her to become queen.
paras.zh: 绝不会允许她当女王。

paras.en: We can’t let that happen.
paras.zh: 我们不能让那种事发生。

paras.en: We must protect Elsa and her right to the throne.
paras.zh: 我们必须保护艾莎和她继承王位的权利。

paras.en: Unless you can think of any other way…” She hung her head.
paras.zh: 除非你能想出别的法子……”她垂下头。

paras.en: I knew she didn’t like it, but she also saw no alternative.
paras.zh: 我知道她不喜欢，可她也找不到别的出路。

paras.en: We needed to protect our family.
paras.zh: 我们得保护家人。

paras.en: Our girls. “I love you,” she whispered. “I love you, too,” I murmured back, stroking her hair with my hand. “And I know this is hard.
paras.zh: 我们的姑娘们。“我爱你，”她轻声说，“我也爱你，”我低声回，用手抚她的头发，“我知道这很难。

paras.en: Probably the hardest thing we’ve ever had to face.
paras.zh: 大概是我们面对过最难的事。

paras.en: But I promise you, we will And until then?
paras.zh: 但我向你保证，我们会——在那之前呢？

paras.en: Conceal, don’t feel.
paras.zh: 隐藏，别去感受。

chapters.title: Chapter Forty-Six: Iduna: Ten Years Later

paras.en: “NO!
NO!
paras.zh: 不！

paras.en: NO!” Elsa’s anguished cry rang through the hall.
paras.zh: 不！”艾莎痛苦的哭喊响彻大厅。

paras.en: Heart in my throat, I ran to her door and pushed it open after making sure no one was standing nearby.
paras.zh: 心提到嗓子眼，我跑到她门前，确认附近没人后推开了门。

paras.en: I ducked in, then quickly shut the door and locked it before turning to my daughter.
paras.zh: 我闪身进去，迅速关上门锁好，才转向女儿。

paras.en: Elsa was standing at her window.
paras.zh: 艾莎正站在窗边。

paras.en: Ice seeped from her fingers, crusting the sill.
paras.zh: 冰从她指尖渗出来，在窗台上结了壳。

paras.en: The entire room was freezing cold and I fought back a shiver.
paras.zh: 整个房间冰冷刺骨，我强忍住发抖。

paras.en: Usually I wore my coat to visit her.
paras.zh: 平时我来看她都穿着外套。

paras.en: But she had sounded so distraught I didn’t know if she could wait. “Elsa,” I called quietly, not wanting to frighten her.
paras.zh: 可她听起来那么崩溃，我不知道她还能不能等。“艾莎，”我轻声唤，不想吓到她。

paras.en: She lost control when she was scared.
paras.zh: 她害怕时就会失控。

paras.en: And that was when things got worse.
paras.zh: 而那时情况会更糟。

paras.en: As long as we could keep her calm, quiet, she could sometimes regain her composure.
paras.zh: 只要我们让她平静、安静，她有时能重新稳住。

paras.en: She turned to me, icy tears crusting her eyelashes.
paras.zh: 她转向我，冰冷的泪在她睫毛上结了霜。

paras.en: The sorrow that surrounded her was unbearable. “Sweetheart,” I begged, stepping toward her.
paras.zh: 包围着她的哀伤让人无法承受。“亲爱的，”我恳求道，朝她走去。

paras.en: She held up a trembling hand. “No!” she cried. “Please don’t come any closer!
paras.zh: 她举起一只发抖的手。“不！”她喊，“求你别再靠近！

paras.en: I don’t want to hurt you!” I could see the icicles forming at her fingertips and took a hasty step backward, though it killed me to do so.
paras.zh: 我不想伤到你！”我看见冰柱在她指尖成形，急忙退后一步，尽管这让我心如刀割。

paras.en: She was my daughter!
paras.zh: 她是我的女儿啊！

paras.en: But she had grown into something else, too.
paras.zh: 可她也长成了另一种存在。

paras.en: Something so powerful it scared me half to death.
paras.zh: 强大到让我怕得要死。

paras.en: I thought back to Grand Pabbie’s words.
paras.zh: 我想起皮比的话。

paras.en: Your power will only grow, You must learn to control it.
paras.zh: 你的力量只会增长，你必须学会控制它。

paras.en: Since then, Agnarr had tried to help her do just that—control her emotions, control her magic.
paras.zh: 从那以后，安格瑞就试着帮她做到这点——控制情绪，控制魔法。

paras.en: Conceal, don’t feel.
paras.zh: 隐藏，别去感受。

paras.en: Don’t let it show.
paras.zh: 别让它显露。

paras.en: It hadn’t worked.
paras.zh: 没管用。

paras.en: In fact, things had only gotten worse.
paras.zh: 事实上，情况只更糟了。

paras.en: It was as though the castle had been put under a storybook curse: Anna wandering the halls like a ghost, not understanding why her sister had shut her out, her memories of her sister’s magic, and the night she was injured, erased.
paras.zh: 仿佛城堡被施了童话里的诅咒：安娜像幽灵一样在走廊游荡，不明白姐姐为何把她关在门外，关于姐姐魔法、以及她受伤那夜的记忆都被抹去了。

paras.en: Elsa, too frightened to leave her room.
paras.zh: 艾莎则吓得不敢离开房间。

paras.en: I used to try to talk her into coming out to play a game or eat dinner with the family.
paras.zh: 我以前常劝她出来玩个游戏，或和家人一起吃晚饭。

paras.en: Surely she could handle that!
paras.zh: 那她总应付得来吧！

paras.en: Her powers only manifested when her emotions were strong.
paras.zh: 她的力量只有在情绪强烈时才显现。

paras.en: We could keep things calm.
paras.zh: 我们能保持平静。

paras.en: Peaceful.
paras.zh: 安宁。

paras.en: She’d be safe.
paras.zh: 她就安全。

paras.en: Anna would be safe.
paras.zh: 安娜就安全。

paras.en: But she always refused.
paras.zh: 可她总拒绝。

paras.en: Too afraid she’d hurt her sister again.
paras.zh: 太怕会再伤到妹妹。

paras.en: Even after all these years, I still saw the guilt of what she’d done to Anna swimming in her eyes.
paras.zh: 即使过了这么多年，我仍看见她眼里游动着对安娜所做之事的愧疚。

paras.en: It broke me every time.
paras.zh: 每次都让我心碎。

paras.en: As for Agnarr, he’d retreated into his work, throwing himself into the affairs of state and holding endless meetings.
paras.zh: 至于安格瑞，他退进了工作里，一头扎进国务，开没完没了的会。

paras.en: I felt like I hardly saw him these days, except at night when he finally crawled into bed, so exhausted he barely spoke before falling asleep.
paras.zh: 这些天我几乎见不到他，除非夜里他终于爬上床，累得没说几句就睡着。

paras.en: When I pressed him, he assured me everything was fine.
paras.zh: 我追问时，他向我保证一切都好。

paras.en: He was just busy.
paras.zh: 他只是忙。

paras.en: But I could see the torment deep in his eyes.
paras.zh: 可我看得到他眼底深处的煎熬。

paras.en: He knew, deep down, that his plan hadn’t worked, would never work.
paras.zh: 他心底知道，他的计划没管用，也永远不会管用。

paras.en: And our family, our happiness, was being torn apart, day by day.
paras.zh: 而我们的家庭、我们的幸福，正一天天被撕碎。

paras.en: I spent most of my days in the secret room in the library.
paras.zh: 我多数日子都待在图书馆的密室里。

paras.en: But instead of painting stars on the ceiling, or sharing hopes and dreams, I now dove into research, translating old books and scrolls.
paras.zh: 但如今我不再在天花板上画星星、分享希望与梦想，而是埋头研究，翻译古书和卷轴。

paras.en: Taking notes, trying to piece together clues. “Why?” I asked the spirits in frustration after a particularly grueling translation of an old folklore book. “Why did you do this to her?
paras.zh: 做笔记，试图拼凑线索。“为什么？”在艰难译完一本古老民俗书后，我沮丧地问精灵，“你们为什么要这样对她？

paras.en: Why must she suffer so?
paras.zh: 为什么她必须这么受苦？

paras.en: If this is a gift, let her use it!
paras.zh: 如果这是天赋，就让她用它！

paras.en: But the spirits didn’t answer.
paras.zh: 可精灵没有回答。

paras.en: For they were still locked away behind the mist. “Mama,” Elsa whimpered now, her voice drawing me back to the present.
paras.zh: 因为他们仍被锁在迷雾之后。“妈妈，”艾莎此刻呜咽着，声音把我拉回当下。

paras.en: But when I tried to step closer, she backed away again, until she was flush against the wall, with ice crawling up the sides of it.
paras.zh: 可我刚想靠近，她又退开，直到后背贴墙，冰沿着墙边爬上来。

paras.en: I remembered, sadly, how she used to cuddle up to me as a child, allowing me to sing her to sleep.
paras.zh: 我难过地想起，她小时候怎样依偎着我，让我唱着歌哄她入睡。

paras.en: I wondered if she even slept these days at all. “It’s okay, dear one,” I told her, forcing myself to stop in my tracks. “I won’t come any closer if that’s what you want.” Her face twisted in agony. “Conceal, don’t feel,” I heard her whisper. “Don’t let it show.” My heart panged. “I know that’s what your father has told you,” I said slowly. “And maybe it does help, for a time.
paras.zh: 我怀疑她这些天到底睡不睡。“没关系，亲爱的，”我告诉她，逼自己停下脚步，“如果你希望这样，我就不靠近了。”她的脸因痛苦而扭曲。“隐藏，别去感受，”我听见她低语，“别让它显露。”我心一揪。“我知道这是你父亲教你的，”我慢慢说，“也许短时间它确实有用。

paras.en: But squashing down your emotions can only work for so long.
paras.zh: 但把情绪硬压下去，撑不了多久。

paras.en: Before you feel like a powder keg.
paras.zh: 迟早你会像一桶火药。

paras.en: Ready to explode.” I cringed at the idea of the coming explosion, which at this point seemed unavoidable.
paras.zh: 随时会炸。”想到即将到来的爆发，我打了个寒颤，此刻它似乎已不可避免。

paras.en: It could be devastating not only to her, but perhaps to the entire kingdom.
paras.zh: 那不仅对她，对整个王国都可能是毁灭性的。

paras.en: That was why we had her here, tucked away, I tried to remind myself.
paras.zh: 所以我们才把她藏在这里，我试图提醒自己。

paras.en: But all the rationality in the world couldn’t quash the guilt.
paras.zh: 可天下所有的理智，也压不住这份愧疚。

paras.en: It was cruel to keep her here in this cramped room.
paras.zh: 把她困在这狭窄的房间里，太残忍了。

paras.en: The kind of thing villains did in the storybooks—not heroes. “Elsa, please,” I begged. “You can do this.
paras.zh: 那是故事书里反派才干的事——不是英雄。“艾莎，求你了，”我恳求，“你做得到的。

paras.en: I know you can.
paras.zh: 我知道你做得到。

paras.en: Just try a little harder.” “I’ve been She looked like a broken doll.
paras.zh: 只要再努力一点。”“我已经——”她像个破碎的玩偶。

paras.en: A shell of the person she’d been meant to be.
paras.zh: 本该成为的那个人的空壳。

paras.en: All these years, we’d tried to protect her.
paras.zh: 这么多年，我们一直想保护她。

paras.en: We’d tried to keep her safe.
paras.zh: 我们一直想护她平安。

paras.en: Instead, we’d broken her spirit.
paras.zh: 结果，我们却打碎了她的灵性。

paras.en: This beautiful, wild, magical girl should not be trapped in a cage of our making.
paras.zh: 这个美丽、野性、充满魔力的女孩，不该被困在我们亲手造的笼子里。

paras.en: She should be free to spread her wings and fly like the wind.
paras.zh: 她该自由地展翅，像风一样飞翔。

paras.en: Like the spirits themselves… Was this destined to go on forever?
paras.zh: 像精灵们自己一样……难道这注定要永远持续下去？

paras.en: Only Ahtohallan knows.
paras.zh: 只有阿托哈兰知道。

paras.en: Ahtohallan.
paras.zh: 阿托哈兰。

paras.en: The one spirit still out there.
paras.zh: 那个仍在外面游荡的精灵。

paras.en: Somewhere.
paras.zh: 在某处。

paras.en: If only there was a way to find her. “I understand, sweetheart,” I said at last. “Just…hang on a little longer, okay?
paras.zh: 要是有办法找到她就好了。“我明白了，亲爱的，”我终于说，“就……再撑一会儿，好吗？

paras.en: My brave girl.” My voice cracked on the last part and I felt a tear fall from my eye, sliding slowly down my cheek.
paras.zh: 我勇敢的姑娘。”最后几个字我声音破了，感到一滴泪从眼中落下，缓缓滑过脸颊。

paras.en: Elsa saw it, and to my surprise, she suddenly stepped forward, closing the distance between us.
paras.zh: 艾莎看见了，出乎意料，她突然向前，拉近了我们之间的距离。

paras.en: I watched, breathless, as she reached out with a shaky hand and swiped the tear from my cheek.
paras.zh: 我屏住呼吸，看她伸出发抖的手，拭去我脸上的泪。

paras.en: It froze on her fingertip—a perfect crystal trapped in time.
paras.zh: 泪在她指尖冻住——一颗完美的水晶，被时间定格。

paras.en: Then she flicked it away, looking at me with her great, deep, sorrowful eyes. “I love you, Mama,” she said slowly. “And I trust you.
paras.zh: 然后她弹开它，用那双深邃、哀伤的大眼睛望着我。“我爱你，妈妈，”她慢慢说，“我也相信你。

paras.en: I know you will help me.” I nodded woodenly, wanting to grab her, to pull her close and squeeze her tight.
paras.zh: 我知道你会帮我的。”我木然点头，想一把抓住她，把她搂紧。

paras.en: Never let her go.
paras.zh: 绝不放她走。

paras.en: But such a move could cause her to hurt me.
paras.zh: 可这样的动作也许会让她伤到我。

paras.en: And I knew if she did—however unintentional—it would destroy her.
paras.zh: 而我知道，如果她伤了我——无论多无意——会毁了她。

paras.en: I gave a fleeting smile and a wave, even though inside I felt like dying. “I’ll be back,” I assured her. “Soon.” I unlocked the door and headed through it, back into the warmth of the castle.
paras.zh: 我挤出一抹转瞬即逝的笑，挥了挥手，尽管内心痛不欲生。“我会回来，”我向她保证，“很快。”我打开门锁走过去，回到城堡的温暖里。

paras.en: Back to the library.
paras.zh: 回到图书馆。

paras.en: This time I wasn’t leaving until I figured it out.
paras.zh: 这次我不弄明白绝不离开。

paras.en: “I NEED TO TALK TO YOU.” I burst into Agnarr’s study, not bothering to knock.
paras.zh: “我得跟你谈谈。”我闯进安格瑞的书房，连门都懒得敲。

paras.en: Agnarr looked up from behind the great oak desk, where he was going over his papers. “Can it wait?” he asked, looking a little stressed, which these days was nothing new. “No.” I shook my head, excitement coursing through me, mixed with quite a bit of fear. “It can’t.” To his credit, he set down his papers, then rose to his feet to face me. “What is it?” “Not here,” I said. “Meet me in the secret library.” I dashed out of the study and down the hall, not waiting for his reply.
paras.zh: 安格瑞从那张巨大的橡木书桌后抬起头，他正在审阅公文。“能等会儿吗？”他问，看起来有点紧绷——这年头也不稀奇了。“不行。”我摇头，兴奋在身体里奔流，夹杂着不少恐惧。“等不得。”难得的是，他放下公文，站起身面对我。“什么事？”“别在这儿，”我说，“到秘密书房见我。”我冲出书房跑下走廊，没等他回答。

paras.en: I’d been practically living in the secret library for weeks now, barely bothering to eat or sleep, never mind bathe.
paras.zh: 这几个星期我几乎住在了秘密书房，吃睡都顾不上，更别提洗澡。

paras.en: I probably looked like a castle ghost at this point.
paras.zh: 这会儿我大概像个城堡幽灵。

paras.en: Kai and Gerda were constantly asking me if I was all right.
paras.zh: 凯和格尔达总问我是不是还好。

paras.en: Encouraging me to get some rest.
paras.zh: 劝我休息。

paras.en: To eat.
paras.zh: 吃饭。

paras.en: But I couldn’t.
paras.zh: 可我做不到。

paras.en: Not until I found what I was looking for.
paras.zh: 直到找到我要找的东西。

paras.en: And now, maybe, I had.
paras.zh: 而现在，也许，我找到了。

paras.en: Maybe.
paras.zh: 也许吧。

paras.en: And now I had to share it with Agnarr.
paras.zh: 现在我得把它告诉安格瑞。

paras.en: I had to share everything.
paras.zh: 我得把一切都告诉他。

paras.en: It shouldn’t be so terrifying to talk openly with my own husband.
paras.zh: 和自己的丈夫开诚布公，本不该这么可怕。

paras.en: But it had been too long.
paras.zh: 可拖得太久了。

paras.en: There were too many secrets.
paras.zh: 秘密太多了。

paras.en: And I was fully aware that coming clean now might finally cause the house of cards we’d been building for years to topple over for good.
paras.zh: 而我完全清楚，此刻坦白，也许终于会让我们多年搭建的纸牌屋彻底倒塌。

paras.en: But I had no choice.
paras.zh: 可我别无选择。

paras.en: Elsa’s life depended on it.
paras.zh: 艾莎的命就系于此。

paras.en: I stepped into the library, still remembering that first day in the castle, when Agnarr had proudly showed it off to me.
paras.zh: 我走进图书馆，仍记得初到城堡那天，安格瑞骄傲地向我展示它的样子。

paras.en: I recalled my surprise as I looked up from floor to ceiling at the seemingly endless rows of books lining the shelves.
paras.zh: 我回想起自己从地板望到天花板，看着书架上似乎无穷无尽的一排排书时，那份惊讶。

paras.en: Before then, I’d only seen a few books in my life; most Northuldra stories came from song and oral tales.
paras.zh: 在那之前，我一生只见过的书寥寥无几；北地人的故事大多来自歌谣和口述。

paras.en: It had been quite a shock, back then, to see so much written down.
paras.zh: 那时看到这么多被写下来的东西，着实是一大冲击。

paras.en: But now I walked past the shelves, hardly noticing them as I headed directly to the back of the room, where the statue of the Water Nokk stood, guarding our secret chamber.
paras.zh: 可如今我走过书架，几乎没留意它们，径直走向房间后面——水马雕像立在那里，守着我们的密室。

paras.en: With a quick, practiced motion, I activated the door, and it opened with a loud creaking sound.
paras.zh: 我熟练地快速一动，启动了门，它吱呀一声大开。

paras.en: I stepped inside, with Agnarr on my heels.
paras.zh: 我走进去，安格瑞紧跟在身后。

paras.en: It was embarrassingly messy—a result of my desperate studies—and I paced the room nervously, sitting down one moment, standing the next.
paras.zh: 屋里乱得让人难为情——那是我拼命钻研的结果——我紧张地在屋里踱步，时而坐下，时而站起。

paras.en: After this conversation, everything would change.
paras.zh: 这次谈话之后，一切都会改变。

paras.en: Forever.
paras.zh: 永远。

paras.en: And I wasn’t sure I was ready for it.
paras.zh: 而我不确定自己是否准备好了。

paras.en: Agnarr joined me after closing the passageway door behind him.
paras.zh: 安格瑞关上身后的暗门，来到我身边。

paras.en: I thought back to all the time we’d spent here when we were young, hiding our love from the world.
paras.zh: 我想起年轻时我们在这里共度的时光，把爱向全世界藏起。

paras.en: Had my whole life just been a series of secrets, each more dangerous than the last?
paras.zh: 我的一生，难道只是一连串秘密，一个比一个危险？

paras.en: Was that why we were cursed now, by a secret so awful it was destroying my child’s very life?
paras.zh: 难道这就是为什么我们现在被诅咒——被一个如此可怕、正摧毁我孩子生命的秘密所诅咒？

paras.en: It’s a gift, not a curse, Conceal, don’t feel….
paras.zh: 这是天赋，不是诅咒；隐藏，别去感受……

paras.en: No.
paras.zh: 不。

paras.en: We were done with that.
paras.zh: 那一套我们受够了。

paras.en: I swallowed hard, turning to Agnarr. “There’s something I have to tell you,” I said, surprised at Agnarr stepped toward me, grasping my hands and pulling them to his chest.
paras.zh: 我硬咽一下，转向安格瑞。“有件事我必须告诉你，”我说，却惊讶地见安格瑞朝我走来，握住我的手按在他胸口。

paras.en: His eyes met mine.
paras.zh: 他的目光与我的相遇。

paras.en: His were troubled but focused. “I’m listening,” he said softly.
paras.zh: 他的眼神困惑却专注。“我在听。”他轻声说。

paras.en: It was more than I could take.
paras.zh: 这让我承受不住。

paras.en: Tears streamed down my cheeks like rain.
paras.zh: 泪水如雨般滑落脸颊。

paras.en: Agnarr pulled me into his arms, stroking my back with his hands.
paras.zh: 安格瑞把我搂进怀里，用手抚着我的背。

paras.en: Hands as gentle and strong as they’d always been.
paras.zh: 那双手一如往常，温柔而有力。

paras.en: I almost gave in right there—almost melted into his embrace and pushed down the truth for another day.
paras.zh: 我差点就在那儿屈服——差点融进他的怀抱，把真相再压下去一天。

paras.en: But in the end, I pulled away, angrily wiping at the tears.
paras.zh: 但最后我挣脱开，恼火地抹去眼泪。

paras.en: I couldn’t fall apart now.
paras.zh: 现在我不能崩溃。

paras.en: I had to get through this.
paras.zh: 我必须撑过去。

paras.en: For Elsa.
paras.zh: 为了艾莎。

paras.en: My sweet Elsa.
paras.zh: 我甜美的艾莎。

paras.en: And for Anna as well.
paras.zh: 也为了安娜。

paras.en: My two daughters.
paras.zh: 我的两个女儿。

paras.en: I had to be strong for them.
paras.zh: 为了她们我必须坚强。

paras.en: I had to tell the truth at last.
paras.zh: 我终于必须说出真相。

paras.en: Only, I didn’t know where to start.
paras.zh: 只是，我不知道从何说起。

paras.en: How would I even begin to explain?
paras.zh: 我又该怎么开口解释？

paras.en: But then a single moment rose to my consciousness, blooming in my heart.
paras.zh: 可随即，一个瞬间浮上心头，在我心底绽放。

paras.en: The first spark that had grown into this inferno. “That…day in the forest,” I managed to say. “The battle by the dam.” “Yes?” “The person who saved you.
paras.zh: 那粒长成如今这场烈火的第一颗火星。“那……森林里那天，”我好不容易说出，“水坝边的那场战斗。”“嗯？”“救你的人。

paras.en: That was…me.” His eyes widened.
paras.zh: 那是……我。”他的眼睛瞪大了。

paras.en: I could feel his hands trembling against my body, but he stood tall and still, only tightening his grip, not letting me go. “It was you?” he whispered, but I could see the recognition begin to dawn in his eyes. “It was I nodded, emotions flying through me too hard and fast to catalog. “Me,” I continued. “And my friend Gale, the Wind Spirit.” He stared at me, for a moment, not comprehending. “Wind spirit?
paras.zh: 我感到他的手在我身上发抖，可他站得高直而静止，只收紧了手，不放我走。“是你？”他轻声问，可我已看见了然的神色在他眼中浮现。“是——”我点头，情绪太猛太快，无从归整。“是我，”我继续，“还有我的朋友盖尔，风灵。”他盯着我，一时没懂。“风灵？

paras.en: But…” He dropped his hands to his sides.
paras.zh: 可是……”他把手垂到身侧。

paras.en: Fear thrummed in my heart as I searched his face.
paras.zh: 我望着他的脸，恐惧在心头跳动。

paras.en: There was no going back. “I am Northuldra,” I blurted out. “I was trapped outside the mist because I saved your life.
paras.zh: 已经无法回头了。“我是北地人，”我脱口而出，“因为救了你，我被困在迷雾之外。

paras.en: I was discovered in Arendelle and Peterssen felt bad for me and protected me, saying my Arendellian parents died in the fight.
paras.zh: 我在阿伦黛尔被发现，彼得森可怜我，保护了我，说我在那场战斗里失去了阿伦黛尔的父母。

paras.en: In truth, my parents were already dead.” My cheeks felt as if they were on fire as I stumbled on.
paras.zh: 其实，我的父母早已不在人世。”我磕磕绊绊地说着，脸颊像着了火。

paras.en: Agnarr staggered backward.
paras.zh: 安格瑞踉跄后退。

paras.en: But I had to get it all out there now if there was any chance to save Elsa. “I’m sorry,” I said simply. “I know people have kept secrets from you your entire life.
paras.zh: 可若要还有一丝救艾莎的机会，此刻我必须把一切倒出来。“对不起，”我简简单单地说，“我知道，你一生都有人瞒着你。

paras.en: The last thing I wanted was to be one of them.
paras.zh: 我最不愿成为他们中的一员。

paras.en: I wanted to tell you, Agnarr—so much.
paras.zh: 我多想告诉你，安格瑞——真的。

paras.en: I was going to right after the proposal.
paras.zh: 我本打算求婚之后立刻说。

paras.en: But that night, Peterssen told me to keep my secret close, for the good of Arendelle.
paras.zh: 可那晚，彼得森让我把秘密紧藏，为了阿伦黛尔好。

paras.en: I was told I would be responsible for Arendelle’s fall if people were to learn the truth.
paras.zh: 他们告诉我，若百姓知道真相，阿伦黛尔的衰亡要由我负责。

paras.en: And your fall, too.” My voice broke. “I was told you could lose everything—your crown, maybe even your life—if I revealed my secret.
paras.zh: 还有你的衰亡。”我的声音破了。“他们告诉我，若我泄露秘密，你可能会失去一切——你的王冠，甚至你的性命。

paras.en: And even when he said it, I knew it was true.” “What?” Agnarr’s face twisted. “But that’s not fair!
paras.zh: 而即便他这么说，我也知道那是真的。”“什么？”安格瑞的脸扭曲了。“可那不公平！

paras.en: You were just a girl!
paras.zh: 你当时只是个小姑娘！

paras.en: To force you to keep silent about who you are?
paras.zh: 逼你对自己的身份闭口不谈？

paras.en: To make you think your truth could take down a kingdom?” His anger on my behalf brought tears to my eyes.
paras.zh: 让你以为你的真相能拖垮一个王国？”他为我而发的怒火，让我眼里泛起泪。

paras.en: His willingness to put the blame on others—not me.
paras.zh: 他愿把责怪落到别人身上——而不是我。

paras.en: But though Peterssen had indeed pushed me to keep my secret safe, in the end it had been my decision to stay silent.
paras.zh: 可尽管彼得森确实逼我保守秘密，最终选择沉默的是我。

paras.en: Not out of shame of who I was.
paras.zh: 不是因为为自己是谁而羞耻。

paras.en: But out of fear.
paras.zh: 而是出于恐惧。

paras.en: Fear was the only true enemy.
paras.zh: 恐惧才是唯一真正的敌人。

paras.en: And it was still hurting us now. “I did what I thought I had to do,” I said. “I regret it now, but I cannot change it.
paras.zh: 而它现在仍在伤害我们。“我做了我认为必须做的事，”我说，“如今我后悔，却无法改变。

paras.en: I do believe Peterssen, for all his faults, was trying to protect Arendelle—the only way he knew how.” I gave a sour laugh. “And who could blame him?
paras.zh: 我确实相信，彼得森尽管有种种不是，却是在试图保护阿伦黛尔——用他所知的唯一方式。”我苦笑一声。“谁能怪他呢？

paras.en: It’s practically the castle’s motto, right? ‘Conceal, don’t feel’?” I paused, meeting his eyes with my own. “And before you judge Peterssen, haven’t we, ourselves, been guilty of demanding the same from Elsa?
paras.zh: 那简直是城堡的座右铭，对吧？‘隐藏，别去感受’？”我停顿，与他对视。“而在你评判彼得森之前，我们自己，难道不也曾要求艾莎做同样的事？

paras.en: Asking her to hide who she truly is?” Agnarr’s face went stark white.
paras.zh: 让她藏起真实的自己？”安格瑞的脸一下子惨白。

paras.en: I stood there, waiting for him to digest this truth.
paras.zh: 我站在那儿，等他消化这真相。

paras.en: I knew it was harsh—for he, like Peterssen, had only wanted to do the right thing.
paras.zh: 我知道这话刺耳——因为他和彼得森一样，只是想做正确的事。

paras.en: But sometimes even the best intentions can lead to disastrous ends. “My whole life I was told to hide,” I said after a pause. “I don’t want Elsa to have to grow up doing the same.” Agnarr bit his lower lip. “Do you…have magic?” he asked slowly. “Is that why…Elsa…?” “No.” I shook my head firmly. “Like the rest of the Northuldra, I lived in harmony with the spirits and used their gifts.
paras.zh: 但有时，再好的意图也会通向灾难的结局。“我的一生都被教导去隐藏，”我停顿后说，“我不愿艾莎也这样长大。”安格瑞咬着下唇。“你……有魔法吗？”他慢慢问，“所以……艾莎……？”“没有。”我坚定摇头，“和别的北地人一样，我与精灵和谐共处，借用他们的馈赠。

paras.en: But I have no magic running through my veins.
paras.zh: 可我血脉里没有任何魔法。

paras.en: I never have.
paras.zh: 从来没有。

paras.en: And yet…” I trailed off, not knowing how to continue.
paras.zh: 然而……”我顿住了，不知如何继续。

paras.en: He reached out, brushing my cheek with gentle fingers. “And yet?” he asked.
paras.zh: 他伸出手，用温柔的手指拂过我的脸颊。“然而？”他问。

paras.en: So calm, so quiet, considering the storm I’d stirred up with my truth.
paras.zh: 面对我用真相掀起的风暴，他是如此平静、如此安静。

paras.en: He had to be screaming inside.
paras.zh: 他内心一定在呐喊。

paras.en: But somehow, he didn’t look angry.
paras.zh: 可不知为何，他并不生气。

paras.en: And not because he was concealing it; I knew that look by now.
paras.zh: 也不是因为他藏着——这神情我如今认得。

paras.en: But rather because he wasn’t angry.
paras.zh: 而是因为他真的不生气。

paras.en: He was just sad.
paras.zh: 他只是难过。

paras.en: And not sad for himself, either.
paras.zh: 而且也不是为自己难过。

paras.en: But sad for me.
paras.zh: 而是为我难过。

paras.en: For all those years I’d suffered in silence.
paras.zh: 为我那些年沉默的煎熬。

paras.en: Sad for Elsa, too.
paras.zh: 也为艾莎难过。

paras.en: I pushed on, suddenly feeling brave. “I believe Elsa is a gift from the spirits,” I told him. “A daughter of Arendellian and Northuldra blood.
paras.zh: 我继续说，突然感到一股勇气。“我相信艾莎是精灵的恩赐，”我告诉他，“一个流着阿伦黛尔与北地人血液的女儿。

paras.en: A union of our people, born out of love instead of fear.
paras.zh: 我们两族的结合，生于爱而非恐惧。

paras.en: I believe Elsa was born with her powers for a reason.” For the longest time, Agnarr stood stock-still.
paras.zh: 我相信艾莎生来拥有力量，是有原因的。”很长一段时间，安格瑞一动不动地站着。

paras.en: Then he nodded slowly.
paras.zh: 然后他缓缓点头。

paras.en: I could tell he was struggling to take it in.
paras.zh: 我看得出他在努力消化。

paras.en: It was too much, far too much to lay on him all at once after so many years of keeping him in the dark.
paras.zh: 这太多了，在他被蒙在鼓里多年之后，一次性压给他，实在太多。

paras.en: I tried to imagine if the tables were turned, how I would feel if I learned everything he’d told me had been a lie.
paras.zh: 我试着想象，若位置对调，得知他告诉我的一切都是谎言，我会是什么感受。

paras.en: It wasn’t a comfortable thought.
paras.zh: 那可不是令人舒服的念头。

paras.en: But Agnarr, I realized, was strong.
paras.zh: 可我意识到，安格瑞是坚强的。

paras.en: His love for me was strong.
paras.zh: 他对我的爱是坚强的。

paras.en: I had never doubted that.
paras.zh: 这一点我从未怀疑。

paras.en: And I couldn’t doubt it now.
paras.zh: 此刻我也不能怀疑。

paras.en: Drawing in a breath, I dared to slip my hands back into his. “Look, Agnarr, you need to know.
paras.zh: 深吸一口气，我鼓起勇气把手重新滑进他的手里。“听着，安格瑞，你得知道。

paras.en: Though I may have hidden where I came from, I never once hid who I am.
paras.zh: 尽管我也许藏起了来处，却从未藏过我是谁。

paras.en: The girl you His hands tightened around mine. “I love you, too,” he said firmly, without doubt or hesitation. “And there is no need to hide anything anymore.
paras.zh: 那个你——”他的手收紧在我的手上。“我也爱你，”他坚定地说，没有疑虑、没有迟疑，“而且再也不必隐藏任何事了。

paras.en: From anyone—ever again.” He looked down at me, an expression on his face so earnest it made me think of the boy he once was. “And we’ll tell the girls, too.
paras.zh: 对任何人——永远不再。”他低头看我，脸上的神情如此真挚，让我想起当年的那个少年。“我们也会告诉姑娘们。

paras.en: They’re going to think it’s so great.
paras.zh: 她们会觉着特别棒。
