paras.en: Maybe you can even teach us some of the Northuldra traditions.
paras.zh: 说不定你还能教我们一些北地人的传统。

paras.en: Your songs, your stories.” He paused, a look of realization washing over his face. “Your crazy reindeer marriage proposal,” he added, as if it had just come to him. “Was that…?” My mouth spread in a bashful grin. “It was,” I confirmed. “After all, you had the Arendellian love spoon.
paras.zh: 你的歌，你的故事。”他顿住，脸上掠过恍然大悟的神情。“你那疯狂的驯鹿求婚，”他补了一句，像刚想起来，“那是……？”“我腼腆地咧嘴一笑。“就是它，”我确认，“毕竟，你已经有阿伦黛尔的爱情木勺了。

paras.en: If we were truly coming together, I wanted to include something from my family’s traditions, too.
paras.zh: 如果我们真要结合，我也想加上一些我家传统里的东西。

paras.en: However ridiculous that particular one might be,” I added with a small laugh. “I think the word you’re looking for is ‘amazing,’” he corrected me, looking down at me with so much love it took my breath away.
paras.zh: 不管那个传统有多荒唐。”我小声笑着补了一句。“我想你要找的词是‘了不起’，”他纠正我，低头看我，满眼的爱意让我屏息。

paras.en: He pulled me into an embrace and held me tight.
paras.zh: 他把我搂进怀里，紧紧抱着。

paras.en: Tears of sharp relief rolled down my cheeks as I cradled my head in his solid chest, listening to his heartbeat.
paras.zh: 如释重负的泪滚下我的脸颊，我把头靠在他坚实的胸膛，听着他的心跳。

paras.en: Strong, steady.
paras.zh: 有力，平稳。

paras.en: Just like Agnarr himself.
paras.zh: 就像安格瑞本人。

paras.en: For a moment, we just stood there, wrapped in one another’s arms in the tiny secret room just off the library.
paras.zh: 有那么一刻，我们就那样站着，在图书馆旁这小小的密室里相拥。

paras.en: How many times had we been here before?
paras.zh: 从前我们来过这里多少次？

paras.en: How many kisses had been shared?
paras.zh: 分享过多少吻？

paras.en: Declarations of love made?
paras.zh: 许下过多少爱的誓言？

paras.en: But this time felt different.
paras.zh: 可这次感觉不同。

paras.en: For now he knew the truth.
paras.zh: 因为此刻他知道真相了。

paras.en: And all the guilt and fear I’d pushed down deep inside was finally gone.
paras.zh: 而所有被我深压心底的愧疚与恐惧，终于消散。

paras.en: For the first time in forever, I was free.
paras.zh: 我有生以来第一次，自由了。

paras.en: But we still had to talk about Elsa.
paras.zh: 可我们仍得谈谈艾莎。

paras.en: Agnarr cleared his throat. “You said you think Elsa was a gift from the spirits,” he said slowly. “And you also said since you’re Northuldra, you know the spirits.
paras.zh: 安格瑞清了清嗓子。“你说你认为艾莎是精灵的恩赐，”他慢慢说，“你还说，既然你是北地人，你认识精灵。

paras.en: Can you…maybe…ask them I practically gasped.
paras.zh: 你……也许能……问问他们——”我几乎倒吸一口气。

paras.en: In all the emotion of telling him, I’d almost forgotten why I’d started to do so. “The spirits are still locked away in the mist,” I explained. “At least as far as I can tell.
paras.zh: 在倾诉的种种情绪里，我几乎忘了自己当初为何要讲。“精灵仍被锁在迷雾里，”我解释，“至少据我所知。

paras.en: I have not been able to talk to them for years.
paras.zh: 我已有多年没能和他们对话。

paras.en: I thought once they might have come, when I was out in the blizzard the day I left Arendelle.
paras.zh: 我以为他们或许来过一次，就是我离开阿伦黛尔那天，我在暴风雪里的那次。

paras.en: But it must have been a hallucination.
paras.zh: 可那准是幻觉。

paras.en: For I have called them every day since and they have never returned.” “I see,” Agnarr said, his face ashen, the hope gone.
paras.zh: 因为自从那以后，我每天都呼唤他们，他们却从未回来。”“我明白了，”安格瑞说，脸色灰白，希望消失了。

paras.en: I drew in a breath. “However, there is still…something…that might be out there.
paras.zh: 我吸了口气。“不过，还是有……什么……可能还在外面。

paras.en: Who might be able to give us the answers we seek.” His head cocked in question. “Ahtohallan,” I explained. “My mother used to sing me a song about her when I was small.
paras.zh: 能给我们寻求的答案。”他偏头疑问。“阿托哈兰，”我解释，“我小的时候，母亲常唱一首关于她的歌给我听。

paras.en: It’s a Northuldra song about a spirit—the mother of all the other spirits—who knows everything about the past.
paras.zh: 那是首北地人的歌，关于一位精灵——所有其他精灵之母——她知晓关于过去的一切。

paras.en: A river of memories.
paras.zh: 一条记忆之河。

paras.en: I always thought if I could only find her, she could provide answers about Elsa and what we are a part of.” “Well, then let’s find Ahtohallan,” Agnarr declared, his voice fierce.
paras.zh: 我一直想，只要能找到她，她就能解答艾莎的事，以及我们身属何物。”“那好，我们去找阿托哈兰。”安格瑞斩钉截铁地宣布。

paras.en: I always loved when he decided on a plan of action.
paras.zh: 我向来爱他下定决心的样子。

paras.en: He committed fully and immediately, no matter the challenges.
paras.zh: 他一旦决定便全情投入、立刻行动，无论有多少挑战。

paras.en: I reached down and pulled the old, faded map off the table. “I think I already have,” I said slowly. “That’s why I’ve been in here every day.
paras.zh: 我伸手从桌上拿起那张老旧褪色的地图。“我想我已经找到了，”我慢慢说，“这就是我每天待在这里的原因。

paras.en: Puzzling over all these maps.
paras.zh: 对着所有这些地图苦苦琢磨。

paras.en: The song says, ‘Where the north wind meets the sea,’ but I could never find a river there that fit that description.
paras.zh: 歌里唱‘北风与海相遇之处’，可我始终找不到一条符合这描述的河。

paras.en: Until now.” I placed my finger over the dark block on the top of the map. “Ahtohallan,” I declared. “But that’s not a river.” “No.” My eyes shone as I looked up at him. “It’s a glacier.
paras.zh: 直到现在。”我把手指按在地图顶端的暗色方块上。“阿托哈兰，”我宣布，“可那不是河。”“不是。”我抬头看他，眼睛发亮，“那是一座冰川。

paras.en: Glaciers are rivers of ice.” “Ahtohallan is…frozen?” he asked, eyes wide.
paras.zh: 冰川是冰的河流。”“阿托哈兰是……冻住的？”他睁大眼睛问。

paras.en: I shrugged. “It’s the only thing that makes sense.” He stared down at the map.
paras.zh: 我耸耸肩。“这是唯一说得通的解释。”他低头盯着地图。

paras.en: I could practically see the gears “I think so,” I said, my voice hardly more than a whisper. “It’s worth a try, right?” “Yes,” he said.
paras.zh: 我几乎能看到齿轮转动。“我想是吧，”我说，声音细若耳语，“值得一试，对吧？”“是的，”他说。

paras.en: And I was relieved to hear not a drop of doubt his voice. “I would go to the ends of the earth to help her.” My shoulders slumped in relief.
paras.zh: 听他声音里没有一丝怀疑，我松了口气。“为了帮她，我愿走遍天涯海角。”我肩膀一松，如释重负。

paras.en: Hope rose in my chest.
paras.zh: 希望在我胸口升起。

paras.en: Agnarr rolled up the map. “We will travel there.
paras.zh: 安格瑞卷起地图。“我们要去那里。

paras.en: As soon as it can be arranged.” He gave me a hesitant smile. “One last, last adventure.
paras.zh: 一安排好就去。”他朝我迟疑地一笑。“最后一次，最后的冒险。

paras.en: You and me.”
paras.zh: 你和我。

paras.en: “DO YOU HAVE TO GO?” Things had moved quickly from the night I had told Agnarr the truth in our secret room.
paras.zh: “你非去不可吗？”自从那晚我在密室里把真相告诉安格瑞，事情进展得很快。

paras.en: Our story was simple: we were going on a two-week trip, to attend the wedding of a faraway princess by route of the Southern Sea.
paras.zh: 我们的说辞很简单：我们要去两周的旅行，取道南海，去参加一位远方公主的婚礼。

paras.en: We would trust only the captain of the ship and his skeleton crew with the truth—and even then, not until after we’d set sail.
paras.zh: 我们只把真相告诉船长和他那几个骨干船员——而且还要等开船之后。

paras.en: No one wanted us to go, of course, the seas being notoriously dangerous at this time of year.
paras.zh: 当然没人想让我们去，这个时节的海向来凶险出名。

paras.en: But no one was more adamant about this than Elsa. “You’ll be fine, Elsa,” Agnarr said to her sympathetically.
paras.zh: 可没人比艾莎更坚决反对。“你会没事的，艾莎，”安格瑞同情地对她说。

paras.en: I knew he was trying to build up her confidence, but it ended up sounding a little patronizing.
paras.zh: 我知道他想给她打气，可听起来倒有点居高临下。

paras.en: I could see her chin wobble.
paras.zh: 我能看见她下巴在抖。

paras.en: Her lips tremble.
paras.zh: 嘴唇在颤。

paras.en: I could practically hear the thoughts whirling through her head.
paras.zh: 我几乎能听见她脑中打转的念头。

paras.en: Conceal, don’t feel.
paras.zh: 隐藏，别去感受。

paras.en: Ignoring the danger of my daughter’s emotions, I grabbed her in a tight hug. “We will be back soon,” I promised her. “You’ll barely notice we’re gone.” And if all works out, you’ll never have to conceal your She was stiff in my arms, and when I released her, she looked a hair’s breadth from breaking down in tears.
paras.zh: 顾不上女儿情绪的危险，我紧紧抱住她。“我们很快回来，”我向她保证，“你几乎注意不到我们走了。”如果一切顺利，你就再不必隐藏——”她在我的臂弯里僵硬着，我放开她时，她眼看就要崩溃落泪。

paras.en: My heart tore and suddenly it was all I could do not to back down, beg to stay home.
paras.zh: 我的心被撕扯着，有那么一刻，我几乎要退缩、求着留在家里。

paras.en: Send Agnarr alone on our quest so I didn’t have to leave my baby girl behind.
paras.zh: 让安格瑞独自踏上这趟寻找，这样我就不必丢下我的小姑娘。

paras.en: Elsa had no one but us, not even her sister.
paras.zh: 艾莎除了我们谁也没有，连姐姐都没有。

paras.en: She would be truly alone.
paras.zh: 她会真的孤身一人。

paras.en: But I had to stay strong.
paras.zh: 可我必须坚强。

paras.en: We needed answers.
paras.zh: 我们需要答案。

paras.en: And this was the only way to find them.
paras.zh: 而这是找到答案的唯一办法。

paras.en: To help Elsa once and for all. “Come on,” Agnarr said firmly, placing a hand at the small of my back and leading me away.
paras.zh: 一劳永逸地帮到艾莎。“走吧，”安格瑞坚定地说，把手放在我后腰，领我离开。

paras.en: I went with him, almost reaching the front door before I turned around again for one last look.
paras.zh: 我跟着他，几乎走到前门，才又转身最后看了一眼。

paras.en: Elsa stood there alone.
paras.zh: 艾莎独自站在那里。

paras.en: Her shoulders pushed back.
paras.zh: 肩膀绷直。

paras.en: Her head held high.
paras.zh: 昂着头。

paras.en: Trying so desperately to be brave.
paras.zh: 拼命想显得勇敢。

paras.en: And suddenly my mind flashed back to that day I’d first arrived in Arendelle so long ago.
paras.zh: 突然，我的思绪闪回多年前初到阿伦黛尔那天。

paras.en: I had stood there, too, at the entrance of the orphanage, alone in a new world filled only with strangers.
paras.zh: 那时我也曾那样站着，在孤儿院门口，孤身一人处在只有陌生人的新世界。

paras.en: I still remembered how badly I wanted to give up at that moment.
paras.zh: 我仍记得那一刻我多想放弃。

paras.en: To crumble and fall apart and let it all go.
paras.zh: 想崩溃、想垮掉、想让一切随风而去。

paras.en: But instead I managed to hold my head high.
paras.zh: 可我最终抬起头挺住了。

paras.en: To force myself to go on, even when all seemed lost.
paras.zh: 逼自己继续前行，即便一切看似已失。

paras.en: And I had.
paras.zh: 而我做到了。

paras.en: I’d built a life here in Arendelle.
paras.zh: 我在这里，在阿伦黛尔，建起了一份生活。

paras.en: I’d found friends.
paras.zh: 我找到了朋友。

paras.en: Built a family with my true love.
paras.zh: 与真爱建起了一个家。

paras.en: A beautiful life, blooming out of ashes.
paras.zh: 一段从灰烬中绽放的美丽人生。

paras.en: It hadn’t always been easy, but I wouldn’t change it for the world.
paras.zh: 它并非总是一帆风顺，可我无论如何也不愿换掉它。

paras.en: And Elsa would find her way, too, I told myself as the lump formed in my throat again.
paras.zh: 而艾莎也会找到自己的路，我告诉自己，喉头又涌起硬块。

paras.en: For all her pain, she was stronger than anyone I knew.
paras.zh: 尽管痛苦，她比我认识的任何人都坚强。

paras.en: Far stronger than I had ever been.
paras.zh: 远胜过当年的我。

paras.en: And no matter what happened, she would find a way to keep going.
paras.zh: 无论发生什么，她都会找到继续走下去的办法。

paras.en: To forge a path into the unknown.
paras.zh: 去开辟一条通往未知的路。

paras.en: A little while later we were at the harbor, crossing the gangplank and boarding the ship.
paras.zh: 过了一会儿，我们到了港口，走过跳板，登上船。

paras.en: Everything in me cried out to turn around, to run back to the shelter of the castle, to my daughters.
paras.zh: 我整个人都在呐喊着要转身，跑回城堡的庇护所，回到女儿们身边。

paras.en: But this was Elsa’s one hope.
paras.zh: 可这是艾莎唯一的希望。

paras.en: I had to be brave.
paras.zh: 我必须勇敢。

paras.en: I had to do this.
paras.zh: 我必须这么做。

paras.en: For her.
paras.zh: 为了她。

paras.en: I just hoped it wouldn’t all be in vain.
paras.zh: 我只希望这一切不会白费。

paras.en: THE WIND PICKS UP AGAIN, SENDING A FIERCE swell slamming into the side of our ship, nearly causing me to fall out of bed.
paras.zh: 风又起了，一股猛浪狠狠撞在船舷上，差点把我从床上掀下去。

paras.en: My vision is blurry and it takes me a moment to realize why.
paras.zh: 我的视线模糊，过了一会儿才明白为何。

paras.en: Then it hits me.
paras.zh: 然后我猛然醒悟。

paras.en: I’m crying.
paras.zh: 我在哭。

paras.en: I’m sobbing, actually.
paras.zh: 其实，我在抽泣。

paras.en: I turn to Agnarr, reaching for his hands.
paras.zh: 我转向安格瑞，去握他的手。

paras.en: He clasps them in his own, his face troubled, trying to take it all in.
paras.zh: 他用自己的手攥住我的，脸上写满忧虑，努力消化着一切。

paras.en: I would give anything to know his thoughts.
paras.zh: 我愿付出一切，只想知道他在想什么。

paras.en: Everything has happened so fast.
paras.zh: 一切都发生得太快。

paras.en: We haven’t had a chance to really talk until now. “I’m sorry for not telling you everything from the start,” I say, my voice barely audible over the raging storm.
paras.zh: 直到现在，我们才有机真正谈谈。“很抱歉从一开始就没能把一切告诉你，”我说，声音在狂暴的风暴里几乎听不清。

paras.en: Agnarr pushes back the bedcovers, rises to his feet.
paras.zh: 安格瑞掀开被子，站起身。

paras.en: His eyes meet mine and I am surprised to see the fierceness they reflect. “Don’t apologize again,” he said. “You did what you needed to do to survive.
paras.zh: 他的目光与我的相遇，我惊讶地看到那里面映出的决绝。“别再道歉了，”他说，“你做了为求生必须做的事。

paras.en: And because of it, I got to spend my life by your side.
paras.zh: 也正因为如此，我才得以一生伴你左右。

paras.en: There is no other life on earth I would have rather lived.” I don’t like the past tense he’s already started to use.
paras.zh: 这世上没有另一种人生我更愿度过。”我不喜欢他已经用上的过去时态。

paras.en: But I know in my heart he’s not wrong.
paras.zh: 可我心里知道，他没错。

paras.en: The storm is raging, growing worse with every passing moment.
paras.zh: 风暴在咆哮，每过一刻都更猛烈。

paras.en: Whatever I want to say, it But I love you “I love you, too,” he murmurs. “So much.” He pulls me into his arms. “And I promise you, there’s no secret in the world big enough to tear that love apart.” I lean against him, absorbing his strength.
paras.zh: 无论我想说什么，它——可我爱你——“我也爱你，”他低语，“非常爱。”他把我搂进怀里。“我向你保证，这世上没有哪个秘密大到能拆散那份爱。”我靠着他，汲取他的力量。

paras.en: He is as warm and strong as always.
paras.zh: 他一如往常，温暖而有力。

paras.en: But still, I’m not at peace. “Our girls,” I murmur. “What will they do?” When we’re gone, “They will do what they will have to do,” Agnarr says gently. “As we once did.” I know he’s right.
paras.zh: 可我仍无法平静。“我们的姑娘们，”我低语，“她们会怎样？”当我们不在了——“她们会做必须做的事，”安格瑞温柔地说，“正如我们当年。”我知道他是对的。

paras.en: But I don’t want to accept it.
paras.zh: 可我不想接受。

paras.en: I don’t want my daughters suffering, all alone. “At least they have each other,” Agnarr reminds me. “They don’t “We did what we thought was best,” Agnarr says firmly. “For our children.
paras.zh: 我不愿我的女儿们孤零零受苦。“至少她们还有彼此，”安格瑞提醒我，“她们不——”我们做了自认为最好的事，”安格瑞坚定地说，“为了我们的孩子。

paras.en: Only time will tell if it was right or wrong.
paras.zh: 是对是错，只有时间能证明。

paras.en: But I have faith in them.
paras.zh: 可我对她们有信心。

paras.en: They are young.
paras.zh: 她们还年轻。

paras.en: But they are already so strong.
paras.zh: 却已经如此坚强。

paras.en: And if anyone can help Elsa, it’s Anna.” He smiles softly. “There’s not much that girl can’t do.” “You’re right about that,” I reply, shaking my head as I think lovingly about my youngest daughter. “Her love could hold up the world.” Agnarr nods. “When the time comes, I truly believe they will do the right thing.” “For Arendelle?” “No.” He shakes his head. “For each other.” The thought about breaks me.
paras.zh: 而若说谁能帮到艾莎，那就是安娜。”他温柔地笑。“那姑娘没几样做不来的。”“这点你说对了，”我答，摇着头，满心爱意地想着小女儿，“她的爱能撑起整个世界。”安格瑞点头。“到时候，我真心相信她们会做对的事。”“为了阿伦黛尔？”“不。”他摇头，“为了彼此。”这个念头几乎把我击垮。

paras.en: My mind flashes to Elsa, standing at the bottom of the stairs, fear running through her eyes.
paras.zh: 我的思绪闪向艾莎，她站在楼梯底端，眼里淌着恐惧。

paras.en: I think of Anna, waiting endlessly, hopefully, at her sister’s bedroom door.
paras.zh: 我想起安娜，在姐姐卧室门外无尽地、满怀希望地等待。

paras.en: Will they ever have the chance to become the sisters they once were, before we tore them apart?
paras.zh: 她们还有机会变回我们拆散之前、曾经的那对姐妹吗？

paras.en: And could it be possible that someday they will find happiness and love as Agnarr and I I can’t bear the thoughts swirling through my head any longer.
paras.zh: 而是否有一天，她们也能像安格瑞和我一样，找到幸福与爱——我再也承受不住脑中盘旋的念头。

paras.en: I walk to the door and start up the stairs to the top deck of the ship.
paras.zh: 我走向门，踏上楼梯，去往船的顶层甲板。

paras.en: I won’t spend what may be my last minutes below deck—all darkness and stale air.
paras.zh: 我不要可能在甲板下度过我的最后几分钟——全是黑暗和浊气。

paras.en: I am Northuldra.
paras.zh: 我是北地人。

paras.en: We are the people of the sun.
paras.zh: 我们是太阳之子。

paras.en: I may never see another sunrise.
paras.zh: 我也许再也见不到下一次日出。

paras.en: But I refuse to die in the darkness.
paras.zh: 可我拒绝在黑暗中死去。

paras.en: I hear Agnarr follow me on the stairs and am relieved.
paras.zh: 我听见安格瑞跟上楼梯，松了口气。

paras.en: I’d never force him to follow me.
paras.zh: 我绝不会逼他跟来。

paras.en: But I am glad he has chosen to.
paras.zh: 可我很高兴他选择了跟来。

paras.en: I step out onto the deck.
paras.zh: 我走出到甲板上。

paras.en: The ship is rocking furiously and I have to grab on to a mast to keep upright.
paras.zh: 船剧烈颠簸，我得抓住桅杆才站得稳。

paras.en: Sailors are running half-heartedly, checking the sails, but I can tell from their faces they’ve already lost hope.
paras.zh: 水手们有气无力地跑动，查看船帆，可我从他们脸上看出，他们已经放弃了希望。

paras.en: The end is coming.
paras.zh: 末日将近。

paras.en: There will be no last-minute salvation.
paras.zh: 不会有最后一刻的救赎。

paras.en: And if all we have left is this moment, I don’t want to waste it.
paras.zh: 如果我们只剩这一刻，我不想浪费它。

paras.en: I walk to the side of the boat, staring down into the angry sea.
paras.zh: 我走到船边，俯视那愤怒的海。

paras.en: The waves are huge and the water is swirling in immense, twisting shapes.
paras.zh: 浪头极高，海水打着巨大的旋涡，扭曲成形。

paras.en: It makes me think of the Water Nokk—the Water Spirit from my childhood long ago.
paras.zh: 这让我想起水马——很久以前我童年时的水灵。

paras.en: A sharp pain of regret stabs at my stomach.
paras.zh: 一阵尖锐的悔痛刺进胃里。

paras.en: I never did get back home.
paras.zh: 我始终没能回到家乡。

paras.en: I stare down at the water, my vision blurry from the driving rain.
paras.zh: 我低头望着水，视线被疾雨打得模糊。

paras.en: To my surprise, a wavering image seems to float up from the depths of the sea.
paras.zh: 出乎我意料，一个摇晃的影像似乎从深海浮起。

paras.en: A girl, laughing and dancing in the wind.
paras.zh: 一个女孩，在风里笑着、跳着。

paras.en: Is it me?
paras.zh: 是我吗？

paras.en: But no…it looks more like… I turn and ask Agnarr, “Are you seeing this?” But he’s gone off to confer with the captain.
paras.zh: 可不……它更像——我转头问安格瑞：“你看见了吗？”可他已走开去和船长商议。

paras.en: I turn back to the water, desperate for another look.
paras.zh: 我转回水面，急切想再看一眼。

paras.en: But the girl is now gone, too.
paras.zh: 可那女孩现在也不见了。

paras.en: In her place stand two women.
paras.zh: 取而代之的，是两位女子。

paras.en: One dressed in a glowing white gown with white-blond hair tumbling down her back.
paras.zh: 一位身着发光白裙，白金色的头发垂落背后。

paras.en: The other—a redhead—clothed in rich greens and blacks and purples, with a familiar-looking crown atop her head.
paras.zh: 另一位——红发——身着华丽的绿、黑、紫，头上戴着一顶眼熟的王冠。

paras.en: Both women are smiling.
paras.zh: 两位女子都在微笑。

paras.en: Smiling at each other.
paras.zh: 相视而笑。

paras.en: My breath hitches.
paras.zh: 我屏住了呼吸。

paras.en: Tears well in my eyes.
paras.zh: 泪涌上眼眶。

paras.en: Could it be?
paras.zh: 会是她们吗？

paras.en: Could Only Ahtohallan knows The waters churn again and the vision vanishes.
paras.zh: 会是——只有阿托哈兰知道——海水再次翻腾，幻象消失了。

paras.en: I cry out in alarm, causing Agnarr to rush to my side. “What is it?” he asks urgently.
paras.zh: 我惊呼一声，安格瑞急忙冲到我身边。“怎么了？”他急切地问。

paras.en: I shake my head. “Nothing,” I say. “I just…I thought I saw something in the water.” Was it a vision from Ahtohallan?
paras.zh: 我摇摇头。“没什么，”我说，“我只是……好像在水里看见了什么。”那是阿托哈兰的幻象吗？

paras.en: Or simply a mother’s heartfelt wish on a wave?
paras.zh: 还是只是一个母亲在浪尖上的衷心期盼？

paras.en: I will never know for certain.
paras.zh: 我永远无法确定。

paras.en: But still, I draw that image of my beautiful girls deep into my soul.
paras.zh: 可我仍将那两个美丽女儿的影像，深深刻进灵魂。

paras.en: Their wide smiles.
paras.zh: 她们灿烂的笑容。

paras.en: The joyous looks in their eyes.
paras.zh: 她们眼中喜悦的神情。

paras.en: It seems an impossible future.
paras.zh: 那似乎是个不可能的未来。

paras.en: And yet… Why couldn’t it be?
paras.zh: 然而……为何不能呢？

paras.en: They are strong; they are smart.
paras.zh: 她们坚强；她们聪明。

paras.en: They will be able to shape their own destinies.
paras.zh: 她们能塑造自己的命运。

paras.en: Make their ways as Agnarr and I once did.
paras.zh: 像安格瑞和我当年那样，走出自己的路。

paras.en: Find their own happily ever afters.
paras.zh: 找到各自的幸福结局。

paras.en: I just hope they find them together.
paras.zh: 我只希望她们能一起找到。

paras.en: Agnarr puts his arms around me.
paras.zh: 安格瑞张开双臂搂住我。

paras.en: I cuddle in close to him, feeling a strange sense of peace wash over me at last as the sea rages on.
paras.zh: 我依偎向他，在怒海翻腾中，终于感到一种奇异的平静漫过心头。

paras.en: We won’t survive this night.
paras.zh: 我们挨不过今夜。

paras.en: But it doesn’t matter in the end.
paras.zh: 可说到底，那不重要。

paras.en: For our love has created a legacy.
paras.zh: 因为我们的爱已铸成一份遗产。

paras.en: A true magic all its own that will live on in our daughters.
paras.zh: 一种独属其身的真正魔法，将活在我们的女儿们身上。

paras.en: And hopefully their daughters and sons.
paras.zh: 但愿还有她们的女儿和儿子。

paras.en: Arendelle and Northuldra, united again and again, in every heartbeat to come.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔与北地人，在一次次心跳里，一遍遍重归一体。

paras.en: I lift my face to the wind.
paras.zh: 我仰起脸迎向风。

paras.en: My voice rises in song. “Ah ah ah ah…”
paras.zh: 我的声音随歌声扬起。“啊——啊——啊——啊……”
